target_text: **Li Yun** (courtesy name Xingzu) was from Ganling County. He was learned in yin-yang and became magistrate of Baima County. In Emperor Huan's second year of Yanxi, after Liang Ji was executed, Shan Chao and others were made marquises, and a popular woman became queen. Disasters struck, and Li Yun submitted a memorial criticizing the emperor's rewards and the disorder of official positions. The emperor became furious and ordered Li Yun's arrest. Du Zhong and Chen Fan pleaded for him, but Li Yun died in prison.

input_text: 曷其绞讦摩上，以沽成名哉？ 李云草茅之生，不识失身之义，遂乃露布帝者，班檄三公，至于诛死而不顾，斯岂古之狂也！ 夫未信而谏，则以为谤己，故说者识其难焉。 刘瑜字季节，广陵人也。 高祖父广陵靖王。 父辩，清河太守。 瑜少好经学，尤善图谶、天文、历算之术。州郡礼请不就。 延熹八年，太尉杨秉举贤良方正，及到京师，上书陈事曰：臣瑜自念东国鄙陋，得以丰沛枝胤，被蒙复除，不给卒伍。 故太尉杨秉知臣窃窥典籍，猥见显举，诚冀臣愚直，有补万一。 而秉忠谟不遂，命先朝露。 臣在下土，听闻歌谣，骄臣虐政之事，远近呼嗟之音，窃为辛楚，泣血涟如。 幸得引录，备答圣问，泄写至情，不敢庸回。
target_text: **Liu Yu** (courtesy name Jiji) was from Guangling, descendant of King Jing of Guangling. He was skilled in astronomy and mathematics. In Yanxi's eighth year, Taiwei Yang Bing recommended him as virtuous and upright. He submitted a memorial criticizing eunuchs for creating offspring to inherit titles, the harem's excess, and the people's suffering. He advised the emperor to open the path of remonstrance. When General Dou Wu failed to kill the eunuchs, Liu Yu was killed.

input_text: 今之四公，唯司空刘宠断断守善，余皆素餐致寇之人，必有折足覆餗之凶。 可因灾异，并加罢黜。 征故司空王暢，长乐少府李膺，并居政事，庶灾变可消，国祚惟永。 臣山薮顽暗，未达国典。策曰 无有所隐 ，敢不尽愚，用忘讳忌。 伏惟陛下裁其诛罚。 左右恶其言，出为广陵府丞。 去官归家。 中常侍曹节从子绍为东郡太守，忿疾于弼，遂以它罪收考掠按，死狱中，时人悼伤焉。 初平二年，司隶校尉赵廉讼弼忠节，求报其怨魂，乃收绍斩之。
target_text: **Xie Bi** (courtesy name Fuxuan) was from Wuyang County, Dongjun. In Jianning's second year, he was recruited as a doctor. When a green snake appeared and strong winds blew, Xie Bi submitted a secret report blaming the emperor's weakness, the Queen Mother's imprisonment, and the execution of Chen Fan. He recommended recruiting Wang Chang and Li Ying. The emperor's attendants sent him to be prime minister of Guangling. He later resigned. Cao Shao, nephew of eunuch Cao Jie, hated Xie Bi and had him tortured to death in prison. In Chuping's second year, Zhao Qian avenged Xie Bi by arresting and killing Cao Shao.

input_text: 杨终字子山，蜀郡成都人也。 年十三，为郡小吏，太守奇其才，遣诣京师受业，习《春秋》，显宗时，征诣兰台，拜校书郎。 建初元年，大旱谷贵，终以为广陵、楚、淮阳、济南之狱，徙者万数，又远屯绝域，吏民怨旷，乃上疏曰：臣闻 善善及子孙，恶恶止其身 ，百王常典，不易之道也。 秦政酷烈，违忤天心，一人有罪，延及三族。 高祖平乱，约法三章。 太宗至仁，除去收孥。 万姓廓然，蒙被更生，泽及昆虫，功垂万世。 陛下圣明，德被四表。 今以比年久旱，灾疫未息，躬自菲薄，广访失得，三代之隆，无以加焉。 臣窃桉《春秋》水旱之变，皆应暴急，惠不下流。
target_text: **Yang Zhong** (courtesy name Zishan), from Chengdu, Shu County, became a county official at thirteen. The prefect, impressed by his talent, sent him to study the *Spring and Autumn Annals* in the capital. During Emperor Xianzong's reign, he served at Lantai as school secretary. In the first year of Jianchu, during a severe drought and high grain prices, Yang Zhong submitted a memorial arguing that excessive imprisonment and military settlements in remote areas caused widespread suffering. He cited historical precedents, including the Qin dynasty's harsh policies and Emperor Gaozu's reforms, urging the emperor to show mercy. When officials debated his proposals, Yang Zhong defended his position by referencing historical examples of wise rulers who changed harmful policies. The emperor eventually accepted his advice, recalling exiles and ending border settlements. Yang Zhong also advocated for scholarly examinations following the Shiqu Pavilion model, leading to the Baihu Temple conference. Despite imprisonment, he was pardoned and participated. He later edited the *Tai Shi Gong Shu* and wrote on the *Spring and Autumn Annals*. He died in the twelfth year of Yongyuan.

input_text: 李法字伯度，汉中南郑人也。 博通群书，性刚而有节。 和帝永元九年，应贤艮方正对策。除博士，迁侍中、光禄大夫。 岁余，上疏以为朝政苛碎，违永平、建初故事；宦官权重，椒房宠盛，又讥史官记事不实，后世有识，寻功计德，必不明信。 坐失旨，下有司，免为庶人，还乡里，杜门自守。 故人儒生时有侯之者，言谈之次，问其不合上意之由，法未尝应对。 友人固问之，法曰： 鄙夫可与事君乎哉？ 敬患失之，无所不至。 孟子有言： 夫仁者如射，正己而后发。 发而不中，不怨胜己者，反诸身而已矣。 在家八年，征拜议郎、谏议大夫，正言极辞，无改于旧。 出为汝南太守，政有声迹。 后归乡里，卒于家。 翟酺字子超，广汉雒人也。 四世传《诗》。
target_text: **Li Fa** (courtesy name Bodu), from Nanzheng, Hanzhong, was well-read and upright. In the ninth year of Emperor Yongyuan's reign, he became a doctor and later Shizhong and Guanglu doctor. He criticized harsh government policies, excessive eunuch power, and favoritism toward concubines, which led to his removal from office. He returned home and lived in seclusion for eight years, refusing to discuss politics with friends. He later served as Yilang and admonished officials, maintaining his principles. As governor of Runan, he achieved political success before returning home and dying.

input_text: 酺好《老子》，尤善图纬、天文、历算。 以报舅仇，当徙日南，亡于长安，为卜相工，后牧羊凉州。 遇赦还。 仕郡，征拜议郎，迁侍中。 时，尚书有缺，诏将大夫六百石以上试对政事、天文、道术，以高第者补之。 自恃能高，而忌故太史令孙懿，恐其先用，乃往侯懿。 既坐，言无所及，唯涕泣流连。 懿怪而问之，酺曰： 图书有汉贼孙登，将以才智为中官所害。观君表相，似当应之。 酺受恩接，凄怆君之祸耳！ 懿忧惧，移病不试。 由是酺对第一，拜尚书。 时，安帝始亲政事，追感祖母宋贵人，悉封其家。 又元舅耿宝及皇后兄弟阎显等并用威权。酺上疏谏曰：臣闻微子佯狂而去殷，叔孙通背秦而归汉，彼非自疏其君，时不可也。
target_text: **Zhai Youfu** (courtesy name Zichao), from Luo, Guanghan, was skilled in the *Book of Songs*, *Laozi*, astronomy, and calendar calculation. After avenging his uncle, he fled to Chang'an, worked as a fortune teller, and later shepherded sheep in Liangzhou. He eventually became a court official. When a vacancy arose, he manipulated the examination process out of fear of competition. He submitted a memorial criticizing the emperor for granting excessive power to relatives and eunuchs, warning of historical disasters from such practices. He advocated for frugality and wise counsel. His memorial was ignored, and he became feared by the emperor's favorites. As prefect of Jiuquan, he defeated Qiang rebels, beheading 900. He later served as Jing Zhaoyin and Guanglu doctor. He was falsely accused, imprisoned, and eventually cleared. He wrote twelve chapters on classical texts and advocated for restoring the Imperial Academy, which the emperor approved.

input_text: 延熹中，武陵蛮复寇乱荆州，车骑将军冯绲以奉有威恩，为蛮夷所服，上请与俱征。 拜从事中郎。 奉勤设方略，贼破军罢，绲推功于奉，荐为司隶校尉。 纠举奸违，不避豪威，以严厉为名。 及邓皇后败，而田贵人见幸，桓帝有建立之议。 奉以田氏微贱，不宜超登后位，上书谏曰： 臣闻周纳狄女，襄王出居于郑；汉立飞燕，成帝胤嗣泯绝。 母后之重，兴废所因。 宜思《关雎》之所求，远五禁之所忌。 帝纳其言，竟立窦皇后。 及党事起，奉乃慨然以疾自退。 追愍屈原，因以自伤，著《感骚》三十篇，数万言。 诸公多荐举，会病卒。 子劭。 劭字仲远。 少笃学，博览多闻。 灵帝时举孝廉，辟车骑将军何苗掾。
target_text: **Ying Feng** (courtesy name Shishu), from Nandun, Runan, was exceptionally intelligent, memorizing everything he read. As governor, he visited forty-two counties and accurately recalled prisoner details. He wrote the *Preface to the Book of Han*. During a Wuling Man rebellion, he was appointed prefect and successfully pacified them through diplomacy. He later served as Sili Xiaowei, known for his severity. When Emperor Huan wanted to make Tian Guiren queen, Ying Feng advised against it, citing historical disasters from such choices. The emperor accepted his advice. He later resigned due to illness and wrote thirty chapters commemorating Qu Yuan.

input_text: 延熹中，武陵蛮复寇乱荆州，车骑将军冯绲以奉有威恩，为蛮夷所服，上请与俱征。 拜从事中郎。 奉勤设方略，贼破军罢，绲推功于奉，荐为司隶校尉。 纠举奸违，不避豪威，以严厉为名。 及邓皇后败，而田贵人见幸，桓帝有建立之议。 奉以田氏微贱，不宜超登后位，上书谏曰： 臣闻周纳狄女，襄王出居于郑；汉立飞燕，成帝胤嗣泯绝。 母后之重，兴废所因。 宜思《关雎》之所求，远五禁之所忌。 帝纳其言，竟立窦皇后。 及党事起，奉乃慨然以疾自退。 追愍屈原，因以自伤，著《感骚》三十篇，数万言。 诸公多荐举，会病卒。 子劭。 劭字仲远。 少笃学，博览多闻。 灵帝时举孝廉，辟车骑将军何苗掾。
target_text: **Ying Shao** (courtesy name Zhongyuan), studious and well-read, served as a messenger under Emperor Ling. During border conflicts, he argued against recruiting Xianbei soldiers, citing their unreliability and past betrayals. His view prevailed. As prefect of Taishan, he defeated 300,000 Yellow Turban rebels. After failing to protect Cao Song, he fled to Yuan Shao. He wrote extensively on legal matters, compiling works like *Han Yi* and *Customs of Customs*. He refuted legal precedents, arguing that punishment should follow established principles. His writings totaled 136 works, and he interpreted the *Book of Han*. He died in Ye.

input_text: 明将军德盛位尊，人臣无二，言行动天地，举厝移阴阳，诚能留神，沛然晓察，必有于公高门之福，和气立应，天下幸甚。 商高谞才志，即为奏原光罪，由是显名。 仕郡，举孝廉，稍迁金城太守。 性明达笃厚，能以恩信化诱殊俗，甚为羌胡所敬服。 遭母忧，自上归行丧。 服阙，公车征，再迁北海相，入为尚书仆射。 是时，大将军梁冀贵戚秉权，自公卿以下莫敢违忤。 谞与尚书令尹勋数奏其事，又因陛见陈闻罪失。 及冀诛后，桓帝嘉其忠节，封鄴都亭侯。 前后固让，不许。 出为河南尹，迁司隶校尉，转少府、廷尉，卒官。 子俊，安定太守。 爰延字季平，陈留外黄人也。 清苦好学，能通经教授。 性质悫，少言辞。
target_text: **Huo Chen** (courtesy name Shuzhi), from Ye, Wei County, was a young scholar. When his uncle Song Guang was falsely accused and imprisoned, fifteen-year-old Huo Chen wrote to General Liang Shang, arguing for leniency based on the *Spring and Autumn Annals* principle of judging intent. Liang Shang pardoned Song Guang, and Huo Chen became famous. He served as prefect of Jincheng, respected by the Qiang and Hu. After his mother's death, he resigned for mourning. He later served as prime minister of Beihai and minister, courageously opposing Liang Ji's power. After Liang Ji's death, Emperor Huan honored him. He died in office.

input_text: 县令陇西牛述好士知人，乃礼请延为廷掾，范丹为功曹，濮阳潜为主籍，常共言谈而已。 后令史昭以为乡啬夫，仁化大行，人但闻啬夫，不知郡县。 在事二年，州府礼请，不就。 桓帝时征博士，太尉杨秉等举贤良方正，再迁为侍中。 帝游上林苑，从容问延曰： 朕何如主也？ 对曰： 陛下为汉中主。 帝曰： 何以言之？ 对曰： 尚书令陈蕃任事则化，中常侍黄门豫政则乱，是以知陛下可与为善，可与为非。 帝曰： 昔朱云廷折栏槛，今侍中面称朕违，敬闻阙矣。 拜五官中郎将，转长水校尉，迁魏郡太守，征拜大鸿胪。 帝以延儒生，常特宴见。 时，太史令上言客星经帝坐，帝密以问延。 延因上封事曰：臣闻天子尊无为上，故天以为子，位临臣庶，威重四海。
target_text: **Yuan Yan** (courtesy name Jiping), from Chenliu, was poor but studious. He served as a village official, known for benevolent governance. When Emperor Huan asked what kind of ruler he was, Yuan Yan replied he was a "Lord of Hanzhong," explaining that while Chen Fan handled affairs well, eunuchs interfered. The emperor appointed him to various positions. Yuan Yan warned against favoring unworthy associates, citing historical disasters from such practices. He urged the emperor to distance himself from flatterers and eunuchs. He later retired due to illness and died.

input_text: 璆到州，举奏忠臧余一亿，使冠军县上簿诣大司农，以彰暴其事。 又奏五郡太守及属县有臧污者，悉征案罪，威风大行。 中平元年，与中郎将朱俊击黄巾贼于宛，破之。 张忠怨璆，与诸阉官构造无端，璆遂以罪征。 有破贼功，得免官归家。 后再征，迁汝南太守，转东海相，所在化行。 献帝迁许，以廷尉征，当诣京师，道为袁术所劫，授璆以上公之位。 璆乃叹曰： 龚胜、鲍宣，独何人哉？ 守之必死！ 术不敢逼。 术死军破，璆得其盗国玺，及还许，上之，并送前所假汝南、东海二郡印绶。 司徒赵温谓璆曰： 君遭大难，犹存此邪？ 璆曰： 昔苏武困于匈奴，不队七尺之节，况此方寸印乎？ 后拜太常，使持节拜曹操为丞相。 操以相让璆，璆不敢当。 卒于官。
target_text: **Xu Chu** (courtesy name Mengyu), from Guangling, was learned and served as governor of Jingzhou. He prosecuted corrupt officials, including Zhang Zhong, despite pressure from the Empress Dowager. He defeated Yellow Turban rebels but was falsely accused by eunuchs and dismissed. He later served as prime minister of Donghai. When Emperor Xian moved the capital, Xu Chu was kidnapped by Yuan Shu but refused to serve him. After Yuan Shu's defeat, Xu Chu recovered the imperial seal and returned it. He served as Taichang and died in office.

input_text: 高祖敞，昭帝时为丞相，封安平侯。 父宝，习《欧阳尚书》。哀、平之世，隐居教授。 居摄二年，与两龚、蒋诩俱征，遂遁逃，不知所处。 光武高其节。 建武中，公车特征，老病不到，卒于家。 震少好学，受《欧阳尚书》于太常桓郁，明经博览，无不穷究。 诸儒为之语曰： 关西孔子杨伯起。 常客居于湖，不答州郡礼命数十年，众人谓之晚暮，而震志愈笃。 后有冠雀衔三鳣鱼，飞集讲堂前，都讲取鱼进曰： 蛇鳣者，卿大夫服之象也。 数三者，法三台也。先生自此升矣。 年五十，乃始仕州郡。 大将军邓骘闻其贤而辟之，举茂才，四迁荆州刺史、东莱太守。 当之郡，道经昌邑，故所举荆州茂才王密为昌邑令，谒见，至夜怀金十斤以遗震。 震曰： 故人知君，君不知故人，何也？
target_text: Yang Zhen, styled Boqi, was from Hongnong Huayin. His eighth-generation ancestor Yang Hou was granted the title of Marquis of Chiquan under Emperor Gaozu of Han. His father Yang Bao studied Ouyang Shangshu, lived in seclusion during the reigns of Emperors Ai and Ping, and refused official appointments, disappearing. Emperor Guangwu admired his integrity but he died at home due to old age and illness.

input_text: 高祖敞，昭帝时为丞相，封安平侯。 父宝，习《欧阳尚书》。哀、平之世，隐居教授。 居摄二年，与两龚、蒋诩俱征，遂遁逃，不知所处。 光武高其节。 建武中，公车特征，老病不到，卒于家。 震少好学，受《欧阳尚书》于太常桓郁，明经博览，无不穷究。 诸儒为之语曰： 关西孔子杨伯起。 常客居于湖，不答州郡礼命数十年，众人谓之晚暮，而震志愈笃。 后有冠雀衔三鳣鱼，飞集讲堂前，都讲取鱼进曰： 蛇鳣者，卿大夫服之象也。 数三者，法三台也。先生自此升矣。 年五十，乃始仕州郡。 大将军邓骘闻其贤而辟之，举茂才，四迁荆州刺史、东莱太守。 当之郡，道经昌邑，故所举荆州茂才王密为昌邑令，谒见，至夜怀金十斤以遗震。 震曰： 故人知君，君不知故人，何也？
target_text: Yang Zhen loved learning, studied Ouyang Shangshu under Taichang Huanyu, and became a renowned scholar, called "Confucius of Kansai." He lived in Hucheng, declining official invitations for decades. At age fifty, he became a state and county official after a crested sparrow brought three fish, interpreted as a sign of promotion. General Deng Zhi recommended him, and he rose to Governor of Jingzhou and Donglai. Passing through Changyi, Wang Mi, a former subordinate, offered him ten pounds of gold at night, saying no one would know. Yang Zhen replied, "Heaven knows, earth knows, I know, you know—how can you say no one knows?" Wang Mi left in shame. As Prefect of Zhuo County, he was honest and refused personal requests, leaving his descendants a legacy of being "descendants of an innocent official."

input_text: 密曰： 暮夜无知者。 震曰： 天知，神知，我知，子知。何谓无知！ 密愧而出。 后转涿郡太守。 性公廉，不受私谒。 子孙常蔬食步行，故旧长者或欲令为开产业，震不肯，曰： 使后世称为清白吏子孙，以此遗之，不亦厚乎！ 元初四年，征入为太仆，迁太常。 先是博士选举多不以实，震举荐明经名士陈留杨伦等，显传学业，诸儒称之。 永宁元年，代刘恺为司徒。 明年，邓太后崩，内宠始横。 安帝乳母王圣，因保养之勤，缘恩放恣；圣子女伯荣出入宫掖，传通奸赂。 震上疏曰： 臣闻政以得贤为本，理以去秽为务。 阿母王圣出自贱微，得遭千载，奉养圣躬，虽有推燥居湿之勤，前后赏惠，过报劳苦，而无厌之心，不知纪极，外交属托，扰乱天下，损辱清朝，尘点日月。
target_text: In the fourth year of Yuanchu, he became a servant and Taichang, reforming doctorate elections by recommending worthy scholars. In Yongning's first year, he became Situ. When Empress Dowager Deng died, Emperor An's nurse Wang Sheng and her daughter Bo Rong became corrupt. Yang Zhen memorialized, citing historical examples to warn against women and villains in politics, urging their removal. Emperor An showed the memorial to Wang Sheng, who held a grudge. Bo Rong's arrogance grew; she married Liu Gui, who took a title. Yang Zhen protested this breach of protocol, but the emperor ignored him.

input_text: 震深疾之，复诣阙上疏曰：臣闻高祖与群臣约，非功臣不得封，故经制父死子继，兄亡弟及，以防篡也。 伏见诏书封故朝阳侯刘护再从兄瑰袭护爵为侯。护同产弟威，今犹见在。 臣闻天子专封封有功，诸侯专爵爵有德。 今瑰无佗功行，但以配阿母女，一时之间，既位侍中，又至封侯，不稽旧制，不合经义，行人喧哗，百姓不安。 陛下宜览镜既往，顺帝之则。 书奏不省。 延光二年，代刘恺为太尉。 帝舅大鸿胪耿宝荐中常侍李闰兄于震，震不从。 宝乃自往候震曰： 李常侍国家所重，欲令公辟其兄，宝唯传上意耳。 震曰： 如朝廷欲令三府辟召，故宜有尚书敕。 遂拒不许，宝大恨而去。 皇后兄执金吾阎显亦荐所亲厚于震，震又不从。 司空刘授闻之，即辟此二人，旬日中皆见拔擢。 由是震益见怨。 时诏遣使者大为阿母修弟，中常侍樊丰及侍中周广、谢恽等更相扇动，倾摇朝廷。 震复上疏曰：
target_text: In Yanguang's second year, Yang Zhen became Taiwei. He refused to recommend Li Gui's brother at Geng Bao's request and rejected Yan Xian's recommendation of relatives, causing resentment. When an edict ordered building a house for the queen mother, Yang Zhen criticized the extravagance during disasters and border unrest, but Fan Feng and others continued unchecked. After an earthquake, Yang Zhen attributed it to excessive yin from corrupt officials, urging the emperor to abandon the arrogant. The emperor was displeased, and Fan Feng resented him but dared not harm him due to his reputation.

input_text: 帝不省，腾竟伏尸都市。会三年春，东巡岱宗，樊丰等因乘舆在外，竞修第宅，震部掾高舒召大匠令史考校之，得丰等所诈下诏书，具奏，须行还上之。 丰等闻，惶怖，会太史言星变逆行，遂共谮震云： 自赵腾死后，深用怨怼；且邓氏故吏，有恚恨之心。 及车驾行还，便时太学，夜遣使者策收震太尉印绶，于是柴门绝宾客。 丰等复恶之，乃请大将军耿宝奏震大臣不服罪，怀恚望，有诏遣归本郡。 震行至城西几阳亭，乃慷慨谓其诸子门人曰： 死者士之常分。 吾蒙恩居上司，疾奸臣狡猾而不能诛，恶嬖女倾乱而不能禁，何面目复见日月！ 身死之日，以杂木为棺，布单被裁足盖形，勿归冢次，忽设祭祠。 因饮鸩而卒，时年七十余。
target_text: When Zhao Teng was arrested for criticizing the government, Yang Zhen pleaded for leniency, but the emperor ignored him, and Zhao Teng was killed. In the third year, Fan Feng framed Yang Zhen for resentment after Zhao Teng's death. The emperor stripped Yang Zhen of his position and ordered him home. At Jiyang Pavilion, Yang Zhen declared he could not face the world with traitors unpunished, took poison, and died at seventy. His coffin was exposed by the roadside. After Emperor Shun ascended, Fan Feng was executed. Yang Zhen's students petitioned, and the emperor posthumously honored him, granting titles and money, and buried him with ceremony. A large bird mourned at his funeral, and a stone bird was erected in his memory. His son Yang Mu became Prime Minister of Fubo.

input_text: 桓荣字春卿，沛郡龙亢人也。 少学长安，习《欧阳尚书》，事博士九江朱普。贫窭无资，常客佣以自给，精力不倦，十五年不窥家园。至王莽篡位乃归。 会朱普卒，荣奔丧九江，负土成坟，因留教授，徒众数百人。 莽败，天下乱。荣抱其经书与弟子逃匿山谷，虽常饥困而讲论不辍，后复客授江淮间。 建武十九年，年六十余，始辟大司徒府。 时，显宗始立为皇太子，选求明经，乃擢荣弟子豫章何汤为虎贲中郎将，以《尚书》授太子。 世祖从容问汤本师为谁，汤对曰： 事沛国桓荣。 帝即召荣，令说《尚书》，甚善之。 拜为议郎，赐钱十万，入使授太子。 每朝会，辄令荣于公卿前敷奏经书。 帝称善。曰： 得生几晚！ 会欧阳博士缺，帝欲用荣。 荣叩头让曰： 臣经术浅薄，不如同门生郎中彭闳，扬州从事皋弘。
target_text: Huan Rong, courtesy name Chunqing, was a native of Longkang, Pei County. He studied the "Ouyang Shangshu" under Zhu Pu in Chang'an, supporting himself through servant labor. He did not return home for fifteen years, only returning after Wang Mang's usurpation. After Zhu Pu's death, Huan Rong built his grave and stayed to teach, amassing hundreds of disciples. During the chaos following Wang Mang's fall, he fled into the valleys with his students, continuing to lecture despite hunger. Later, he taught in the Jianghuai region.

input_text: 帝曰： 俞，往，女谐。 因拜荣为博士，引闳、弘为议郎。 车驾幸大学，会诸博士论难于前，荣被服儒衣，温恭有蕴藉，辩明经义，每以礼让相厌，不以辞长胜人，儒者莫之及，特加赏赐。 又诏诸生雅吹击磬，尽日乃罢。 后荣入会庭中，诏赐奇果，受者皆怀之，荣独举手捧之以拜。 帝笑指之曰： 此真儒生也。 以是愈见敬厚，常令止宿太子宫。 积五年，荣荐门下生九江胡宪侍讲，乃听得出，旦一入而已。 荣尝寝病，太子朝夕遣中傅问病，赐以珍羞、帷、帐、奴婢，谓曰： 如有不讳，无忧家室也。 后病愈，复入侍进。 二十八年，大会百官，诏问谁可傅太子者，群臣承望上意，皆言太子舅执金吾原鹿侯阴识可。 博士张佚正色曰： 今陛下立太子，为阴氏乎？为天下乎？ 即为阴氏，则阴侯可；为天下，则固宜用天下之贤才。 帝称善，曰： 欲置傅者，以辅太子也。 今博士不难正朕，况太子乎？ 即拜佚为太子太傅，而以荣为少傅，赐以辎车、乘马。 荣大会诸生，陈其车马、印绶，曰： 今日所蒙，稽古之力也，可不勉哉！ 荣以太子经学成毕，上疏谢曰： 臣幸得侍帷幄，执经连年，而智学浅短，无以补益万分。 今皇太子以聪睿之姿，通明经义，观览古今，储君副主莫能专精博学若此者也。 斯诚国家福祐，天下幸甚。 臣师道已尽，皆在太子，谨使掾臣汜再拜归道。 太子报书曰： 庄以童蒙，学道九载，而典训不明，无所晓识。 夫《五经》广大，圣言幽远，非天下之至精，岂能与于此！ 况以不才，敢承诲命。
target_text: In the 19th year of Jianwu, over sixty, Huan Rong was appointed Grand Situ. When Xianzong became crown prince, Huan Rong's student He Tang was chosen to teach him the "Book of Documents." The emperor summoned Huan Rong, was impressed by his explanation of "Shang Shu," and appointed him Yilang, allowing him to teach the prince. Huan Rong declined a promotion to Dr. Ouyang, recommending his disciples Peng Hong and Gao Hong instead. He was later made a doctor. The emperor praised his gentle, erudite manner and rewarded him. Huan Rong served as the prince's young tutor, and after the prince's studies were complete, he requested retirement but was persuaded to stay. He was later appointed Taichang. When Xianzong ascended the throne, Huan Rong was honored as a master of etiquette. He repeatedly requested retirement due to old age, receiving additional rewards each time. The emperor visited him, showing great respect. Huan Rong died after a long illness, and the emperor personally attended his funeral and granted him a tomb.

input_text: 建武元年，拜河南太守。 及封功臣，帝令各言所乐，诸将皆占丰邑美县，惟綝愿封本乡。 或谓綝曰： 人皆欲县，子独求乡，何也？ 綝曰： 昔孙叔敖敕其子，受封必求硗埆之地，今綝能蒲功微，得乡亭厚矣。 帝从之，封定陵新安乡侯，食邑五千户，后徙封陵阳侯。 鸿年十三，从桓荣受《欧阳尚书》，三年而明章句，善论难，为都讲，遂笃志精锐，布衣荷担，不远千里。 初，綝从世祖征伐，鸿独与弟盛居，怜盛幼小而共寒苦。 及綝卒，鸿当袭封，上书让国于盛，不报。 既葬，乃挂缞绖于冢庐而逃去，留书与盛曰： 鸿贪经书，不顾恩义，弱而随师，生不供养，死不饭，皇天先祖，并不祐助，身被大病，不任茅土。
target_text: Ding Hong, courtesy name Xiaogong, was a native of Dingling, Yingchuan. His father, Ding Lin, surrendered Yingyang to Shizu and was rewarded, later becoming Governor of Henan. Ding Lin chose to be enfeoffed in his hometown, becoming Marquis of Xin'an Township. Ding Hong studied "Ouyang Shangshu" under Huan Rong at thirteen, mastering it in three years. After his father's death, he attempted to cede his title to his younger brother Ding Sheng but fled when his request was ignored. His friend Bao Jun persuaded him to return, citing the importance of upholding his father's legacy. Ding Hong returned, taught disciples, and was later summoned by Emperor Xianzong, becoming a servant and then Captain of Shesheng. He participated in the White Tiger Temple discussions on the Five Classics, where his eloquence was praised. He was promoted to Shaofu and later Taichang. During Empress Dowager Dou's regency, Ding Hong submitted a memorial warning against the Dou family's power, citing solar eclipses as divine warnings. His advice led to the confiscation of Dou Xian's seal and the suicides of Dou Xian and his brothers. Ding Hong also reformed the system for recommending filial and incorrupt candidates. He died in the sixth year of Yongyuan.

input_text: 桓谭冯衍 桓谭字君山，沛国相人也。 父成帝时为太乐令。 谭以父任为郎，因好音律，善鼓琴。 博学多通，遍习《五经》，皆诂训大义，不为章句。 能文章，尤好古学，数从刘歆、杨雄辩析疑异。性嗜倡乐，简易不修威仪，而憙非毁俗儒，由是多见排抵。 哀、平间，位不过郎。 傅皇后父孔乡侯晏深善于谭。 是时，高安侯董贤宠幸，女弟为昭仪，皇后日已疏，晏嘿嘿不得意。 谭进说曰： 昔武帝欲立卫子夫，阴求陈皇后之过，而陈后终废，子夫竟立。 今董贤至爱而女弟尤幸，殆将有子夫之变，可不忧哉！ 晏惊动，曰： 然，为之奈何？ 谭曰： 刑罚不能加无罪，邪枉不能胜正人。 夫士以才智要君，女以媚道求主。
target_text: Huan Tan, courtesy name Junshan, was from Xiangxian County, Peiguo. He was appointed as a minister through his father's connections. He was knowledgeable in the Five Classics, wrote excellent essays, and favored ancient learning. He debated with Liu Xin and Yang Xiong, and enjoyed criticizing secular Confucian scholars, which led to his ostracism. During the reigns of Emperor Ai and Emperor Ping, his status remained low.

input_text: 皇后年少，希更艰难，或驱使医巫，外求方技，此不可不番。 又君侯以后父尊重而多通宾客，必借以重势，贻致讥议。 不如谢遣门徒，务执廉悫，此修己正家避祸之道也。 晏曰： 善 。 遂罢遣常客，入白皇后，如谭所戒。 后贤果风太医令真钦，使求傅氏罪过，遂逮后弟侍中喜，诏狱无所得，乃解，故傅氏终全于哀帝之时。 及董贤为大司马，闻谭名，欲与之交。 谭先奏书于贤，说以辅国保身之术，贤不能用，遂不与通。 当王莽居摄篡弑之际，天下之士，莫不竟褒称德美，作符命以求容媚，谭独自守，默然无言。 莽时为掌乐大夫，更始立，召拜太中大夫。 世祖即位，征待诏，上书言事失旨，不用。 后大司空宋弘荐谭，拜议郎给事中，因上疏陈时政所宜，曰：臣闻国之废兴，在于政事；政事得失，由乎辅佐。
target_text: Fu Yan, Marquis of Kongxiang, valued Huan Tan. When Emperor Ai favored Dong Xian and his sister Zhaoyi over Empress Fu, Huan Tan warned Fu Yan of potential danger, advising him to dismiss guests and remain humble. Fu Yan followed this advice, and when Dong Xian later attempted to incriminate the Fu family, no evidence was found, saving them. Dong Xian later sought Huan Tan's friendship, but Huan Tan refused, criticizing Dong Xian's inability to protect himself through proper governance. During Wang Mang's usurpation, Huan Tan remained silent while others praised Wang Mang.

input_text: 夫天命难知，人道易守，守道之臣，何患死亡？ 顷之，帝以衍为曲阳令，诛斩剧贼郭胜等，降五千余人，论功当封，以谗毁，故赏不行。 建武六年日食，衍上书陈八事：其一曰显文德，二曰褒武烈，三曰修旧功，四曰招俊杰，五曰明好恶，六曰简法令，七曰差秩禄，八曰抚边境。 书奏，帝将召见。 初，衍为狼孟长，以罪摧陷大姓令狐略。是时，略为司空长史，谗之于尚书令王护、尚书周生丰曰： 衍所以求见者，欲毁君也。 护等惧之，即共排间，衍遂不得入。 后卫尉阴兴、新阳侯阴就以外戚贵显，深敬重衍，衍遂与之交结，是由为诸王所聘请，寻为司隶从事。 帝惩西京外戚宾客，故皆以法绳之，大者抵死徙，其余至贬黜。 衍由此得罪，尝自诣狱，有诏赦不问。 西归故郡，闭门自保，不也复与亲故通。
target_text: After Emperor Guangwu (Shizu) ascended, Huan Tan served as a郎官. He submitted memorials on governance, emphasizing the importance of wise advisors, harmony between ruler and ministers, and adapting policies to circumstances. He criticized harsh laws, private revenge killings, usury by merchants, and inconsistent legal punishments. He advocated for unified laws, agricultural development, and suppressing commerce. His proposals were not accepted.

input_text: 臣谭伏观陛下用兵，诸所降下，既无重赏以相恩诱，或至虏掠夺其财物，是以兵长渠率，各生孤疑，党辈连结，岁月不解。 古人有言曰： 天下皆知取之为取，而莫知与之为取。 陛下诚能轻爵重赏，与士共之，则何招而不至，何说而不释，何向而不开，何征而不克！ 如此，则能以狭为广，以迟为速，亡者复存，失者复得矣。 帝省奏，愈不悦。 其后，有诏会议灵台所处，帝谓谭曰： 吾欲以谶决之，何如？ 谭默然良久，曰： 臣不读谶。 帝问其故，谭复极言谶之非经。 帝大怒曰： 桓谭非圣无法，将下斩之！ 谭叩头流血，良久乃得解。 出为六安郡丞，意忽忽不乐，道病卒，时年七十余。 初，谭著书言当世行事二十九篇，号曰《新论》，上书献之，世祖善焉。
target_text: The emperor believed in prophecies. Huan Tan submitted another memorial denouncing prophecies as absurd, urging the emperor to follow the Five Classics instead. He also criticized inadequate rewards for surrendered rebels, which prolonged military campaigns. The emperor became displeased. When later asked about using prophecies to decide the location of the Lingtai, Huan Tan refused, arguing prophecies were irrational. The emperor ordered his execution, but Huan Tan kowtowed until bleeding and was instead demoted to Liu'an County Magistrate. He died en route, over seventy years old. He wrote the "New Treatise" in twenty-nine chapters and other works.

input_text: 《琴道》一篇未成，肃宗使班固续成之。 所著赋、诔、书、奏，凡二十六篇。 元和中，肃宗行东巡狩，至沛，使使者祠谭冢，乡里以为荣。 冯衍字敬通，京兆杜陵人也。 祖野王，元帝时为大鸿胪。 衍幼有奇才，年九岁，能诵《诗》，至二十而博通群书。 王莽时，诸公多荐举之者，衍辞不肯仕。 时，天下兵起，莽遣更始将军廉丹讨伐山东。 丹辟衍为掾，与俱至定陶。 莽追诏丹曰： 仓廪尽矣，府库空矣，可以怒矣，可以战矣。 将军受国重任，不捐身于中野，无以报恩塞责。 丹惶恐，夜召衍，以书示之。 衍因说丹曰： 衍闻顺而成者，道之所大也；逆而功者，权之所贵也。 是故期于有成，不问所由；论于大体，不守小节。 昔逢丑父伏轼而使其君取饮，称于诸侯；郑祭仲立突而出忽，终得复位，美于《春秋》。
target_text: Feng Yan, courtesy name Jingtong, was from Duling, Jingzhao. A prodigy, he could recite the "Book of Songs" at nine and was well-read by twenty. During Wang Mang's reign, he declined official recommendations. He served under Lian Dan, advising him to garrison troops and wait for opportunities rather than fight recklessly. Lian Dan refused and died in battle. Feng Yan later served Bao Yong, advising him to prepare defenses in Bingzhou, cultivate virtue, and select talented officers.

input_text: 衍不从。 或讹言更始随赤眉在北，永、衍信之，故屯兵界休，方移书上党，云皇帝在雍，以惑百姓。 永遣弟升及子媚张舒诱降涅城，舒家在上党，邑悉系之。 又书劝永降，永不答，自是与邑有隙。 邑字伯玉，冯翊人也，后为渔阳太守。 永、衍审知更始已殁，乃共罢兵，幅巾降于河内。 帝怨衍等不时至，永以立功得赎罪，遂任用之，而衍独见黜。 永谓衍曰： 昔高祖赏季布之罪，诛丁固之功。 今遭明主，亦何忧哉！ 衍曰： 记有之，人有挑其邻人之妻者，挑其长者，长者詈之，挑其少者，少者报之，后其夫死而取其长者。 或谓之曰： 夫非骂尔者邪？ 曰： 在人欲其报我，在我欲其骂人也。
target_text: After Emperor Guangwu's ascension, Feng Yan wrote to Tian Yi, urging him to remain loyal to the Gengshi regime. Tian Yi responded defiantly, criticizing Bao Yong and Feng Yan for their failures. Feng Yan and Bao Yong eventually surrendered. The emperor initially dismissed Feng Yan for his late surrender, but Bao Yong's intercession led to Feng Yan's appointment as Quyang Magistrate, where he suppressed bandits.

input_text: 夫天命难知，人道易守，守道之臣，何患死亡？ 顷之，帝以衍为曲阳令，诛斩剧贼郭胜等，降五千余人，论功当封，以谗毁，故赏不行。 建武六年日食，衍上书陈八事：其一曰显文德，二曰褒武烈，三曰修旧功，四曰招俊杰，五曰明好恶，六曰简法令，七曰差秩禄，八曰抚边境。 书奏，帝将召见。 初，衍为狼孟长，以罪摧陷大姓令狐略。是时，略为司空长史，谗之于尚书令王护、尚书周生丰曰： 衍所以求见者，欲毁君也。 护等惧之，即共排间，衍遂不得入。 后卫尉阴兴、新阳侯阴就以外戚贵显，深敬重衍，衍遂与之交结，是由为诸王所聘请，寻为司隶从事。 帝惩西京外戚宾客，故皆以法绳之，大者抵死徙，其余至贬黜。 衍由此得罪，尝自诣狱，有诏赦不问。 西归故郡，闭门自保，不也复与亲故通。
target_text: Feng Yan later submitted a memorial on eight matters during a solar eclipse. However, former enemies slandered him, preventing imperial audience. He befriended influential relatives but was implicated when the emperor punished their associates. Feng Yan confessed and was pardoned, then returned home, isolating himself from former acquaintances.

input_text: 马衍子豹建武末，上疏自陈曰：臣伏念高祖之略而陈平之谋，毁之则疏，誉之则亲。 以文帝以明而魏尚之忠，绳之以法则为罪，施之以德则为功。 逮至晚世，董仲舒言道德，见妒于公孙弘，李广奋节于匈奴，见排于卫青，此忠臣之常所为流涕也。 臣衍自惟微贱之臣，上无无知之荐，下无冯唐之说，乏董生之才，寡李广之势，而欲免谗口，济怨嫌，岂不难哉！ 臣衍之先祖，以忠贞之故，成私门之祸。 而臣衍复遭扰攘之时，值兵革之际，不敢回行求时之利，事君无倾邪之谋，将帅无虏掠之心。 卫尉阴兴，敬慎周密，内自修敕，外远嫌疑，故敢与交通。 兴知臣之贫，数欲本业之。 臣自惟无三益之才，不敢处三损之地，固让而不受之，昔在更始，太原执货财之柄，居苍卒之间，据位食禄二十余年，而财产岁狭，居处日贫，家无布帛之积，出无舆马之饰。 于今遭清明之时，饬躬力行之秋，而怨仇丛兴，讥议横世。 盖富贵易为善，贫贱难为工也。 疏远垅亩之臣，无望高阙之下，惶恐自陈，以救罪尤。
target_text: In the final years of the Jianwu era, Feng Yan submitted a memorial reflecting on historical figures. He compared Gaozu’s talents and Chen Ping’s wisdom, noting how slander could alienate Chen Ping while praise could draw him closer. He also referenced Emperor Wen’s wisdom and Wei Shang’s loyalty, observing that justice could turn people into criminals while virtue could make them heroes. Feng Yan lamented the tragedies of loyal officials like Dong Zhongshu, who was jealous of Gongsun Hong, and Li Guang, who was rejected by Wei Qing despite his efforts against the Huns. Feng Yan considered himself a humble minister without the recommendations of Wei Wuwu or Feng Tang, nor the talents of Dong Zhongshu or Li Guang, making it difficult to avoid slander and resentment.

input_text: 马衍子豹建武末，上疏自陈曰：臣伏念高祖之略而陈平之谋，毁之则疏，誉之则亲。 以文帝以明而魏尚之忠，绳之以法则为罪，施之以德则为功。 逮至晚世，董仲舒言道德，见妒于公孙弘，李广奋节于匈奴，见排于卫青，此忠臣之常所为流涕也。 臣衍自惟微贱之臣，上无无知之荐，下无冯唐之说，乏董生之才，寡李广之势，而欲免谗口，济怨嫌，岂不难哉！ 臣衍之先祖，以忠贞之故，成私门之祸。 而臣衍复遭扰攘之时，值兵革之际，不敢回行求时之利，事君无倾邪之谋，将帅无虏掠之心。 卫尉阴兴，敬慎周密，内自修敕，外远嫌疑，故敢与交通。 兴知臣之贫，数欲本业之。 臣自惟无三益之才，不敢处三损之地，固让而不受之，昔在更始，太原执货财之柄，居苍卒之间，据位食禄二十余年，而财产岁狭，居处日贫，家无布帛之积，出无舆马之饰。 于今遭清明之时，饬躬力行之秋，而怨仇丛兴，讥议横世。 盖富贵易为善，贫贱难为工也。 疏远垅亩之臣，无望高阙之下，惶恐自陈，以救罪尤。
target_text: Feng Yan recounted his ancestor Feng Shen’s loyalty and the troubles it caused. During disturbances, Feng Yan avoided seeking personal gain, and his servants and generals had no evil plans. He associated with Wei Wei Yinxing, who was respectful and cautious, and who offered money to help Feng Yan establish a livelihood, but Feng Yan refused, believing his talents were insufficient. He noted that during the Gengshi period, he held a position for over twenty years but his property decreased, leaving him poor. In the Qingming period, he faced resentment and ridicule, acknowledging that it is easier for the rich to do good than the poor.

input_text: 书奏，犹以前过不用。 衍不得志，退而作贼，又自论曰：冯子以为夫人之德，不碌碌如玉，落落如石。 风兴云蒸，一龙一蛇，与道翱翔，与时变化，夫岂守一节哉？ 用之则行，舍之则臧，进退无主，屈申无常。 故曰： 有法无法，因时为业，有度无度，与物趣舍。 常务道德之实，而不求当世之名，阔略杪小之礼，荡佚人间之事。 正身直行，恬然肆志。 顾尝好俶傥之策，时莫能听用其谋，喟然长叹，自伤不遭。 久栖迟于小官，不得舒其所怀。 抑心折节，意凄情悲。 夫伐冰之家，不利鸡豚之息；委积之臣，不操市井之利。 况历位食禄二十余年，而财产益狭，居处益贫。 惟夫君子之仕，行其道也。
target_text: After his memorial was ignored due to past mistakes, Feng Yan retired to write poems. He reflected on virtue, comparing it to jade or stone, and emphasized adapting to changing times. He criticized rigid adherence to laws and customs, advocating for moral truth over worldly fame. He lamented that his strategies were unused and that he remained a minor official for years, unable to display his abilities. His property diminished over twenty years, and he suffered hunger and cold, even losing his eldest son.

input_text: 然后阖门讲习道德，观览乎孔老之论，庶几乎松、乔之福，上陇阪，陟高冈，游精宇宙，流目八纮。 历观九州山川之体，追览上古得失之风，愍道陵迟，伤德分崩。 夫睹其终必原其始，故存其人而咏其道。 惟吾志之所庶兮，固与俗其不同；既俶傥而高引兮，愿观其从容。显宗即位，又多短衍以文过其实，遂废于家。 衍娶北地住氏女为妻，悍忌，不得畜媵妾，儿女常自操井臼，老竟逐之，遂埳壈于时。 然有大志，不戚戚于贱贫。 居常慷慨叹曰： 衍少事名贤，经历显位，怀金垂紫，揭节奉使，不求苟得，常有陵云之志。 三公之贵，千金之富，不得其愿，不概于怀。
target_text: Feng Yan chose a cemetery east of Xinfeng, on high ground with broad views, and retreated into seclusion. He mourned his ancestors’ virtues and the disorder of their tombs, planning to repair them and conduct sacrifices. He closed his door to lecture on morality, studying Confucius and Laozi, and sought spiritual blessings. He wrote a poem titled "Xian Zhi" to express his feelings, but after Xianzong ascended the throne, he was accused of exaggeration and abandoned. Feng Yan married a jealous woman who prevented him from raising a young wife, leaving him impoverished in old age. Despite this, he maintained his ambitions, refusing to seek high status or wealth. He died poor and old, leaving behind fifty works valued by Suzong. His son was Feng Bao.

input_text: 梁统子松子竦曾孙商玄孙冀 梁统字仲宁，安定乌氏人，晋大夫梁益耳，即其先也。统高祖父子都，自河东迁居北地，子都子桥，以资千万徙茂陵，至哀、平之末，归安定。 统性刚毅而好法律。 初仕州郡。 更始二年，召补中郎将，使安集凉州，拜酒泉太守。 会更始败，赤眉入长安，统与窦融及诸郡守起兵保境，谋共立帅。 初以位次，咸共推统，统固辞曰： 昔陈婴不受王者，以有老母也。 今统内有尊亲，又德薄能寡，诚不足以当之。 遂共推融为河西大将军，更以统为武威大守。 为政严猛，威行邻郡。 建武五年，统筹各遣使随窦融长史刘钧诣阙奉贡，愿得诣行在所，诏加统宣德将军。 八年夏，光武自征隗嚣，统与窦融等将兵会车驾。 及嚣败，封统为成义侯，同产兄巡、从弟腾并为关内侯，拜腾酒泉典农部尉，悉遣还河西。 十二年，统与融等俱诣京师，以列侯奉朝请，更封高山侯，拜太中大夫，除四子为郎。 统在朝廷，数陈便宜。
target_text: Liang Tong, courtesy name Zhongning, was from Anding Wushi. His ancestor Liang Yi'er was a Jin Dynasty doctor. His grandfather Zidu moved from Hedong northward, and his son Liangqiao relocated to Maoling with great wealth, returning to Anding during the reigns of Emperors Ai and Ping. Liang Tong had a resolute character and loved law. He began his official career in state and county posts. In the second year of Gengshi's reign, he was summoned as General Zhonglang and appointed Governor of Jiuquan. After the reform failed, the Red Eyebrow Army entered Chang'an. Liang Tong, Dou Rong, and other governors raised troops to defend their territory. When they discussed establishing a commander-in-chief, all recommended Liang Tong, but he firmly declined, citing his lack of virtue and ability. Thus, Dou Rong was elected General of Hexi and Governor of Wuwei. Liang Tong's strict political views earned him prestige in neighboring counties.

input_text: 梁统子松子竦曾孙商玄孙冀 梁统字仲宁，安定乌氏人，晋大夫梁益耳，即其先也。统高祖父子都，自河东迁居北地，子都子桥，以资千万徙茂陵，至哀、平之末，归安定。 统性刚毅而好法律。 初仕州郡。 更始二年，召补中郎将，使安集凉州，拜酒泉太守。 会更始败，赤眉入长安，统与窦融及诸郡守起兵保境，谋共立帅。 初以位次，咸共推统，统固辞曰： 昔陈婴不受王者，以有老母也。 今统内有尊亲，又德薄能寡，诚不足以当之。 遂共推融为河西大将军，更以统为武威大守。 为政严猛，威行邻郡。 建武五年，统筹各遣使随窦融长史刘钧诣阙奉贡，愿得诣行在所，诏加统宣德将军。 八年夏，光武自征隗嚣，统与窦融等将兵会车驾。 及嚣败，封统为成义侯，同产兄巡、从弟腾并为关内侯，拜腾酒泉典农部尉，悉遣还河西。 十二年，统与融等俱诣京师，以列侯奉朝请，更封高山侯，拜太中大夫，除四子为郎。 统在朝廷，数陈便宜。
target_text: In the fifth year of Jianwu's reign, Liang Tong and others sent envoys to the imperial court with Dou Rong's chief minister Liu Jun to pay tribute. The emperor conferred on Liang Tong the title of General Xuande. In the eighth year, Emperor Guangwu personally conquered Kui Xiao, and Liang Tong and Dou Rong led soldiers to join him. After Kui Xiao's defeat, Guangwu granted Liang Tong the title of Marquis of Chengyi, and his brother Liang Xun and cousin Liang Teng were also made marquises. In the twelfth year, Liang Tong and Dou Rong came to the capital as marquises. Liang Tong was granted the title of Gaoshan Marquis, appointed Taizhong大夫, and his four sons were named Lang. While in court, Liang Tong repeatedly reported beneficial matters. He believed the law was too light, increasing crime, and advocated for stricter punishments according to old laws. He submitted a memorial arguing that lenient punishments under Emperors Yuan and Ai had led to lawlessness and increased crime. He cited historical precedents from the Five Emperors, Three Kings, and Han emperors, urging the adoption of stricter measures. However, the matter was referred to the Sangong and Tingwei, who deemed harsh punishments unnecessary and refused to change the old law. Liang Tong wrote again, clarifying he did not seek severe punishment but adherence to old rules. He argued that mitigating punishment had caused rampant theft and rebellion, citing recent outbreaks of banditry. His memorial was sent but not reported. Later, Liang Tong served as Prefect of Jiujiang and was granted the title of Marquis of Lingxiang. He achieved great governance in the county, earning the fear and love of officials and people, and died in office.

input_text: 既徂南土，历江、湖，济沅、湘，感悼子胥、屈原以非辜沉身，乃作《悼骚赋》，系玄石而沉之。显宗后诏听还本郡。竦闭门自养，以经籍为娱，著书数篇，名曰《七序》。 班固见而称曰： 孔子著《春秋》而乱臣贼子惧，梁竦作《七序》而窃位素餐者惭。 姓好施，不事产业。 长嫂舞阴公主赡给诸梁，亲疏有序，特重敬竦，虽衣食器物，必有加异。 竦悉分与亲族，自无所服。 竦生长京师，不乐本土，身负其才，郁郁不得意。尝登高远望，叹息言曰： 大丈夫居世，生当封侯，死当庙食。如其不然，闲居可以养志，《诗》、《书》足以自娱，州郡之职，徒劳人耳。 后辟命交至，并无所就。有三男三女，肃宗纳其二女，皆为贵人。
target_text: Liang Ji, courtesy name Bozhuo, had a hunched back like an eagle's wings and upright eyes like a jackal. He was idle and unruly from childhood, fond of drinking, archery, gambling, and racing. He began as Minister of Huangmen and rose to various military and police posts. In the first year of Emperor Shun's Yonghe reign, he was appointed Yin of Henan, where he was brutal and illegal. His father Liang Shang's friend, Lu Fang, criticized Liang Ji, leading Liang Ji to have Lu Fang assassinated. He then framed Lu Fang's enemies and had Lu Fang's brother capture them, killing over a hundred people. After Liang Shang's death, Emperor Shun appointed Liang Ji as General and his brother Liang Buyi as Yin of Henan. When Emperor Shun died, the Queen Mother ordered Liang Ji, Taifu Zhao Jun, and Taiwei Li Gu to manage government affairs. Liang Ji became more extravagant and cruel. After Emperor Chong died, Liang Ji welcomed Emperor Zhi, who was young and intelligent. When Emperor Zhi called Liang Ji a "domineering general," Liang Ji poisoned him. He then welcomed Emperor Huan and framed Li Gu and Du Qiao.

input_text: 南郡太守马融、江夏太守田明，初除，过谒不疑，冀讽州郡以它事陷之，皆髡笞徙朔方。 融自刺不诛，明遂死于路。 永兴二年，封不疑子马为颍阴侯，胤子桃为城父侯。 冀一门前后七封侯，三皇后，六贵人，二大将军，夫人、女食邑称君者七人，尚公主者三人，其余卿、将、尹、校五十七人。 在位二十余年，究极满盛，威行内外，百僚侧目，莫敢违命，天子恭己而不得有所亲豫。 帝即不平之。 延熹元年，太史令陈授因小黄门徐璜，陈灾异日食之变，咎在大将军，冀闻之，讽洛阳令收考授，死于狱。帝由此发怒。 初，掖庭人邓香妻宣生女猛，香卒，宣更适梁纪。 梁纪者，冀妻寿之舅也。 寿引进猛入掖庭，见幸，为贵人，冀因欲认猛为其女以自固，乃易猛姓为梁。
target_text: Emperor Huan granted Liang Ji 13,000 households and increased his staff. Liang Buyi and others were also enfeoffed. In the first year of peace, Liang Ji received another 10,000 households, totaling 30,000. His wife Sun Shou was granted the title of Lord of Xiangcheng. Sun Shou was beautiful and seductive, and Liang Ji doted on and feared her. Liang Ji had an affair with You Tongqi, a former concubine of his father, and she bore him a son. Sun Shou killed You Tongqi's family, and Liang Ji hid the child. Liang Ji also favored a servant named Qin Gong, who had an affair with Sun Shou. Liang Ji and Sun Shou amassed immense wealth through extortion and bribery, confiscating property from wealthy families. They built grand mansions with lavish decorations, gardens, and rare animals. Liang Ji's power grew unchecked, with all court matters decided by him. He killed officials who opposed him, including Wu Shu and Hou Meng. A young doctor named Yuan Zhu wrote to the emperor criticizing Liang Ji's power, but Liang Ji had him beaten to death. Liang Ji also killed many others, including Hao Xie and Hu Wu's families. Liang Buyi, who loved scriptures and treated others well, was estranged by Liang Ji and resigned. Liang Ji's family included seven marquises, three queens, six nobles, two generals, and many other officials. Liang Ji held power for over 20 years, dominating the court. Emperor Huan, angered by Liang Ji's arrogance, plotted with eunuchs to kill him. In the first year of Yanxi, after a series of events, Emperor Huan ordered the arrest of Liang Ji. Liang Ji and Sun Shou committed suicide. Over 300 of his officials and guests were dismissed. His property, worth over three billion, was confiscated and used to reduce taxes. His gardens were given to the poor.

input_text: 宏少有志行。 王莽末，义兵起，刘伯升与族兄赐俱将兵攻湖阳，城守不下。 赐女弟为宏妻，湖阳由是收系宏妻子，令出譬伯升，宏因留不反。 湖阳军帅欲杀其妻子，长吏以下共相谓曰： 樊重子父，礼义恩德行于乡里，虽有罪，且当在后。 会汉兵日盛，湖阳惶急，未敢杀之，遂得免脱。 更始立，欲以宏为将，宏叩头辞曰： 书生不习兵事。 竟得免归。与宗家亲属作营堑自守，老弱归之者千余家。 时赤眉贼掠唐子乡，多所残杀，欲前攻宏营，宏遣人持牛酒米谷，劳遗赤眉。 赤眉长老先闻宏仁厚，皆称曰： 樊君素善，且今见待如此，何心攻之。 引兵而去，遂免寇难。 世祖即位，拜光禄大夫，位特进，次三公。 建武五年，封长罗侯。 十三年，封弟丹为射阳侯，兄子寻玄乡侯，族兄忠更父侯。 十五年，定封宏寿张侯。 十八年，帝南祠章陵，过湖阳，祠重墓，追爵谥为寿张敬侯，立庙于湖阳，车驾每南巡，常幸其墓，赏赐大会。 宏为人谦柔畏慎，不求苟进。 常戒其子曰： 富贵盈溢，未有能终者。 吾非不喜荣势也，天道恶满而好谦，前世贵戚皆明戒也。
target_text: The biographies of Fan Hong and Yin Shi, two figures from the early Eastern Han dynasty.

input_text: 樊宏子儵族曾孙准阴识弟兴 樊宏字靡卿，南阳湖阳人也，世祖之舅。其先周仲山甫，封于樊，因而氏焉，为乡里著姓。 父重，字君云，世善农稼，好货殖。 重性温厚，有法度，三世共财，子孙朝夕礼敬，常若公家。 其营理产业，物无所弃，课役童隶，各得其宜，故能上下戮力，财利岁倍，至乃开广田土三百余顷。 其所起庐舍，皆有重堂高阁，陂渠灌注。 又池鱼牧畜，有求必给。 尝欲作器物，先种梓漆，时人嗤之，然积以岁月，皆得其用，向之笑者咸求假焉。 资至巨万，而赈赡宗族，恩加乡闾。 外孙何氏兄弟争财，重耻之，以田二顷解其忿讼。 县中称美，推为三老。 年八十余终。 其素所假贷人间数百万，遗令焚削文契。 责家闻者皆惭，争往偿之，诸子从敕，竟不肯受。
target_text: Fan Hong, a native of Huyang, Nanyang, was the uncle of Emperor Guangwu (Shizu). His ancestor was granted the title of Fan. His father, Fan Zhong, was a kind, law-abiding farmer and businessman who expanded the family's wealth to over 300 hectares of land, building grand estates with ponds and canals. He provided relief to his clan and village, and once settled a property dispute among his grandsons by giving them two hectares of land. Upon his death at eighty, his son Fan Hong burned the deeds of debtors, refusing repayment. During Wang Mang's reign, rebels attacked Huyang, and Fan Hong's wife was captured, but she was spared due to the family's reputation for kindness. Fan Hong declined a generalship under Gengshi, instead building a defensive camp that sheltered over a thousand people. When Red Eyebrow bandits threatened, he sent them gifts, and they spared him due to his benevolence. Under Emperor Guangwu, he became a high-ranking official, was enfeoffed as Changluohou, and later as Hou Zhang. He was known for his modesty, caution, and advice to his son against excessive wealth. He often arrived early at court and destroyed drafts of his memorials. On his deathbed, he requested a simple burial, which the emperor honored, granting him the posthumous title of Marquis Gong.

input_text: 更始元年，迁偏将军，从攻宛，别降新野、阳、杜衍、冠军、湖阳。 二年，更始封识阴德侯，行大将军事。 建武元年，光武遣使迎阴贵人于新野，并征识。 识随贵人至，以为骑都尉，更封阴乡侯。 二年，以征伐军功增封，识叩头让曰： 天下初定，将帅有功者众，臣托属掖廷，仍加爵邑，不可以示天下。 帝甚美之，以为关都尉，镇函谷。 迁侍中，以母忧辞归。 十五年，定封原鹿侯。 及显宗立为皇太子，以识守执金吾，辅导东宫。 帝每巡郡国，识常留镇守京师，委以禁兵。 入虽极言正议，及与宾客语，未尝及国事。 帝敬重之，常指识以敕戒贵戚，激厉左右焉。 识所用掾史皆简贤者，如虞廷、傅宽、薛等，多至公卿校尉。
target_text: Yin Shi, a native of Xinye, Nanyang, was the brother of Empress Guanglie. His ancestor was Guan Zhong, whose descendant changed his surname to Yin. During Liu Bo's uprising, Yin Shi abandoned his studies in Chang'an to join him, leading over a thousand followers. He became a captain and later a general under Gengshi, conquering five counties. Under Emperor Guangwu, he was made a Cavalry Captain and Marquis of Yin Township. He humbly declined additional titles, stating the world was newly settled. He served as a captain and later returned home for his mother's funeral. He was enfeoffed as Luhou and served as a guardian to the crown prince, often staying to guard the capital during the emperor's travels. He was discreet about state affairs and employed virtuous scribes. Upon Emperor Ming's ascension, he became Zhijinwu. He died in the second year of Yongping, receiving the posthumous title of Zhenhou.

input_text: 谯玄李业刘茂温序彭脩索卢放周嘉范式李善王忳张武陆续戴封李充缪肜陈重雷义范冉戴就赵苞向栩谅辅刘翊王烈孔子曰： 与其不得中庸，必也狂狷乎！ 又云： 狂者进取，狷者有所不为也。 此盖失于周全之道，而取诸偏至之端者也。 然则有所不为，亦将有所必为者矣；既云进取，亦将有所不取者矣。 如此，性尚分流，为否异适矣。 中世偏行一介之夫，能成名立方者，盖亦众也。 或志刚金石，而克扞于强御。或意严冬霜，而甘心于小谅。 亦有结朋协好，幽明共心；蹈义陵险，死生等节。 虽事非通圆，良其风轨，有足怀者。 而情迹殊杂，难为条品；片辞特趣，不足区别。措之则事或有遗，载之则贯序无统。 以其名体虽殊，而操行俱绝，故总为《独行篇》焉。庶备诸阙文，纪志漏脱云尔。 谯玄字君黄，巴郡阆中人也。 少好学，能说《易》、《春秋》。 仕于州郡。 成帝永始二年，有日食之灾，乃诏举敦朴逊让、有行义者各一人。
target_text: It suggests that this is an imperfect approach, as people's temperaments differ, and what they do or refrain from doing is appropriate for each individual. In times of peace, many who deviate from the norm can become famous and upright, with ambitions as strong as gold or integrity as severe as winter frost. Some make friends willing to live and die together, risking their lives for justice. Though not perfect, these deeds are memorable, though their complexities make them hard to categorize. The text states that such exceptional conduct is recorded in the "Ding Xing Pian" to fill gaps in history.

input_text: 彼独何人，我亦何人。 保志全高，死亦奚恨！ 遂受毒药。 玄子瑛泣血叩头于太守曰： 方今国家，东有严敌，兵师四出。国用军资，或不常充足。愿奉家钱千万，以赎父死。 太守为请，述听许之。 玄遂隐藏田野，终述之世。 时，兵戈累年，莫能修尚学业，玄独训诸子勤习经书。 建武十一年卒。 明年，天下平定，玄弟庆以状诣阙自陈。光武美之，策诏本郡祠以中牢，敕所在还玄家钱。 时，亦有犍为费贻，不肯仕述，乃漆身为厉，阳狂以避之，退藏山薮十余年。 述破后，仕至合浦太守。 瑛善说《易》，以授显宗，为北宫卫士令。 李业字巨游，广汉梓潼人也。 少有志操，介特。 习《鲁诗》，师博士许晃。 元始中，举明经，除为郎。
target_text: The biography of Qiao Xuan follows. Born in Ba County, he was learned in the "Yi" and "Spring and Autumn." He became an official and was recommended for his integrity during a solar eclipse in Emperor Yongshi's reign. He criticized Emperor Cheng for neglecting state affairs and focusing on trivial matters, warning of dangers from unpreparedness. Despite frequent disasters, his advice was ignored, and he remained in a low position. He later resigned after his brother's death. During Wang Mang's usurpation, Qiao Xuan abandoned his post and hid. Gongsun Shu tried to recruit him with threats of poison, but Qiao Xuan refused, citing historical examples of integrity. His son offered money to spare his life, and Qiao Xuan hid until Gongsun Shu's death. He died in the eleventh year of Jianwu, and Guangwu later honored him.

input_text: 宜上奉知己，下为子孙，身名俱全，不亦优乎！ 今数年不起，猜疑寇心，凶祸立加，非计之得者也。 业乃叹曰： 危国不入，乱国不居。 亲于其身为不善者，义所不从。 君子见危授命，何乃诱以高位重饵哉？ 融见业辞志不屈，复曰： 宜呼室家计之。 业曰： 丈夫断之于心久矣，何妻、子之为？ 遂饮毒而死。 述闻业死，大惊，又耻有杀贤之名，乃遣使吊祠，赙赠百匹。 业子翚，逃避不受。 蜀平，光武下诏表其闾，《益部纪》载其高节，图画形象。 初，平帝时，蜀郡王皓为美阳令，王嘉为郎。 王莽篡位，并弃官西归。 及公孙述称帝，遣使征皓、嘉，恐不至，遂先系其妻、子。
target_text: Li Ye, from Guanghan, was ambitious and upright, studying the "Lu Shi." He refused to serve under Wang Mang, feigning illness. Forced by Prefect Liu Xian, he was imprisoned but released after a guest intervened. He later hid in the valley. Gongsun Shu tried to recruit him with threats of poison, but Li Ye refused, stating that a gentleman should not enter a chaotic state. He drank poison and died. Gongsun Shu, ashamed, held a funeral. After Shu was pacified, Guangwu honored Li Ye. Others like Wang Hao and Wang Jia also refused to serve Gongsun Shu, choosing death over submission.

input_text: 建武二年归，为郡门下掾。 时，赤眉二十余万众攻郡县，杀长吏及府掾史。 茂负太守孙福逾墙藏空穴中，得免。 其暮，俱奔盂县。 昼则逃隐，夜求粮食。 积百余日，贼去，乃得归府。 明年，诏书求天下义士。 福言茂曰： 臣前为赤眉所攻，吏民坏死，奔走趣山。臣为贼所围，命如丝发，赖茂负臣逾城，出保盂县。 茂与弟触冒兵刃，缘山负食，臣及妻子得度死命，节义尤高。 宜蒙表擢，以厉义士。 诏书即征茂，拜议郎，迁宗正丞。 后拜侍中，卒官。 延平中，鲜卑数百余骑寇渔阳，太守张显率吏士追出塞，遥望虏营烟火，急趣之。 兵马掾严授虑有伏兵，苦谏止，不听。
target_text: Liu Mao, from Taiyuan, was known for filial piety. He studied the "Book of Rites" and taught students. He abandoned his post during Wang Mang's usurpation and hid in Hongnong Mountain. During a Red Eyebrow attack, he carried the prefect Sun Fu to safety, hiding and foraging for food for over a hundred days. Sun Fu praised his integrity, and Liu Mao was appointed Yilang. He later died in office. Other accounts describe Yan Shuo, who died fighting Xianbei invaders, and Suo Fu, who died saving a magistrate from thieves.

input_text: 显蹙令进，授不获已，前战，伏兵发，授身被十创，殁于阵。 显拔刃追散兵，不能制，虏射中显，主簿卫福、功曹徐咸遽赴之，显遂堕马，福以身拥蔽，虏并杀之。 朝廷愍授等节，诏书褒叹，厚加赏赐，各除子一人为郎中。 永初二年，剧贼毕豪等入平原界，县令刘雄将吏士乘船追之。 至厌次河，与贼合战。雄败，执雄，以矛刺之。 时小吏所辅前叩头求哀，愿以身代雄。 豪等纵雄而刺辅，贯心洞背即死。 东郡太守捕得豪等，具以状上。 诏书追伤之，赐钱二十万，除父奉为郎中。 温序字次房，太原祁人也。 仕州从事。 建武二年，骑都尉弓里戍将兵平定北州，到太原，历访英俊大人，问以策谋。 戍见序奇之，上疏荐焉。于是征为侍御史，迁武陵都尉，病免官。 六年，拜谒者，迁护羌校尉。 序行部至襄武，为隗嚣别将苟宇所拘劫。
target_text: Wen Xu, from Taiyuan, was recommended as a talent and became a censor. He was captured by Gou Yu, who tried to persuade him to join a rebellion. Wen Xu refused, scolding the rebels and killing several before falling on his sword. Guangwu honored him with a grand funeral and appointed his sons as doctors. Peng Xiu, from Kuaiji, defended his father from robbers at age fifteen, gaining fame. As an official, he saved a chief clerk from execution by reasoning with the prefect. He later died shielding the prefect from thieves' arrows.

input_text: 初署郡门下掾。 更始时，使者督行郡国，太守有事，当就斩刑，放前言曰： 今天下所以苦毒王氏，归心皇汉者，实以圣政宽仁故也。 而传车所过，未闻恩泽。 太守受诛，诚不敢言，但恐天下惶惧，各生疑变。 夫使功者不如使过，愿以身代太守之命。 遂前就斩。 使者义而赦之，由是显名。 建武六年，征为洛阳令，政有能名。 以病乞身。徙谏议大夫，数纳忠言，后以疾去。 建武末，复征不起，光武使人舆之，见于南宫云台，赐谷二千斛，遣归，除子为太子中庶子。 卒于家。 周嘉字惠文，汝南安城人也。 高祖父燕，宣帝时为郡决曹掾。 太守欲枉杀人，燕谏不听，遂杀囚而黜燕。
target_text: Suo Lufang, from Dongjun, taught the "Shang Shu" and served as a county magistrate. During the Gengshi period, he offered to die in place of a prefect condemned by an envoy, who pardoned them. He later became Luoyang Order, known for his ability. In his old age, Guangwu summoned him to the capital and honored him. Zhou Jia, from Runan, followed a prefect into battle against thieves. When the prefect was wounded, Zhou Jia shielded him and scolded the thieves, who released them. He later refused to marry a princess and died as prefect of Lingling.

input_text: 囚家守阙称冤，诏遣复考。燕见太守曰： 愿谨定文书，皆著燕名，府君但言时病而已。 出谓掾史曰： 诸君被问，悉当以罪推燕。 如有一言及于府君，燕手剑相刃。 使者乃收燕系狱。 屡被掠楚，辞无屈桡。 当下蚕室，乃叹曰： 我平王之后，正公玄孙，岂可以刀锯之余下见先君？ 遂不食而死。 燕有五子，皆至刺史、太守。 嘉仕郡为主簿。 王莽末，郡贼入汝阳城，嘉从太守何敞讨贼，敞为流矢所中，郡兵奔北，贼围绕数十重，白刃交集，嘉乃拥敞，以身扞之。 因呵贼曰： 卿曹皆人隶也。为贼既逆，岂有还害其君者邪？ 嘉请以死赎君命。 因仰天号泣。 群贼于是两两相视，曰： 此义士也！ 给其车马，遣送之。 后太守寇恂举为孝廉，拜尚书侍郎。 光武引见，问以遭难之事。 嘉对曰： 太守被伤，命悬寇手。臣实弩怯，不能死难。 帝曰： 此长者也。 诏嘉尚公主，嘉称病笃，不肯当。 稍迁零陵太守，视事七年，卒。 零陵颂其遗爱，吏民为立祠焉。 嘉从弟暢，字伯持，性仁慈，为河南尹。 永初二年夏，旱，久祷无应，暢因收葬洛城傍客死骸骨，凡万余人。应时澎雨，岁乃丰稔。 位至光禄勋。 范式字巨卿，山阳金乡人也，一名汜。 少游太学，为诸生，与汝南张劭为友。 劭字元伯。
target_text: Shi Shi, from Shanyang, was known for his faithfulness. He promised to visit his friend Zhang Shao after two years and kept his word. When Zhang Shao died, Shi Shi dreamed of him and traveled to attend his funeral, where the coffin moved only after his arrival. He later cared for another friend's family after his death. As governor of Jingzhou, he recognized a poor friend working as a laborer and offered him a position, but the friend refused. Shi Shi died as prefect of Lujiang.

input_text: 式后迁庐江太守，有威名，卒于官。 李善字次孙，南阳淯阳人也，本同县李元苍头也。 建武中疫疾，元家相继死没，唯孤兒续始生数旬，而赀财千万，诸奴婢私共计议，欲谋杀续，分其财产。 善深伤李氏而力不能制，乃潜负续逃去，隐山阳瑕丘界中，亲自哺养，乳为生湩。推燥居湿，备尝艰勤。 续虽在孩抱，奉之不异长君，有事辄长跪请白，然后行之。 闾里感其行，皆相率修义。 续年十岁，善与归本县，修理旧业。 告奴婢于长吏，悉收杀之。 时钟离意为瑕丘令，上书荐善行状。 光武诏拜善及续并为太子舍人。 善显宗时辟公府，以能理剧，再迁日南太守。 从京师之官，道经淯阳，过李元冢。未至一里，乃脱朝服，持锄去草。 及拜墓，哭泣甚悲，身自炊爨，执鼎俎以修祭祀。
target_text: Li Shan, from Nanyang, saved an orphaned infant, Li Xu, from murderous slaves by fleeing and raising him. He treated Li Xu with respect and later returned to reclaim the family property, punishing the slaves. Guangwu honored them. Li Shan later became governor of Rinan, visiting Li Yuan's tomb with great reverence. He died en route to Jiujiang. Wang Yi, from Guanghan, buried a stranger who died in his care, using gold from the deceased. Later, a horse and embroidered quilt led him to the stranger's father, who recognized his son's belongings. Wang Yi also solved a ghostly murder case at an inn.

input_text: 忳曰： 汝何故数杀过客？ 对曰： 妾不得白日自诉，每夜陈冤，客辄眠不见应，不胜感恚，故杀之。 忳曰： 当为汝理此冤，勿复杀良善也。 因解衣于地，忽然不见，明旦召游徼诘问，具服罪，即收系，及同谋十余人悉伏辜。 遣吏送其丧归乡里，于是亭遂清安。 张武者，吴郡由拳人也。 父业，郡门下掾，送太守妻、子还乡里，至河内亭，盗夜劫之，业与贼战死，遂亡失尸骸。 武时年幼，不及识父。 后之太学受业，每节，常持父遗剑，至亡处祭醊，泣而还。 太守第五伦嘉其行，举孝廉。 遭母丧过毁，伤父魂灵不返，因哀恸绝命。 陆续字智初，会稽吴人也。 世为族姓。 祖父闳，字子春，建武中为尚书令。 美姿貌，喜着越布单衣，光武见而好之，自是常敕会稽郡献越布。 续幼孤，仕郡户曹史。
target_text: Zhang Wu, from Wu County, mourned his father, who died fighting thieves. He often visited the site of his father's death with his sword. He was commended for filial piety but died of grief after his mother's death. Lu Yu, from Kuaiji, was known for his intelligence and loyalty. During a rebellion, he and others were tortured but refused to implicate the prefect. His mother's cooking helped identify her presence. He was pardoned and died of old age.

input_text: 充伪酬之曰： 如欲别居，当醖酒具会，请呼乡里内外，共议其事。 妇从充置酒晏客。 充于坐中前跪曰母曰： 此妇无状，而教充离间母兄，罪合遣斥。 便呵叱其妇，逐令出门，妇衔涕而去。 坐中惊肃，因遂罢散。 充后遭母丧，行服墓次，人有盗其墓树者，充手自杀之。 服阕，立精舍讲授。 太守鲁平请署功曹，不就。 平怒，乃援充以捐沟中，因谪署县都亭长。 不得已，起亲职役。 后和帝公车征，不行。 延平中，诏公卿、中二千石各举隐士大儒，务取高行，以劝后进，特征充为博士。 时鲁平亦为博士，每与集会，常叹服焉。 充迁侍中。 大将军邓骘贵戚倾时，无所下借，以充高节，每卑敬之。 尝置酒请充，宾客满堂，酒酣，骘跪曰： 幸托椒房，位列上将。幕府初开，欲辟天下奇伟，以匡不逮，惟诸君博求其器。 充乃为陈海内隐居怀道之士，颇有不合，骘欲绝其说，以肉啖之。 充抵肉于地，曰： 说士犹甘于肉！ 遂出，径去。 骘甚望之。 同坐汝南张孟举往让充曰： 一日闻足下与邓将军说士未究，激刺面折，不由中和，出言之责，非所以光祚子孙者也。 充曰： 大丈夫居世，贵行其意，何能远为子孙计哉！
target_text: Dai Feng, from Jibei, was a devoted student who buried a classmate and returned his belongings. He once gave his remaining money to a thief, who returned his stolen goods. As a magistrate, locusts avoided his territory, and he prayed for rain by threatening self-immolation, which brought rain. He released prisoners to visit families, and all returned. He died in office. Li Chong, from Chenliu, was poor but refused to separate from his family. He expelled his wife for suggesting division. He later killed a tomb robber and refused official posts. He was respected by General Deng Zhi but criticized him openly. He died at eighty-eight.

input_text: 由是见非于贵戚。 迁左中郎将，年八十八，为国三老。 安帝常特进见，赐以几杖。 卒于家。 缪肜字豫公，汝南召陵人也。 少孤，兄弟四人，皆同财业。 及各娶妻，诸妇遂求分异，又数有斗争之言。 肜深怀愤叹，乃掩户自挝曰： 缪肜，汝修身谨行，学圣人之法，将以齐整风俗，奈何不能正其家乎！ 弟及诸妇闻之，悉叩头谢罪，遂更为敦睦之行。 仕县为主簿。 时县令被章见考，吏皆畏惧自诬，而肜独证据其事。掠考苦毒，至乃体生虫蛆，因复传换五狱，逾涉四年，令卒以自免。 太守陇西梁湛召为决曹史。 安帝初，湛病卒官，肜送丧还陇西。 始葬，会西羌反叛，湛妻、子悉避乱它郡，肜独留不去，为起坟冢。 乃潜穿井旁以为窟室，昼则隐窜，夜则负士，及贼平而坟已立。 其妻、子意肜已死，还见大惊。 关西咸称传之，共给车马衣资，肜不受而归乡里。 辟公府，举尤异，迁中牟令。 县近京师，多权豪。肜到，诛诸奸吏及托名贵戚宾客者百有余人，威名遂行。 卒于官。
target_text: Miao Xu, from Runan, resolved family disputes by self-reflection. He defended a magistrate and built a tomb for a prefect during a rebellion. As magistrate, he executed corrupt officials and died in office. Chen Chong, from Yuzhang, was generous, paying a colleague's debts and taking blame for a missing pair of pants. He resigned when a friend was deposed and died as a censor. Lei Yi, from Yuzhang, refused gold and took blame for a colleague's crime. He later feigned madness to avoid office and died as Nandun Order.

input_text: 初署郡门下掾。 更始时，使者督行郡国，太守有事，当就斩刑，放前言曰： 今天下所以苦毒王氏，归心皇汉者，实以圣政宽仁故也。 而传车所过，未闻恩泽。 太守受诛，诚不敢言，但恐天下惶惧，各生疑变。 夫使功者不如使过，愿以身代太守之命。 遂前就斩。 使者义而赦之，由是显名。 建武六年，征为洛阳令，政有能名。 以病乞身。徙谏议大夫，数纳忠言，后以疾去。 建武末，复征不起，光武使人舆之，见于南宫云台，赐谷二千斛，遣归，除子为太子中庶子。 卒于家。 周嘉字惠文，汝南安城人也。 高祖父燕，宣帝时为郡决曹掾。 太守欲枉杀人，燕谏不听，遂杀囚而黜燕。
target_text: Fan Ran, from Chenliu, was a maverick who rejected世俗 norms. He refused to travel with a friend to avoid appearing sycophantic. He lived simply, selling divination and farming. During the party ban, he was imprisoned. He died at seventy-four, instructing a simple burial. Dai Jiu, from Kuaiji, endured brutal torture while refusing to falsely accuse a prefect. His resilience impressed the interrogator, who released him. He died of illness.

input_text: 忳曰： 汝何故数杀过客？ 对曰： 妾不得白日自诉，每夜陈冤，客辄眠不见应，不胜感恚，故杀之。 忳曰： 当为汝理此冤，勿复杀良善也。 因解衣于地，忽然不见，明旦召游徼诘问，具服罪，即收系，及同谋十余人悉伏辜。 遣吏送其丧归乡里，于是亭遂清安。 张武者，吴郡由拳人也。 父业，郡门下掾，送太守妻、子还乡里，至河内亭，盗夜劫之，业与贼战死，遂亡失尸骸。 武时年幼，不及识父。 后之太学受业，每节，常持父遗剑，至亡处祭醊，泣而还。 太守第五伦嘉其行，举孝廉。 遭母丧过毁，伤父魂灵不返，因哀恸绝命。 陆续字智初，会稽吴人也。 世为族姓。 祖父闳，字子春，建武中为尚书令。 美姿貌，喜着越布单衣，光武见而好之，自是常敕会稽郡献越布。 续幼孤，仕郡户曹史。
target_text: Zhao Bao, from Ganling, was ashamed of his eunuch relative. As prefect, he fought Xianbei invaders who captured his mother. She urged him to fight, and he did, but she was killed. He died of grief. Xiang Xu, from Hanoi, was eccentric, wearing disheveled hair and shouting. He taught disciples and later became Prime Minister of Zhao, where he was solemn. He was executed for allegedly conspiring with Zhang Jiao. Lang Fu, from Guanghan, prayed for rain by threatening self-immolation, which brought rain.

input_text: 到南阳，受业于樊英。 又游三辅，就马融通经，历年乃还。 冉好违时绝俗，为激诡之行。常慕梁伯鸾、闵仲叔之为人。 与汉中李固、河内王奂亲善，而鄙贾伟节、郭林宗焉。 奂后为考城令，境接外黄，屡遣书请冉，冉不至。 及奂迁汉阳太守，将行，冉乃与弟协步赍麦酒，于道侧设坛以待之。 冉见奂车徒骆驿，遂不自闻，惟与弟共辩论于路。 奂识其声，即下车与相揖对。 奂曰： 行路仓卒，非陈契阔之所，可共到前亭宿息，以叙分隔。 冉曰： 子前在考城，思欲相从，以贱质自绝豪友耳。 今子远适千里，会面无期，故轻行相候，以展诀别。 如其相追，将有慕贵之讥矣。 便起告违，拂衣而去。 奂瞻望弗及，冉长逝不顾。 桓帝时，以冉为莱芜长，遭母忧，不到官。 后辟太尉府，以狷急不能从俗，常佩韦于朝。 议者欲以为侍御史，因遁身逃命于梁沛之间，徒行敝服，卖卜于市。
target_text: Liu Yi, from Yingchuan, was generous, giving his car to a mourner and helping the poor. He refused office but later served as chief minister during Emperor Xian's reign. He sold his horse to bury a stranger and starved to death helping friends. Wang Lie, from Taiyuan, was known for his virtue, encouraging a thief to reform by giving him cloth. He fled to Liaodong during the Yellow Turban rebellion and died there.

input_text: 王充王符仲长统王充字仲任，会稽上虞人也，其先自魏郡元城徒焉。 充少孤，乡里称孝。 后到京师，受业太学，师事扶风班彪。 好博览而不守章句。 家贫无书，常游洛阳市肆，阅所卖书，一见辄能诵忆，遂博通众流百家之言。 后归乡里，屏居教授。 仕郡为功曹，以数谏争不合去。 充好论说，始若诡异，终有理实。 以为俗儒守文，多失其真，乃闭门潜思，绝庆吊之礼，户牖墙壁各置刀笔。著《论衡》八十五篇，二十余万言，释物类同异，正时俗嫌疑。 刺史董勤辟为从事，转治中，自免还家。 友人同郡谢夷吾上书荐充才学，肃宗特诏公车征，病不行。 年渐七十，志力衰耗，乃造《养性书》十六篇，裁节嗜欲，颐神自守。 永元中，病卒于家。 王符字节信，安定临泾人也。 少好学，有志操，与马融、窦章、张衡、崔瑗等友善。 安定俗鄙庶孽，而符无外家，为乡人所贱。 自和、安之后，世务游宦，当涂者更相荐引，而符独耿介不同于俗，以此遂不得升进。 志意蕴愤，乃隐居著书三十余篇，以讥当时失得，不欲章显其名，故号曰《潜夫论》。
target_text: Wang Chong, courtesy name Zhongren, was from Shangyu, Kuaiji, though his ancestors had moved from Yuancheng, Wei County. His father died when he was young, and he was praised for his filial piety. He studied at Taixue in the capital under Ban Biao of Fufeng. Despite his family's poverty and lack of books, he frequently visited Luoyang bookstores, memorizing texts after a single reading, which allowed him to master various schools of thought. He later returned home to teach and served as a meritorious official, but left due to disagreements with his superiors after repeatedly offering advice.

target_text: Wang Chong criticized Confucian scholars for clinging to textual details while losing deeper meanings. He secluded himself, placing writing tools throughout his home, and composed 85 chapters of "Lunheng" (over 200,000 words) to explain phenomena and correct contemporary misconceptions. Governor Dong Qin recruited him, but he resigned. His friend Xie Yiwu recommended him to the court, and Emperor Suzong issued an edict for his service, but illness prevented him from traveling. Near age seventy, with failing memory, he wrote sixteen chapters of "The Book of Cultivation of Nature" on self-discipline and spiritual preservation. He died at home during the Yongyuan period.

target_text: Wang Fu, courtesy name Xin, was from Linjing, Anding. Studious and ambitious, he befriended Ma Rong, Dou Zhang, Zhang Heng, and Cui Yuan. Because he was born to a secondary wife, his village looked down on him. During the reigns of Emperors He and An, when powerful families recommended each other for office, Wang Fu's uprightness prevented him from becoming an official. Distressed, he secluded himself and wrote over thirty books criticizing contemporary politics, calling his work "The Theory of Qianfu" to remain anonymous.

target_text: His writings denounced societal ills. He argued that officials should govern justly, as heaven loves the people, and that stealing official positions for personal gain was worse than robbery. He criticized the neglect of agriculture, noting that in Luoyang, merchants outnumbered farmers tenfold, creating widespread poverty. He condemned extravagant dress, wasteful religious practices, and lavish funerals where families spent fortunes on coffins and burials while neglecting living parents. He advocated for proper talent selection, arguing that wise men existed but were improperly used, and criticized judicial corruption where the poor could not obtain justice against wealthy officials. He opposed frequent amnesties, which he believed emboldened criminals while harming the virtuous.

input_text: 何也？ 凡敢为大奸者，才必有过于众，而能自媚于上者也。 多散诞得之财，奉以谄谀之辞，以转相驱，非有第五公之廉直，孰不为顾哉？ 论者多曰： 久不赦则奸轨炽而吏不制，宜数肆眚以解散之。 此未昭政乱之本源，不察祸福之所生也。 后度辽将军皇甫规解官归安定，乡人有以贷得雁门太守者，亦去职还家，书刺谒规。 规卧不迎，既入而问： 卿前在郡食雁美乎？ 有顷，又白王符在门。 规素闻符名，乃惊遽而起，衣不及带，屣履出迎，援符手而还，与同坐，极欢。 时人为之语曰： 徒见二千石，不如一缝掖。 言书生道义之为贵也。 符竟不仕，终于家。 仲长统字公理，山阳高平人也。 少好学，博涉书记，赡于文辞。
target_text: Wang Fu never served as an official and died at home. His contemporary Huangfu Gui famously demonstrated respect for him by rushing to greet him while ignoring a wealthy former governor, leading people to say that "a governor with two thousand stones is not worth a common man."

input_text: 年二十余，游学青、徐、并、冀之间，与交友者多异之。 并州刺史高，袁绍甥也。素贵有名，招致四方游土，士多归附。 统过，善待遇，访以当时之事。 统谓曰： 君有雄志而无雄才，好士而不能择人，所以为君深戒也。 雅自多，不纳其言，统遂去之。 无几，以并州叛，卒至于败。 并、冀之士皆以是异统。 统性俶傥，敢直言，不矜小节，默语无常，时人或谓之狂生。 每州郡命召，辄称疾不就。 常以为凡游帝王者，欲以立身扬名耳，而名不常存，人生易灭，优游偃仰，可以自娱。欲卜居清旷，以乐其志，论之曰： 使居有良田广宅，背山临流，沟池环匝，竹木周布，场圃筑前，果园树后。
target_text: Zhong Changtong was from Gaoping, Shanyang. Studious and well-read, he was considered extraordinary by his peers. When visiting Gao Gan, the governor of Bingzhou, he warned that Gao had great ambitions but insufficient talent and poor judgment in choosing associates. Gao ignored this advice and later rebelled and was defeated.

target_text: Zhong Changtong was unconventional and outspoken, earning the nickname "Kuang Sheng" (Mad Scholar). He frequently declined government summons by claiming illness. He valued personal freedom over official service, describing an ideal life of leisure with fertile land, comfortable housing, family, friends, entertainment, and philosophical contemplation. He wrote poems expressing his desire to transcend worldly concerns. Minister Xun Yu appointed him, and he later served under Prime Minister Cao Cao. He wrote "Chang Yan," consisting of 34 chapters and over 100,000 words, expressing his critical views on contemporary society. He died at age forty-one during the year Emperor Xian abdicated.

input_text: 王昌一名郎，赵国邯郸人也。 素为卜相工，明星历，常以为河北有天子气。 时赵缪王子林好奇数，任侠于赵、魏间，多通豪猾，而郎与之亲善。 初，王莽篡位，长安中或自称成帝子子舆者，莽杀之。 郎缘是诈称真子舆，云 母故成帝讴者，尝下殿卒僵，须臾有黄气从上下，半日乃解，遂妊身就馆。赵后欲害之，伪易他人子，以故得全。 子舆年十二，识命者郎中李曼卿，与俱至蜀；十七，到丹阳；二十，还长安；展转中山，来往燕、赵，以须天时 。 林等愈动疑惑，乃与赵国大豪李育、张参等通谋，规共立郎。 会人间传赤眉将度河，林等因此宣言赤眉当至，立刘子舆以观众心，百姓多信之。 更始元年十二月，林等遂率车骑数百，晨入邯郸城，止于王宫，立郎为天子。 林为丞相，李育为大司马，张参为大将军。 分遣将帅，徇下幽、冀。 移檄州郡曰： 制诏部刺史、郡太守：朕，孝成皇帝子子舆者也。 昔遭赵氏之祸，因以王莽篡杀，赖知命者将护朕躬，解形河滨，削迹赵、魏。 王莽窃位，获罪于天，天命佑汉，故使东郡太守翟义、严乡侯刘信，拥兵征讨，出入胡、汉。
target_text: Wang Chang, a prince from Handan in Zhao State, was originally a fortune-teller with knowledge of astronomy. He believed Hebei had the aura of a Son of Heaven. Liu Lin, son of King Mu of Zhao, was a chivalrous man with connections to powerful figures, and Wang Chang befriended him. After Wang Mang usurped the throne and killed a man claiming to be Liu Ziyu, son of Emperor Cheng, Wang Lang falsely claimed to be the true son. He fabricated a story about his mother, a singer who became the emperor's consort, and his escape with a doctor. Liu Lin and others, including Li Yu and Zhang Shen, conspired to support Wang Lang. In December of the first year of Gengshi, they entered Handan, made Wang Lang emperor, and appointed Liu Lin as Prime Minister, Li Yu as Grand Sima, and Zhang Shen as General. They sent proclamations to prefectures, declaring Wang Lang as Liu Ziyu and calling for support. Wang Lang's claims gained traction, and much of northern China submitted to him.

input_text: 更始即位，永先诣洛阳，绍封为梁王，都睢阳。永闻更始政乱，遂据国起兵，以弟防为辅国大将军，防弟少公御史大夫，封鲁王。 遂招诸豪杰沛人周建等，并署为将帅，攻下齐阴、山阴、沛、楚、淮阳、汝南，凡得二十八城。 又遣使拜西防贼帅山阳佼彊为横行将军。 是时，东海人董宪起兵据其郡，而张步亦定齐地。 永遣使拜宪翼汉大将军、步辅汉大将军，与共连兵，遂专据东方。 及更始败，永自称天子。 建武二年夏，光武遣虎牙大将军盖延等伐永。 初，陈留人苏茂为更始讨难将军，与朱鲔等守洛阳。 鲔既降汉，茂亦归命，光武因使茂与盖延俱攻永。军中不相能，茂遂反，杀淮阳太守，掠得数县。据广乐而臣于永。 永以茂为大司马、淮阳王。 盖延遂围睢阳，数月，拔之，永将家属走虞。
target_text: The next year, Guangwu attacked Wang Lang, besieging Julu and then Handan. Wang Lang sent Du Wei to negotiate, claiming to be the true son of Emperor Cheng, but Guangwu refused. After a 20-day siege, Li Li, Wang Lang's Shaofu, rebelled and opened the city gates. Wang Lang fled but was killed. Liu Yong, an eighth-generation grandson of King Xiao of Liang, was enfeoffed after Gengshi's ascension. He raised troops, captured 28 cities, and allied with Dong Xian and Zhang Bu. After Gengshi's failure, Liu Yong proclaimed himself emperor. Guangwu sent Gai Yan to attack Liu Yong. Su Mao, initially serving Gengshi, surrendered to Guangwu but later rebelled and joined Liu Yong. Gai Yan besieged Suiyang, capturing it, but Liu Yong fled. After several battles, Liu Yong was killed, and his son Liu Yu was briefly established as king before being defeated. Dong Xian and Pang Meng also rebelled but were eventually killed. Zhang Bu, from Langfu, gathered troops and declared himself General Wuwei. He allied with Liu Yong and later killed Fulong, Guangwu's envoy. Guangwu attacked Zhang Bu, who was defeated and surrendered, but later fled and was killed.

input_text: 今汉亦中绝，刘氏来归我，亦当立之，令尊事我。 乃使句林王将数千骑迎芳，芳与兄禽、弟程俱入匈奴。 单于遂立芳为汉帝。 以程为中郎将，将胡骑还入安定。 初，五原人李兴、随昱，朔方人田飒，代郡人石鲔、闵堪，各起兵自称将军。 建武四年，单于遣无楼且渠王入五原塞，与李兴等和亲，告兴欲令芳还汉地为帝。 五年，李兴、闵堪引兵至单于庭迎芳，与俱入塞，都九原县。 掠有五原、朔方、云中、定襄、雁门五郡，并置守令，与胡通兵，侵苦北边。 六年，芳将军贾览将胡骑击杀代郡太守刘兴。 芳后以事诛其五原太守李兴兄弟，而其朔方太守田飒、云中太守桥扈恐惧，叛芳，举郡降，光武令领职如故。 后大司马吴汉、骠骑大将军杜茂数击芳，并不克。 十二年，芳与贾览共攻云中，久不下，其将随昱留守九原，欲胁芳降。 芳知羽翼外附，心膂内离，遂弃辎重，与十余骑亡入匈奴，其众尽归随昱。 昱乃随使者程恂诣阙。拜昱为五原太守，封镌胡侯，昱弟宪武进侯。 十六年，芳复入居高柳，与闵堪兄林使使请降。 乃立芳为代王，堪为代相，林为代太傅，赐缯二万匹，因使和集匈奴。 芳上疏谢曰： 臣芳过托先帝遗体，弃在边陲。社稷遭王莽废绝，以是子孙之忧，所宜共诛，故遂西连羌戎，北怀匈奴。 单于不忘旧德，权立救助，是时兵革并起，往往而在。 臣非敢有所贪觊，期于奉承宗庙，兴立社稷，是以久僣号位，十有余年，罪宜万死。
target_text: Li Xian, from Xuchang, declared himself King of Huainan and later emperor. Guangwu attacked and captured Shu County, leading to Li Xian's death. Peng Chong, from Wan County, served as a county official and later fled to Yuyang. He supported Guangwu but became resentful when his rewards were insufficient. He rebelled, attacked Zhufu, and allied with the Xiongnu. He declared himself King of Yan but was killed by his servants. Lu Fang, from Sanshui, falsely claimed to be Liu Wenbo, a descendant of Emperor Wu. He allied with the Xiongnu and declared himself emperor. He fought with Guangwu's forces but eventually surrendered, though he later rebelled again and died among the Xiongnu. The historian comments that the Liu family's legacy endured due to the deep kindness of Gaozu and Xiaowen, and that the rebels like Wang, Liu, Zhang, Li, Peng, and Lu merely took advantage of the situation without true foresight or strategy.

input_text: 班彪字叔皮，扶风安陵人也。 祖况，成帝时为越骑校尉。 父稚，哀帝时为广平太守。 彪性沈重好古。 年二十馀，更始败，三辅大乱。 时隗嚣拥众天水，彪乃避难从之。 嚣问彪曰 往者周亡，战国并争，天下分裂，数世然后定。 意者从横之事复起于今乎。将承运迭兴，在于一人也。 愿生试论之 对曰 周之废兴，与汉殊异。 昔周爵五等，诸侯从政，本根既微，枝叶强大，故其末流有从横之事，势数然也。 汉承秦制，改立郡县，主有专已之威，臣无百年之柄。
target_text: Ban Biao, courtesy name Shupi, was born in Anling, Fufeng. His grandfather Ban Kuang served as a captain of the Yue Cavalry School, and his father Ban Zhi was prefect of Guangping. Ban Biao had a serious personality and valued traditional culture. In his twenties, during the chaos following Gengshi's defeat, he followed Wei Xiao to Tianshui. When Wei Xiao asked whether the Warring States period's vertical and horizontal alliances would recur or if a single ruler would unify the realm, Ban Biao explained that the Zhou Dynasty's feudal system led to weak central control and allowed such alliances, while the Han Dynasty's prefecture and county system centralized power. He argued that the Han's decline stemmed from above, not below, and that after Wang Mang's usurpation, people longed for the Han, leading to widespread uprisings under the Liu family banner. Wei Xiao disagreed, citing the Qin collapse as an unpredictable event. Ban Biao, disturbed by Wei Xiao's arrogance, wrote "On the King's Mandate" to argue that Han virtue succeeded Tang Yao, but Wei Xiao remained unmoved, so Ban Biao fled to Hexi.

input_text: 及融征还京师，光武问曰 所上章奏，谁与参之 融对曰 皆从事班彪所为 帝雅闻彪才，因召入见，举司隶茂才，拜徐令，以病免。 后数应三公之命，辄去。 彪既才高而好述作，遂专心史籍之间。 武帝时，司马迁著《史记》，自太初以后，阙而不录，后好事者颇或缀集时事，然多鄙俗，不足以踵继其书。 彪乃继采前史遗事，傍贯异闻，作后传数十篇，因斟酌前史而讥正得失。
target_text: There, Dou Rong employed him as an official, treating him with great respect. Ban Biao advised Dou Rong to serve the Han and resist Wei Xiao. When Dou Rong returned to the capital, Emperor Guangwu learned of Ban Biao's role and summoned him, promoting him to Secretary Maocai and appointing him as Order of Xuzhou, though illness prevented him from taking the post. Ban Biao later served under the Three Dukes.

input_text: 及融征还京师，光武问曰 所上章奏，谁与参之 融对曰 皆从事班彪所为 帝雅闻彪才，因召入见，举司隶茂才，拜徐令，以病免。 后数应三公之命，辄去。 彪既才高而好述作，遂专心史籍之间。 武帝时，司马迁著《史记》，自太初以后，阙而不录，后好事者颇或缀集时事，然多鄙俗，不足以踵继其书。 彪乃继采前史遗事，傍贯异闻，作后传数十篇，因斟酌前史而讥正得失。
target_text: Ban Biao was talented in writing and focused on historical records. After Sima Qian's "Historical Records," no comprehensive history existed for the period after Taichu. Ban Biao collected historical materials and wrote dozens of later biographies, critiquing their merits and flaws. He noted that various states had their own histories, such as "Mu Shou Chu," "Cheng," and "Spring and Autumn." He praised Sima Qian's narrative skill but criticized his bias toward Huang-Lao thought, neglect of the Five Classics, and superficial discussions. Ban Biao emphasized the need for strict factual verification and stylistic consistency in history writing.

input_text: 汉兴，太宗使晁错导太子以法术，贾谊教梁王以《诗》、《书》。及至中宗，亦令刘向、王褒、萧望之、周堪之徒，以文章儒学保训东宫以下，莫不崇简其人，就成德器。 今皇太子诸王，虽结发学问，修习礼乐，而傅相未值贤才，官属多阙旧典。 宜博选名儒有威重明通政事者，以为太子太傅，东宫及诸王国，备置官属。 又旧制，太子食汤沐十县，设周卫交戟，五日一朝，因坐东箱，省视膳食，其非朝日，使仆、中允旦旦请问而已，明不媟黩，广其敬也。 书奏，帝纳之。 后察司徒廉为望都长，吏民爱之。 建武三十年，年五十二，卒官。 所著赋、论、书、记、奏事合九篇。
target_text: Ban Biao also advised on the selection of tutors for princes, citing historical examples like King Cheng of Zhou and the Han's use of scholars like Chao Cuo and Jia Yi. He recommended choosing prestigious Confucian scholars as tutors and ensuring proper staffing for the Eastern Palace and other kingdoms. The emperor accepted his advice. Ban Biao later served as commander of the capital under Situ Lian, beloved by officials and people. He died in office at age 52, leaving nine works including fu, treatises, and memorials.

input_text: 主人喟然而叹曰 痛乎风俗之移人也。 子实秦人，矜夸馆室，保界河山，信识昭、襄而知始皇矣，恶睹大汉之云为乎。 夫大汉之开原也，奋布衣以登皇极，繇数期而创万世，盖六籍所不能谈，前圣靡得而言焉。 当此之时，功有横而当天，讨有逆而顺人，故娄敬度势而献其说，萧公权宜以拓其制。时岂泰而安之哉。计不得以已也。吾子曾不是睹，顾燿后嗣之末造，不亦暗乎。今将语子以建武之理，永平之事，监乎太清，以变子之或志。
target_text: Ban Gu, courtesy name Meng Jian, was a precocious scholar who could compose sentences and recite poems at age nine. As an adult, he mastered classical texts and philosophical schools without adhering to a single teacher, focusing on general principles rather than textual minutiae. He was generous and unassuming, earning admiration from fellow Confucians.

input_text: 往者王莽作逆，汉祚中缺，天人致诛，六合相灭。 于时之乱，生民几亡，鬼神泯绝，壑无完柩，郛罔遗室，原野厌人之肉，川谷流人之血，秦、项之灾犹不克半，书契已来未之或纪也。故下民号而上诉，上帝怀而降鉴，致命于圣皇。 于是圣皇乃握乾符，阐坤珍，披皇图，稽帝文，赫尔发愤，应若兴云，霆发昆阳，凭怒雷震。遂超大河，跨北岳，立号高邑，建都河洛。 绍百王之荒屯，因造化之荡涤，体元立制，继天而作。系唐统，接汉绪，茂育群生，恢复疆宇，勋兼乎在昔，事勤乎三五。 岂特方轨并迹，纷纷后辟，理近古之所务，蹈一圣之险易云尔哉。 且夫建武之元，天地革命，四海之内，更造夫妇，肇有父子，君臣初建，人伦实始，斯乃虙羲氏之所以基皇德也。 分州土，立市朝，作舟车，造器械，斯轩辕氏之所以开帝功也。 龚行天罚，应天顺人，斯乃汤、武之所以昭王业也。迁都改邑，有殷宗中兴之则焉。 即土之中，有周成隆平之制焉。 不阶尺土一人之柄，同符乎高祖。 克己复礼，以奉终始，允恭乎孝文。 宪章稽古，封岱勒成，仪炳乎世宗。 案《六经》而校德，妙古昔而论功，仁圣之事既该，帝王之道备矣。
target_text: During the early Yongping era, King Cang of Dongping, serving as a general, opened the East Pavilion to recruit talents. Twenty-year-old Ban Gu addressed him, praising his extraordinary achievements and urging him to emulate ancient sage-kings in selecting virtuous officials. Ban Gu recommended six exceptional individuals: a retired Confucian elder, Jingzhao wine-offerer Jin Feng, Fufeng scholar Li Yu, Jingzhao governor Guo Ji, Jingzhou officer Wang Yong, and Hongnong clerk Yin Su. He emphasized the importance of recognizing talent without bias, citing historical examples like Bian He and Qu Yuan to warn against neglecting worthy men. King Cang adopted his advice.

input_text: 至于永平之际，重熙而累洽，盛三雍之上仪，修衮龙之法服，敷洪藻，信景铄，扬世庙，正矛乐。 人神之和允洽，君臣之序既肃。 乃动大路，遵皇衢，省方巡狩，穷览万国之有无，考声教之所被，散皇明以烛幽。 然后增周旧，修洛邑，翩翩巍巍，显显翼翼，光汉京于诸夏，总八方而为之极。 是时，圣上固已垂精游神，包举艺文，屡访群儒，谕咨做老，与之乎斟酌道德之渊源，肴核仁义之林薮，以望元符之臻焉。 既成群后之谠辞，又悉经五繇之硕虑矣。 将絣万嗣，炀洪晖，奋景炎，扇遗风，播芳烈，久而愈新，用而不竭，汪汪乎丕天之大律，其畴能亘之哉。 唐哉皇哉，皇哉唐哉。 固后以母丧去官。
target_text: After his father Ban Biao died, Ban Gu sought to complete his father's incomplete historical work. However, he was accused of secretly altering national history and imprisoned. His brother Ban Chao successfully petitioned the emperor, explaining Ban Gu's intentions. Ban Gu was subsequently promoted to court positions and tasked with writing about heroes and compiling historical records. He authored the *Book of Han*, covering 230 years from Emperor Gaozu to Wang Mang's death, completing it over twenty years. The work was highly regarded by contemporaries.

input_text: 永元初，大将军窦宪出征匈奴，以固为中护军，与参议。 北单于闻汉军出，遣使款居延塞，欲修呼韩邪故事，朝见天子，请大使。 宪上遣固行中郎将事，将数百骑与虏使俱出居延塞迎之。 会南匈奴掩破北庭，固至私渠海，闻虏中乱，引还。 及窦宪败，固先坐免官。 固不教学诸子，诸子多不遵法度，吏人苦之。 初，洛阳令种兢尝行，固奴干其车骑，吏椎呼之，奴醉骂，兢大怒，畏宪不敢发，心衔之。 及窦氏宾客皆逮考，兢因此捕系固，遂死狱中。 时年六十一。 诏以谴责兢，抵主者吏罪。 固所著《典引》、《宾戏》、《应讥》、诗、赋、铭、诔、颂、书、文、记、论、议、六言，在者凡四十一篇。
target_text: Ban Gu later served under General Dou Xian during campaigns against the Xiongnu, acting as a counselor and envoy. After Dou Xian's downfall, Ban Gu was dismissed. He failed to discipline his sons, who often broke laws. A grudge held by Luoyang magistrate Zhong Jing, stemming from an incident with Ban Gu's drunken slaves, led to Ban Gu's arrest and death in prison at age sixty-one. The court later condemned Zhong Jing. Ban Gu's writings, including various literary forms, comprised forty-one works.

input_text: 班超子勇梁慬何熙班超字仲升，扶风平陵人，徐令彪之少子也。 为人有大志，不修细节。 然内孝谨，居家常执勤苦，不耻劳辱。 有口辩，而涉猎书传。 永平五年，兄固被召诣校书郎，超与母随至洛阳。 家贫，常为官佣书以供养。 久劳苦，尝辍业投笔叹曰： 大丈夫无它志略，犹当效傅介子、张骞立功异域，以取封侯，安能久事笔研间乎？ 左右皆笑之。 超曰： 小子安知壮士志哉！ 其后行诣相者，曰： 祭酒，布衣诸生耳，而当封侯万里之外。 超问其状。相者指曰： 生燕颔虎颈，飞而食肉，此万里侯相也。 久之，显宗问固： 卿弟安在？ 固对： 为官写书，受直以养老母。 帝乃除超为兰台令史。 后坐事免官。
target_text: Ban Chao, courtesy name Zhong Sheng, was from Pingling County, Fufeng, and the youngest son of Ban Biao. Ambitious and diligent, he supported his mother by copying documents. In the fifth year of Yongping, he followed his brother Ban Gu to Luoyang. Dissatisfied with clerical work, he aspired to emulate Fu Jiezi and Zhang Qian in foreign exploits. A fortune-teller predicted he would become a marquis. Emperor Xianzong appointed him Lantai Lingshi, but he was later dismissed.

input_text: 超于是召鄯善王广，以虏使首示之，一国震怖。 超晓告抚慰，遂纳子为质。 还奏于窦固，固大喜，具上超功效，并求更选使使西域，帝壮超节，诏固曰： 吏如班超，何故不遣而更选乎？ 今以超为军司马，令遂前功。 超复受使，固欲益其兵，超曰： 愿将本所从三十余人足矣。 如有不虞，多益为累。 是时，于窴王广德新攻破莎车，遂雄张南道，而匈奴遣使监护其国，超既西，先至于窴。广德礼意甚疏。 且其俗信巫。 巫言： 神怒何故欲向汉？ 汉使有騧马，急求取以祠我。 广德乃遣使就超请马。 超密知其状，报许之，而令巫自来取马。 有顷，巫至，超即斩其首以送广德，因辞让之。 广德素闻超在鄯善诛灭虏使，大惶恐，即攻杀匈奴使者而降超。 超重赐其王以下，因镇抚焉。
target_text: In the 16th year of Yongping, Ban Chao served as a fake Sima under Dou Gu, attacking the Xiongnu at Puleihai. Dou Gu then sent him as an envoy to the Western Regions. In Shanshan, Ban Chao deduced that the Huns had arrived when King Guang's hospitality waned. He interrogated a servant, confirmed his suspicion, and gathered his 36 men. At night, he led a fire attack on the Hun camp, killing the envoy and over 30 followers, with 100 burned to death. King Guang, impressed, sent his son as a hostage. Ban Chao reported to Dou Gu, who recommended him to Emperor Ming. Appointed Army Sima, Ban Chao refused extra troops, retaining only his original 36 men.

input_text: 以乌孙兵强，宜历其力，乃上言： 乌孙大国，控弦十万，故武帝妻以公主，至孝宣皇帝，卒得其用。 今可遣使招慰，与共合力。 帝纳之。 八年，拜超为将兵长史，假鼓吹幢麾。 以徐为军司马，别遣卫侯李邑护送乌孙使者，赐大小昆弥以下锦帛。 李邑始到于窴，而值龟兹攻疏勒，恐惧不敢前，因上书陈西域之功不可成，又盛毁超拥爱妻，抱爱子，安乐外国，无内顾心。 超闻之，叹曰： 身非曾参而有三至之谗，恐见疑于当时矣。 遂去其妻。 帝知超忠，乃切责邑曰： 纵超拥爱妻，抱爱子，思归之士千余人，何能尽与超同心乎？
target_text: In Yutian, Ban Chao killed a wizard who demanded his horse, shocking King Guangde into submitting. In Shule, he captured the usurper Douti, installed King Zhong, and released Douti to show prestige. After Emperor Ming's death, Ban Chao faced isolation but held Shule with minimal forces. Recalled by Emperor Suzong, he was persuaded by the people to stay, defeating rebels and stabilizing Shule. In the third year of Jianchu, he led 10,000 troops to capture Gumo, then petitioned for reinforcements to conquer Qiuci, proposing to use local forces and resources. The emperor approved, sending Xu Qian with 1,000 men. Ban Chao defeated Fan Chen, and later, despite slander from Li Yi, he remained loyal, leaving his wife to prove his commitment.

input_text: 初，月氏尝助汉击车师有功，是岁贡奉珍宝、符拔、师子，因求汉公主。 超拒还其使，由是怨恨。 永元二年，月氏遣其副王谢将兵七万攻超。 超众少，皆大恐。 超譬军士曰： 月氏兵虽多，然数千里逾葱领来，非有运输，何足忧邪？ 但当收谷坚守，彼饥穷自降，不过数十日决矣。 谢遂前攻超，不下，又抄掠无所得。 超度其粮将尽，必从龟兹求救，乃遣兵数百于东界要之。 谢果遣骑赍金银珠玉以赂龟兹。 超伏兵庶击，尽杀之，持其使首以示谢。 谢大惊，即遣使请罪，愿得生归。 超纵遣之。月氏由是大震，岁奉贡献。 明年，龟兹、姑墨、温宿皆降，乃以超为都护，徐为长史。拜白霸为龟兹王，遣司马姚光送之。 超与光共胁龟兹废其王尤利多而立白霸，使光将尤利多还诣京师。 超居龟兹它乾城，徐屯疏勒。 西域唯焉耆、危须、尉犁以前没都护，怀二心，其余悉定。 六年秋，超遂发龟兹、鄯善等八国兵合七万人，及吏士贾客千四百人讨焉耆。 兵到尉犁界，而遣晓说焉耆、尉犁、危须曰： 都护来者，欲镇抚三国。
target_text: Ban Chao conquered Shadong, killed the treacherous King Zhong, and opened the southern route. In a major battle, he feigned retreat, then attacked Shadong at dawn, killing 5,000 and securing surrender. Yuezhi attacked but were repelled due to supply issues. By the third year of Yongyuan, Qiuci, Gumo, and Wensu submitted. Ban Chao became Protector General, stationed in Tagancheng. In the sixth year, he led 70,000 troops to attack Yanqi, capturing and executing King Guang and others, pacifying over 50 states. He was granted the title Marquis of Dingyuan.

input_text: 妾愚戆不知大义，触犯忌讳。 书奏，帝感其言，乃征超还。 超在西域三十一岁。 十四年八月至洛阳，拜为射声校尉。 超素有胸胁疾，既至，病遂加。帝遣中黄门问疾，赐医药。 其年九月卒，年七十一。 朝廷愍惜焉，使者吊祭，赠赗甚厚。 子雄嗣。 初，超被征，以戊己校尉任尚为都护。与超交代。尚谓超曰： 君侯在外国三十余年，而小人猥承君后，任重虑浅，宜有以诲之。 超曰： 年老失智，任君数当大位，岂班超所能及哉！ 必不得已，愿进愚言。 塞外吏士，本非孝子顺孙，皆以罪过徙补边屯。 而蛮夷怀鸟兽之心，难养易败。 今君性严急，水清无大鱼，察政不得下和。 宜荡佚简易，宽小过，总大纲而已。
target_text: Aged and homesick, Ban Chao petitioned to return, citing his long service. His sister Ban Zhao also pleaded. In the 14th year of Yongyuan, he returned to Luoyang, dying at 71. His son Ban Xiong inherited his title. Ban Chao's advice to successor Ren Shang—to be lenient—was ignored, leading to rebellion.

input_text: 二年，勇上请攻元孟，于是遗敦煌太守张朗将河西四郡兵三千人配勇。 因发诸国兵四万余人，分骑为两道击之。 勇从南道，朗从北道，约期俱至焉耆。 而朗先有罪，欲徼功自赎，遂先期至爵离关，遣司马将兵前战，首虏二千余人。 元孟惧诛，逆遣使乞降，张朗径入焉耆受降而还。 元孟竟不肯面缚，惟遣子诣阙贡献。 朗遂得免诛。 勇以后期，征下狱，免。后卒于家。 梁字伯威，北地弋居人也。 父讽，历州宰。 永元元年，车骑将军窦宪出征匈奴，除讽为军司马，令先赍金帛使北单于，宣国威德，其归附者万余人。 后坐失宪意，髡输武威，武威太守承旨杀之。 窦氏既灭，和帝知其为宪所诬，征，除为郎中。 有勇气，常慷慨好功名。 初为车骑将军邓鸿司马，再迁，延平元年拜西域副校尉。 行至河西，会西域诸国反叛，攻都护任尚于疏勒。 尚上书求救，诏将河西四郡羌胡五千骑驰赴之，未至而尚已得解。 会征尚还，以骑都尉段禧为都护，西域长史赵博为骑都尉。 禧、博守它乾城。 它乾城小，以为不可固，乃谲说龟兹王白霸，欲入共保其城，白霸许之。 吏人固谏，白霸不听，懂既入，遣将急迎禧、博，合军八九千人。 龟兹吏人并叛其王，而与温宿、姑墨数万兵反，共围城。
target_text: Ban Yong, Ban Chao's son, served as an army commander. In the first year of Yongchu, he helped withdraw Han forces from the Western Regions. Later, he advised against a costly campaign, recommending a modest garrison in Dunhuang. His strategy was adopted, stabilizing the region. In the second year of Yanguang, he led 500 soldiers to Liuzhong, securing Shanshan and Qiuci's submission. He defeated the Xiongnu and pacified Cheshi. In Yongjian's first year, he attacked Yanqi but was imprisoned for missing a rendezvous, later dying at home.
