target_text: After nine months, a general amnesty allowed his return, but he fled to Wuhui after offending Wang Zhi. He lived in Wu for twelve years, once crafting a famous "Jiaowei Qin" from a burnt tung tree. In the sixth year of Zhongping, Dong Zhuo forced him into service, promoting him rapidly. Cai Yong advised Dong Zhuo against excessive honors but grew disillusioned with his tyranny. After Dong Zhuo's execution, Cai Yong expressed regret, angering Wang Yun, who imprisoned him. Despite pleas from scholars like Ma Rishidan, Wang Yun executed him, fearing his historical writings would slander the court. Cai Yong died at sixty-one, mourned by many. His works included poems, inscriptions, and 104 other pieces, though much was lost in chaos. The historian noted his tragic fate, bound by loyalty and circumstance.

input_text: 闻者皆惭。 诩又上言： 台郎显职，仕之通阶。今或一郡七八，或一州无人。宜令均平，以厌天下之望。 及诸奏议，多见从用。 诩好刺举，无所回容，数以此忤权戚，遂九见谴考，三遭刑罚，而刚正之性，终老不屈。永和初，迁尚书令，以公事去官。朝廷思其忠，复征之，会卒。 临终，谓其子恭曰： 吾事君直道，行己无愧，所悔者为朝歌长时杀贼数百人，其中何能不有冤者。自此二十余年，家门不增一口，斯获罪于天也。 恭有俊才，官至上党太守。 傅燮字南容，北地灵州人也。 本字幼起，慕南容三复白珪，乃易字焉。 身长八尺，有威容。 少师事太尉刘宽。再举孝廉。 闻所举郡将丧，乃弃官行服。 后为护军司马，与左中郎将皇甫嵩俱讨贼张角。 燮素疾中官，既行，因上疏曰：臣闻天下之祸，不由于外，皆兴于内。
target_text: Yu Xu, from Wuping in Chen, was known for his integrity. His grandfather, a prison officer, handled cases with compassion. Yu Xu was orphaned young and cared for his grandmother, refusing an official post until after her death. He later served as a doctor. When General Deng Zhi proposed abandoning Liangzhou due to Qiang rebellions, Yu Xu argued against it, stating it would expose the imperial tombs and that Liangzhou's people were a vital defense. He suggested controlling local leaders by giving their sons official posts to prevent rebellion. Deng Zhi, resentful of Yu Xu's opposition, sent him to govern Chaoge, a bandit-ridden area. Yu Xu used deception, recruiting former bandits to ambush others and marking thieves' clothes with silk threads, leading to their dispersal. Promoted to Wudu's prefect, he again used deception against the Qiang, increasing his campfires to feign strength and marching rapidly. He then used a strategy of weak arrows to lure the Qiang into range of his strong crossbows, defeating them. He improved the county by building fortifications, opening waterways for transport, and increasing the population. As Sili Xiaowei, he impeached powerful officials, earning their hatred. He was framed and sentenced to hard labor, but eunuch Sun Cheng defended him, leading to his release and promotion. He later abolished the practice of "righteous money" and argued for fair treatment of petitioners. He remained upright despite nine reprimands and three punishments, dying as Shangshu Ling. On his deathbed, he regretted killing many bandits at Chaoge, believing it brought divine punishment.

input_text: 书奏，宦者赵忠见而忿恶。 及破张角，燮功多当封，忠诉谮之，灵帝犹识燮言，得不加罪，竟亦不封，以为安定都尉。 以疾免。 后拜议郎。 会西羌反，边章、韩遂作乱陇右，征发天下。 役赋无已。司徒崔烈以为宜弃凉州。 诏会公卿百官，烈坚执先议。 燮厉言曰： 斩司徒，天下乃安。 尚书郎杨赞奏燮廷辱大臣。 帝以问燮。 燮对曰：昔冒顿至逆也，樊哙为上将，愿得十万众横行匈奴中，愤激思奋，未失人臣之节，顾计当从与不耳，季布犹曰 哙可斩也。 今凉州天下要冲，国家籓卫。 高祖初兴，使郦商别定陇右；宗世拓境，列置四郡，议者以为断匈奴右臂。 今牧御失和，使一州叛逆，海内为之骚动，陛下卧不安寝。
target_text: Fu Xie, from Lingzhou, was known for his caution in speech and action. He served as Sima under Huangfu Song against Zhang Jiao's Yellow Turbans. Before the campaign, he warned the emperor that the real threat was internal, from eunuchs like Zhao Zhong, and that evil and good cannot coexist. Despite his merits, Zhao Zhong framed him, but the emperor spared him. Later, when Situ Cui Lie proposed abandoning Liangzhou during a Xiqiang rebellion, Fu Xie vehemently opposed him, arguing that Liangzhou was the empire's shield and that abandoning it would empower the barbarians. The emperor agreed. Fu Xie refused to curry favor with the powerful eunuch Zhao Zhong, even when offered a marquisate. As Hanyang's governor, he pacified the Qiang. He warned Governor Geng Bi against attacking Han Sui with untrained troops, predicting disaster. Geng Bi ignored him and was killed. When Hanyang was besieged, Fu Xie refused to abandon the city despite his son's pleas and the offer of safe passage from grateful Hu cavalry. He chose to die in battle, cursing a defecting official. His posthumous title was Zhuangjiehou.

input_text: 时，武威太守倚恃权势，恣行贪横，从事武都苏正和案致其罪。 凉州刺史梁鹄畏惧贵戚，欲杀正和以免其负，乃访之于勋。 勋素与正和有仇，或劝勋可因此报隙。 勋曰： 不可。 谋事杀良，非忠也；乘人之危，非仁也。 乃谏鹄曰： 夫绁食鹰鸢欲其鸷，鸷而亨之，将何用哉？ 鹄从其言。 正和喜于得免，而诣勋求谢。 勋不见，曰： 吾为梁使君谋，不为苏正和也。 怨之如初。 中平元年，北地羌胡与边章等寇乱陇右，刺史左昌因军兴新盗数千万。 勋固谏，昌怒，乃使勋别屯阿阳以拒贼锋，欲因军事罪之，而勋数有战功。 边章等遂攻金城，杀郡守陈懿，勋劝昌救之，不从。 边章等进围昌于冀，昌惧而召勋。 勋初与从事辛曾、孔常俱屯阿阳，及昌檄到，曾等疑不肯赴。 勋怒曰： 昔庄贾后期，穰苴奋剑。 今之从事，岂重于古之监军哉！ 曾等惧而从之。 勋即率兵救昌。 到，乃诮让章等，责以背叛之罪。 皆曰： 左使君若早从君言，以兵临我，庶可自改。今罪已重，不得降也。 乃解围而去。 昌坐断盗征，以扶风宋枭代之。 枭患多寇叛，谓勋曰： 凉州寡于学术，故屡致反暴。
target_text: Gai Xun, from Dunhuang, was a Xiaolian and Hanyang's chief historian. He refused to take revenge on an enemy, Su Zhenghe, when the governor wanted to kill him to cover for a corrupt prefect, arguing it was wrong to kill a good man. He later remonstrated with Governor Zuo Chang for embezzling funds, but Zuo Chang sent him to a dangerous post. Gai Xun survived and later rescued Zuo Chang from a siege by Bian Zhang. He criticized Governor Song Xiao's plan to teach the *Classic of Filial Piety* to pacify the border, calling it impractical. During a battle against Qiang rebels, he was wounded but refused to flee, cursing his captors. The Qiang, respecting his courage, released him. As a famine relief official, he used his own grain to save over a thousand people. Summoned by Emperor Ling, he blamed eunuchs for the world's chaos. He planned with Liu Yu and Yuan Shao to kill the eunuchs, but was made Jing Zhaoyin instead. There, he prosecuted a corrupt official despite pleas from nobles. After Emperor Ling's death, he wrote to Dong Zhuo, criticizing his deposition of the young emperor. He openly defied Dong Zhuo in court, refusing to bow. He died of illness at 51, refusing Dong Zhuo's funeral gifts.

input_text: 洪亲见将军呼张陈留为兄，则洪府君亦宜为弟，而不能同心戮力，为国除害，坐拥兵众，观人屠灭。 惜洪力劣，不能推刃为天下报仇，何谓服乎？ 绍本爱洪，意欲屈服赦之，见其辞切，知终不为用，乃命杀焉。 洪邑人陈容，少为诸生，亲慕于洪，随为东郡丞。 先城未败，洪使归绍。 时，容在坐，见洪当死，起谓绍曰： 将军举大事，欲为天下除暴，而专先诛忠义，岂合天意？ 臧洪发举为郡将，奈何杀之！ 绍惭，使人牵出，谓曰： 汝非臧洪畴，空复尔为？ 容顾曰： 夫仁义岂有常所，蹈之则君子，背之则小人。 今日宁与臧洪同日死，不与将军同日生也。 遂复见杀。 比还，城已陷，皆赴敌死。 论曰：雍丘之围，臧洪之感愤壮矣！想其行跣且号，束甲请举，诚足怜也。
target_text: Zang Hong, from Guangling, was made a Dong Zilang due to his father's military merits. After Dong Zhuo killed the emperor, Zang Hong urged Prefect Zhang Chao to raise an army. He helped organize an alliance at Suanzao, where he gave a passionate oath, calling for the destruction of Dong Zhuo. The alliance, however, failed to act decisively. Later, Zang Hong served Yuan Shao as Qingzhou's governor, pacifying the region. When Cao Cao besieged Zhang Chao, Zang Hong begged Yuan Shao for troops to rescue him, but Yuan Shao refused. Zhang Chao was killed. Enraged, Zang Hong broke with Yuan Shao, who then besieged him. Despite a letter from Chen Lin urging surrender, Zang Hong refused, accusing Yuan Shao of betraying allies and killing loyal men. He stated he would rather die for righteousness. During the siege, he shared his last food with his soldiers and even killed his concubine to feed them. The city fell, and Zang Hong was captured. He defiantly cursed Yuan Shao for his treachery and was executed. His subordinate Chen Rong also chose to die with him.

input_text: 袁安字邵公，汝南汝阳人也。 祖父良，习《孟氏易》，平帝时举明经，为太子舍人；建武初，至成武令。 安少传良学。 为人严重有威，见敬于州里。 初为县功曹，奉檄诣从事，从事因安致书于令。安曰： 公事自有邮驿，私请则非功曹所持。 辞不肯受，从事惧然而止。 后举孝廉，除阴平长、任城令，所在吏人畏而爱之。 永平十三年，楚王英谋为逆，事下郡复考。 明年，三府举安能理剧，拜楚郡太守。 是时英辞所连及系者数千人，显宗怒甚，吏案之急，迫痛自诬，死者甚众。 安到郡，不入府，先往案狱，理其无明验者，条上出之。 府丞掾史皆叩头争，以为阿附反虏，法与同罪，不可。 安曰： 如有不合，太守自当坐之，不以相及也。
target_text: Yuan An, courtesy name Shaogong, was from Ruyang County in Runan. He inherited his grandfather Yuan Liang's knowledge of the *Book of Changes*. A dignified and authoritative man respected by his state, he began his career as a county magistrate. When a superior asked him to deliver a private letter, Yuan An refused, stating that official business should use official channels and private matters should not seek merit through him. He was later recommended as Xiaolian and served as magistrate of Yinping and Rencheng counties, where officials and people respected him.

input_text: 袁安字邵公，汝南汝阳人也。 祖父良，习《孟氏易》，平帝时举明经，为太子舍人；建武初，至成武令。 安少传良学。 为人严重有威，见敬于州里。 初为县功曹，奉檄诣从事，从事因安致书于令。安曰： 公事自有邮驿，私请则非功曹所持。 辞不肯受，从事惧然而止。 后举孝廉，除阴平长、任城令，所在吏人畏而爱之。 永平十三年，楚王英谋为逆，事下郡复考。 明年，三府举安能理剧，拜楚郡太守。 是时英辞所连及系者数千人，显宗怒甚，吏案之急，迫痛自诬，死者甚众。 安到郡，不入府，先往案狱，理其无明验者，条上出之。 府丞掾史皆叩头争，以为阿附反虏，法与同罪，不可。 安曰： 如有不合，太守自当坐之，不以相及也。
target_text: In the twelfth year of Yongping, when King Liu Ying of Chu conspired to rebel, Yuan An was appointed prefect of Chu County to handle the case. Thousands were imprisoned due to confessions, and investigators tortured many to death. Yuan An went directly to the prison, tried those without clear evidence, and reported them for release. Despite officials arguing that associates of Liu Ying were equally guilty, Yuan An took full responsibility. The emperor agreed, and over 400 families were freed.

input_text: 且汉故事，供给南单于费直岁一亿九十余万，西域岁七千四百八十万。 今北庭弥远，其费过倍，是乃空尽天下，而非建策之要也。 诏下其议，安又与宪更相难折。 宪险急负势，言辞骄讦，至诋毁安，称光武诛韩歆、戴涉故事，安终不移。 宪竟立匈奴降者右鹿蠡王於除鞬为单于，后遂反叛，卒和安策。 安以天子幼弱，外戚擅权，每朝会进见，及与公卿言国家事，未尝不噫呜流涕。 自天子及大臣皆恃赖之。 四年春，薨，朝廷痛惜焉。 后数月，窦氏败，帝始亲万机，追思前议者邪正之节，乃除安子赏为郎。 子孙之盛，不亦宜乎？ 张字孟侯，汝南细阳人，赵王张敖之后也。 敖子寿，封细阳之池阳乡，后废，因家焉。 少从祖父充受《尚书》，能传其业，又事太常桓荣。 勤力不怠，聚徒以百数。 永平九年，显宗为四姓小侯开学于南宫，置《五经》师。 以《尚书》教授，数讲于御前，以论难当意，除为郎，赐车马衣裳，遂令入授皇太子。 为人质直，守经义，每侍讲间隙，数有匡正之辞，以严见惮。 及肃宗即位，擢为侍中、虎贲中郎将。 数月，出为东郡太守。 自以尝经亲近，未悟见出，意不自得，上疏辞曰： 臣愚以经术给事左右，少不更职，不晓文法，猥当剖符典郡，班政千里，必有负恩辱位之咎。 臣窃私自分，殊不虑出城阙，冀蒙留恩，托备冗官，群僚所不安，耳目所闻见，不敢避好丑。
target_text: Yuan An later served as Henan Yin for ten years, maintaining strict but fair governance with no bribery cases. He believed officials should aspire to be prime ministers or prefects, not imprison talented people. He was promoted to imperial servant, then to Sikong and later Situ. When Emperor He ascended as a child, Empress Dowager Dou ruled. Her brother Dou Xian attacked the Xiongnu without provocation. Yuan An and others repeatedly advised against this costly policy, but their memorials were withheld. Yuan An also impeached Dou Jing for illegally mobilizing border troops. When Dou Xian wanted to appoint a surrendered Xiongnu king as Northern Chanyu, Yuan An argued against it, warning it would empty the treasury and break faith with the Southern Chanyu. Dou Xian proceeded anyway, but the appointee soon rebelled as Yuan An predicted. Yuan An died in the spring of four years, deeply mourned by court officials.

input_text: 且汉故事，供给南单于费直岁一亿九十余万，西域岁七千四百八十万。 今北庭弥远，其费过倍，是乃空尽天下，而非建策之要也。 诏下其议，安又与宪更相难折。 宪险急负势，言辞骄讦，至诋毁安，称光武诛韩歆、戴涉故事，安终不移。 宪竟立匈奴降者右鹿蠡王於除鞬为单于，后遂反叛，卒和安策。 安以天子幼弱，外戚擅权，每朝会进见，及与公卿言国家事，未尝不噫呜流涕。 自天子及大臣皆恃赖之。 四年春，薨，朝廷痛惜焉。 后数月，窦氏败，帝始亲万机，追思前议者邪正之节，乃除安子赏为郎。 子孙之盛，不亦宜乎？ 张字孟侯，汝南细阳人，赵王张敖之后也。 敖子寿，封细阳之池阳乡，后废，因家焉。 少从祖父充受《尚书》，能传其业，又事太常桓荣。 勤力不怠，聚徒以百数。 永平九年，显宗为四姓小侯开学于南宫，置《五经》师。 以《尚书》教授，数讲于御前，以论难当意，除为郎，赐车马衣裳，遂令入授皇太子。 为人质直，守经义，每侍讲间隙，数有匡正之辞，以严见惮。 及肃宗即位，擢为侍中、虎贲中郎将。 数月，出为东郡太守。 自以尝经亲近，未悟见出，意不自得，上疏辞曰： 臣愚以经术给事左右，少不更职，不晓文法，猥当剖符典郡，班政千里，必有负恩辱位之咎。 臣窃私自分，殊不虑出城阙，冀蒙留恩，托备冗官，群僚所不安，耳目所闻见，不敢避好丑。
target_text: Zhang Youfu, courtesy name Menghou, was from Xiyang, Runan, a descendant of Zhao King Zhang Ao. He studied *Shangshu* from his grandfather and later served Taichang Huanrong, gathering hundreds of followers. During Yongping, he taught *Shangshu* at the imperial school and lectured before the emperor, who appointed him as a minister and tutor to the crown prince. A simple, upright man who strictly adhered to the classics, he was promoted to governor of Dongjun under Suzong. Though a Confucian scholar, he had a strong character and fought against powerful men. He promoted Wang Qing, whose family had shown three generations of loyalty, to a high position.

input_text: 由出后，帝每见诸王师傅，常言： 张前入侍讲，屡有谏正，恻恻，出于诚心，可谓有史鱼之风矣。 元和二年，东巡狩，幸东郡，引及门生并郡县掾史并会庭中。帝先备弟子之仪，使讲《尚书》一篇，然后修君臣之礼。 赏赐殊特，莫不沾洽。 视事十五年，和帝初，迁魏郡太守。 郡人郑据时为司隶校尉，奏免执金吾窦景。 景后复位，遣掾夏猛私谢曰： 郑据小人，为所侵冤。 闻其兒为吏，放纵狼藉。 取是曹子一人，足以惊百。 大怒，即收猛系狱，檄言执金吾府，疑猛与据子不平，矫称卿意，以报私仇。 会有赎罪令，猛乃得出。 顷之，征入为河南尹。 窦景家人复击伤市卒，吏捕得之，景怒，遣缇骑侯海等五百人欧伤市丞。 部吏杨章等穷究，正海罪，徙朔方。 景忿怨，乃移书辟章等六人为执金吾吏，欲因报之。 章等惶恐，入白，愿自引臧罪，以辞景命。 即上言其状。 窦太后诏报： 自今执金吾辟吏，皆勿遣。 及窦氏败，乃上疏曰： 臣实愚蠢，不及大体，以为窦氏虽伏厥辜，而罪刑未著，后世不见其事，但闻其诛，非所以垂示国典，贻之将来。 宜下理官，与天下平之。 方宪等宠贵，群臣阿附唯恐不及，皆言宪受顾命之托，怀伊、吕之忠，至乃复比邓夫人于文母。
target_text: When the emperor toured Dongjun, he invited Zhang Youfu and his disciples to lecture on *Shangshu*. After fifteen years of service, Zhang Youfu became prefect of Wei County. When Dou Jing sought revenge against Zheng Ju through Zhang Youfu, Zhang Youfu imprisoned Dou Jing's messenger instead. Later, as Henan Yin, he investigated Dou Jing's men who had injured city soldiers and exiled them. After Dou Xian's fall, Zhang Youfu argued that Dou's crimes should be publicly examined rather than secretly punished. He was promoted to Taiwei but repeatedly requested retirement due to illness. The emperor refused, sending gifts and urging him to remain in service.

input_text: 皇恐诣阙谢，还复视事。 虽在公位，而父常居田里，每有迁职，辄一诣京师。 尝来候，适会岁节，公卿罢朝，俱诣府奉酒上寿，极欢卒日，众人皆庆羡之。 及父卒，既葬，诏遣使赍牛、酒为释服。 后以事与司隶校尉晏称会于朝堂，从容谓称曰： 三府辟吏，多非其人。 称归，即奏令三府各实其掾史。 本以私言，不意称奏之，甚怀恨。 会复共谢阙下，因责让于称，称辞语不顺，怒，遂廷叱之，称乃劾奏有怨言。 天子以先帝师，有诏公卿、博士、朝臣会议。 司徒吕盖奏位居三司，知公门有仪，不屏气鞠躬以须诏命，反作色大言，怨让使臣，不可以示四远。 于是策免。 归里舍，谢遣诸生，闭门不通宾客。 左中郎将何敞及言事者多讼公忠，帝亦雅重之。
target_text: Zhang Youfu's father lived in the countryside, and Zhang Youfu visited him whenever his position changed. After his father's death, Zhang Youfu was dismissed for scolding an official in court. He returned home, closed his doors, and refused visitors. Later reinstated as Guang Luxun and then Situ, he died soon after. Before death, he instructed his son to bury him simply without an ancestral hall, using only a straw shelter for offerings.

input_text: 十六年，复拜为光禄勋。 数月，代鲁恭为司徒。 月余薨。 乘舆缟素临吊，赐冢茔地，赗赠恩宠异于它相。 其年，追济侍讲有劳，封子根为蔡阳乡侯。 济弟喜，初平中为司空。韩棱字伯师，颍川舞阳人，弓高侯穨当之后也。 世为乡里著姓。 父寻，建武中为陇西太守。 棱四岁而孤，养母弟以孝友称。 及壮，推先父余财数百万与从昆弟，乡里益高之。 初为郡功曹，太守葛兴中风，病不能听政，棱阴代兴视事，出入二年，令无违者。 兴子尝发教欲署吏，棱拒执不从，因令怨者章之。
target_text: Han Leng, courtesy name Bo Shi, was from Wuyang, Yingchuan, a descendant of Marquis Xiugui. Orphaned at four, he was known for filial piety and gave away his father's wealth to cousins. As a county official, he secretly handled affairs for a paralyzed prefect for two years. Though imprisoned for this, Emperor Xianzong pardoned him. He was promoted to Shangshu Ling and was known for his talent. Emperor Suzong once gave swords inscribed with names to three ministers, including Han Leng, whose sword was inscribed "Longyuan" for his profound strategies.

input_text: 会帝西祠园陵，诏宪与车驾会长安。 及宪至，尚书以下议欲拜之，伏称万岁。 棱正色曰： 夫上交不谄，下交不黩，礼无人臣称万岁之制。 议者皆惭而止。 尚书左丞王龙私奏记上牛、酒于宪，棱举奏龙，论为城旦。 棱在朝数荐举良吏应顺、吕章、周纡等，皆有名当时。 及窦氏败，棱典案其事，深竟党与，数月不休沐。 帝以为忧国忘家，赐布三百匹。 迁南阳太守，特听棱得过家上冢，乡里以为荣。 棱发奸盗，郡中震栗，政号严平。 数岁，征入为太仆。 九年冬，代张奋为司空。 后复征拜司隶校尉。 周荣字平孙，庐江舒人也。
target_text: When Dou Xian assassinated a marquis, Han Leng insisted the thieves were in the capital, not elsewhere. Though the Empress Dowager was angry, the truth proved him correct. When officials wanted to bow to Dou Xian and shout "long live," Han Leng sternly rebuked them. After the Dou family fell, Han Leng investigated their accomplices tirelessly, and the emperor rewarded him with cloth. He became governor of Nanyang, where he exposed villains and maintained strict fairness. Later recalled as a servant, he served as Sikong but died the following year.

input_text: 肃宗时，举明经，辟司徒袁安府。 安数与论议，甚器之。 及安举奏窦景及与窦宪争立北单于事，皆荣所具草。 窦氏客太尉掾徐齮深恶之，胁荣曰： 子为袁公腹心之谋，排奏窦氏，窦氏悍士刺客满城中，谨备之矣！ 荣曰： 荣江淮孤生，蒙先帝大恩，以历宰二城。 今复得备宰士，纵为窦氏所害，诚所甘心。 故常敕妻子，若卒遇飞祸，无得殡敛，冀以区区腐身觉悟朝廷。 及窦氏败，荣由此显名。 自郾令擢为尚书令。 出为颍川太守，坐法，当下狱，和帝思荣忠节，左转共令。 岁余，复以为山阳太守。 所历郡县，皆见称纪。 以老病乞身，卒于家，诏特赐钱二十万，除子男兴为郎中。 兴少有名誉，永宁中，尚书陈忠上疏荐兴曰： 臣伏惟古者帝王有所号令，言心弘雅，辞必温丽，垂于后世，列于典经。 故仲尼嘉唐、虞之文章，从周室之郁郁。 臣窃见光禄郎周兴，孝友之行，著于闺门，清厉之志，闻于州里。 蕴椟古今，博物多闻，《三坟》之篇，《五典》之策，无所不览。 属文著辞，有可观采。
target_text: Zhou Rong, courtesy name Pingsun, was from Shu, Lujiang. During Suzong's reign, he served as an official in Situ Yuan An's house. Yuan An valued him highly, and Zhou Rong drafted Yuan An's arguments against Dou Xian regarding the Northern Chanyu. When Dou Xian's guest threatened Zhou Rong with assassins, Zhou Rong declared he was willing to be harmed to awaken the court. After the Dou family fell, Zhou Rong became famous and rose to Shangshu Ling. As governor of Yingchuan, he violated the law but was demoted rather than imprisoned due to his loyalty. He later served as governor of Shanyang with praise, then retired due to illness and died at home. His son Zhou Xing was recommended for his literary talent and served as Shangshu Lang before dying.

input_text: 袁绍袁绍字本初，汝南阳人，司徒汤之孙。 父成，五官中郎将，壮健好交结，大将军梁冀以下莫不善之。 绍少为郎，除濮阳长，遭母忧去官。 三年礼竟，追感幼孤，又行父服。 服阕，徙居洛阳。 绍有姿貌威容，爱士养名。 既累世台司，宾客所归，加倾心折节，莫不争赴其庭，士无贵贱，与之抗礼，辎軿柴毂，填接街陌。 内官皆恶之。 中常侍赵忠言于省内曰： 袁本初坐作声价，好养死士，不知此兒终欲何作。 叔父太傅隗闻而呼绍，以忠言责之，绍终不改。 后辟大将军何进掾，为侍御史、虎贲中郎将。 中平五年，初置西园八校尉，以绍为佐军校尉。 灵帝崩，绍劝何进征董卓等众军，胁太后诛诸宦官，转绍司隶校尉。 语已见《何进传》。
target_text: Yuan Shao, courtesy name Benchu, was from Ruyang, Runan, and the grandson of Situ Yuan Tang. His father Yuan Cheng served as a lieutenant general. Yuan Shao began his career as a Langguan and later became Chief of Puyang. After his mother's death, he resigned to observe mourning, and later also mourned his father. He then moved to Luoyang, where his elegant demeanor and generosity attracted many scholars, leading to resentment from court eunuchs. His uncle Yuan Wei reprimanded him, but Yuan Shao did not change his ways.

input_text: 袁绍袁绍字本初，汝南阳人，司徒汤之孙。 父成，五官中郎将，壮健好交结，大将军梁冀以下莫不善之。 绍少为郎，除濮阳长，遭母忧去官。 三年礼竟，追感幼孤，又行父服。 服阕，徙居洛阳。 绍有姿貌威容，爱士养名。 既累世台司，宾客所归，加倾心折节，莫不争赴其庭，士无贵贱，与之抗礼，辎軿柴毂，填接街陌。 内官皆恶之。 中常侍赵忠言于省内曰： 袁本初坐作声价，好养死士，不知此兒终欲何作。 叔父太傅隗闻而呼绍，以忠言责之，绍终不改。 后辟大将军何进掾，为侍御史、虎贲中郎将。 中平五年，初置西园八校尉，以绍为佐军校尉。 灵帝崩，绍劝何进征董卓等众军，胁太后诛诸宦官，转绍司隶校尉。 语已见《何进传》。
target_text: Yuan Shao served under General He Jin as a subordinate officer and later as Colonel of the Eight Xiuyuan. After Emperor Ling's death, he advised He Jin to eliminate the eunuchs, but He Jin was killed. When Dong Zhuo arrived, Yuan Shao opposed his plan to depose the young emperor. After a heated argument, Yuan Shao fled to Jizhou. Dong Zhuo initially offered a reward for his capture but later pardoned him and appointed him Governor of Bohai and Marquis of Yunxiang.

input_text: 时，侍中周珌、城门校尉伍琼为卓所信待，琼等阴为绍说卓曰： 夫废立大事，非常人所及。 袁绍不达大体，恐惧出奔，非有它志。 今急购之，势必为变。 袁氏树恩四世，门生故吏遍于天下，若收豪杰以聚徒众，英雄因之而起，则山东非公之有也。 不如赦之，拜一郡守，绍喜于免罪，必无患矣。 卓以为然，乃遣授绍勃海太守，封邟乡侯。 绍犹称兼司隶。 初平元年，绍遂以勃海起兵，与从弟后将军术、冀州牧韩馥、豫州刺史孔亻由、兗州刺史刘岱、陈留太守张邈、广陵太守张超、河内太守王匡、山阳太守袁遗、东郡太守桥瑁、济北相鲍信等同时俱起，众各数万，以讨卓为名。 绍与王匡屯河内，亻由屯颍川，馥屯鄴，余军咸屯酸枣，约盟，遥推绍为盟主。 绍自号车骑将军，领司隶校尉。 董卓闻绍起山东，乃诛绍叔父隗，及宗族在京师者，尽灭之。
target_text: In the first year of Chuping, Yuan Shao raised troops in Bohai, joining forces with Yuan Shu, Han Fu, and others to crusade against Dong Zhuo. They formed an alliance with Yuan Shao as leader. Dong Zhuo killed Yuan Shao's uncle and clan members in the capital. Yuan Shao then took control of Jizhou from Han Fu through a combination of military pressure and persuasion, becoming its governor. He appointed Ju Shou as his advisor and expanded his territory.

input_text: 绍于是引军南还。 三月上已，大会宾徒于薄落津。 闻魏郡兵反，与黑山贼干毒等数万人共覆鄴城，杀郡守。坐中客家在鄴者，皆忧怖失色，或起而啼泣，绍容貌自若，不敢常度。 贼有陶升者，自号 平汉将军 ，独反诸贼，将部众逾西城入，闭府门，具车重，载绍家及诸衣冠在州内者，身自扞卫，送到斥丘。 绍还，因屯斥丘，以陶升为建义中郎将。 六月，绍乃出军，入朝歌鹿肠山苍岩谷口，讨干毒。 围攻五日，破之，斩毒及其众万余级。 绍遂寻山北行，进击诸贼左髭丈八等，皆斩之，又击刘石、青牛角、黄龙、左校、郭大贤、李大目、于氐根等，复斩数万级，皆屠其屯壁。 遂与黑山贼张燕及四营屠各、雁门乌桓战于常山。 燕精兵数万，骑数千匹，连战十余日，燕兵死伤虽多，绍军亦疲，遂各退。 曲义自恃有功，骄纵不轨，绍召杀之，而并其众。 兴平二年，拜绍右将军。 其冬，车驾为李傕等所追于曹阳，沮授说绍曰： 将军累叶台辅，世济忠义。
target_text: Yuan Shao defeated Gongsun Zan in battle, killing Yan Gang and pursuing him to the boundary bridge. Despite a near-capture by Gongsun Zan's cavalry, Yuan Shao's forces prevailed. He later suppressed rebellions in Wei County and defeated the Black Mountain bandits, killing tens of thousands. Yuan Shao also killed his general Qu Yi for insubordination.

input_text: 绍有三子：谭字显思、熙字显雍、尚字显甫。 谭长而惠，尚少而美。 绍后妻刘有宠，而偏爱尚，数称于绍，绍亦奇其姿容，欲使传嗣。 乃以谭继兄后，出为青州刺史。 沮授谏曰： 世称万人逐兔，一人获之，贪者悉止，分定故也。 且年均以贤，德均则卜，古之制也。 愿上惟先代成败之诫，下思逐兔分定之义。 若其不改，祸始此矣。 绍曰： 吾欲令诸子各据一州，以视其能。 于是以中子熙为幽州刺史，处甥高为并州刺史。 建安元年，曹操迎天子都许，乃下诏书于绍，责以地广兵多而专自树党，不闻勤王之师而但擅相讨伐。 绍上书曰：臣闻昔有哀叹而霜陨，悲哭而崩城者。
target_text: When Emperor Xian was in danger, Ju Shou advised Yuan Shao to welcome the emperor, but Yuan Shao hesitated due to advice from Guo Tu and Chunyu Qiong. He eventually declined. Yuan Shao had three sons: Yuan Tan, Yuan Xi, and Yuan Shang. He favored Yuan Shang due to his wife's influence, adopting Yuan Tan as his brother's heir and sending him to Qingzhou, against Ju Shou's warnings.

input_text: 若以臣今行权为衅，则桓、文当有诛绝之则；若以众不讨贼为贤，则赵盾可无书弑援贬矣。 臣虽小人，志守一介。 若使得申明本心，不愧先帝，则伏首欧刀，褰衣就镬，臣之愿也。 惟陛下垂《尸鸠》之平，绝邪谄之论，无令愚臣结恨三泉。 于是以绍为太尉，封鄴侯。 时曹操自为大将军，绍耻为之下，伪表辞不受。 操大惧，乃让位于绍。 二年，使将作大匠孔融持节拜绍大将军，锡弓矢节钺，虎贲百人，兼督冀、青、幽、并四州，然后受之。 绍每得诏书，患有不便于己，乃欲移天子自近，使说操以许下埤湿，洛阳残破，宜徙都甄城，以就全实。 操拒之。 田丰说绍曰： 徙都之计，既不克从，宜早图许，奉迎天子，动托诏令，响号海内，此算之上者。 不尔，终为人所禽，虽悔无益也。
target_text: In the first year of Jian'an, Cao Cao welcomed the emperor to Xu County and blamed Yuan Shao for not aiding the emperor. Yuan Shao responded with a lengthy letter defending his actions, citing his loyalty and efforts against Dong Zhuo and others. The court appointed him Taiwei and Marquis of Ye, but he refused until Cao Cao yielded the position of General. Later, he was granted command of four provinces.

input_text: 绍不从。 四年春，击公孙瓚，遂定幽土，事在《瓚传》。 绍既并四州之地，众数十万，而骄心转盛，贡御稀简。 主簿耿包密白绍曰； 赤德衰尽，袁为黄胤，宜顺天意，以从民心。 绍以包白事示军府僚属，议者以包妖妄宜诛。 绍知众情不同，不得已乃杀包以弭其迹。 于是简精兵十万，骑万匹，欲出攻许，以审配、逢纪统军事，田丰、荀谌及南阳许攸为谋主，颜良、文丑为将帅。 沮授进说曰： 近讨公孙，师出历年，百姓疲敝，仓库无积，赋役方殷，此国之深忧也。 宜先遣使献捷天子，务农逸人。
target_text: Yuan Shao attacked Gongsun Zan again, pacifying Youzhou. With control of four provinces and hundreds of thousands of troops, he grew arrogant. He planned to attack Xu County, ignoring Ju Shou's advice to rest and farm. Instead, he followed Guo Tu and Shen Pei's counsel to attack immediately. Tian Feng's warnings led to his imprisonment.

input_text: 乃忠臣肝脑涂地之秋，烈士立功之会也。可不勖哉！ 乃先遣颜良攻曹操别将刘延于白马，绍自引兵至黎阳。 沮授临行，会其宗族，散资财以与之。 曰： 势存则威无不加，势亡则不保一身。 哀哉！ 其弟宗曰： 曹操士马不敌，君何惧焉？ 授曰： 以曹兗州之明略，又挟天子以为资，我虽克伯珪，众实疲敝，而主骄将忲，军之破败，在此举矣。 杨雄有言： 六国蚩蚩，为嬴弱姬。 今之谓乎！ 曹操遂救刘延，击颜良，斩之。 绍乃度河，壁延津南。 沮授临船叹曰： 上盈其志，下务其功，悠悠黄河，吾其济乎！ 遂以疾退，绍不许而意恨之，复省其所部，并属郭图。 绍使刘备、文丑挑战，曹操又击破之，斩文丑。 再战而禽二将，绍军中大震。
target_text: In the fifth year of Jian'an, Yuan Shao marched south after Liu Bei's defection. He issued a proclamation condemning Cao Cao's crimes. His forces initially succeeded but were defeated at Guandu after Xu You defected and revealed the location of Yuan Shao's grain supplies at Wuchao. Cao Cao attacked and destroyed the supplies, leading to Yuan Shao's defeat. Yuan Shao fled with 800 cavalry, while many of his troops were killed or surrendered. Ju Shou was captured and executed after attempting to return to Yuan Shao.

input_text: 绍遂以岱为监军，代配守鄴。 护军逢纪与配不睦，绍以问之，纪对曰： 配天性烈直，每所言行，慕古人之节，不以二子在南为不义也，公勿疑之。 绍曰： 君不恶之邪？ 纪曰： 先所争者私情，今所陈者国事。 绍曰： 善 。 乃不废配，配、纪由是更协。 冀州城邑多畔，绍复击定之。 自军败后发病，七年夏，薨。 未及定嗣，逢纪、审配宿以骄侈为谭所病，辛评、郭图皆比干谭而与配、纪有隙。 众以谭长，欲立之。 配等恐谭立而评等为害，遂矫绍遗命，奉尚为嗣。
target_text: Yuan Shao appeared generous but was proud and unable to accept advice, leading to his downfall. After his defeat, he killed Tian Feng. He fell ill and died in the seventh year of Jian'an. His succession was disputed: Shen Pei and Feng Ji supported Yuan Shang, while others favored Yuan Tan, leading to internal conflict.

input_text: 刘表字景升，山阳高平人，鲁恭王之后也。 身长八尺余，姿貌温伟。 与同郡张俭等俱被讪议，号为 八顾 ，诏书捕案党人，表亡走得免。 党禁解，辟大将军何进掾。 初平元年，长沙太守孙坚杀荆州刺史王，诏书以表为蒯州刺史。 时，江南宗贼大盛，又袁术阻兵屯鲁阳，表不能得至，乃单马入宜城，请南郡人荆越、襄阳人蔡瑁与共谋画。 表谓越曰： 宗贼虽盛而众不附，若袁术因之，祸必至矣。 吾欲征兵，恐不能集，其策焉出？ 对曰： 理平者先仁义，理乱者先权谋。 兵不在多，贵乎得人。 袁术骄而无谋，宗贼率多贪暴。 越有所素养者，使人示之以利，必持众来。 使君诛其无道，施其才用，威德既行，襁负而至矣。
target_text: Liu Biao, courtesy name Jingsheng, was a descendant of King Lu Gong from Gaoping, Shanyang. Over eight feet tall with a gentle appearance and burly build, he was implicated in the "Ba Gu" party affair and escaped arrest. After the party ban was lifted, he served as an assistant to General He Jin. In the first year of Chuping, he was appointed Governor of Jingzhou following Sun Jian's murder of Governor Wang Xu. Unable to reach Jingzhou due to bandits and Yuan Shu's troops blocking the road, Liu Biao rode alone to Yicheng and consulted Kuai Yue and Cai Mao. Following Kuai Yue's advice, he lured and killed fifteen clan bandit leaders, then pacified their tribes. The Jiangxia thieves Zhang Hu and Chen Li surrendered after negotiations, and the region south of the Yangtze River was subdued. Liu Biao organized troops to observe the situation.

input_text: 兵集众附，南据江陵，北守襄阳，荆州八郡可传檄而定。 公路虽至，无能为也。 表曰： 善。 乃使赵遣人诱宗贼帅，至者十五人，皆斩之而袭取其众。 唯江夏贼张虎、陈坐拥兵据襄阳城，表使越与庞季往譬之，乃降。 江南悉平。 诸守令闻表威名，多解印绶去。 表遂理兵襄阳，以观时变。 袁术与其从兄绍有隙，而绍与表相结，故术共孙坚合从袭表。 表败，坚遂围襄阳。 会表将黄祖救至，坚为流箭所中死，余众退走。 及李等入长安，冬，表遣使奉贡。 傕以表为镇南将军、荆州牧，封成武侯，假节，以为己援。 建安元年，骠骑将军张济自关中走南阳，因攻穰城，中飞矢而死。 荆州官属皆贺。
target_text: Yuan Shu and Sun Jian attacked Liu Biao, but Sun Jian was killed by a stray arrow during the siege of Xiangyang. Liu Biao sent tribute to Emperor Xian and was appointed General of Zhennan, Shepherd of Jingzhou, and Marquis of Wu. When Zhang Ji attacked Lucheng and was killed, Liu Biao accepted condolences and recruited Zhang Ji's troops. He suppressed rebellions by Zhang Xian and others, expanding his territory to connect with Wuling in the south and Han in the north, commanding over 100,000 armored warriors. Liu Biao pacified bandits, supported scholars, established schools, and commissioned commentaries on the Five Classics.

input_text: 表以为惮使，强之。 至许，果拜嵩侍中、零陵太守。 及还，盛称朝廷曹操之德，劝遣子入侍。 表大怒，以为怀贰，陈兵诟嵩，将斩之。 嵩不为动容，徐陈临行之言。 表妻蔡氏知嵩贤，谏止之。 表犹怒，乃考杀从行者。 知无他意，但囚嵩而已。 六年，刘备自袁绍奔荆州，表厚相待结而不能用也。 十三年，曹操自将征表，未至。 八月，表疽发背卒。 在荆州几二十年，家无余积。 二子：琦、琮。 表初以琦貌类于己，甚爱之，后为琮娶其后妻蔡氏之侄，蔡氏遂爱琮而恶琦，毁誉之言日闻于表。 表宠耽后妻，每信受焉。 又妻弟蔡瑁及外甥张允并得幸于表，又睦于琮。
target_text: During Cao Cao and Yuan Shao's conflict at Guandu, Liu Biao remained neutral despite advice from Han Song and Kuai Yue to submit to Cao Cao. He sent Han Song to observe Cao Cao, but after Han Song praised Cao Cao and urged submission, Liu Biao imprisoned him. Liu Bei defected to Jingzhou in the sixth year of Jian'an, but Liu Biao did not utilize him. In the thirteenth year, Cao Cao marched south, and Liu Biao died of illness in August after nearly twenty years in Jingzhou.

input_text: 蒯越、韩嵩及东曹掾傅巽等说琮归降。 琮曰： 今与诸君据全楚之地，守先君之业，以观天下，何为不可？ 巽曰： 逆顺有大体，强弱有定势。 以人臣而拒人主，逆道也；以新造之楚而御中国，必危也；以刘备而敌曹公，不当也。 三者皆短，欲以抗王师之锋，必亡之道也。 将军自料何与刘备？ 琮曰： 不若也。 巽曰： 诚以刘备不足御曹公，则虽全楚不能以自存也。 诚以刘备足御曹公，则备不为将军下也。 愿将军勿疑。 及操军到襄阳，琮举州请降，刘备奔夏口。 操以琮为青州刺史，封列侯。 蒯越等侯者十五人。 乃释嵩之囚，以其名重，甚加礼待，使条品州人优劣，皆擢而用之。 以嵩为大鸿胪，以交友礼待之。 蒯越光禄勋，刘先尚书令。 初，表之结袁绍也，侍中从事邓义谏不听。义以疾退，终表世不仕，操以为侍中，其余多至大官。 操后败于赤壁，刘备表琦为荆州刺史。 明年卒。 论曰： 袁绍初以豪侠得众，遂怀雄霸之图，天下胜兵举旗者，莫不假以为名。
target_text: Liu Biao favored his son Liu Qi initially but later favored Liu Cong due to his wife Cai's influence. Liu Qi, feeling unsafe, sought advice from Zhuge Liang and requested to govern Jiangxia. When Liu Biao fell ill, Liu Qi was prevented from visiting him, and Liu Cong succeeded. Liu Cong surrendered Jingzhou to Cao Cao, who appointed him Governor of Qingzhou and granted marquisates to others. Cao Cao later released Han Song and appointed him Da Honglu. Liu Biao's alliance with Yuan Shao was criticized by Deng Yi, who resigned. Cao Cao was defeated at Chibi, and Liu Bei recommended Liu Qi as Jingzhou's historian; Liu Qi died the following year. The text concludes that Liu Biao's indecision and favoritism led to his downfall.

input_text: 西羌之本，出自三苗，姜姓之别也。 其国近南岳。 及舜流四凶，徙之三危，河关之西南羌地是也。滨于赐支，至乎河首，绵地千里。 赐支者，《禹贡》所谓析支者也。 南接蜀、汉徼外蛮夷，西北接鄯善、车师诸国。 所居无常，依随水草。 地少五谷，以产牧为业。 其俗氏族无定，或以父名母姓为种号。 十二世后，相与婚姻，父没则妻后母，兄亡则纳嫂，故国无鳏寡，种类繁炽。 不立君臣，无相长一，强则分种为酋豪，弱则为人附落，更相抄暴，以力为雄。 杀人偿死，无它禁令。 其兵长在山谷，短于平地，不能持久，而果于触突，以战死为吉利，病终为不祥。 堪耐寒苦，同之禽兽。 虽妇人产子，亦不避风雪。
target_text: The Xiqiang people, originally from Sanmiao, a branch of the Jiang surname, lived in a region near Nanyue, stretching from the Cizhi River to the borders of Shu and Han in the south and Shanshan and Cheshi in the northwest. They were nomadic, migrating with water and grass, relying primarily on livestock rather than grain. Their society lacked fixed clans, with tribes named after paternal or maternal lines. After twelve generations, intermarriage occurred, and customs included marrying stepmothers after a father's death and widows after an elder brother's death, leading to rapid population growth. They had no central ruler; power determined leadership, with violence and plunder common. Their soldiers excelled in valley combat but not on plains, valued death in battle over illness, and endured harsh conditions.

input_text: 乃文王为西伯，西有昆夷之患，北有猃狁之难，遂攘戎狄而戍之，莫不宾服。 乃率西戎，征殷之叛国以事纣。 及武王伐商，羌、髳率师会于牧野。 至穆王时，戎狄不贡，王乃西征犬戎，获其五王，又得四白鹿，四白狼，王遂迁戎于太原。 夷王衰弱，荒服不朝，乃命虢公率六师伐太原之戎，至于俞泉，获马千匹。 厉王无道，戎狄寇掠，乃入犬丘，杀秦仲之族。王命伐戎，不克。 及宣王立四年，使秦仲伐戎，为戎所杀。 王乃召秦仲子庄公，与兵七千人伐戎，破之，由是少却。 后二十七年，王遣兵伐太原戎，不克。 后五年，王伐条戎、奔戎，王师败绩。 后二年，晋人败北戎于汾隰，戎人灭姜侯之邑。 明年，王征申戎，破之。 后十年，幽王命伯士伐六济之戎，军败，伯士死焉。 其年，戎围犬丘，虏秦襄公之兄伯父。 时幽王昏虐，四夷交侵，遂废申后而立褒姒。 申侯怒，与戎寇周，杀幽王于郦山，周乃东迁洛邑，秦襄公攻戎救周。 后二年，邢侯大破北戎。 及平王之末，周遂陵迟，戎逼诸夏，自陇山以东，及乎伊、洛，往往有戎。 于是渭首有狄、豸原、邽、冀之戎，泾北有义渠之戎，洛川有大荔之戎，渭南有骊戎，伊、洛间有杨拒、泉皋之戎，颍首以西有蛮氏之戎。 当春秋时，间在中国，与诸夏盟会。 鲁庄公伐秦，取邽、冀之戎。
target_text: Historically, the Xiqiang's relationship with Chinese dynasties fluctuated. During the Xia Dynasty, Taikang's loss of control led to barbarian rebellion, but later rulers like Houxiang and Houxie subdued them. Under the Yin Dynasty, Wuding conquered Xirong and Guifang, but Wu Yi's brutality provoked Dog Soldier invasions. The Zhou Dynasty saw King Wen and King Wu command Xirong, while King Mu campaigned against Quanrong. As Zhou weakened, Rong tribes invaded, leading to conflicts with Qin and Jin. During the Spring and Autumn period, Rong groups like Yiqu and Dali grew powerful, building cities and claiming kingship. Qin gradually absorbed them, with King Zhao of Qin destroying Yiqu in the 4th century BCE.

input_text: 后悉归服，徙置天水、陇西、扶风三郡。 明年，武都参狼羌反，援又破降之。 事已具《援传》。 自烧当至滇良，世居河北大允谷，种小人贫。 而先零、卑湳并皆强富，数侵犯之。 滇良父子积见陵易，愤怒，而素有恩信于种中，于是集会附落及诸杂种，乃从大榆入，掩击先零、卑湳，大破之，杀三千人，掠取财畜，夺居其地大榆中，由是始强。 滇良子滇吾立。 中元元年，武都参狼羌反，杀略吏人，太守与战不胜，陇西太守刘盱遣从事辛都、监军掾李苞，将五千人赴武都，与羌战，斩其酋豪，首虏千余人。 时，武都兵亦更破之，斩首千余级，余悉降。 时滇吾附落转盛，常雄诸羌，每欲侵边者，滇吾转教以方略，为其渠帅。 二年秋，烧当羌滇吾与弟滇岸率步骑五千寇陇西塞，刘盱遣兵于枹罕击之，不能克，又战于允街，为羌所败，杀五百余人。 于是守塞诸羌皆复相率为寇。 遣谒者张鸿领诸郡兵击之，战于允吾、唐谷，军败，鸿及陇西长史田飒皆没。 又天水兵为牢姐种所败于白石，死者千余人。 时，烧何豪有妇人比铜钳者，年百余岁，多智算，为种人所信向，皆从取计策。 时为卢水胡所击，比铜钳乃将其众来依郡县。 种人颇有犯法者，临羌长收系比铜钳，而诛杀其种六七百人。 显宗怜之，乃下诏曰： 昔桓公伐戎而无仁惠。故《春秋》贬曰： 齐人 。 今国家无德，恩不及远，羸弱何辜，而当并命！
target_text: Under the Han Dynasty, the Xiqiang faced expulsion and relocation. Emperor Wu expanded borders, building fortresses and separating Qiang from Xiongnu. In 42 BCE, Xianling Qiang allied with Xiongnu, attacking Lingju and Paohan, but were suppressed by General Li Xi. Later, Zhao Chongguo defeated them in 60 BCE. During Wang Mang's reign, Qiang lands were seized, but after his fall, they rebelled. In 25 CE, Guangwu restored the Qiang Protectorate, but conflicts persisted. Ma Yuan defeated Qiang rebellions in 35 CE, moving them to Tianshui and Longxi. By 58 CE, Dianwu's rebellion was crushed, and Qiang were resettled in Sanfu.

target_text: The Qiang continued to resist Han rule. In 77 CE, Miwu led a revolt, defeating Han forces. Fu Yu, the Qiang Protector, was killed in 87 CE. Zhang Yu retaliated by poisoning Qiang leaders, but Miwu's son Mitang continued raids. Deng Xun and later officials used bribery to divide the Qiang, but conflicts resumed. In 107 CE, the Qiang rebellion under Dianling and others devastated border regions, costing billions and causing massive displacement. Ren Shang and Deng Zun campaigned against them, but corruption and mismanagement plagued efforts. By 118 CE, the Qiang were largely subdued, though sporadic revolts occurred.

input_text: 自爰剑后，子孙支分，凡百五十种。 其九种在赐支河首以西，及在蜀、汉徼北，前史不载口数。 唯参狼在武都，胜兵数千人。 其五十二种衰少，不能自立，分散为附落，或绝灭无后，或引而远去。 其八十九种，唯钟最强，胜兵十余万。 其余大者万余人，小者数千人，更相抄盗，盛衰无常，无虑顺帝时胜兵合可二十万人。 发羌、唐旄等绝远，未尝往来。 牛、白马羌在蜀、汉，其种别名号，皆不可纪知也。 建武十三年，广汉塞外白马羌豪楼登等率种人五千余户内属，光武封楼登为归义君长。 至和帝永元六年，蜀郡徼外大牂夷种羌豪造头等率种人五十余万口内属，拜造头为邑君长，赐印绶。 至安帝永初元年，蜀郡徼外羌龙桥等六种万七千二百八十口内属。 明年，蜀郡徼外羌薄申等八种三万六千九百口复举土内属。 冬，广汉塞外参狼种羌二千四百口复来内属。
target_text: In later years, the Qiang faced further suppression. Ma Xian defeated them in 141 CE, but his death in battle in 144 CE led to renewed chaos. Zhao Chong and others campaigned, but the Qiang declined by the 2nd century CE. During the Han dynasty's decline, Qiang allied with Yellow Turban rebels in 184 CE. By the 3rd century CE, the Qiang had fragmented into 150 tribes, with the Zhong Qiang being the most powerful, fielding over 100,000 warriors. The Yuezhi Hu, a related group, intermarried with Qiang and lived in Huangzhong.

input_text: 桓帝建和二年，白马羌千余人寇广汉属国，杀长吏，益州刺史率板蛮讨破之。 湟中月氏胡，其先大月氏之别也，旧在张掖、酒泉地。 月氏王为匈奴冒顿所杀，余种分散，西逾葱领。 其羸弱者南入山阻，依诸羌居止，遂与共婚姻。 及骠骑将军霍去病破匈奴，取西河地，开湟中，于是月氏来降，与汉人错居。 虽依附县官，而首施两端。其从汉兵战斗，随势强弱。 被服饮食言语略与羌同，亦以父名母姓为种。 其大种有七，胜兵合九千余人，分在湟中及令居。 又数百户在张掖，号曰义从胡。 中平元年，与北宫伯玉等反，杀护羌校尉泠征、金城太守陈懿，遂寇乱陇右焉。 论曰：羌戎之患，自三代尚矣。 汉世方之匈奴，颇为衰寡，而中兴以后，边难渐大。 朝规失绥御之和，戎师骞然诺之信。 其内属者，或倥偬之豪右之手，或屈折于奴仆之勤。
target_text: The text concludes that the Qiang's persistent harm stemmed from Han mismanagement, including broken promises and exploitation. The Yongchu period saw widespread rebellion, with Qiang plundering Sanfu and cutting off Longxi. Despite costly campaigns by generals like Deng Lu and Ren Shang, the Han failed to achieve lasting peace. The author criticizes the policy of relocating Qiang into Han territory, which exacerbated conflicts. Ultimately, the Qiang were suppressed by Duan Yi, but the Han dynasty's decline followed. The narrative emphasizes the cyclical nature of Qiang-Han relations, marked by rebellion, suppression, and eventual fragmentation.

input_text: 野王二老向长逢萌周党王霸严光井丹梁鸿高凤台佟韩康矫慎戴良法真汉阴老父陈留老父庞公《易》称 《遯》之时义大矣哉 。又曰： 不事王侯，高尚其事。 是以尧称则天，不屈颍阳之高；武尽美矣，终全孤竹之洁。 自兹以降，风流弥繁，长往之轨未殊，而感致之数匪一。 或隐居以求其志，或回避以全其道，或静已以镇其躁，或去危以图其安，或垢俗以动其概，或疵物以激其清。 然观其甘心畎亩之中，憔悴江海之上，岂必亲鱼鸟、乐林草哉！ 亦云性分所至而已。 故蒙耻之宾，屡黜不去其国；蹈海之节，千乘莫移其情。适使矫易去就，则不能相为矣。 彼虽硜硜有类沽名者，然而蝉蜕嚣埃之中，自致寰区之外，异夫饰智巧以逐浮利者乎！ 荀卿有言曰， 志意修则骄富贵，道义重则轻王公 也。
target_text: The preface explains that seclusion has been a respected tradition since ancient times, as seen in figures like Chao Fu and Xu You, who refused Yao’s throne, and Boyi and Shuqi, who rejected Zhou’s rule. The motivations for seclusion vary: some seek to fulfill ambitions, perfect moral character, suppress impatience, avoid danger, establish integrity, or preserve innocence. While some criticize such acts as seeking fame, the preface argues that true hermits transcend worldly pursuits, as Xunzi noted: high ambitions despise wealth, and strong morals disdain princes. During Wang Mang’s usurpation, many abandoned office, and under Emperor Guangwu, hermits like Yan Guang and Zhou Dang were recruited but often refused to serve. The text records those who lived in seclusion or withdrew after serving.

input_text: 既而散与宗族，悉免遣奴婢，遂至长安游学。 初，乡佐尝众中辱党，党久怀之。 后读《春秋》，闻复仇之义，便辍讲而还，与乡佐相闻，期克斗日。 既交刃，而党为乡佐所伤，困顿。 乡佐服其义，舆归养之，数日方苏，既悟而去。 自此敕身修志，州里称其高。 及王莽窃位，托疾杜门。 自后贼暴从横，残灭郡县，唯至广武，过城不入。 建武中，征为议郎，以病去职，遂将妻子居黾池。 复被征，不得已，乃着短布单衣，穀皮绡头，待见尚书。 及光武引见，党伏而不谒，自陈愿守所志，帝乃许焉。 博士范升奏毁党曰： 臣闻尧不须许由、巢父，而建号天下；周不待伯夷、叔齐，而王道以成。 伏见太原周党、东海王良、山阳王成等，蒙受厚恩，使者三聘，乃肯就车。 及陛见帝廷，党不以礼屈，伏而不谒，偃蹇骄悍，同时俱逝。 党等文不能演义，武不能死君，钓采华名，庶几三公之位。 臣愿与坐云台之下，考试图国之道。
target_text: Xiang Changchuan, a hermit from Hanoi, refused Wang Mang’s summons, studied the *Book of Changes*, and after his children married, he severed ties with his family and disappeared into the Five Mountains. Feng Meng, from Beihai, left his post as a pavilion chief, studied the *Spring and Autumn Annals*, and fled to Liaodong after Wang Mang killed his son. He later refused Guangwu’s summons, claiming old age and disorientation, and died in seclusion. Zhou Dang, a wealthy man from Taiyuan, studied in Chang’an, fought a duel over an old insult, and later refused to serve Wang Mang. Under Guangwu, he was summoned but declined, and the emperor defended his choice, granting him silk. Zhou Dang wrote books and died in Mianchi.

input_text: 既而散与宗族，悉免遣奴婢，遂至长安游学。 初，乡佐尝众中辱党，党久怀之。 后读《春秋》，闻复仇之义，便辍讲而还，与乡佐相闻，期克斗日。 既交刃，而党为乡佐所伤，困顿。 乡佐服其义，舆归养之，数日方苏，既悟而去。 自此敕身修志，州里称其高。 及王莽窃位，托疾杜门。 自后贼暴从横，残灭郡县，唯至广武，过城不入。 建武中，征为议郎，以病去职，遂将妻子居黾池。 复被征，不得已，乃着短布单衣，穀皮绡头，待见尚书。 及光武引见，党伏而不谒，自陈愿守所志，帝乃许焉。 博士范升奏毁党曰： 臣闻尧不须许由、巢父，而建号天下；周不待伯夷、叔齐，而王道以成。 伏见太原周党、东海王良、山阳王成等，蒙受厚恩，使者三聘，乃肯就车。 及陛见帝廷，党不以礼屈，伏而不谒，偃蹇骄悍，同时俱逝。 党等文不能演义，武不能死君，钓采华名，庶几三公之位。 臣愿与坐云台之下，考试图国之道。
target_text: Wang Ba, also from Taiyuan, abandoned his official post during Wang Mang’s reign and refused to serve Guangwu, citing the emperor’s lack of respect for his subjects. Yan Guang, a childhood friend of Guangwu, changed his name and fished in seclusion. The emperor found him, but Yan Guang refused to serve, famously putting his feet on Guangwu’s belly while sleeping. He later farmed in Fuchun Mountain and died at home. Jing Dan, a scholar from Fufeng, was known for his pride and refused invitations from princes. When tricked into a banquet by a relative of the empress, he criticized the host’s meager food and left, living in seclusion thereafter.

input_text: 恢亦高抗，终身不仕。高凤字文通，南阳叶人也。 少为书生，家以农亩为业，而专精诵读，昼夜不息。 妻尝之田，曝麦于庭，令凤护鸡。 时天暴雨，而凤持竿诵经，不觉潦水流麦。 妻还怪问，凤方悟之。 其后遂为名儒，乃教授于西唐山中。 邻里有争财者，持兵而斗，凤往解之，不已，乃脱巾叩头，固请曰： 仁义逊让，奈何弃之！ 于是争者怀感，投兵谢罪。 凤年老，执志不倦，名声著闻。 太守连召请，恐不得免，自言本巫家，不应为吏，又诈与寡嫂讼田，遂不仕。 与夫委体渊沙，鸣弦揆日者，不其远乎！ 台佟字孝威，魏郡鄴人也。隐于武安山，凿穴为居，采药自业。 建初中，州辟，不就。 刺史行部，乃使从事致谒。 佟载病往谢。 刺史乃执贽见佟曰： 孝威居身如是，甚苦，如何？ 佟曰： 佟幸得保终性命，存神养和。
target_text: Liang Hong, from Fufeng, studied in Taixue, worked as a pig herder, and compensated a neighbor for a fire by labor. He married Meng Guang, who dressed simply and shared his life of seclusion. They fled to Baling Mountain, then to Wu, where Liang Hong worked as a rice pounder. His wife served him with respect, raising the tray to her eyebrows. Liang Hong died in Wu and was buried near the martyr Yaoli. Gao Feng, a scholar from Nanyang, was so absorbed in reading that he let rain ruin his wheat. He mediated disputes and refused official summons, pretending to have a lawsuit to avoid service. Tai Tong, from Wei County, lived in a cave, collected herbs, and refused summons, stating his life was peaceful compared to officials’ toil.

input_text: 如明使君奉宣诏书，夕惕庶事，反不苦邪？ 遂去，隐逸，终不见。 韩康字伯休，一名恬休，京兆霸陵人。 家世著姓。 常采药名山，卖于长安市，口不二价，三十余年。 时有女子从康买药，康守价不移。 女子怒曰： 公是韩伯休那？ 乃不二价乎？ 康叹曰： 我本欲避名，今小女子皆知有我，何用药为？ 乃遁入霸陵山中。 博士公车连征，不至。 桓帝乃备玄纁之礼，以安车聘之。 使者奉诏造康，康不得已，乃许诺。 辞安车，自乘柴车，冒晨先使者发。 至亭，亭长以韩征君当过，方发人牛修道桥。 及见康柴车幅巾，以为田叟也，使夺其牛。 康即释驾与之。 有顷，使者至，知夺牛翁乃征君也。 使者欲奏杀亭长。 康曰： 此自老子与之，亭长何罪！ 乃止。 康因中道逃遁，以寿终。
target_text: Han Kang, from Jingzhao, sold herbs at a fixed price for thirty years. When a girl recognized him, he fled to Baling Mountain and refused Emperor Huan’s summons, escaping halfway. Jiao Shen, from Fufeng, studied Huang-Lao, lived in a cave, and refused to marry. He predicted his death and later was seen in Dunhuang, rumored to be immortal. Dai Liang, from Runan, imitated his mother’s braying for fun, and after her death, he ate meat while mourning, arguing that rituals should not suppress genuine emotion. He refused office and fled to Jiangxia, marrying off his five daughters with simple dowries.

input_text: 再辟司空府，弥年不到，州郡迫之，乃遁辞诣府，悉将妻子，既行在道，因逃入江夏山中。 优游不仕，以寿终。初，良五女并贤，每有求姻，辄便许嫁，疏裳布被、竹笥木屐以遣之。五女能遵其训，皆有隐者之风焉。 法真字高卿，扶风眉阝人，南郡太守雄之子也。 好学而无常家，博通内外图典，为关西大儒。 弟子自远方至者，陈留范冉等数百人。 性恬静寡欲，不交人间事。 太守请见之，真乃幅巾诣谒。 太守曰： 昔鲁哀公虽为不肖，而仲尼称臣。 太守虚薄，欲以功曹相屈，光赞本朝，何如？ 真曰： 以明府见待有礼，故敢自同宾末。 若欲吏之，真将在北山之北，南山之南矣。 太守然，不敢复言。 辟公府，举贤良，皆不就。 同郡田弱荐真曰： 处士法真，体兼四业，学穷典奥，幽居恬泊，乐以忘忧。将蹈老氏之高踪，不为玄纁屈也。 臣愿圣朝就加衮职，必能唱《清庙》之歌，致来仪之凤矣。 会顺帝西巡，弱又荐之。 帝虚心欲致，前后四征。 真曰： 吾既不能遁形远世，岂饮洗耳之水哉？
target_text: Fa Zhen, a great Confucian from Fufeng, refused a prefect’s offer of office, saying he would rather be north of Beishan or south of Nanshan. He was recommended to Emperor Shun but declined, living in seclusion and earning the title Mr. Xuande. The Hanyin Old Man, during Emperor Huan’s visit, continued plowing and criticized the emperor for indulging in leisure while the people suffered. The Chenliu Old Man, during the party insurrection, told weeping officials that crying was useless, as the world’s traps were everywhere. Pang Gong, from Xiangyang, refused Liu Biao’s summons, saying he left peace to his descendants, not danger. He and his wife later retreated to Lumen Mountain.

input_text: 邓禹字仲华，南阳新野人也。 年十三，能诵诗，受业长安。时光武亦游学京师，禹年虽幼，而见光武知非常人，遂相亲附。 数年归家。 及汉兵起，更始立，豪杰多荐举禹，禹不肯从。 及闻光武安集河北，即杖策北渡，追及于邺。 光武见之甚欢，谓曰： 我得专封拜，生远来，宁欲仕乎？ 禹曰： 不愿也。 光武曰： 即如是，何欲为？ 禹曰： 但愿明公威德加于四海，禹得效其尺寸，垂功名于竹帛耳。 光武笑，因留宿闲语。 禹进说曰： 更始虽都关西，今山东未安，赤眉、青犊之属，动以万数，三辅假号，往往群聚。 更始既未有所挫，而不自听断，诸将皆庸人屈起，志在财币，争用威力，朝夕自快而已，非有忠良明智，深虑远图，欲尊主安民者也。 四方分崩离析，形势可见。 明公虽建藩辅之功，犹恐无所成立。 于今之计，莫如延揽英雄，务悦民心，立高祖之业，救万民之命。 以公而虑天下，不足定也。 光武大悦，因令左右号禹曰邓将军。 常宿止于中，与定计议。
target_text: Deng Yu, courtesy name Zhonghua, was from Xinye County, Nanyang. At thirteen, he could recite poems and studied in Chang'an, where he befriended Guangwu, recognizing his extraordinary nature. After returning home, he refused offers from other heroes when the Han army rose. He told Guangwu he wished to serve him and achieve lasting fame. Guangwu kept him close, and Deng Yu advised that while Gengshi held Guanxi, instability in Shandong and bandit groups like the Red Eyebrows threatened order. He urged Guangwu to recruit heroes, win over the people, and build a great cause. Guangwu appointed him General Deng and consulted him on strategies.

input_text: 乃拜为前将军持节，中分麾下精兵二万人，遣西入关，令自选偏裨以下可与俱者。 于是以韩歆为军师，李文、李春、程虑为祭酒，冯愔为积弩将军，樊崇为骁骑将军，宗歆为车骑将军，邓寻为建威将军，耿为赤眉将军，左于为军师将军，引而西。 建武元年正月，禹自箕关将入河东，河东都尉守关不开，禹攻十日，破之，获辎重千余乘。 进围安邑，数月未能下。 更始大将军樊参将数万人，度大阳欲攻禹，禹遣诸将逆击于解南，大破之，斩参首。 于是王匡、成丹、刘均等合军十余万，复共击禹，禹军不利，樊崇战死。 会日幕，战罢，军师韩歆及诸将见兵势已摧，皆劝禹夜去，禹不听。 明日癸亥，匡等以六甲穷日不出，禹因得更理兵勒众。 明旦，匡悉军出攻禹，禹令军中无得妄动；既至营下，因传发诸将鼓而并进，大破广。 承制拜李文为河东太守，悉更置属县令长以镇抚之。 是月，光武即位于鄗，使使者持节拜禹为大司徒。 策曰： 制诏前将军禹：深执忠孝，与朕谋谟帷幄，决胜千里。 孔子曰： 自吾有回，门人日亲。 斩将破军，平定山西，功效尤著。
target_text: Deng Yu recruited troops for Guangwu, defeating enemies like the bronze horses in Qingyang. When the Red Eyebrows threatened, Guangwu entrusted Deng Yu with the Western Expedition, appointing him Former General with 20,000 elite troops. In the first year of Jianwu, Deng Yu entered Hedong, defeating Gengshi generals and pacifying the region. Guangwu ascended the throne and made Deng Yu Chief Minister, praising his loyalty and achievements. At twenty-four, Deng Yu crossed into Xiayang, defeating more enemies as the Red Eyebrows entered Chang'an. His disciplined troops attracted many followers, and he became famous in Guanxi.

input_text: 帝问使人： 愔所亲爱为谁？ 对曰： 护军黄防。 帝度愔、防不能久和，势必相忤，因报禹曰： 缚冯愔者，必黄防也。 乃遣尚书宗广持节降之。 后月余，防果执愔，将其众归罪。 更始诸将王匡、胡殷等皆诣广降，与共东归。 至安邑，道欲亡，广悉斩之。 愔至洛阳，赦不诛。 二年春，遣使者更封禹为梁侯，食四县。 时，赤眉西走扶风，禹乃南至长安，军昆明池，大飨士卒。 率诸将斋戒，择吉日，修礼谒祠高庙，收十一帝神主，遣使奉诣洛阳，因循行园陵，为置吏士奉守焉。 禹引兵与延岑战于蓝田，不克，复就谷云阳。 汉中王刘嘉诣禹降。 嘉相李宝倨慢无礼，禹斩之。 宝弟收宝部曲击禹，杀将军耿。 无得复妄进兵。 禹惭于受任而功不遂，数以饥卒徼战，辄不利。 三年春，与车骑将军邓弘击赤眉，遂为所败，众皆死散。 事在《冯异传》。 独与二十四骑还诣宜阳，谢上大司徒、梁侯印绶。 有诏归侯印绶。 数月，拜右将军。 延岑自败于东阳，遂与秦丰合。 四年春，复寇顺阳间。 遣禹护复汉将军邓晔、辅汉将军于匡，击破岑于邓；追至武当，复破之。 岑奔汉中，余党悉降。 十三年，天下平定，诸功臣皆增户邑，定封禹为高密侯，食高密、昌安、夷安、淳于四县。
target_text: Deng Yu advised against directly attacking Chang'an, citing the Red Eyebrows' strength and advocating a strategy of gathering resources in the north to observe their weaknesses. He led his army north, defeating Red Eyebrow camps and gaining surrenders. However, internal conflicts among his generals led to setbacks. In the second year of Jianwu, Deng Yu was made Marquis of Liang. He fought the Red Eyebrows but faced defeats, and Guangwu recalled him, advising caution. Deng Yu, ashamed, continued fighting but was ultimately defeated in the third year, returning to Yiyang with few men and resigning his posts. He was later reinstated as Right General and achieved victories against Yan Cen.

input_text: 帝以禹功高，封弟宽为明亲侯。 其后左右将军官罢，以特进奉朝请。 禹内文明，笃行淳备，事母至孝。 天下既定，常欲远名势。 有子十三人，各使守一艺。 修整闺门，教养子孙，皆可以为后世法。 显宗即位，以禹先帝元功，拜为太傅，进见东向，甚见尊宠。 居岁余，寝疾。 帝数自临问，以子男二人为郎。 永平元年，年五十七薨，谥曰元侯。 帝分禹封为三国：长子震为高密侯，袭为昌安侯，珍为夷安侯。 禹少子鸿，好筹策。 永平中，以为小侯。 引入与议边事，帝以为能，拜将兵长史，率五营士屯雁门。 肃宗时，为度辽将军。
target_text: In the 13th year of Jianwu, Deng Yu was made Marquis of Gaomi. He was known for his filial piety, modesty, and avoidance of fame and power. He had thirteen children, each skilled in a craft, and lived frugally on his fiefdom taxes. He served as Acting Situ again and accompanied the emperor to Mount Tai. Under Xianzong, he was made Grand Tutor and treated with great respect. He died at fifty-seven in the first year of Yongping, posthumously titled Yuan Hou. His sons inherited his titles, and his descendants continued in service, though some faced downfall due to political incidents.

input_text: 今始至上谷而先堕大信，沮向化之心，生离畔之隙，将复何以号令它郡乎？ 且耿府君在上谷，久为使人所亲，今易之，得贤则造次未安，不紧则只更生乱。 为使君计，莫若复之以安百姓。 使者不应，恂左右以使者命召况。况至，恂进取印绶带况。 使者不得已，乃承制诏之，况受而归。 及王郎起，遣将徇上谷，急况发兵。 恂与门下掾闵业共说况曰： 邯郸拔起，难可信向。 昔王莽时，所难独有刘伯升耳。 今闻大司马刘公，伯升母弟，尊贤下士，士多归之，可攀附也。 况曰： 邯郸方盛，力不能独拒，如何？ 恂对曰： 今上谷完实，控弦万骑，举大郡之资，可以详择去就。 恂请东约渔阳，齐心合众，邯郸不足图也。 况然之，乃遣恂到渔阳，结谋彭宠。 恂还，至昌平，袭击邯郸使者，杀之，夺其军，遂与况子弇等俱南及光武于广阿。
target_text: Kou Xun, courtesy name Ziyi, was from Changping, Shanggu, from a prominent family. He served as a county officer under Prefect Geng Kuang. When Gengshi sent envoys, Kou Xun ensured Geng Kuang retained his position by persuading an envoy to return the seal. When Wang Lang rose, Kou Xun advised Geng Kuang to ally with Guangwu, citing his virtue. He attacked Handan's envoys and joined Guangwu, who made him a partial general. Deng Yu admired him, and Guangwu entrusted him with guarding Hanoi, comparing him to Xiao He.

input_text: 拜恂为偏将军，号承义侯，从破群贼。 数与邓禹谋议，禹奇之，因奉牛、酒共交欢。 光武南定河内，而更始大司马朱鲔等盛兵据洛阳，及并州未定，光武难其守，问于邓禹曰： 诸将谁可使守河内者？ 禹曰： 昔高祖任萧何于关中，无复四顾之忧，所以得专精山东，终成大业。 今河内带河为固，户口殷实，北通上党，南迫洛阳。 寇恂文武备足，有牧人御众之才，非此子莫可使也。 乃拜恂河内太守，行大将军事。 光武谓恂曰： 河内完富，吾将因是而起。 昔高祖留萧何镇关中，吾今委公以河内，坚守转运，给足军粮，率厉士马，防遏它兵，勿令北度而已。 光武于是复北征燕、代。 恂移书属县，讲兵肄射，伐淇园之竹，为矢百余万，养马二千匹，收租四百万斛，转以给军。 朱鲔闻光武北而河内孤，使讨难将军苏茂、副将贾彊将兵三万余人，度巩河攻温。
target_text: Kou Xun fortified Hanoi, supplying Guangwu's army with arrows, horses, and grain. When Zhu Tuna attacked Wen, Kou Xun led a swift defense, defeating Su Mao and Jia Qiang with reinforcements. Guangwu praised him and ascended the throne. Kou Xun continued supplying the army, but heeded advice to feign illness to avoid suspicion. He later served as Prefect of Yingchuan, suppressing bandits, and was made Marquis of Yongnu. He avoided conflict with General Jia Fu, reconciling with him for the nation's sake.

input_text: 初，隗嚣将安定高峻，拥兵万人，据高平第一，帝使待诏马援招降峻，由是河西道开。 中郎将来歙承制拜峻通路将军，封关内侯，后属大司马吴汉，共围嚣于冀。 及汉军退，峻亡归故营，复助嚣拒陇阺。 及嚣死，峻据高平，畏诛坚守。 建威大将军耿弇率太中大夫窦士、武威太守梁统等围之，一岁不拔。 十年，帝入关，将自征之，恂时从驾，谏曰： 长安道里居中，应接近便，安定、陇西必怀震惧，此从容一处可以制四方也。 今士马疲倦，方履险阻，非万乘之固，前年颍川，可为至戒。 帝不从。 进军及汧，峻犹不下，帝议遣使降之，乃谓恂曰： 卿前止吾此举，今为吾行也。 若峻不即降，引耿弇等五营击之。 恂奉玺书至第一，峻遣军师皇甫文出谒，辞礼不屈。 恂怒，将诛文。 诸将谏曰： 高峻精兵万人，率多强弩，西遮陇道，连年不下。 今欲降之而反戮其使，无乃不可乎？ 恂不应，遂斩之。 遣其副归告峻曰： 军师无礼，已戮之矣。 欲降，急降；不欲，固守。 峻惶恐，即日开城门降。 诸将皆贺，因曰： 敢问杀其使而降其城，何也？ 恂曰： 皇甫文，峻之腹心，其所取计者也。 今来，辞意不屈，必无降心。 全之则文得其计，杀之则峻亡其胆，是以降耳。 诸将皆曰： 非所及也。 遂传峻还洛阳。
target_text: Kou Xun governed Runan, building schools and teaching the Spring and Autumn Annals. He pacified Yingchuan again when bandits rose, and the people begged for his continued service. He advised Guangwu against personally attacking Gaoping, but when the campaign stalled, he persuaded Gao Jun to surrender by executing his advisor. Kou Xun was known for his virtue, generosity, and learning, and was considered prime minister material. He died in the 12th year of Jianwu, posthumously titled Wei Hou. His descendants continued his legacy, and his family remained influential. The historian praised his ability to control his emotions and avoid grudges, likening him to Boyi and Shuqi.

input_text: 邓彪张禹徐防张敏胡广邓彪字智伯，南阳新野人，太傅禹之宗也。父邯，中兴初以功封鄳侯，仕至勃海太守。 彪少励志，修孝行。 父卒，让国于异母弟荆凤，显宗高其节，下诏许焉。 后仕州郡，辟公府，五迁桂阳太守。 永平十七年，征入为太仆。 数年，丧后母，辞疾乞身，诏以光禄大夫行服。服竟，拜奉车都尉，迁大司农。 数月，代鲍昱为太尉。 彪在位清白，为百僚式。 视事四年，以疾乞骸骨。 元和元年，赐策罢，赠钱三十万，在所以二千石奉终其身。 又诏太常四时致宗庙之胙，河南尹遣丞存问，常以八月旦奉羊、酒。 和帝即位，以彪为太傅，录尚书事，赐爵关内侯。 永元初，窦氏专权骄纵，朝廷多有谏争，而彪在位修身而已，不能有所匡正。
target_text: **Deng Biao** (courtesy name Zhibo), a native of Nanyang and of the same clan as Taifu Deng Yuzhi, was the son of Deng Han. In the early Zhongxing Dynasty, he was made Marquis of Monument for his service and served as Prefect of Bohai Sea. Known for filial piety, he ceded his inheritance to his half-brother Jing Feng after his father's death, a decision Emperor Xianzong approved. He held various official posts, including Guiyang magistrate, and was recruited as a servant in Yongping's 17th year. After his stepmother's death, he served as Guanglu Dafu, then Fengche Captain and Dasi Nong, eventually replacing Bao Yu as Taiwei. Known for his integrity, he resigned due to illness after four years. In Yuanhe's first year, he was dismissed with a gift of 300,000 yuan and a lifelong salary of 2,000 dan. Emperor He later appointed him Taifu and Marquis of Guannei. During the Dou family's autocracy, he remained self-cultivating but made no corrections. He died in office in the spring of the fifth year, and the emperor visited his home.

input_text: 又尝奏免御史中丞周纡，纡前失窦氏旨，故颇以此致讥，然当时宗其礼让。 及窦氏诛，以老病上还枢机职，诏赐养牛、酒而许焉。 五年春，薨于位，天子新临吊临。 张禹字伯达，赵国襄国人也。 祖父况族姊为皇祖考夫人，数往来南顿，见光武。 光武为大司马，过邯郸，况为郡吏，谒见光武。 光武大喜，曰： 乃今得我大舅乎！ 因与俱北，到高邑，以为元氏令。 迁涿郡太守。 后为常山关长。 会赤眉攻关城，况战殁。 父歆，初以报仇逃亡，后仕为淮阳相，终于汲令。 禹性笃厚节俭。 父卒，汲吏人赙送前后数百万，悉无所受。 又以田宅推与伯父，身自寄止。 永平八年，举孝廉，稍迁；建初中，拜杨州刺史。 当过江行部，中上人皆以江有子胥之神，难于济涉。 禹将度，吏固请不听。 禹厉言曰： 子胥如有灵，知吾志在理察枉讼，岂危我哉？ 遂鼓楫而过。 历行郡邑，深幽之处莫不毕到，亲录囚徒，多所明举。
target_text: **Zhang Yu** (courtesy name Boda), from Zhao Guoxiang, was the grandson of Zhang Kuang, whose clan sister married Emperor Zukao. Zhang Kuang met Emperor Guangwu and served as Yuan family order, Zhuo County governor, and Changshan Pass chief, dying in battle against the Red Eyebrow Army. Zhang Yu's father, Zhang Xin, sought revenge and later became Prime Minister of Huaiyang. Zhang Yu was honest and thrifty, refusing donations after his father's death and giving his land to his uncle. Promoted to Xiaolian in Yongping's 8th year, he became Yangzhou governor in Jianchu's early years. He famously crossed the river despite fears of the god Zixu, personally interrogating prisoners and resolving cases. As Yanzhou governor, he gained a reputation for fairness. As Xiapi Prime Minister, he irrigated Puyangpo, reclaiming hundreds of hectares and attracting over a thousand poor households. He punished the powerful official Shi Dairun, earning respect. In Yongyuan's 6th year, he became Grand Sima and Taiwei, advising Emperor He against risky travel. Promoted to Taifu in Yanping's 1st year, he lived in the palace under Empress Dowager Deng's orders, advocating for allocating open lands to the poor. He served Emperor An, resigning several times but receiving gifts. He was made Marquis of Anxiang in Yongchu's 1st year. He advised the Empress Dowager to return to the palace during her mother's illness. After years of famine, he requested tax collection for relief. He was dismissed in the 5th year due to yin-yang disharmony and died at home seven years later.

input_text: 五年，以阴阳不和策免。 七年，卒于家。 使者吊祭。 除小子为郎中。 长子盛嗣。 徐防字谒卿，沛国铚人也。 祖父宣，为讲学大夫，以《易》教授王莽。 父宪，亦传宣业。 防少习父祖学，永平中，举孝廉，除为郎。 防体貌矜严，占对可观，显宗异之，特补尚书郎。 职典枢机，周密畏慎，奉事二帝，未尝有过。 和帝时，稍迁司隶校尉，出为魏郡太守。 永元十年，迁少府、大司农。 防勤晓政事，所在有迹。 十四年，拜司空。 防以《五经》久远，圣意难明，宜为章句，以悟后学。 上疏曰：臣闻《诗》、《书》、《礼》、《乐》，定自孔子；发明章句，始于子夏。 其后诸家分析，各有异说。 汉承乱秦，经典废绝，本文略存，或无章句。 收拾缺遗，建立明经，博征儒术，开置太学。
target_text: **Xu Fang** (courtesy name Yeqing), from Pei, learned from his father and grandfather, who taught Wang Mang the Book of Changes. Promoted to Xiaolian during Yongping, he became Shangshulang, serving two emperors without fault. Under Emperor He, he served as Sili Xiaowei, Wei County prefect, Shaofu, and DaSinong. In Yongyuan's 14th year, he became Sikong. He proposed reforming the examination system for doctors, advocating for testing based on famous scholars' chapters and verses to prevent private interests and disputes. His suggestions were followed. In the 16th year, he became Situ, then Taiwei in Yanping's 1st year, participating in Shangshu affairs with Taifu Zhang Yu. Emperor An made him Marquis of Longxiang. He was dismissed due to disasters and bandits, the first of the three ministers to be exempted. After his death, his son Xu Heng inherited, later passing the title to his brother Xu Chong.

input_text: 夫春生秋杀，天道之常。 春一物枯即为灾，秋一物华即为异。 王者承天地，顺四时，法圣人，从经律。 愿陛下留意下民，考寻利害，广令平议，天下幸甚。 和帝从之。 九年，拜司隶校尉。 视事二岁，迁汝南太守。 清约不烦，用刑平正，有理能名。 坐事免。 延平元年，拜议郎，再迁颍川太守。 永初元年，征拜司空，在位奉法而已。 视事三岁，以病乞身，不听。 六年春，行大射礼，陪位顿仆，乃策罢之。 因病笃，卒于家。 胡广字伯始，南郡华容人也。 六世祖刚，清高有志节。 平帝时，大司徒马宫辟之。 值王莽居摄，刚解其衣冠，县府门而去，遂亡命交阯，隐于屠肆之间。 后莽败，乃归乡里。 父贡，交阯都尉。 广少孤贫，亲执家苦。 长大，随辈入郡为散吏。 太守法雄之子真，从家来省其父。
target_text: **Zhang Min** (courtesy name Boda), from Molan, Hejian, was promoted to Xiaolian in Jianchu's 2nd year. He opposed the "Insult Law," arguing it opened the way to killing and promoted sin. He cited Confucius and the Spring and Autumn Annals, advocating for removing complicated laws. Emperor He agreed. In the 9th year, he became Sili Xiaowei, then Runan prefect, known for fairness. After dismissal, he became Yilang and Yingchuan prefect in Yanping's 1st year. In Yongchu's 1st year, he was recruited as Sikong, serving according to law. He requested retirement due to illness but was refused. In the spring of the 6th year, he fell during a grand shooting ceremony and was dismissed, dying at home.

input_text: 夫春生秋杀，天道之常。 春一物枯即为灾，秋一物华即为异。 王者承天地，顺四时，法圣人，从经律。 愿陛下留意下民，考寻利害，广令平议，天下幸甚。 和帝从之。 九年，拜司隶校尉。 视事二岁，迁汝南太守。 清约不烦，用刑平正，有理能名。 坐事免。 延平元年，拜议郎，再迁颍川太守。 永初元年，征拜司空，在位奉法而已。 视事三岁，以病乞身，不听。 六年春，行大射礼，陪位顿仆，乃策罢之。 因病笃，卒于家。 胡广字伯始，南郡华容人也。 六世祖刚，清高有志节。 平帝时，大司徒马宫辟之。 值王莽居摄，刚解其衣冠，县府门而去，遂亡命交阯，隐于屠肆之间。 后莽败，乃归乡里。 父贡，交阯都尉。 广少孤贫，亲执家苦。 长大，随辈入郡为散吏。 太守法雄之子真，从家来省其父。
target_text: **Hu Guang** (courtesy name Boshi), from Huarong, Nanjun, was a descendant of the virtuous Hu Gang. Orphaned and poor, he worked as a casual official. Recommended by Fazhen, he was tested by Zhang Zhi and deemed the best in the world by Emperor An. He became Shangshulang and Shangshu Pushe. He advised Emperor Shun against drawing lots to choose a queen, advocating for selecting based on virtue, age, and appearance. He opposed Zuo Xiong's proposal to set a minimum age of 40 for officials, arguing for flexibility based on talent. He served as Chenliu prefect, Jiyin prefect, Runan prefect, and Da Sinong. In Han'an's 1st year, he became Situ, then Taiwei, establishing Emperor Huan and becoming Marquis of Yuyang Anle Township. He served multiple terms, including as Sikong and Taiwei, but was dismissed after Liang Ji's death. He later served under Emperor Ling as Taifu. Known for his gentle and discreet nature, he mastered court rules and was praised in the capital: "Ignore everything and ask Bo Shi, there is only Hu Gong among the mediocre." He served six emperors for over 30 years, holding high offices repeatedly. He died at 82 in Xiping's 1st year, receiving grand honors. He also compiled the "Baiguan Zhen" and other works. Emperor Ling later had his portrait painted in the province.

input_text: 郎顗襄楷 郎顗字雅光，北海安丘人也。 父宗，字仲绥，学《京氏易》，善风角、星算、六日七分，能望气占候吉凶，常卖卜自奉。 安帝征之，对策为诸儒表，后拜吴令。 时卒有暴风，宗占知京师当有大火，记识时日，遣人参候，果如其言。 诸公闻而表上，以博士征之。 宗耻以占验见知，闻征书到，夜县印绶于县廷而遁去，遂终身不仕。 顗少传父业，兼明经典，隐居海畔，延致学徒常数百人。 昼研精义，夜占象度，勤心锐思，朝夕无倦。 州郡辟召，举有道、方正，不就。 顺帝时，灾异屡见，阳嘉二年正月，公正征，顗乃诣阙拜章曰：臣闻天垂妖象，地见灾符，所以谴告人主，责躬修德，使正机平衡，流化兴政也。
target_text: Lang Yi, courtesy name Yaguang, was born in Anqiu, Beihai. His father, Lang Zong, studied the "Jing's Book of Changes," excelled in divination and astrology, and supported himself by fortune-telling. Emperor An summoned him, and his responses set a standard for Confucian scholars. He later became magistrate of Wu County, where he accurately predicted a fire in the capital through divination. The imperial court summoned him with a doctor's title, but Lang Zong, ashamed of being known for fortune-telling, fled by night, hanging his seal in the county court, and never served as an official again.

input_text: 郎顗襄楷 郎顗字雅光，北海安丘人也。 父宗，字仲绥，学《京氏易》，善风角、星算、六日七分，能望气占候吉凶，常卖卜自奉。 安帝征之，对策为诸儒表，后拜吴令。 时卒有暴风，宗占知京师当有大火，记识时日，遣人参候，果如其言。 诸公闻而表上，以博士征之。 宗耻以占验见知，闻征书到，夜县印绶于县廷而遁去，遂终身不仕。 顗少传父业，兼明经典，隐居海畔，延致学徒常数百人。 昼研精义，夜占象度，勤心锐思，朝夕无倦。 州郡辟召，举有道、方正，不就。 顺帝时，灾异屡见，阳嘉二年正月，公正征，顗乃诣阙拜章曰：臣闻天垂妖象，地见灾符，所以谴告人主，责躬修德，使正机平衡，流化兴政也。
target_text: Lang Yi inherited his father's studies, lived in seclusion by the sea, and taught hundreds of disciples. During Emperor Shun's reign, disasters occurred frequently. In the first month of the second year of Yangjia, Lang Yi was summoned to court. He submitted a memorial attributing disasters to the ruler's governance, urging the emperor to practice frugality, reflect on faults, and reform policies. He warned that luxury, excessive construction, and harsh punishments caused celestial anomalies like prolonged cloudiness, cold spells, and fires. He cited classical texts to argue that the emperor should reduce palace expenditures, release palace maids to restore harmony, and dismiss incompetent officials. He also predicted earthquakes, floods, and invasions if reforms were not enacted.

input_text: 朝廷前加优宠，宾于上位。 琼入朝日浅，谋谟未就，因以丧病，致命遂志。 《老子》曰： 大音希声，大器晚成。 善人为固，三年乃立。 天下莫不嘉朝廷有此良人，而复怪其不时还任。 陛下宜加降崇之恩，极养贤之礼，征反京师，以慰天下。 又处士汉中李固，年四十，通游、夏之艺，履颜、闵之仁。 洁白之节，情同璬日，忠贞之操，好是正直，卓冠古人，当世莫及。 元精所生，王之佐臣，天之生固，必为圣汉，宜蒙特征，以示四方。 夫有出伦之才，不应限以官次。 昔颜子十八，天下归仁；子奇稚齿，化阿有声。 若还琼征固，任以时政，伊尹、傅说，不足为此，则可垂景光，致休祥矣。 臣顗明不知人，伏听众言，百姓所归，臧否共叹。 愿泛问百僚，核其名行，有一不合，则臣为欺国。
target_text: In a dialogue with the minister, Lang Yi elaborated on seven urgent matters: cemetery fires due to extravagance, hypocritical officials causing yin-yang imbalances, impending droughts and floods, the need to establish an heir, white rainbow portending coups, and the necessity to change the calendar and official titles. He recommended recruiting virtuous men like Huang Qiong and Li Gu to stabilize the state. Despite his detailed warnings, Lang Yi resigned from his appointed doctor position and returned home. His predictions of earthquakes, droughts, and barbarian invasions later proved accurate. He was eventually killed by a local knight-errant, Sun Li.

input_text: 秋，鲜卑入马邑城，破代郡兵。 明年，西羌寇陇右。 皆略如顗言。 后复公车征，不行。 同县孙礼者，积恶凶暴，好游侠，与其同里人常慕顗名德，欲与亲善。 顗不顾，以此结怨，遂为礼所杀。 襄楷字公矩，平原隰阴人也。 好学博古，善天文阴阳之术。 桓帝时，宦官专朝，政刑暴滥，又比失皇子，灾异尤数。 延熹九年，楷自家诣阙上疏曰：臣闻皇天不言，以文象设教。 尧、舜虽圣，必历象日月星辰，察五纬所在，故能享百年之寿，为万世之法。 臣窃见去岁五月，荧惑入太微，犯帝座，出端门，不轨常道。 其闰月良辰，太白入房，犯心小星，震动中耀。 中耀，天王也；傍小星者，天王子也。 夫太微天廷，五帝之坐，而金火罚星扬光其中，于占，天子凶；又俱入房、心，法无继嗣。 今年岁星久守太微，逆行西至掖门，还切执汉。
target_text: Xiang Kai, courtesy name Gongju, was from Xiyin, Pingyuan. During Emperor Huan's reign, eunuchs dominated, punishments were brutal, and disasters were frequent. In the ninth year of Yanxi, Xiang Kai submitted a memorial citing astronomical anomalies—Mars and Venus invading key stars—as warnings against harsh rule and unjust executions. He criticized the killing of loyal officials like Li Yun and Du Zhong, the neglect of heirs due to excessive palace maids, and the decline of education. He noted omens like a dead dragon and falling stars, linking them to past dynastic collapses. He urged the emperor to reform punishments, release prisoners, and promote virtue.

input_text: 楷不正辞理，指陈要务，而析言破律，违背经艺，假借星宿，伪托神灵，造合私意，诬上罔事。请下司隶，正楷罪法，收送洛阳狱。 帝以楷言虽激切，然皆天文恒象之数，故不诛，犹司寇论刑。 初，顺帝时，琅邪宫崇诣阙，上其师干吉于曲阳泉水上所得神书百七十卷，皆缥白素朱介青首朱目，号《太平清领书》。 其言以阴阳五行为家，而多巫觋杂语。 有司奏崇所上妖妄不经，乃收臧之。 后张角颇有其书焉。 及灵帝即位，以楷书为然。 太傅陈蕃举方正，不就。 乡里宗之，每太守至，辄致礼清。 中平中，与荀爽、郑玄俱以博士征，不至，卒于家。
target_text: Emperor Huan initially ignored Xiang Kai's reports. When summoned, Xiang Kai condemned eunuchs, stating their proliferation caused the lack of an heir. The minister of corrections accused him of slander, but the emperor spared him, citing the astronomical basis of his words. Xiang Kai later refused official posts, including one offered by Grand Tutor Chen Fan, and died at home during the Zhongping period.

input_text: 郑太字公业，河南开封人，司农众之曾孙也。 少有少略。灵帝末，知天下将乱，阴交结豪杰。 家富于财，有田四百顷，而食常不足，名闻山东。 初，举孝廉，三府辟，公车征，皆不就。 及大将军何进辅政，征用名士，以公业为尚书待郎，迁待御史。 进将诛阉官，欲召并州牧董卓为助。 公业谓进曰： 董卓强忍寡义，志欲无厌。 若借之朝政，授以大事。将恣凶欲，必危朝廷。 明公以亲德之重，据阿衡之权，秉意独断，诛除有罪，诚不宜假卓以为资援也。 且事留变生，殷鉴不远。 又为陈时务之所急数事。 进不能用，乃弃官去。 谓颍川人旬攸曰： 何公未易辅也。 进寻见害，卓果作乱。 公业等与侍中伍琼、卓长史何颙共说卓，以袁绍为勃海太守，以发山东之谋。 及义兵起，卓乃会公卿议，大发卒讨之，群僚莫敢忤旨。 公业恐其众多益横，凶强难制，独曰： 夫政在德，不在众也。 卓不悦，曰： 如卿此言，兵为无用邪？ 公业惧，乃诡词更对曰：非谓无用，以为山东不足加大兵耳。
target_text: **Zheng Taichuan (Zheng Gongye)** was born in Kaifeng, Henan, as the great-grandson of Sinong Zheng Zhong. Talented from youth, his mother foresaw chaos in the final years of Emperor Ling's reign and secretly befriended heroes. Despite owning 400 hectares of land, he often lacked food. He was renowned throughout Shandong. Initially recommended for office, he declined multiple appointments. When General He Jin recruited him as Minister of the Secretariat and Censor, Zheng warned against recruiting Dong Zhuo, predicting his violent ambition would endanger the court. He Jin ignored this advice, so Zheng resigned. After He Jin was killed and Dong Zhuo rebelled, Zheng conspired with others to oppose Dong Zhuo. When Dong Zhuo wanted to attack the rebels, Zheng argued that governing depends on virtue, not military might. Fearing Dong Zhuo's anger, he fabricated a flattering analysis listing ten reasons why Dong Zhuo would defeat the rebels. Dong Zhuo appointed him general, but others warned of Zheng's cunning, so Dong Zhuo revoked the command. Zheng later plotted to kill Dong Zhuo, but the plan leaked. He escaped to Yuan Shu, who appointed him Governor of Yangzhou, but he died en route at age forty-one.

input_text: 左丞祖者，称有意谋，劝融有所结纳。 融知绍、操终图汉室，不欲与同，故怒而杀之。 融负有高气，志在靖难，而才疏意广，迄无成功。 在郡六年，刘备表领青州刺史。 建安元年，为袁谭所攻，自春至夏，战士所余裁数百人，流矢雨集，戈矛内接。 融隐几读书，谈笑自若。 城夜陷，乃奔东山，妻、子为谭所虏。 及献帝都许，征融为将作大匠，迁少府。 融乃独议曰： 日磾以上公之尊，秉髦节之使，衔命直指，宁辑东夏，而曲媚奸臣，为所牵率，章表署用，辄使首名，附下罔上，奸以事君。 昔国佐当晋军而不挠，宜僚临白刃而正色。
target_text: **Kong Rong**, a descendant of Confucius, showed exceptional intelligence as a child. At ten, he cleverly gained an audience with Li Ying by claiming family friendship through Confucius and Laozi. When Chen Wei dismissed him, Kong retorted sharply. At thirteen, his father's death caused such grief he needed support to stand. At sixteen, he sheltered the fugitive Zhang Jian, leading to his brother's execution when the family competed to take blame. Kong Rong became famous and was recruited as an official. He criticized corrupt eunuch relatives, offended He Jin, and later opposed Dong Zhuo's deposition of the Young Emperor. Dong Zhuo sent him to troubled Beihai as punishment. There, Kong Rong built cities, schools, promoted Confucianism, and recommended worthy men. When surrounded by Yellow Turban rebels, Liu Bei rescued him, amazed that Kong Rong knew of him. Kong Rong refused to ally with Yuan Shao or Cao Cao, knowing they would usurp the Han. After six years, Liu Bei recommended him as Qingzhou governor. Yuan Tan attacked; though outnumbered, Kong Rong remained calm, reading and laughing until the city fell. He fled, but his wife was captured. Later serving Emperor Xian, Kong Rong often made court decisions. He opposed corporal punishment, argued against publicizing Liu Biao's treason, and criticized Cao Cao's massacre of Yecheng and his son's marriage to Yuan Xi's wife. He mocked Cao Cao's campaigns and opposed his alcohol ban. Cao Cao, though outwardly tolerant, grew jealous. Eventually, Cao Cao had Kong Rong executed for treason at fifty-six. His children were also killed; his seven-year-old daughter and nine-year-old son calmly accepted death, saying a destroyed nest cannot have unbroken eggs.

input_text: 操每征伐在外，其军国之事，皆与彧筹焉，彧又进操计谋之士从子攸，及钟繇、郭嘉、陈群、杜袭、司马懿、戏志才等，皆称其举。 唯严象为杨州，韦康为凉州，后并负败焉。 袁绍既兼河朔之地，有骄气。 而操败于张绣，绍与操书甚倨。 操大怒，欲先攻之，而患力不敌，以谋于彧。 彧量绍虽强，终为操所制，乃说先取吕布，然后图绍，操从之。 三年，遂擒吕布，定徐州。 五年，袁绍率大众以攻许，操与相距。 绍甲兵甚盛，议者咸怀惶惧。 少府孔融谓彧曰： 袁绍地广兵强，田丰、许攸智计之士为其谋，审配、逢纪尽忠之臣任其事，颜良、文丑勇冠三军，统其兵，殆难克乎？ 彧曰： 绍兵虽多而法不整，田丰刚而犯上，许攸贪而不正，审配专而无谋，逢纪果而自用，颜良、文丑匹夫之勇，可一点而擒也。 后皆如彧所筹，事在《袁绍传》。 操保官度，与绍连战，虽胜而军粮方尽，书与彧议，欲还许以致绍师。 彧报曰： 今谷食虽少，未若楚汉在荥阳、成皋间也。 是时刘、项莫肯先退者，以为先退则势屈也。 公以十分居一之众，画地而守之，扼其喉而不得进，已半年矣。
target_text: **Xun Yu**, grandson of Magistrate Xun Shu, was recognized as extraordinary by He Yong. Recommended as Xiaolian, he abandoned office when Dong Zhuo rebelled. He warned his clan to flee Yingchuan, predicting war; those who stayed were later killed. He joined Yuan Shao but, seeing the Han's chaos, left for Cao Cao, who called him "my Zhang Liang." When Zhang Miao and Chen Gong rebelled, Xun Yu defended Zhen City, outsmarting their deception and personally meeting Guo Gong to prevent his alliance with rebels. He secured three cities for Cao Cao's return. Xun Yu advised Cao Cao to stabilize Yanzhou before attacking Xuzhou, leading to Lu Bu's defeat. He urged Cao Cao to welcome Emperor Xian to Xuchang, arguing this would bring legitimacy. Xun Yu recommended talented men like Xun You, Zhong Yao, and Guo Jia. He predicted Yuan Shao's defeat despite his strength, correctly assessing his generals' weaknesses. During the Guandu stalemate, when Cao Cao wanted to retreat, Xun Yu insisted on holding position, leading to Yuan Shao's defeat. He advised against attacking Liu Biao before pacifying Yuan Shao's remnants. When Cao Cao wanted to restore the ancient Jiuzhou system, Xun Yu warned it would cause panic, and Cao Cao abandoned the plan. Cao Cao praised Xun Yu's strategies as turning defeat into victory. When Dong Zhao proposed making Cao Cao Duke of Jin, Xun Yu opposed it, saying Cao Cao should remain loyal to Han. Cao Cao grew resentful. During a southern campaign, Cao Cao kept Xun Yu at his camp, then sent him an empty food box. Xun Yu took poison and died at fifty. The next year, Cao Cao declared himself Duke of Wei.

input_text: 郑兴字少赣，河南开封人也。 少学《公羊春秋》。晚善《左氏传》，遂积精深思，通达其旨，同学者皆师之。 天凤中，将门人从刘歆讲正大义，歆美兴才，使撰条例、章句、传诂，及校《三统历》。 更始立，以司直李松行丞相事，先入长安，松以兴为长史，令还奉迎迁都。 更始诸将皆山东人，咸劝留洛阳。 兴说更始曰： 陛下起自荆楚，权政未施，一朝建号，而山西雄桀争诛王莽，开关郊迎者，何也？ 此天下同苦王氏虐政，而思高祖之旧德也。 今久不抚之，臣恐百姓离心，盗贼复起矣。 《春秋》书 齐小白入齐 ，不称侯，未朝庙故也。 今议者欲先定赤眉而后入关，是不识其本而争其末，恐国家之守转在函谷，虽卧洛阳，庸得安枕乎？ 更始曰： 朕西决矣。 拜兴为谏议大夫，使安集关西及朔方、凉、益三州，还拜凉州刺史。 会天水有反者，攻杀郡守，兴坐免。 时赤眉入关，东道不通，兴乃西归隗嚣，嚣虚心礼请，而兴耻为之屈，称疾不起。 嚣矜己自饰，常以为西伯复作，乃与诸将议自立为王。 兴闻而说嚣曰： 《春秋传》云： 口不道忠信之言为嚣，耳不听五声之和为聋。
target_text: Zheng Xing, courtesy name Shaogan, was born in Kaifeng, Henan. He studied "Gongyang Chunqiu" in his youth and later "Zuo Shi Zhuan," becoming so knowledgeable that his classmates regarded him as their teacher. During the Tianfeng period, he taught Liu Xin the meaning of "Zuo Shi Zhuan." When Gengshi ascended the throne, Zheng Xing served as chief historian and advised the emperor to move west to Chang'an rather than stay in Luoyang, arguing that the people missed Han virtues and that delaying would cause alienation and rebellion. Gengshi appointed him as an admonishment official and later governor of Liangzhou.

target_text: After being dismissed following a rebellion in Tianshui, Zheng Xing joined Wei Xiao. When Wei Xiao considered declaring himself king, Zheng Xing dissuaded him by citing historical examples of King Wen of Zhou and Emperor Gaozu of Han, warning that such ambition would bring disaster. He also advised against establishing excessive official positions. When Wei Xiao refused to let Zheng Xing return home to bury his parents, Zheng Xing argued that using his parents as leverage was improper, and Wei Xiao eventually relented.

input_text: 今陛下高明而群臣惶促，宜留思柔克之政，垂意《洪范》之法，博采广谋，纳群下之策。书奏，多有所纳。 帝尝问兴郊祀事，曰： 吾欲以谶断之，何如？ 兴对曰： 臣不为谶。 帝怒曰： 卿之不为谶，非之邪？ 兴惶恐曰： 臣于书有所未学，而无所非也。 帝意乃解。 兴数言政事，依经守义，文章温雅，然以不善谶故不能任。 九年，使监征南、积弩营于津乡，会征南将军岑彭为刺客所杀，兴领其营，遂与大司马吴汉俱击公孙述。 述死，诏兴留屯成都。 顷之，侍御史举奏兴奉使私买奴婢，坐左转莲勺令。 是时丧乱之余，郡县残荒，兴方欲筑城郭，修礼教以化之，会以事免。 兴好古学，尤明《左氏》、《周官》，长于历数，自杜林、桓谭、卫宏之属，莫不斟酌焉。 世言《左氏》者多祖于兴，而贾逵自传其父业，故有郑、贾之学。 及顺帝立，安世已卒，追赐钱、帛，除子亮为郎。众曾孙公业，自有传。范升字辩卿，代郡人也。 少孤，依外家居。 九岁通《论语》、《孝经》，及长，习《梁丘易》、《老子》，教授后生。 王莽大司空王邑辟升为议曹史。 时莽频发兵役，征赋繁兴，升乃奏记邑曰： 升闻子以人不间于其父母为孝，臣以下不非其君上为忠。 今众人咸称朝圣，皆曰公明。
target_text: In the sixth year of Jianwu, Du Lin recommended Zheng Xing to the emperor, praising his knowledge and virtue. Zheng Xing was recruited as Taizhong doctor. After a solar eclipse, he submitted a memorial discussing celestial omens and advising the emperor to select officials based on merit rather than personal grudges. The emperor once asked Zheng Xing about using prophecies for suburban sacrifices, but Zheng Xing admitted he did not understand prophecies, which limited his advancement. In the ninth year, he was sent to supervise military campaigns and later demoted for privately purchasing slaves. He died at home after retiring from official service.
