target_text: In the ninth year, Wei Xiao died, and his son Wei Chun became king. Yanmen officials were moved to Taiyuan. The Qingjin Left School Lieutenant was appointed. Gongsun Shu occupied Jingmen. Emperor Guangwu climbed Mount Fuyuan. Wu Han attacked Lu Fang's general but was unsuccessful. Lai She led a campaign against Wei Chun. Du Mao was defeated. The Guandu Lieutenant was abolished, and the Qiang School Lieutenant was restored.

input_text: 八月，帝自上邽晨夜东驰。 九月乙卯，车驾还宫。 庚申，帝自征颍川盗贼，皆降。 安丘侯张步叛归琅邪，琅邪太守陈俊讨获之。 戊寅，至自颍川。 冬十月丙午，幸怀。 十一月乙丑，至自怀。 公孙述遣兵救隗器，吴汉、盖延等还军长安。 天水、陇西复反归嚣。 十二月，高句丽王遣使奉贡。 是岁大水。 九年春正月，隗器病死，其将王元、周宗复立嚣子纯为王。 徙雁门吏人于太原。 三月辛亥，初置青巾左校尉官。 公孙述遣将田戎、任满据荆门。 夏六月丙戌，幸缑氏，登轘辕。 遣大司马吴汉率四将军击卢芳将贾览于高柳，战不利。 秋八月，遣中郎将来歙监征西大将军冯异等五将军讨隗纯于天水。 骠骑大将军杜茂与贾览战于繁畤，茂军败绩。 是岁，省关都尉，复置护羌校尉官。 十年春正月，大司马吴汉率捕虏将军王霸等五将军击贾览于高柳，匈奴遣骑救览，诸将与战，却之。 修理长安高庙。 夏，征西大将军冯异破公孙述将赵匡于天水，斩之。 征西大将军冯异薨。 秋八月己亥，幸长安，祠高庙，遂有事十一陵。 戊戌，进幸氵幵。隗嚣将高峻降。 冬十月，中郎将来歙等大破隗纯于落门，其将王元奔蜀，纯与周宗降，陇右平。 先零羌寇金城、陇西，来歙率诸将击羌于五溪，大破之。 庚寅，车驾还宫。 是岁，省定襄郡，徙其民于西河。 泗水王歙薨。淄川王终薨。
target_text: In the tenth year, Wu Han drove back Xiongnu cavalry. The Gaomiao Temple in Chang'an was repaired. Feng Yi defeated and killed Gongsun Shu's general. Feng Yi died. Emperor Guangwu visited Chang'an. Wei Xiao's general Gao Jun surrendered. Wei Chun fled to Shu but later surrendered, pacifying Longyou. Lai She defeated the Qiang. Emperor Guangwu returned to Luoyang. Dingxiang County was abolished.

input_text: 十一年春二月己卯，诏曰： 天地之性人为贵。 其杀奴婢，不得减罪。 三月己酉，幸南阳；还，幸章陵，祠园陵。 城阳王祉薨。 庚午，车驾还宫。 闰月，征南大将军岑彭率三将军与公孙述将田戎、任满战于荆门，大破之，获任满。 威虏将军冯骏围田戎于江州，岑彭遂率舟师伐公孙述，平巴郡。 夏四月丁卯，省大司徒司直官。 先零羌寇临洮。 六月，中郎将来歙率扬武将军马成破公孙述将王元、环安于下辩。 安遣间人刺杀中郎将来歙。 帝自将征公孙述。 秋七月，次长安。 八月，岑彭破公孙述将侯丹于黄石。 辅威将军臧宫与公孙述将延岑战于沈水，大破之。 王元降。 至自长安。 癸亥，诏曰： 敢灸灼奴婢，论如律，免所灸灼者为庶人。 冬十月壬午，诏除奴婢射伤人弃市律。 公孙述遣间人刺杀征南大将军岑彭。
target_text: In the eleventh year, an edict stated that killing a slave or maid was still murder. Emperor Guangwu visited Nanyang and Zhangling. Cen Peng defeated Gongsun Shu's generals and captured Ren Man. Feng Jun besieged Tian Rong. Cen Peng pacified Bajun. Lai She defeated Gongsun Shu's generals but was assassinated. Emperor Guangwu personally campaigned against Gongsun Shu. Cen Peng defeated Hou Dan. Zang Gong defeated Yancen. Wang Yuan surrendered. An edict banned the burning of slaves and abolished the law requiring slaves to be executed for shooting someone. Gongsun Shu assassinated Cen Peng. Ma Cheng pacified Wudu. Wu Han led a naval attack on Gongsun Shu. The Shuofang Mu was eliminated.

input_text: 马成平武都，因陇西太守马援击破先零羌，徙致天水、陇西、扶风。 十二月，大司马吴汉率舟师伐公孙述。 是岁，省朔方牧，并并州。 初断州牧自还奏事。 十二年春正月，大司马吴汉与公孙述将史兴战于武阳，斩之。 三月癸酉，诏陇、蜀民被略为奴婢自讼者，及狱官未报，一切免为庶人。 夏，甘露降南行唐。 六月，黄龙见东阿。 秋七月，威虏将军冯骏拔江州，获田戎。 九月，吴汉大破公孙述将谢丰于广都，斩之。 辅威将军臧宫拔涪城，斩公孙恢。 大司空李通罢。 冬十一月戊寅，吴汉、臧宫与公孙述战于成都，大破之。 述被创，夜死。 辛巳，吴汉屠成都，夷述宗族及延岑等。 十二月辛卯，扬武将军马成行大司空事。 是岁，九真徼外蛮夷张游率种人内属，封为归汉里君。 省金城郡属陇西。 参狼羌寇武都，陇西太守马援讨降之。
target_text: In the twelfth year, Wu Han killed Shi Xing. An edict freed those robbed as slaves in Long and Shu. Timely rain fell. A yellow dragon appeared. Feng Jun captured Jiangzhou. Wu Han defeated Xie Feng. Zang Gong captured Fucheng. Li Tong was dismissed. Wu Han defeated Gongsun Shu, who died of injuries. Chengdu was massacred. Ma Cheng became Grand Sikong. Zhang You surrendered. Jincheng County was merged into Longxi. Ma Yuan subdued the Shenlang Qiang. An edict allowed border troops to determine pursuit distances. Wang Chang died, and Du Mao led prisoners to build fortifications.

input_text: 丁巳，降赵王良为赵公，太原王章为齐公，鲁王兴为鲁公。 庚午，以殷绍嘉公孔安为宋公，周承休公姬武为卫公。 省并西京十三国：广平属巨鹿，真定属常山，河间属信都，城阳属琅邪，泗水属广陵，淄川属高密，胶东属北海，六安属庐江，广阳属上谷。 三月辛未，沛郡太守韩歆为大司徒。 丙子，行大司空马成罢。 夏四月，大司马吴汉自蜀还京师，于是大飨将士，班劳策勋。 功臣增邑更封，凡三百六十五人。 其外戚恩泽封者四十五人。 罢左右将军官。 建威大将军耿弇罢。 益州传送公孙述瞽师、郊庙乐器、葆车、舆辇，于是法物始备。 时，兵革既息，天下少事，文书调役，务从简寡，至乃十存一焉。 甲寅，冀州牧窦融为大司空。 五月，匈奴寇河东。
target_text: In the thirteenth year, Hou Ba died. An edict stopped counties from contributing exotic delicacies. Ma Wu was sent to guard against the Xiongnu. Lu Fang rebelled. Several kings were demoted to marquises. Nine feudal states were merged. Han Xin became Grand Situ. Ma Cheng was dismissed. Wu Han returned from Shu, and meritorious officials were rewarded. The left and right generals were abolished. Gongsun Shu's treasures were used to complete palace ceremonies. Official documents were reduced to one-tenth. Dou Mu became Grand Sikong. The Xiongnu invaded Hedong. The Baima Qiang surrendered. Japan presented white pheasants and rabbits. An edict freed slaves in Yizhou. Jincheng County was restored.

input_text: 秋七月，广汉徼外白马羌豪率种人内属。 九月，日南徼外蛮夷献白雉、白兔。 冬十二月甲寅，诏益州民自八年以来被略为奴婢者，皆一切免为庶人；或依托为人下妻，欲去者，恣听之；敢拘留者，比青、徐二州以略人法从事。 复置金城郡。 十四年春正月，起南宫前殿。 匈奴遣使奉献，使中郎将报命。 夏四月辛巳，封孔子后志为褒成侯。 越巂人任贵自称太守，遣使奉计。 秋九月，平城人贾丹杀卢芳将尹由来降。 是岁，会稽大疫。 莎车国、鄯善国遣使奉献。 十二月癸卯，诏益、凉二州奴婢，自八年以来自讼在所官，一切免为庶人，卖者无还直。 十五年春正月辛丑，大司徒韩歆免，自杀。 丁未，有星孛于昴。
target_text: In the fourteenth year, the Nangong front hall was built. The Xiongnu paid tribute. Kong Zhi was made a marquis. Ren Gui claimed to be governor. Jia Dan surrendered. A plague struck Kuaiji. Shache and Shanshan paid tribute. Slaves in Yi and Liang were freed.

input_text: 汝南太守欧阳歙为大司徒。 建义大将军朱祐罢。 丁未，有星孛于营室。 二月，徙雁门、代郡、上谷三郡民，置常山关、居庸关以东。 初，巴蜀既平，大司马吴汉上书请封皇子，不许，重奏连岁。 三月，乃诏群臣议。 大司空融、固始侯通、胶东侯复、高密侯禹、太常登等奏议曰： 古者封建诸侯，以藩屏京师。 周封八百，同姓诸姬并为建国，夹辅王室，尊事天子，享国永长，为后世法。 故《诗》云： 大启尔宇，为周室辅。 高祖圣德，光有天下，亦务亲亲，封立兄弟诸子，不违旧章。陛下德横天地，兴复宗统，褒德赏勋，亲睦九族，功臣宗室，咸蒙封爵，多受广地，或连属县。 今皇子赖天，能胜衣趋拜，陛下恭谦克让，抑而未议，群臣百姓，莫不失望。 宜因盛夏吉时，定号位，以广藩辅，明亲亲，尊宗庙，重社稷，应古合旧，厌塞众心。 臣请大司空上舆地图，太常择吉日，具礼仪。 制曰： 可。 夏四月戊申，以太牢告祠宗庙。 丁巳，使大司空融告庙，封皇子辅为右翊公，英为楚公，阳为东海公，康为济南公，苍为东平公，延为淮阳公，荆为山阳公，衡为临淮公，焉为左翊公，京为琅邪公。 癸丑，追谥兄伯升为齐武公，兄仲为鲁哀公。 六月庚午，复置屯骑、长水、射声三校尉官，改青巾左校尉为越骑校尉。
target_text: In the fifteenth year, Han Xin committed suicide. Comets appeared. Ouyang She became Grand Situ. Zhu You was dismissed. Residents of Yanmen, Daijun, and Shanggu were relocated. Wu Han requested titles for princes. Officials recommended enfeoffment. Emperor Guangwu agreed. Princes were granted dukedoms. The three lieutenants were restored. An order was issued to verify land and household registrations. Ouyang She died in prison. Dai She became Grand Situ. Lu Fang returned from the Xiongnu. Du Mao and Gai Yan died.

input_text: 诏下州郡检核垦田顷亩及户口年纪，又考实二千石长吏阿枉不平者。 冬十一月甲戌，大司徒欧阳歙下狱死。 十二月庚午，关内侯戴涉为大司徒。 卢芳自匈奴入居高柳。 是岁，骠骑大将军杜茂免。 虎牙大将军盖延薨。 十六年春二月，交阯女子微侧反，略有城邑。 三月辛丑晦，日有蚀之。 秋九月，河南尹张伋及诸郡守十余人，坐度田不实，皆下狱死。 郡国大姓及兵长、群盗处处并起，攻劫在所，害杀长吏。 郡县追讨，到则解散，去复屯结。 青、徐、幽、冀四州尤甚。 冬十月，遣使者下郡国，听群盗自相纠擿，五人共斩一人者，除其罪。 吏虽逗留回避故纵者，皆勿问，听以禽讨为效。 其牧守令长坐界内盗贼而不收捕者，又以畏忄耎捐城委守者，皆不以为负，但取获贼多少为殿最，唯蔽匿者乃罪之。 于是更相追捕，贼并解散。 徙其魁帅于它郡，赋田受禀，使安生业。 自是牛马放牧，邑门不闭。
target_text: In the sixteenth year, Jiaochangzhi women rebelled. A solar eclipse occurred. Officials were imprisoned for fraud. Bandits caused chaos. An edict allowed bandits to report each other. Lu Fang surrendered. Five baht coins were introduced.

input_text: 卢芳遣使乞降，十二月甲辰，封芳为代王。 初，王莽乱后，货币杂用布、帛、金、粟。是岁，始行五铢钱。 十七年春正月，赵公良薨。 二月乙未晦，日有食之。 夏四月乙卯，南巡狩，皇太子及右翊公辅、楚公英、东海公阳、济南公康、东平公苍从，幸颍川，进幸叶、章陵。 五月乙卯，车驾还宫。 六月癸巳，临淮公衡薨。 秋七月，妖巫李广等群起据皖城，遣虎贲中郎将马援、骠骑将军段志讨之。 九月，破皖城，斩李广等。 冬十月辛巳，废皇后郭氏为中山太后，立贵人阴氏为皇后。 进右翊公辅为中山王，食常山郡。 其余九国公，皆即旧封进爵为王。 甲申，幸章陵。 修园庙，祠旧宅，观田庐，置酒作乐，赏赐。 时，宗室诸母因酣悦，相与语曰： 文叔少时谨信，与人不款曲，唯直柔耳。
target_text: In the seventeenth year, Zhao Gongliang died. A solar eclipse occurred. Emperor Guangwu visited the south. Liu Heng died. Li Guang rebelled but was killed. Queen Guo was deposed, and Noble Yin became empress. Princes were promoted. Emperor Guangwu visited Zhangling. Five phoenixes appeared. Yarkand paid tribute.

input_text: 今乃能如此！ 帝闻之，大笑曰： 吾理天下，亦欲以柔道行之。 乃悉为舂陵宗室起祠堂。 有五凤凰见于颍川之郏县。 十二月，至自章陵。 是岁，莎车国遣使贡献。 十八年春二月，蜀郡守将史歆叛，遣大司马吴汉率二将军讨之，围成都。 甲寅，西巡狩，幸长安。 三月壬午，祠高庙，遂有事十一陵。 历冯翊界，进幸蒲坂，祠后土。 夏四月癸酉，车驾还宫。 甲戌，诏曰： 今边郡盗谷五十斛，罪至于死，开残吏妄杀之路，其蠲除此法，同之内郡。 遣伏波将军马援率楼船将军段志等击交阯贼微侧等。 甲申，幸河内。 戊子，至自河内。 五月，旱。 卢芳复亡入匈奴。 秋七月，吴汉拔成都，斩史歆等。 壬戌，赦益州所部殊死已下。 冬十月庚辰，幸宜城。还，祠章陵。 十二月乙丑，车驾还宫。
target_text: In the eighteenth year, Shi Xin rebelled but was defeated. Emperor Guangwu visited Chang'an. An edict abolished harsh laws for border counties. Ma Yuan attacked Jiaozhi. Lu Fang fled to the Xiongnu. Wu Han killed Shi Xin. Emperor Guangwu visited Yicheng. State pastors were dismissed and replaced by governors.

input_text: 是岁，罢州牧，置刺史。 十九年春正月庚子，追遵孝宣皇帝曰中宗。 始祠昭帝、元帝于太庙，成帝、哀帝、平帝于长安，舂陵节侯以下四世于章陵。 妖巫单臣、傅镇等反，据原武，遣太中大夫臧宫围之。 夏四月，拔原武，斩臣、镇等。 伏波将军马援破交阯，斩微侧等。因击破九真贼都阳等，降之。 闰月戊申，进赵、齐、鲁三国公爵为王。 六月戊申，诏曰： 《春秋》之义，立子以贵。 东海王阳，皇后之子，宜承大统。 皇太子彊，崇执谦退，愿备藩国。 父子之情，重久违之。 其以彊为东海王，立阳为皇太子，改名庄。 秋九月，南巡狩。 壬申，幸南阳，进幸汝南南顿县舍，置酒会，赐吏人，复南顿田租岁。
target_text: In the nineteenth year, Emperor Xiaoxuan was honored as Zhongzong. Shanchen rebelled but was killed. Ma Yuan captured Jiaozhi. Princes were promoted. Liu Yang became crown prince. Emperor Guangwu visited the south. Nanton County was exempted from rent. The southwestern barbarians invaded. Ren Gui rebelled but was killed. The Hangu Pass Commandery was restored.

input_text: 乙未，徙中山王辅为沛王。 秋，东夷韩国人率众诣乐浪内附。 冬十月，东巡狩。甲午，幸鲁，进幸东海、楚、沛国。 十二月，匈奴寇天水。 壬寅，车驾还宫。 是岁，省五原郡，徙其吏人置河东。复济阳县徭役六岁。 二十一年春正月，武威将军刘尚破益州夷，平之。 夏四月，安定属国胡叛，屯聚青山，遣将兵长史陈讨平之。 秋，鲜卑寇辽东，辽东太守祭肜大破之。 冬十月，遣伏波将军马援出塞击乌桓，不克。 匈奴寇上谷、中山。 其冬，鄯善王、车师王等十六国皆遣子入侍奉献，愿请都护。 帝以中国初定，未遑外事，乃还其侍子，厚加赏赐。 二十二年春闰月丙戌，幸长安，祠高庙，遂有事十一陵。 二月己巳，至自长安。 夏五月乙未晦，日有食之。 秋七月，司隶校尉苏邺下狱死。 九月戊辰，地震裂。 制诏曰： 日者地震，南阳尤甚。 夫地者，任物至重，静而不动者也。 而今震裂，咎在君上。
target_text: In the twentieth year, Emperor Guangwu returned to Luoyang. Dai She died in prison. Dou Rong was dismissed. Wu Han died. The Xiongnu invaded. Cai Mao became Grand Situ. Liu Long became general. Liu Fu was transferred to Pei. Koreans surrendered. Emperor Guangwu inspected the east. The Xiongnu invaded Tianshui. Wuyuan County was abolished.

input_text: 乙未，徙中山王辅为沛王。 秋，东夷韩国人率众诣乐浪内附。 冬十月，东巡狩。甲午，幸鲁，进幸东海、楚、沛国。 十二月，匈奴寇天水。 壬寅，车驾还宫。 是岁，省五原郡，徙其吏人置河东。复济阳县徭役六岁。 二十一年春正月，武威将军刘尚破益州夷，平之。 夏四月，安定属国胡叛，屯聚青山，遣将兵长史陈讨平之。 秋，鲜卑寇辽东，辽东太守祭肜大破之。 冬十月，遣伏波将军马援出塞击乌桓，不克。 匈奴寇上谷、中山。 其冬，鄯善王、车师王等十六国皆遣子入侍奉献，愿请都护。 帝以中国初定，未遑外事，乃还其侍子，厚加赏赐。 二十二年春闰月丙戌，幸长安，祠高庙，遂有事十一陵。 二月己巳，至自长安。 夏五月乙未晦，日有食之。 秋七月，司隶校尉苏邺下狱死。 九月戊辰，地震裂。 制诏曰： 日者地震，南阳尤甚。 夫地者，任物至重，静而不动者也。 而今震裂，咎在君上。
target_text: In the twenty-first year, Liu Shang pacified Yizhou. The Anding Hu rebelled but were quelled. Xianbei invaded Liaodong. Ma Yuan attacked Wuhuan unsuccessfully. The Xiongnu invaded. Sixteen kingdoms requested protection but were refused.

input_text: 鬼神不顺无德，灾殃将及吏人，朕甚惧焉。 其令南阳勿输今年田租刍稿。 遣谒者案行，其死罪系囚在戊辰以前，减死罪一等；徒皆弛解钳，衣丝絮。赐郡中居人压死者棺钱，人三千。 其口赋逋税而庐宅尤破坏者，勿收责。 吏人死亡，或在坏垣毁屋之下，而家羸弱不能收拾者，其以见钱谷取佣，为寻求之。 冬十月壬子，大司空朱浮免。 癸丑，光禄勋杜林为大司空。 是岁，齐王章薨。 青州蝗。 匈奴薁鞬日逐王比遣使诣渔阳请和亲，使中郎将李茂报命。 乌桓击破匈奴，匈奴北徒，幕南地空。诏罢诸边郡亭侯吏卒。 二十三年春正月，南郡蛮叛，遣武将军刘尚讨破之，徒其种人于江夏。 夏五月丁卯，大司徒蔡茂薨。 秋八月丙戌，大司空杜林薨。
target_text: In the twenty-second year, Emperor Guangwu visited Chang'an. A solar eclipse occurred. Su Ye died in prison. An earthquake struck Nanyang. An edict provided relief. Zhufu was dismissed. Du Lin became Grand Sikong. The Xiongnu sought peace. Wuhuan defeated the Xiongnu.

input_text: 九月辛未，陈留太守玉况为大司徒。 冬十月丙申，太仆张纯为大司空。 高句丽率种人诣乐浪内属。 十二月，武陵蛮叛，寇掠郡县，遣刘尚讨之，战于沅水，尚军败殁。 是岁，匈奴薁鞬日逐王比率部曲遣使诣西河内附。 二十四年春正月乙亥，大赦天下。 匈奴薁鞬日逐王比遣使款五原塞，求扞御北虏。 秋七月，武陵蛮寇临沅，遣谒者李嵩、中山太守马成讨蛮，不克，于是伏波将军马援率四将军讨之。 诏有司申明旧制阿附蕃王法。 冬十月，匈奴薁鞬日逐王比自立为南单于，于是分为南、北匈奴。 二十五年春正月，辽东徼外貊人寇右北平、渔阳、上谷、太原，辽东太守祭肜招降之。 乌桓大人来朝。 南单于遣使诣厥贡献，奉蕃称臣；又遣其左贤王击破北匈奴，却地千余里。 三月，南单于遗子入侍。 戊申晦，日有食之。 伏波将军马援等破武陵蛮于临沅。 冬十月，叛蛮悉降。 夫馀王遣使奉献。 是岁，乌桓大人率众内属，诣厥朝贡。 二十六年春正月，诏有司增百官奉。其千石已上，减于西京旧制；六百石已下，增于旧秩。 初作寿陵。
target_text: In the twenty-third year, the Nanjun barbarians rebelled but were subdued. Cai Mao and Du Lin died. Yu Kuang became Grand Situ. Zhang Chun became Grand Sikong. Goguryeo joined Lelang. The Wuling barbarians rebelled, and Liu Shang died in battle.

target_text: In the twenty-seventh year, Yu Kuang died. Official titles were changed. The Northern Xiongnu sought peace. Princes entered their fiefdoms.

input_text: 骠骑大将军行大司马刘隆即日罢，以太仆赵熹为太尉，大司农冯勤为司徒。 益州郡徼外蛮夷率种人内属。 北匈奴遣使诣武威乞和亲。 冬，鲁王兴、齐王石始就国。 二十八年春正月己巳，徙鲁王兴为北海王，以鲁国益东海。 赐东海王彊虎贲、旄头、钟虡之乐。 夏六月丁卯，沛太后郭氏薨，因诏郡县捕王侯宾客，坐死者数千人。 秋八月戊寅，东海王彊、沛王辅、楚王英、济南王康、淮阳王延始就国。 冬十月癸酉，诏死罪系囚皆一切募下蚕室，其女子宫。 北匈奴遣使贡献，乞和亲。 二十九年春二月丁巳朔，日有食之。 遣使者举冤狱，出系囚。 庚申，赐天下男子爵，人二级；鳏、寡、孤、独、笃癃、贫不能自存者粟，人五斛。
target_text: In the twenty-eighth year, Liu Xing was transferred to Beihai. Queen Mother Pei Guo died. Princes entered their fiefdoms. Prisoners were summoned for punishment. The Northern Xiongnu paid tribute.

input_text: 夏四月乙丑，诏令天下系囚自殊死已下及徒各减本罪一等，其余赎罪输作各有差。 三十年春正月，鲜卑大人内属，朝贺。 二月，东巡狩。甲子，幸鲁，进幸济南。 闰月癸丑，车驾还宫。 有星孛于紫宫。 夏四月戊子，徙左翊王焉为中山王。 五月，大水。 赐天下男子爵，人二级；鳏、寡、孤、独、笃癃、贫不能自存者粟，人五斛。 秋七月丁酉。幸鲁国。 复济阳县是年徭役。 冬十一月丁酉，至自鲁。 三十一年夏五月，大水。 戊辰，赐天下男子爵，人二级；鳏、寡、孤、独、笃癃、贫不能自存者粟，人六斛。 癸酉晦，日有食之。 是夏，蝗。 秋九月甲辰，诏令死罪系囚皆一切募下蚕室，其女子宫。 是岁，陈留雨谷，形如稗实。
target_text: In the twenty-ninth year, a solar eclipse occurred. Prisoners were released. Rewards were given.

target_text: In the thirty-first year, floods and locusts occurred. Prisoners were summoned for punishment. The Northern Xiongnu paid tribute.

input_text: 北匈奴遣使奉献。 中元元年春正月，东海王彊、沛王辅、楚王英、济南王康、淮阳王延、赵王盱皆来朝。 丁卯，东巡狩。 二月己卯，幸鲁，进幸太山。 北海王兴、齐王石朝于东岳。 辛卯，柴望岱宗，登封太山；甲午，禅于梁父。 三月戊辰，司空张纯薨。 夏四月癸酉，车驾还宫。 己卯，大赦天下。 复嬴、博、梁父、奉高，勿出今年田租刍稿。改年为中元。 行幸长安。 戊子，祀长陵。 五月乙丑，至自长安。 六月辛卯，太仆冯鲂为司空。 乙未，司徒冯勤薨。 是夏，京师醴泉涌出，饮之者固疾皆愈，惟眇、蹇者不瘳。 又有赤草生于水崖。 郡国频上甘露。 群臣奏言： 地祇灵应而朱草萌生。 孝宣帝每有嘉瑞，辄以改元、神爵、五凤、甘露、黄龙，列为年纪，盖以感致神祇，表彰德信。
target_text: In the first year of Zhongyuan, princes paid homage. Emperor Guangwu performed sacrifices on Mount Tai. A general amnesty was declared. Sweet spring water and red grass appeared. Emperor Guangwu rejected auspicious omens. Locusts struck. Sikong Zhang Chun died. Feng Li became Sikong. Situ Fengqin died. Emperor Guangwu died at age sixty-two. An edict ordered frugal burial. Historians noted auspicious signs at his birth and throughout his reign.

input_text: 孝和皇帝讳肇，肃宗第四子也。 母梁贵人，为窦皇后所谮，忧卒，窦后养帝以为己子。 建初七年，立为皇太子。 章和二年二月壬辰，即皇帝位，年十岁。 尊皇后曰皇太后，太后临朝。 三月丁酉，改淮阳为陈国，楚郡为彭城国，西平并汝南郡，六安复为庐江郡。 遗诏徙西平王羡为陈王，六安王恭为彭城王。 癸卯，葬孝章皇帝于敬陵。 庚戌，皇太后诏曰： 先帝以明圣，奉承祖宗至德要道，天下清静，庶事咸宁。 今皇帝以幼年，茕茕在疚，朕且佐助听政。 外有大国贤王并为蕃屏，内有公卿大夫统理本朝，恭己受成，夫何忧哉！ 然守文之际，必有内辅以参听断。 侍中宪，朕之元兄，行能兼备，忠孝尤笃，先帝所器，亲受遗诏，当以旧典辅斯职焉。 宪固执谦让，节不可夺。 今供养两宫，宿卫左右，厥事已重，亦不可复劳以政事。 故太尉邓彪，元功之族，三让弥高，海内归仁，为群贤首，先帝褒表，欲以崇化。 今彪聪明康强，可谓老成黄耇矣。 其以彪为太傅，赐爵关内侯，录尚书事，百官总己以听，朕庶几得专心内位。
target_text: Emperor Xiaohe, named Zhao, was the fourth son of Emperor Suzong. His mother, Liang Guiren, was framed by Empress Dou and died of melancholy; Empress Dou adopted him. He became crown prince in the seventh year of Jianchu and ascended the throne at age ten in the second year of Zhanghe. Empress Dou was honored as empress dowager and attended court. Early edicts renamed several states and moved kings accordingly. Emperor Xiaozhang was buried in Jingling. The empress dowager issued an edict appointing Dou Xian, her brother, to a role, but he declined; she then appointed Deng Biao as Taifu to oversee secretarial affairs. The late emperor was honored with the temple name Suzong. Kings began entering their fiefdoms. The emperor visited temples. An edict lifted bans on salt and iron, allowing the people to boil salt and cast iron with taxes. A drought occurred in the capital. Dou Xian was appointed chariot and cavalry general to attack the Northern Huns. Parthian envoys offered lions and hornless lins. In the first year of Yongyuan, Dou Xian defeated the Northern Xiongnu at Jiluo Mountain, carved a stone at Yanran Mountain, and returned. The Northern Shanyu sent tribute. Mount Kuaiji collapsed. An edict praised the victory and ordered sacrifices. Dou Xian was made general, and Liu Shang became chariot and cavalry general. Prisoners were released to military camps. Fuling King Liu Yan died. Floods occurred in nine counties. A general amnesty was declared. A solar eclipse occurred. Captaincy officers were re-established. Taishan was divided, and new kings were appointed. Yan Pan attacked the Northern Xiongnu. Liu Wuji and Liu Wei were named kings. The Yuezhi Kingdom attacked Ban Chao, who counterattacked. Zhongshan King Liu Yan died. Dou Xian stationed troops in Liangzhou. The Northern Huns sent envoys to declare vassalage. Ban Gu was sent to Nan Shanyu. The emperor was crowned, with rewards and amnesty. Dou Xian besieged and defeated the Northern Shanyu. Princess Biyang was honored as eldest princess. Fuling King Liu Zhong died. The emperor visited Chang'an, issued edicts, and sacrificed at tombs. The Western Region Protectorate was re-established. The Northern Xiongnu king established himself as chanyu. Situ Yuan An died; Ding Hong succeeded. Dou Xian returned to the capital. A solar eclipse and earthquake occurred. Dou Xian plotted rebellion; the emperor arrested his party, and Dou Xian and his brothers committed suicide. Drought and locust plague occurred. Taiwei Song You committed suicide. Sikong Renkai died; Yin Mu became Taiwei. Liu Fang became Sikong. An edict exempted land rent due to drought and locusts. Barbarians and Qiang rebelled. The emperor worshiped the Five Emperors and granted amnesty. Kings died or were granted titles. Edicts reduced horse stables and gave orchards to the poor. Grand Tutor Deng Biao died. Earthquakes occurred. Edicts addressed talent selection and relief. Hailstorms occurred. King Liu Wansui died. The Xiongnu chanyu was killed. Edicts encouraged food conservation. Taiwei Yin Mu died; Zhang Youfu succeeded. Wuling rebels surrendered. Qiang fled. Nan Dan rebelled. Foreigners presented rhinos and elephants. Situ Dinghong died. Relief was provided to the poor. Xu Yanghou Ma Guang committed suicide. Liu Fang became Situ; Zhang Fen became Sikong. Edicts addressed refugees and talent selection. The Qiang submitted. King Liu Shu died. A solar eclipse occurred. Drought led to reduced sentences. The emperor inspected prisons. Ban Chao defeated Yanqi and Yuli; the Western Regions surrendered. Fenghou fled. Deng Hong attacked Fenghou. Ren Shang defeated Fenghou. Bohai was transferred to Jizhou. Wuling barbarians rebelled. Deng Hong and others were imprisoned. A solar eclipse occurred. The emperor consulted officials. Edicts addressed talent selection. Qiancheng became Le'an. King Pei died. Earthquakes occurred. The noble Yin became queen, with rewards. King Liu Dang died. Relief was provided. Locust plagues occurred. The Xiongnu king rebelled and was killed. The queen of Che Division rebelled. Edicts addressed locust plagues. Guangyang County was restored. Beihai King Liu Wei committed suicide. King Chen died. A fire occurred in Nangong. Barbarians paid tribute. Earthquakes occurred. King Jinan died. Ban Chao killed the queen of Che Division. Liu Xun became king. Locusts and drought occurred. Edicts exempted rent. Locusts flew over the capital. Xianbei bandits plundered. Empress Dowager Dou died. Shaodang Qiang raided. Situ Liu Fang committed suicide. Liang Guizhen was honored as empress dowager. Lu Gai became Situ. Zhang Fen left; Han Xun became Sikong. Ruolu prison officer was restored. Edicts addressed embankments. Floods occurred. Sikong Hanxun died. Taishan was empty. Linxi office was restored. Rain occurred in five states. Shaodang Qiang paid tribute. Liang Wang died. Edicts provided relief. A general amnesty was declared. The right school lieutenant was restored. Edicts addressed lavish burials. Bailang and Zhilou Boyi submitted. Edicts addressed disasters and talent selection. Rewards were given. Rinan barbarians rebelled. Relief was provided. Landslides occurred. A solar eclipse occurred. Taiwei Zhang Youfu was dismissed; Zhang Yu succeeded. Western Region kings were given seals. Shaodang Qiang rebelled. The emperor visited Dongguan. King Rencheng died. Relief was provided. A fire occurred. Zhou Tuna defeated Shaodang Qiang. Edicts exempted rent. Parthian envoys offered lions. Edicts addressed talent selection in border regions. Xianbei raided. Situ Lu Gai was dismissed; Lu Gong succeeded. Wuman rebelled. King Donghai died. Xihai County was repaired. The emperor visited Piyong. Wuman were defeated. Relief was provided. Xianglin office was established. Queen Yin was deposed. Edicts exempted Xianglin. King Changshan died. Rain occurred. Edicts addressed floods. Noble Deng became queen. Sikong Chaokan was dismissed; Xu Fang succeeded. Officials were re-established. Edicts addressed refugees. Relief was provided. A solar eclipse occurred. Edicts allowed fishing. King Jinan died. Gu'an Iron Office was restored. The emperor inspected the south. Rain occurred. The emperor visited Zhangling. King Langyi died. Light punishments were ordered. Edicts addressed poor farmers. Wine-making was banned. Inspectors were sent. King Zhao died. Drought occurred. Edicts addressed officials. Situ Lu Gong was dismissed; Zhang Youfu succeeded. Edicts exempted rent. Situ Zhang Youfu died. Xu Fang became Situ; Chen Chong became Sikong. The emperor climbed Baichui Mountain. Northern Huns paid tribute. The governor of eastern Liaoning was restored. Talents were selected. Gaoguli raided. A general amnesty was declared. Yongdi collapsed. Geng Kui defeated the Qi people. The emperor died at age twenty-seven. Prince Liu Long became crown prince. After Dou Xian's death, the emperor governed personally. He consulted officials during disasters and did not publicize auspicious omens. The South China Sea offered longan and litchi, causing deaths; an edict stopped the tribute. Historians noted population growth and territorial expansion under Emperor He.

input_text: 孝殇皇帝讳隆，和帝少子也。 元兴元年十二月辛未夜，即皇帝位，时诞育百余日。 尊皇后曰皇太后，太后临朝。 北匈奴遣使称臣，诣敦煌奉献。 延平元年春正月辛卯，太尉张禹为太傅。 司徒徐防为太尉，参录尚书事，百官总己以听。 封皇兄胜为平原王。 癸卯，当禄勋梁鲔为司徒。 三月甲申，葬孝和皇帝于慎陵，尊庙曰穆宗。 丙戌，清河王庆、济北王寿、河间王开、常山王章始就国。 夏四月庚申，诏罢祀官不在祀典者。 鲜卑寇渔阳，渔阳太守张显追击，战没。 丙寅，以虎贲中郎将邓骘为车骑将军。 司空陈宠薨。 五月辛卯，皇太后诏曰： 皇帝幼冲，承统鸿业，朕且权佐助听政，兢兢寅畏，不知所济。
target_text: Emperor Xiaoshang, named Long, was the youngest son of Emperor He. He became emperor at over a hundred days old. The empress dowager governed. Northern Huns paid tribute. Zhang Yu became Taifu. Xu Fang became Taiwei. Liu Sheng became king. Liang Tuna became Situ. Emperor He was buried. Kings entered fiefdoms. Edicts removed improper priests. Xianbei raided; Zhang Xian died. Deng Zhi became chariot and cavalry general. Sikong Chen Chong died. The empress dowager issued an edict granting amnesty and restoring prisoners. Landslides occurred. Yin Qin became Sikong. Rain occurred. Edicts addressed waste. The empress dowager ordered the release of palace women and slaves. Edicts addressed disasters and corruption. The emperor died at age two. Historians praised Emperor He's calmness and punishment of traitors, while Emperor Shang died young.

input_text: 恭宗孝安皇帝讳祜，肃宗孙也。 父清河孝王庆，母左姬。 帝自在邸第，数有神光照室，又有赤蛇盘于床第之间。 年十岁，好学《史书》，和帝称之，数见禁中。 延平元年，庆始就国，邓太后特诏留帝清河邸。 八月，殇帝崩，太后与兄车骑将军邓骘定策禁中。 其夜，使骘持节，以王青盖车迎帝，斋于殿中。 皇太后御崇德殿，百官皆吉服，群臣陪位，引拜帝为长安侯。 皇太后诏曰： 先帝圣德淑茂，早弃天下。 朕奉皇帝，夙夜瞻仰日月，冀望成就。 岂意卒然颠沛，天年不遂，悲痛断心。 朕惟平原王素被痼疾，念宗庙之重，思继嗣之统，唯长安侯祜质性忠孝，小心翼翼，能通《诗》、《论》，笃学乐古，仁惠爱下。
target_text: Emperor Gongzong Xiaoan, named Liu Hu, was the grandson of Suzong and son of Liu Qing, the Xiaowang of Qinghe, and Zuo Ji. From childhood, supernatural signs like illuminated rooms and red snakes on his bed were observed. At ten, he studied "Historical Records" and was favored by Emperor He. In the first year of Yanping, after Emperor Shang's death, Empress Dowager Deng and her brother Deng Zhi chose Liu Hu as successor. He was enthroned at thirteen, with the Empress Dowager regent. The early years saw natural disasters, Qiang rebellions, and relief efforts. In Yongchu years, floods, earthquakes, and famines struck, leading to edicts for grain relief, tax exemptions, and crackdowns on corruption. The Qiang conflicts persisted, with battles and occasional victories. In 107, a solar eclipse prompted calls for virtuous officials. By 108, droughts and locust plagues worsened, with cannibalism reported. The emperor crowned in 109, but disasters continued. In 110, pirate Zhang Bolu raided coastal counties. By 111, rebellions and Qiang attacks intensified. In 112, the capital suffered locusts and earthquakes. In 113, the Empress Dowager visited the ancestral temple. In 114, solar eclipses and Qiang raids occurred. In 115, the reign changed to Yuanchu, with amnesties and relief. In 116, floods and Qiang attacks persisted. In 117, solar eclipses and rebellions marked the year. In 118, the Qiang were pacified. In 119, droughts and Xianbei raids continued. In 120, earthquakes and epidemics struck. In 121, the Empress Dowager died, and the emperor assumed full power. In 122, Xianbei and Qiang attacks continued. In 123, the emperor toured east, performing sacrifices. In 124, solar eclipses and rebellions occurred. In 125, the emperor died at thirty-two, succeeded by Beixiang Hou Liu Yi. Historians criticized his reign for weak governance, reliance on Empress Dowager Deng, and decline of Han power, marked by corruption, Qiang troubles, and natural disasters.

input_text: 孝桓皇帝讳志，肃宗曾孙也。祖父河间孝王开，父蠡吾侯翼，母匽氏。 翼卒，帝袭爵为侯。 本初元年，梁太后征帝到夏门亭，将妻以女弟。 会质帝崩，太后遂与兄大将军冀定策禁中，闰月庚寅，使冀持节，以王青盖车迎帝入南宫，其日即皇帝位，时年十五。 太后犹临朝政。 秋七月乙卯，葬孝质皇帝于静陵。 齐王喜薨。 辛巳，谒高庙、光武庙。 丙戌，诏曰： 孝廉、廉吏皆当典城牧民，禁奸举善，兴化之本，恒必由之。 诏书连下，分明恳恻，而在所玩习，遂至怠慢，选举乖错，害及元元。 顷虽颇绳正，犹未惩改。 方今淮夷未殓，军师屡出，百姓疲悴，困于征发。庶望群吏，惠我劳民，蠲涤贪秽，以祈休详。 其令秩满百石，十岁以上，有殊才异行，乃得参选。 臧吏子孙，不得察举。 杜绝邪伪请托之原。令廉白守道者得信其操。 各明守所司，将观厥后。 九月戊戌，追尊皇祖河间孝王曰孝穆皇，夫人赵氏曰孝穆皇后，皇考蠡吾侯曰孝崇皇。 冬十月甲午，尊皇母匽氏为孝崇博园贵人。 建和元年春正月辛亥朔，日有食之。 诏三公、九卿、校尉各言得失。 戊午，大赦天下。 赐史更劳一岁；男子爵，人二级，为父后及三老、孝悌、力田人三级；鳏、寡、孤、独、笃癃、贫不能自存者粟，人五斛；贞妇帛，人三匹。
target_text: Emperor Xiaohuan Liu Zhi, great-grandson of Emperor Suzong Zhang, succeeded his father Liu Yi as Marquis of Liwu. In the first year of this century, Empress Dowager Liang summoned him to Luoyang, intending to marry her sister to him. After Emperor Zhi's death, Empress Dowager Liang and her brother General Liang Ji decided to install Liu Zhi as emperor. He ascended the throne at age fifteen, with Empress Dowager Liang still governing. Emperor Xiaozhi was buried in Jingling.

target_text: The emperor issued edicts calling for filial and honest officials to govern well, but noted that officials were negligent and selections were disorderly, harming the people. He urged officials to benefit workers and eliminate corruption. Only those with over ten years of service and special talents could be selected; descendants of corrupt officials were barred. He honored his ancestors posthumously.

input_text: 夏四月丁卯晦，日有食之。 五月乙亥，诏曰： 盖闻天生蒸民，不能相理，为之立君，使司牧之。 君道得于下，则休祥著乎上；庶事失其序，则咎征见乎象。 间者，日食毁缺，阳光晦暗，朕祗惧潜思，匪遑启处。 传不云乎： 日食修德，月食修刑。 昔孝章帝愍前世禁徙，故建初之元，并蒙恩泽，流徙者使还故郡，没入者免为庶民。 先皇德政，可不务乎！ 其自永建元年迄乎今岁，凡诸妖恶，支亲从坐，及吏民减死徙边者，悉归本郡；唯没入者不从此令。 六月庚子，诏大将军、三公、特进、侯，其与卿、校尉举贤良方正、能直言极谏之士各一人。
target_text: In the first year of Jianhe, a solar eclipse occurred. The emperor ordered officials to discuss government affairs, granted amnesty, and provided relief to the needy. Disasters struck various regions, including earthquakes, floods, and famines. The emperor responded by ordering disaster relief, reducing taxes, and recommending virtuous officials. He also addressed corruption, ordering that officials embezzling over 300,000 yuan be punished.

input_text: 是月，立阜陵王代兄勃遒亭侯便为阜陵王。 郡国六地裂，水涌井溢。 芝草生中黄藏府。 六月，太尉胡广罢，大司农杜乔为太尉。 秋七月，勃海王鸿薨，立帝弟蠡吾侯悝为勃海王。 八月乙未，立皇后梁氏。 九月丁卯，京师地震。 太尉杜乔免。 冬十月，司徒赵戒为太尉，司空袁汤为司徒，前太尉胡广为司空。 十一月，济阴言有五色大鸟见于己氏。 戊午，减天下死罪一等，戍边。 清河刘文反，杀国相射暠，欲立清河王蒜为天子；事觉伏诛。 蒜坐贬为尉氏候，徙桂阳，自杀。 前太尉李固、杜乔皆下狱死。 陈留盗贼李坚自称皇帝，伏诛。 二年春正月甲子，皇帝加元服。 庚午，大赦天下。
target_text: Over subsequent years, the realm faced rebellions, including Liu Wen of Qinghe's attempt to install Liu Lian as emperor, which was suppressed. Former officials Li Gu and Du Qiao were executed. The emperor was crowned in the second year, granted amnesty, and distributed gifts. Earthquakes, fires, and floods continued. The emperor moved to the South Palace after a fire. Rebellions by barbarians and bandits were suppressed.

target_text: In the third year, a solar eclipse prompted the emperor to order the return of exiles and the release of prisoners. Disasters persisted, including earthquakes, floods, and landslides. The emperor issued edicts for relief and burial of the dead. In the first year of Heping, he granted amnesty and changed the era name. Empress Dowager Liang died, and the emperor took full control.

input_text: 二月，司隶、冀州饥，人相食。 敕州郡赈给贫弱。 若王侯吏民有积谷者，一切貣十分之三，以助禀贷；其百姓吏民者，以见钱雇直。 王侯须新租乃偿。 夏四月，白乌见齐国。 六月，洛水溢，坏鸿德苑。 南阳大水。 司空房植免，太常韩縯为司空。 诏太山、琅琊遇贼者，勿收租、赋，复更、算三年。 又诏被水死流失尸骸者，令郡县钩求收葬；及所唐突压溺物故，七岁以上赐钱，人二千。 坏败庐舍，亡失谷食，尤贫者禀，人二斛。 巴郡、益州郡山崩。 秋七月，初置太山、琅邪都尉官。 南匈奴左薁鞬台耆、且渠伯德等叛，寇美稷，安定属国都尉张奂讨除之。 二年春正月，初听中官得行三年服。 二月甲申，东海王臻薨。 三月，蜀郡属国夷叛。

input_text: 三月，车驾徙幸北宫。甲午，葬顺烈皇后。 夏五月庚辰，尊博园匽贵人曰孝崇皇后。 秋七月，梓潼山崩。 冬十一月辛巳，减天下死罪一等，徙边戍。 元嘉元年春正月，京师疾疫，使光禄大夫将医药案行。 癸酉，大赦天下，改元元嘉。 二月，九江、庐江大疫。 甲午，河间王建薨。 夏四月己丑，安平王得薨。 京师旱。任城、梁国饥，民相食。 司徒张歆罢，光禄勋吴雄为司徒。 秋七月，武陵蛮叛。 冬十月，司空胡广罢。 十一月辛巳，京师地震。 闰月庚午，任城王崇薨。太常黄琼为司空。 二年春正月，西域长史王敬为于窴国所杀。 丙辰，京师地震。 夏四月甲寅，孝崇皇后匽氏崩。 庚午，常山王豹薨。 五月辛卯，葬孝崇皇后于博陵。 秋七月庚辰，日有食之。八月，济阴言黄龙见句阳，金城言黄龙见允街。 冬十月乙亥，京师地震。 十一月，司空黄琼免。 十二月，特进赵戒为司空。 右北平太守和旻坐臧，下狱死。 永兴元年春二月，张掖言白鹿见。 三月丁亥，幸鸿池。 夏五月丙申，大赦天下，改元永兴。 丁酉，济南王广薨，无子，国除。 秋七月，郡国三十二蝗。 河水溢。 百姓饥穷，流冗道路，至有数十万户，冀州尤甚。
target_text: In the third year, amnesty was granted. Rebellions by barbarians were suppressed. Solar eclipses and locust plagues occurred. The emperor established offices and conducted hunts. In the first year of Yanxi, amnesty was granted. Earthquakes and locust plagues continued. The emperor hunted and visited Shanglinyuan. Xianbei invaders were defeated.

input_text: 甲子，太尉黄琼免，太常胡广为太尉。 冬十月，校猎广成，遂幸上林苑。 十二月，鲜卑寇边，使匈奴中郎将张奂率南单于击破之。 二年春二月，鲜卑寇雁门。 己亥，阜陵王便薨。 蜀郡夷寇蚕陵，杀县令。 三月，复断刺史、二千石行三年丧。 夏，京师雨水。 六月，鲜卑寇辽东。 秋七月，初造显阳苑，置丞。 丙午，皇后梁氏崩。 乙丑，葬懿献皇后于懿陵。 大将军梁冀谋为乱。八月丁丑，帝御前殿，诏司隶校尉张彪将兵围冀第，收大将军印绶，冀与妻皆自杀。 卫尉梁淑、河南尹梁胤、屯骑校尉梁让、越骑校尉梁忠、长大校尉梁戟等，及中外宗亲数十人，皆伏诛。 太尉胡广坐免。 司徒韩縯、司空孙朗下狱。 壬午，立皇后邓氏，追废懿陵为贵人冢。 诏曰： 梁冀奸暴，浊乱王室。 孝质皇帝聪敏早茂，冀心怀忌畏，私行杀毒。 永乐太后亲尊莫二，冀又遏绝，禁还京师，使朕离母子之爱，隔顾复之恩。 祸害深大，罪衅日滋。 赖宗庙之灵，及中常侍单超、徐璜、具瑗、左悺、唐衡、尚书令尹勋等激愤建策，内外协同，漏刻之间，桀逆枭夷。
target_text: In the second year, Xianbei raided Yanmen. The emperor suspended mourning leave for officials. Heavy rains and floods occurred. Queen Liang died. General Liang Ji conspired to rebel; the emperor ordered his execution, along with many relatives. The emperor established Queen Deng and issued an edict condemning Liang Ji. He rewarded eunuchs who helped him. He appointed new officials and visited Chang'an.

input_text: 十二月，卫尉周景为司空。 七年春正月庚寅，沛王荣薨。 三月癸亥，陨石于鄠。 夏四月丙寅，梁王成薨。 五月己丑，京师雨雹。 秋七月辛卯，赵王乾薨。 野王山上有死龙。 荆州刺史度尚击零陵、桂阳盗贼及蛮夷，大破平之。 冬十月壬寅，南巡狩。 庚申，幸章陵，祠旧宅，遂有事于园庙，赐守令以下各有差。 戊辰，幸云梦，临汉水；还，幸新野，祠湖阳、新野公主、鲁哀王、寿张敬侯庙。 护羌校尉段颎击当煎羌，破之。 十二月辛丑，车驾还宫。 八年春正月，遣中常侍左悺之苦县，祠老子。 勃海王悝谋反，降为癭陶王。 丙申晦，日有食之。诏公、卿、校尉举贤良方正。 二月己酉，南宫嘉德署黄龙见。千秋万岁殿火。 太仆左称有罪自杀。 癸亥，皇后邓氏废。 河南尹邓万世、虎贲中郎将邓会下狱死。 护羌校尉段颎击罕姐羌，破之。
target_text: In the sixth year, amnesty was granted. Fires and rebellions occurred. The emperor hunted and visited various locations. In the seventh year, meteorites fell. Hail and earthquakes occurred. Rebellions were suppressed. The emperor visited the south and returned. In the eighth year, a solar eclipse occurred. Queen Deng was deposed. Fires and earthquakes occurred. Rebellions were suppressed. The emperor ordered tax increases.

target_text: In the ninth year, a solar eclipse occurred. The emperor ordered tax reductions and relief. Fires and famines occurred. Rebellions by barbarians and bandits continued. The emperor recommended warriors. Officials were executed for corruption. The Southern Xiongnu surrendered. Party members were imprisoned. In the first year of Yongkang, Qiang rebellions were suppressed. Earthquakes and floods occurred. The emperor granted amnesty and lifted party shackles. He died at age thirty-six.

input_text: 及诛梁冀，奋威怒，天下犹企其休息。 而五邪嗣虐，流衍四方。 自非忠贤力争，屡折奸锋，虽愿依斟流彘，亦不可得已。 赞曰：桓自宗支，越跻天禄。 政移五幸，刑淫三狱。 倾宫虽积，皇身靡续。
target_text: Historians commented that Emperor Huan loved music and decorated gardens, but his reliance on eunuchs led to chaos. Despite loyal officials, his reign was marked by corruption and disaster. He had three queens and many concubines but no heirs.

input_text: 孝灵皇帝讳宏，肃宗玄孙也。 曾祖河间孝王开，祖淑，父苌。 世封解渎亭侯，帝袭侯爵。 母董夫人。 桓帝崩，无子，皇太后与父城门校尉窦武定策禁中，使守光禄大夫刘儵持节，将左右羽林至河间奉迎。 建宁元年春正月壬午，城门校尉窦武为大将军。 己亥，帝到夏门亭，使窦武持节，以王青盖车迎入殿中。 庚子，即皇帝位，年十二。 改元建宁。 以前太尉陈蕃为太傅，与窦武及司徒胡广参录尚书事。 使护羌校尉段颎讨先零羌。 二月辛酉，葬孝桓皇帝于宣陵，庙曰威宗。 庚午，谒高庙。 辛未，谒世祖庙。 大赦天下。 赐民爵及帛各有差。 段颎大破先零羌于逢义山。 闰月甲午，追尊皇祖为孝元皇，夫人夏氏为孝元皇后，考为孝仁皇，夫人董氏为慎园贵人。 夏四月戊辰，大尉周景薨。
target_text: Emperor Xiaoling, Liu Hong, was the great-great-grandson of Emperor Suzong. His great-grandfather Liu Kai was the Xiaowang of Hejian, his grandfather Liu Shu and father Liu Chang were both Marquises of Duting, a title Liu Hong inherited. His mother was Mrs. Dong. After Emperor Huan died without children, Empress Dowager Dou and her father Dou Wu sent officials to escort Liu Hong to Luoyang. He became emperor at age twelve in the first year of Jianning (168 CE), with Chen Fan as Taifu and Dou Wu and Hu Guang assisting in governance.

input_text: 司空宣酆免，长乐卫尉王畅为司空。 五月丁未朔，日有食之。 诏公卿以下各上封事，及郡国守、相举有道之士各一人；又故刺史、二千石清高有遗惠、为众所归者，皆诣公车。 太中大夫刘矩为太尉。 六月，京师雨水。 秋七月，破羌将军段颎复破先零羌于泾阳。 八月，司空王畅免，宗正刘宠为司空。 九月辛亥，中常侍曹节矫诏诛太傅陈蕃、大将军窦武及尚书令尹勋、侍中刘瑜、屯骑校尉冯述，皆夷其族。 皇太后迁于南宫。 司徒胡广为太傅，隶尚书事。 司空刘宠为司徒，大鸿胪许栩为司空。 冬十月甲辰晦，日有食之。令天下系囚罪未决入缣赎，各有差。 十一月，太尉刘矩免，太仆沛国闻人袭为太尉。 十二月，鲜卑及濊貊寇幽、并二州。 二年春正月丁丑，大赦天下。 三月乙巳，尊慎园董贵人为孝仁皇后。 夏四月癸巳，大风，雨雹。
target_text: The early years saw military campaigns against the Xianling Qiang, natural disasters including earthquakes and floods, and political purges. In 169 CE, eunuch Cao Jie falsely claimed an imperial order to kill Chen Fan, Dou Wu, and others, with their families executed. The Empress Dowager was moved to Nangong. Party member persecutions intensified, with over a hundred people imprisoned and their families exiled. Solar eclipses, epidemics, and barbarian rebellions occurred frequently.

input_text: 二月癸卯，地震，海水溢，河水清。 三月辛酉朔，日有食之。 太尉闻人袭免，太仆李咸为太尉。 诏公卿至六百石各上封事。 大疫，使中谒者巡行致医药。 司徒许训免，司空桥玄为司徒。 夏四月，太常来艳为司空。 五月，河东地裂，雨雹，山水暴出。 秋七月，司空来艳免。 癸丑，立贵人宋氏为皇后。 司徒桥玄免。 太常宗俱为司空，前司空许栩为司徒。 冬，鲜卑寇并州。 熹平元年春三月壬戌，太傅胡广薨。 夏五月己巳，大赦天下，改元熹平。 长乐太仆侯览有罪，自杀。 六月，京师雨水。 癸巳，皇太后窦氏崩。 秋七月甲寅，葬桓思皇后。 宦官讽司隶校尉段颎捕系太学诸生千余人。 冬十月，渤海王悝被诬谋反，丁亥，悝及妻子皆自杀。
target_text: In 172 CE, the reign name changed to Xiping. Empress Dowager Dou died, and eunuch Hou Lan committed suicide after being found guilty. The Xianbei raided Bingzhou. In 175 CE, the Five Classics were carved on stone tablets outside the Taixue. Floods, locust plagues, and Xianbei raids continued. In 178 CE, the reign changed to Guanghe, and the Hongdumen school was established. The West Residence began selling official positions, with prices varying by rank. Earthquakes, solar eclipses, and the deposal of Empress Song occurred.

input_text: 三月戊申，以河南尹何进为大将军，将兵屯都亭。 置八关都尉官。壬子，大赦天下党人，还诸徙者，唯张角不赦。 诏公卿出马、弩，举列将子孙及吏民有明战阵之略者，诣公车。 遣北中郎将卢植讨张角，左中郎将皇甫嵩、右中郎将朱俊讨颍川黄巾。 庚子，南阳黄巾张曼成攻杀郡守褚贡。 夏四月，太尉杨赐免，太仆弘农邓盛为太尉。 司空张济罢，大司农张温为司空。 朱俊为黄巾波才所败。 侍中向栩、张钧坐言宦者，下狱死。 汝南黄巾败太守赵谦于邵陵。 广阳黄巾杀幽州刺史郭勋及太守刘卫。 五月，皇甫嵩、朱俊复与波才等战于长社，大破之。 六月，南阳太守秦颉击张曼成，斩之。 交阯屯兵执刺史及合浦太守来达，自称 柱天将军 ，遣交阯刺史贾琮讨平之。 皇甫嵩、朱俊大破汝南黄巾于西华。 诏嵩讨东郡，朱俊讨南阳。
target_text: In 179 CE, party members were pardoned. In 180 CE, Empress He was established. The emperor built shops in the inner palace where concubines traded, and he dressed as a merchant, playing with dogs and driving donkey carts. In 184 CE, Zhang Jiao led the Yellow Turban Rebellion, with followers wearing yellow scarves. The emperor appointed He Jin as general, established eight passes, and pardoned party members except Zhang Jiao. Generals Lu Zhi, Huangfu Song, and Zhu Jun suppressed the rebellion, killing Zhang Jiao and his brothers.

input_text: 夏四月，汝南葛陂黄巾攻没郡县。 太尉曹嵩罢。 五月，永乐少府樊陵为太尉。 六月丙寅，大风。 太尉樊陵罢。 益州黄巾马相攻杀刺史郗俭，自称天子，又寇巴郡，杀郡守赵部，益州从事贾龙击相，斩之。 郡国七大水。 秋七月，射声校尉马日磾为太尉。 八月，初置西园八校尉。 司徒许相罢，司空丁宫为司徒。 光禄勋南阳刘弘为司空。 卫尉董重为票骑将军。 九月，南单于叛，与白波贼寇河东。 遣中郎将孟益率骑都尉公孙瓒讨渔阳贼张纯等。 冬十月，青、徐黄巾复起，寇郡县。 甲子，帝自称 无上将军 ，燿兵于平乐观。 十一月，凉州贼王国围陈仓，右将军皇甫嵩救之。 遣下军校尉鲍鸿讨葛陂黄巾。 巴郡板楯蛮叛，遣上军别部司马赵瑾讨平之。 公孙瓒与张纯战于石门，大破之。 是岁，改刺史，新置牧。 六年春二月，左将军皇甫嵩大破王国于陈仓。
target_text: In 185 CE, Nangong caught fire, and taxes were levied per mu for palace construction. Black Mountain bandits and Xianbei raids continued. In 186 CE, Zhao Ci rebelled and was killed. In 187 CE, Zhang Chun and Zhang Ju rebelled in Yuyang, claiming emperorship. In 188 CE, the emperor proclaimed himself "Supreme General" and reviewed the army. Eight captains were established in Xiyuan. The Liangzhou bandit kingdom surrounded Chencang.

input_text: 三月，幽州牧刘虞购斩渔阳贼张纯。 下军校尉鲍鸿下狱死。 夏四月丙午朔，日有食之。太尉马日磾免，幽州牧刘虞为太尉。 丙辰，帝崩于南宫嘉德殿，年三十四。 戊午，皇子辩即皇帝位，年十七。 尊皇后曰皇太后，太后临朝。 大赦天下，改元为光熹。 封皇弟协为渤海王。 后将军袁隗为太傅，与大将军何进参录尚书事。 上军校尉蹇硕下狱死。 五月辛巳，票骑将军董重下狱死。 六月辛亥，孝仁皇后董氏崩。 辛酉，葬孝灵皇帝于文陵。 雨水。 秋七月，甘陵王忠薨。 庚寅，孝仁皇后归葬河间慎陵。 徙渤海王协为陈留王。 司徒丁宫罢。 八月戊辰，中常侍张让、段珪杀大将军何进，于是虎贲中郎将袁术烧东西宫，攻诸宦者。 庚午，张让、段珪等劫少帝及陈留王幸北宫德阳殿。
target_text: In 189 CE, Huangfu Song defeated the kingdom. The emperor died in Nangong at age thirty-four. Prince Bian became emperor at seventeen, with Empress Dowager He regent. Eunuch Zhang Rang and others killed General He Jin, leading to Yuan Shu burning the palaces and Yuan Shao massacring eunuchs. The young emperor and Prince Xie were kidnapped but later returned. Dong Zhuo deposed the emperor as Prince Hongnong. Heavy rain fell from June to September.

input_text: 州郡各拥强兵，而委输不至，群僚饥乏，尚书郎以下自出采稆，或饥死墙壁间，或为兵士所杀。 辛亥，镇东将军曹操自领司隶校尉，录尚书事。 曹操杀侍中台崇、尚书冯硕等。 封卫将军董承为辅国将军，伏完等十三人为列侯，赠沮俊为弘农太守。 庚申，迁都许。己巳，幸曹操营。 九月，太尉杨彪、司空张喜罢。 冬十一月丙戌，曹操自为司空，行车骑将军事，百官总己以听。 二年春，袁术自称天子。 三月，袁绍自为大将军。 夏五月，蝗。 秋九月，汉水溢。 是岁饥，江淮间民相食。 袁术杀陈王宠。 孙策遣使奉贡。 三年夏四月，遣谒者裴茂率中郎将段煨讨李傕，夷三族。 吕布叛。 冬十一月，盗杀大司马张杨。 十二月癸酉，曹操击吕布于徐州，斩之。 四年春三月，袁绍攻公孙瓒于易京，获之。 卫将军董承为车骑将军。 夏六月，袁术死。 是岁，初置尚书左右仆射。 武陵女子死十四日复活。 五年春正月，车骑将军董承、偏将军王服、越骑校尉种辑受密诏诛曹操，事泄。 壬午，曹操杀董承等，夷三族。 秋七月，立皇子冯为南阳王。 壬午，南阳王冯薨。
target_text: Xiaoxian Emperor Liu Xie, the son of Emperor Ling, ascended the throne at age nine in September 189, moving the Empress Dowager to Yong'an Palace and granting amnesty. Dong Zhuo soon killed the Empress Dowager and appointed himself Prime Minister. In 190, prefectures raised troops against Dong Zhuo, who killed the former emperor Liu Bian and moved the capital to Chang'an, burning Luoyang's palaces. Dong Zhuo destroyed five-baht coins for small coins. In 191, Dong Zhuo became Grand Master, and Sun Jian defeated his general. Dong Zhuo excavated imperial tombs. In 192, Dong Zhuo was executed, and his clan was wiped out. His generals Li Jue and Guo Si rebelled, capturing Chang'an and killing over 10,000 officials and civilians. Li Jue killed Wang Yun and others. In 193, Yuan Shu killed the Yangzhou governor and occupied Huainan. In 194, a severe drought and locust plague caused famine, with grain prices soaring and cannibalism. The emperor personally inspected relief efforts. In 195, Li Jue killed Fan Chou and fought Guo Si, forcing the emperor to flee. The emperor began his journey back to Luoyang, facing attacks from Li Jue and Guo Si, with many officials killed. In 196, the emperor arrived in Luoyang, but the palace was burned, and officials suffered from hunger. Cao Cao took control, moving the capital to Xuchang and appointing himself Sikong. In 197, Yuan Shu claimed emperorship. In 198, Cao Cao killed Lü Bu. In 199, Yuan Shao captured Gongsun Zan. In 200, Dong Cheng's plot to kill Cao Cao failed, and Cao Cao killed him. Cao Cao defeated Yuan Shao at Guandu. In 207, Cao Cao defeated the Wuhuan. In 208, Cao Cao became Prime Minister, defeated Liu Biao's son, but was defeated by Sun Quan at Red Cliffs. In 213, Cao Cao became Duke of Wei. In 214, Cao Cao killed Empress Fu. In 215, Cao Cao captured Hanzhong. In 216, Cao Cao became King of Wei. In 220, Cao Cao died, and his son Cao Pi succeeded. Emperor Xian abdicated, becoming Duke of Shanyang. Liu Bei proclaimed himself emperor of Shu, and Sun Quan became king of Wu, dividing the realm into three. Emperor Xian died in 234 at age 54, buried with Han rites. Historians note that Han's decline began long before his reign, and he was a victim of his era.

input_text: 孝顺皇帝讳保，安帝之子也。 母李氏，为阎皇后所害。 永宁元年，立为皇太子。延光三年，安帝乳母王圣、大长秋江京、中常侍樊丰谮太子乳母王男、厨监邴吉，杀之，太子数为叹息。 王圣等惧有后祸，遂与丰、京共构陷太子，太子坐废为济阴王。 明年三月，安帝崩，北乡侯立，济阴王以废黜，不得上殿亲临梓宫，悲号不食，内外群僚莫不哀之。 及北乡侯薨，车骑将军阎显及江京，与中常侍刘安、陈达等白太后，秘不发丧，而更征立诸国王子，乃闭宫门，屯兵自守。 十一月丁巳，京师及郡国十六地震。 是夜，中黄门孙程等十九人共斩江京、刘安、陈达等，迎济阴王于德阳殿西钟下，即皇帝位，年十一。 近臣尚书以下，从辇到南宫，登云台，召百官。 尚书令刘光等奏言： 孝安皇帝圣德明茂，早弃天下。
target_text: In the first year of Yongning, Liu Bao, son of Emperor An, was made crown prince. His mother, Mrs. Li, had been killed by Queen Yan. In the third year of Yanguang, the prince's wet nurse Wang Nan and kitchen supervisor Bing Ji were killed after being framed by Wang Sheng, Jiang Jing, and Fan Feng. Liu Bao sighed repeatedly, leading Wang Sheng and others to fear consequences and frame him, resulting in his deposition as King of Jiyin.

input_text: 孝顺皇帝讳保，安帝之子也。 母李氏，为阎皇后所害。 永宁元年，立为皇太子。延光三年，安帝乳母王圣、大长秋江京、中常侍樊丰谮太子乳母王男、厨监邴吉，杀之，太子数为叹息。 王圣等惧有后祸，遂与丰、京共构陷太子，太子坐废为济阴王。 明年三月，安帝崩，北乡侯立，济阴王以废黜，不得上殿亲临梓宫，悲号不食，内外群僚莫不哀之。 及北乡侯薨，车骑将军阎显及江京，与中常侍刘安、陈达等白太后，秘不发丧，而更征立诸国王子，乃闭宫门，屯兵自守。 十一月丁巳，京师及郡国十六地震。 是夜，中黄门孙程等十九人共斩江京、刘安、陈达等，迎济阴王于德阳殿西钟下，即皇帝位，年十一。 近臣尚书以下，从辇到南宫，登云台，召百官。 尚书令刘光等奏言： 孝安皇帝圣德明茂，早弃天下。
target_text: When Emperor An died in March of the fourth year of Yanguang, Liu Yi became emperor. Liu Bao was barred from attending the funeral, causing him to wail and refuse food, moving officials inside and outside. After Liu Yi's death, Empress Dowager Yan's brother Yan Xian and Jiang Jing plotted to secretly not announce the mourning and conscript another prince. Liu Bao closed the palace gates and defended himself. On the fourth day of November, an earthquake struck sixteen places. That night, Sun Cheng and others killed Jiang Jing, Liu An, and Chen Da, welcoming Liu Bao to ascend the throne at age eleven.

input_text: 陛下正统，当奉宗庙，而奸臣交构，遂令陛下龙潜蕃国，群僚远近莫不失望。 天命有常，北乡不永。汉德盛明，福祚孔章。 近臣建策，左右扶翼，内外同心，稽合神明。 陛下践祚，奉遵鸿绪，为郊庙主，承续祖宗无穷之烈，上当天心，下厌民望。 而即位仓卒，典章多缺，请条案礼仪，分别具奏。 制曰： 可。 乃召公卿百僚，使虎贲、羽林士屯南、北宫诸门。 阎显兄弟闻帝立，率兵入北宫，尚书郭镇与交锋刃，遂斩显弟卫尉景。 戊午，遣使者入省，夺得玺绶，乃幸嘉德殿，遣侍御史持节收阎显及其弟城门校尉耀、执金吾晏，并下狱诛。 己未，开门，罢屯兵。 壬戌，诏司隶校尉： 惟阎显、江京近亲当伏辜诛，其余务崇宽贷。 壬申，谒高庙。 癸酉，谒光武庙。 乙亥，诏益州刺史罢子午道，通褒斜路。 己卯，葬少帝以诸王礼。 司空刘授免。
target_text: The ministers reported that due to treacherous ministers, the emperor had become a vassal king, but destiny favored the Han family. The emperor succeeded to the throne according to heaven's will and the people's wishes. He ordered the organization of rituals. Yan Xian's brothers led troops into the North Palace but were fought by Guo Zhen, who killed Yan Jing. On the fifth day, envoys seized the seal, and the emperor arrested and executed Yan Xian and his brothers. On the sixth day, the palace gates were opened. On the ninth day, an order was issued that only close relatives of Yan Xian and Jiang Jing would be punished.

input_text: 二年春正月戊申，乐安王鸿来朝。 丁卯，常山王章薨。 二月，鲜卑寇辽东、玄菟。 甲辰，诏禀贷荆、豫、兖、冀四州流冗贫人，所在安业之；疾病致医药。 护乌桓校尉耿晔率南单于击鲜卑，破之。 三月，旱，遣使者录囚徒。 疏勒国遣使奉献。 夏六月乙酉，追尊谥皇妣李氏为恭愍皇后，葬于恭北陵。 西域长史班勇、敦煌太守张朗讨焉耆、尉犁、危须三国，破之；并遣子贡献。 秋七月甲戌朔，日有食之。壬午，太尉朱宠、司徒朱伥罢。 庚子，太常刘光为太尉，录尚书事；光禄勋许敬为司徒。 辛丑，下邳王成薨。 三年春正月丙子，京师地震，汉阳地陷裂。 甲午，诏实核伤害者，赐年七岁以上钱，人二千；一家被害，郡县为收敛。 乙未，诏勿收汉阳今年田租、田赋。 夏四月癸卯，遣光禄大夫案行汉阳及河内、魏郡、陈留、东郡，禀贷贫人。 六月，旱。遣使者录囚徒，理轻系。 甲寅，济南王显薨。 秋七月丁酉，茂陵园寝灾，帝缟素避正殿。 辛亥，使太常王龚持节告祠茂陵。 九月，鲜卑寇渔阳。 冬十二月己亥，太傅桓焉免。 是岁，车骑将军来历罢。
target_text: The emperor visited Gaomiao and Guangwu Temple. He ordered the use of Baoxie Road instead of Ziwu Road. Liu Yi was buried with royal rites. Sikong Liu was dismissed, and ministers were rewarded. Tao Dun was appointed Sikong. A major epidemic occurred in the capital. The edict deposing Liu Bao as King Jiyin was returned. In the first year of Yongjian, a general amnesty was granted, with various rewards and exemptions. Empress Dowager Yan passed away. Taifu Feng Shi, Taiwei Liu Xi, and Situ Li were dismissed. Queen Ansi was buried. Taichang Huanyan was appointed Taifu; Zhu Chong was appointed Taiwei; Zhu Qian was appointed Situ.

input_text: 严敕障塞，缮设屯备，立秋之后，简习戎马。 六月己亥，封济南王错子显为济南王。 秋七月庚午，卫尉来历为车骑将军。 八月，鲜卑寇代郡，代郡太守李超战殁。 九月辛亥，初令三公、尚书入奏事。 冬十月辛巳，诏减死罪以下徙边；其亡命赎，各有差。 丁亥，司空陶敦免。 鲜卑犯边。 庚寅，遣黎阳营兵出屯中山北界。告幽州刺史，其令缘边郡增置步兵，死屯塞下。 调五营弩师，郡举五人，令教习战射。 壬寅，廷尉张皓为司空。 甲辰，诏以疫疠水潦，令人半输今年田租；伤害什四以上，勿收责；不满者，以实除之。 十二月辛巳，赐王、主、贵人、公卿以下布各有差。
target_text: The Zhongqiang in Longxi rebelled but were defeated by Ma Xian. Governors were ordered to verify officials and organize border fortifications. Liu Xian was made King of Jinan. Ren Weiwei was appointed general of chariots and cavalry. Xianbei bandits raided Daijun, killing Li Chao. The emperor began to order Sangong and Shangshu to report state affairs. Prisoners with capital crimes were moved to border areas. Sikong Taodun was dismissed. Xianbei invaded border areas. The Liyang Battalion was sent to garrison the northern border of Zhongshan. Five captains of crossbow divisions were selected. Tingwei Zhang Hao was appointed Sikong. Due to severe epidemic, common people lost half of their field rent.

input_text: 二年春正月戊申，乐安王鸿来朝。 丁卯，常山王章薨。 二月，鲜卑寇辽东、玄菟。 甲辰，诏禀贷荆、豫、兖、冀四州流冗贫人，所在安业之；疾病致医药。 护乌桓校尉耿晔率南单于击鲜卑，破之。 三月，旱，遣使者录囚徒。 疏勒国遣使奉献。 夏六月乙酉，追尊谥皇妣李氏为恭愍皇后，葬于恭北陵。 西域长史班勇、敦煌太守张朗讨焉耆、尉犁、危须三国，破之；并遣子贡献。 秋七月甲戌朔，日有食之。壬午，太尉朱宠、司徒朱伥罢。 庚子，太常刘光为太尉，录尚书事；光禄勋许敬为司徒。 辛丑，下邳王成薨。 三年春正月丙子，京师地震，汉阳地陷裂。 甲午，诏实核伤害者，赐年七岁以上钱，人二千；一家被害，郡县为收敛。 乙未，诏勿收汉阳今年田租、田赋。 夏四月癸卯，遣光禄大夫案行汉阳及河内、魏郡、陈留、东郡，禀贷贫人。 六月，旱。遣使者录囚徒，理轻系。 甲寅，济南王显薨。 秋七月丁酉，茂陵园寝灾，帝缟素避正殿。 辛亥，使太常王龚持节告祠茂陵。 九月，鲜卑寇渔阳。 冬十二月己亥，太傅桓焉免。 是岁，车骑将军来历罢。
target_text: In the second year, King Liu Hong of Le'an paid homage. King Liu Zhang of Changshan passed away. Xianbei raided Liaodong and Xuantu. Grain relief was provided to poor people in four prefectures. Geng Ye led Nan Shanyu to attack Xianbei and defeated them. There was a drought. Shule State sent envoys. Imperial concubine Li was given the posthumous title of Queen Gongmin. Ban Yong and Zhang Lang attacked Yanqi, Yuli, and Weixu, defeating them. A solar eclipse occurred. Taiwei Zhu Chong and Situ Zhu Chong were dismissed. Liu Guang was appointed Taiwei; Xu Jing was appointed Situ. King Liu Cheng of Xiapi passed away.
