target_text: Sima Mo, King of Nanyang, was eager to learn young, famous with Emperor Yuan and Sima You. He was initially named Pingchang Gong. He served as Crown Prince's Concubine and Official Attendant. Sima Yue appointed him Beizhonglang General to guard Ye. He was promoted to King of Nanyang. During famine in Guanzhong, Sima Mo cast bronze vessels into cooking utensils for food, criticized by commentators. Sima Yue summoned him as Sikong, but Sima Mo refused, persuaded by Chun Yuding. He was promoted to Taiwei and Grand Governor. When Luo Jing fell, Sima Mo surrendered to Zhao Ran, who recited his crimes and sent him to Liu Can, who killed him. Sima Mo's son Sima Bao succeeded him.

input_text: 模从之，遂降于染。 染箕踞攘袂数模之罪，送诣粲。 粲杀之，以模妃刘氏赐胡张本为妻。 子保立。 保字景度，少有文义，好述作。 初拜南阳国世子。 模遇害，保在邽上。 其后贾疋死，裴苞又为张轨所杀，保全有秦州之地，自号大司马，承制置百官。 陇右氐羌并从之，凉州刺史张寔遣使贡献。 及愍帝即位，以保为右丞相，加侍中、都督陕西诸军事。 寻进位相国。 模之败也，都尉陈安归于保，保命统精勇千余人以讨羌，宠遇甚厚。 保将张春等疾之，谮安有异志，请除之，保不许。 春等辄伏客以刺安，安被创，驰还陇城，遣使诣保，贡献不绝。 愍帝之蒙尘也，保自称晋王。 时上邽大饥，士众窘困，张春奉保之南安。 陈安自号秦州刺史，称籓于刘曜。 春复奉保奔桑城，将投于张寔。 寔使兵迎保，实御之也。
target_text: Sima Bao, courtesy name Jingdu, was talented in literature. When Sima Mo was killed, Sima Bao was in Shangying. He controlled Qinzhou, appointed officials, and Di and Qiang people obeyed him. Emperor Min appointed him Right Prime Minister and Commander-in-Chief. After Emperor Min's humiliation, Sima Bao claimed to be King of Jin. Famine struck Shangbang, and Zhang Chun escorted Sima Bao to Nan'an. Sima Bao died of illness at twenty-seven. He was tall, fat, weighed 800 jin, slept well but was impotent. Having no sons, Zhang Chun established Sima Zhan as successor. Chen An attacked Zhang Chun, Sima Zhan surrendered to Chen An, who sent him to Liu Yao, who killed him. Chen An buried Sima Bao with emperor's rites, posthumous title Yuan.

input_text: 是岁，保病薨，时年二十七。 保体质丰伟，尝自称重八百斤。 喜睡，痿疾，不能御妇人。 无子，张春立宗室司马瞻奉保后。 陈安举兵攻春，春走，瞻降于安，安送诣刘曜，曜杀之。 安迎保丧，以天子礼葬于上邽，谥曰元。 范阳康王绥，字子都，彭城王权季弟也，初为谏议大夫。 泰始元年受封，在位十五年。 咸宁五年薨，子虓立焉。 虓字武会，少好学，驰誉，研考经记，清辩，能言论。 以宗室选拜散骑常侍，累迁尚书。 出为安南将军、都督豫州诸军事、持节，镇许昌，进位征南将军。 河间王颙表立成都王颖为太弟，为王浚所破，挟天子还洛阳。 虓与东平王楙、镇东将军周馥等上言曰： 自愍怀被害，皇储不建，委重前相，辄失臣节。 是以前年太宰与臣，永惟社稷之贰，不可久空，所以共启成都王颖，以为国副。 受重之后，而弗克负荷。 小人勿用 ，而以为腹心。
target_text: Sima Sui, King of Fanyang, was younger brother of Sima Quan, King of Pengcheng. He was initially an Admonishment Official, granted title in the first year of Taishi, reigned fifteen years, died in the fifth year of Xianning, succeeded by his son Sima Gai. Sima Gai was famous for studiousness, studied classics, good at speaking. He served as Sanqi Changshi, Minister, General Annan, guarding Xuchang, promoted to General Conquering the South. Sima Yong proposed appointing Wang Siyan. Sima Gai, Sima Liu, and Zhou Fu reported to the emperor about Sima Ying's failures and recommended Zhang Fang. They urged the emperor to give Guan You to Dazai and send Zhang Fang back to the county. Sima Gai led everyone from Xu to Rongyang to garrison. When Emperor Hui moved west, Sima Gai formed an alliance with Sima Mo and elected Sima Yue as leader. Liu Qiao attacked Xu, Sima Gai crossed the Yellow River, defeated Liu Qiao. Sima Ji killed Zhang Fang and sent his head to Sima Yue. Sima Gai escorted the emperor back to the capital, worshiped as Situ. He died at thirty-seven, no sons, adopted Sima Mo's son Sima Li, who was killed in Chang'an.

input_text: 永兴三年暴疾薨，时年三十七。 无子，养模子黎为嗣，黎随模就国，于长安遇害。 济南惠王遂，字子伯，宣帝弟魏鸿胪丞恂之子也。 仕魏关内侯，进封平昌亭侯，历典军郎将。 景元二年，转封武城乡侯、督鄴城守诸军事、北中郎将。 五等建，封祝阿伯，累迁冠军将军。 武帝受禅，封济南王。 泰始二年薨。 二子：耽、缉。 耽嗣立，咸宁三年徙为中山王。 是年薨，无子，缉继。 成都王颖以缉为建威将军，与石熙等率众距王浚，没于阵，薨。 无子，国除。 后遂之曾孙勋字伟长，年十余岁，愍帝末，长安陷，刘曜将令狐泥养为子。
target_text: Sima Sui, King Hui of Jinan, was son of Sima Xun, younger brother of Emperor Xuan. He was Marquis of Guannei in Wei, promoted to Marquis of Qianchang Ting, served as Dianjunlang. In the second year of Jingyuan, he was granted title of Rural Marquis of Wucheng, Governor of Yecheng and General Beizhonglang. He was named Zhu Abo, moved to Champion General. Emperor Wu made him King of Jinan. He died in the second year of Taishi. He had two sons: Sima Dan and Sima Ji. Sima Dan succeeded, renamed King of Zhongshan, died without sons, Sima Ji succeeded. Sima Ji served as General Jianwei, fought against Wang Chuang, died in battle. Without sons, the feudal state was cancelled. Later, Sima Sui's great-grandson Sima Xun, named Wei Chang, was adopted by Liu Yao's general Linghu Ni. He returned from Guanyou in the sixth year of Xianhe, claimed to be Sima Xun's descendant, paid homage to Pu She. He served as Governor of Liangzhou, attacked Chang'an, captured Hecheng. Guanzhong responded to him. During the Yonghe period, he entered Chang'an, killed Zhang Ju, but was defeated by Fu Xiong. He was promoted to General Conquering the Captives, Marquis of Tongjiting. He was tyrannical, killing wealthy families who disagreed with him. He planned to occupy Shu territory. Huan Wen sent troops to attack him, Sima Xun was captured and killed.

input_text: 二子：随、承。 定王随立。 薨，子邃立，没于石勒，元帝以承嗣逊。 闵王承字敬才，少笃厚有志行。 拜奉车都尉、奉朝请，稍迁广威将军、安夷护军，镇安定。 从惠帝还洛阳，拜游击将军。 永嘉中，天下渐乱，间行依征南将军山简，会简卒，进至武昌。 元帝初镇扬州，承归建康，补军谘祭酒。 愍帝征为龙骧将军，不行。 元帝为晋王，承制更封承为谯王。 太兴初，拜屯骑校尉，加辅国将军，领左军将军。 承居官俭约，家无别室。 寻加散骑常侍，辅国、左军如故。 王敦有无君之心，表疏轻慢。 帝夜召承，以敦表示之，曰： 王敦顷年位任足矣，而所求不已，言至于此，将若之何？ 承曰： 陛下不早裁之，难将作矣。 帝欲树籓屏，会敦表以宣城内史沈充为湘州，帝谓承曰： 湘州南楚险固，在上流之要，控三州之会，是用武之国也。
target_text: Sima Xun, King of Qiao Gang, was son of Sima Jin, younger brother of Emperor Xuan. He was Marquis of Wei Guannei, granted title of Marquis of Yangting of Chengcheng, served as General Qingche and Zuojian Yulin. He was named Jingyang Nan. Emperor Wu made him King Qiao with 4,400 households. He died in the second year of Taishi. He had two sons: Sima Sui and Sima Cheng. Sima Sui succeeded, died in Shile. Emperor Yuan asked Sima to succeed him. Sima Cheng, King Min, was loyal and virtuous young. He served as General Guangwei and Protector of Anyi. He returned to Luoyang with Emperor Hui, became Guerrilla General. During Yongjia period, he secretly attached himself to Shan Jian. When Shan Jian died, he entered Wuchang. When Emperor Yuan guarded Yangzhou, Sima Cheng returned to Jiankang, served as Military Counselor and Wine Worshiper. Emperor Yuan changed his title to King Qiao. He served as Captain of Tunqi School, General of the Auxiliary State and Left Army. He was frugal, did not take concubines. When Wang Dun was disloyal, the emperor summoned Sima Cheng at night, showed him Wang Dun's memorial. Sima Cheng advised early action. The emperor appointed him to guard Xiangzhou. Sima Cheng traveled to Wuchang, saw Wang Dun unarmed. Wang Dun tested him but let him go to his post. Sima Cheng was frugal, rode a reed cart, comforted people, earned good reputation. Wang Dun feared him, requisitioned his ships. When Wang Dun rebelled, Sima Cheng raised righteous deeds, but the city fell after more than a hundred days. Wei Yi sent him to Jingzhou, where Wang Yu killed him on the way at fifty-nine. After Wang Dun was pacified, Sima Cheng was posthumously awarded General of Chariots and Cavalry. His son Wuji succeeded him.

input_text: 然公私宪制，亦巳有断，王当以体国为大，岂可寻绎由来，以乱朝宪。 主者其申明法令，自今已往，有犯必诛。 于是听以赎论。 建元初迁散骑常侍，转御史中丞，出为辅国将军、长沙相，又领江夏相，寻转南郡、河东二郡太守，将军如故。 随桓温伐蜀，以勋赐少子愔爵广晋伯，进号前将军，永和六年薨，赠卫将军。 二子：恬、愔。 恬立。 敬王恬，字元愉，少拜散骑侍郎，累迁散骑常侍、黄门郎、御史中丞。 值海西废，简文帝登阼，未解严，大司马桓温屯中堂，吹警角，恬奏劾温大不敬，请科罪。 温视奏叹曰： 此兒乃敢弹我，真可畏也。 恬忠正有干局，在朝惮之。
target_text: Sima Wuji, King Lie, escaped when young during Sima Cheng's trouble. He served as Sanqi Shilang, moved to Tunqi Xiaowei and Zhongshu. He tried to kill Wang Yu's son Qizhi for revenge but was stopped. The emperor pardoned him. He served as Sanqi Changshi and Censor Zhongcheng, then General of the Auxiliary State and Prime Minister of Changsha. He followed Dandan in expedition against Shu, given title of Duke Guangzhi. He died in the sixth year of Cheng Mian, posthumously awarded General Wei. He had two sons: Sima Tian and Sima Qing. Sima Tian succeeded him.

input_text: 迁右卫将军、司雍秦梁四州大中正，拜尚书，转侍中，领左卫将军，补吴国内史，又领太子詹事。 恬既宗室勋望，有才用，孝武帝时深杖之，以为都督兗、青、冀、幽并扬州之晋陵、徐州之南北郡军事，领镇北将军、兗青二州刺史、假节。 太元十五年薨，追赠车骑将军。 四子：尚之、恢之、允之、休之。 尚之立。 忠王尚之，字伯道，初拜秘书郎，迁散骑侍郎。 恬镇京口，尚之为振威将军、广陵相，父忧去职。 服阕，为骠骑谘议参军。 宗室之内，世有人物。 王国宝之诛也，散骑常侍刘镇之、彭城内史刘涓子，徐州别驾徐放并以同党被收，将加大辟。 尚之言于会稽王道子曰： 刑狱不可广，宜释镇之等。 道子以尚之昆季并居列职，每事仗焉，乃从之。 兗州刺史王恭忌其盛也，与豫州刺史庾楷并称兵，以讨尚之为名，南连荆州刺史殷仲堪、南郡公桓玄等。 道子命前将军王珣、右将军谢琰讨恭，尚之距楷。 允之与楷子鸿战于当利，鸿败走，斩楷将段方，楷单马奔于桓玄。 道子以尚之为建威将军、豫州刺史、假节，一依楷故事，寻进号前将军；允之为吴国内史；恢之骠骑司马、丹杨尹；休之襄城太守。 各拥兵马，势倾朝廷。 后将军元显执政，亦倚以为援。
target_text: Sima Tian, King Jing, served as Sanqi Shilang, Sanqi Changshi, Huangmenlang, and Yushi Zhongcheng. When Duke Haixi was deposed, Sima Tian impeached Grand Sima Xun for disrespect. The emperor sighed at his courage. Sima Tian was loyal, upright, talented, feared by officials. He served as General of the Right Guard, Shangshu, Shizhong, and General of the Left Guard. He was appointed Domestic History of Wu and Prince Zhanshi. Emperor Xiaowu relied on him heavily, appointed him Military Governor of several states and General of Zhenbei. He died in the fifteenth year of Taiyuan, posthumously awarded General of Chariots and Cavalry. He had four sons: Shangzhi, Huizhi, Yunzhi, and Xiuzhi. Shangzhi succeeded him.

input_text: 迁右卫将军、司雍秦梁四州大中正，拜尚书，转侍中，领左卫将军，补吴国内史，又领太子詹事。 恬既宗室勋望，有才用，孝武帝时深杖之，以为都督兗、青、冀、幽并扬州之晋陵、徐州之南北郡军事，领镇北将军、兗青二州刺史、假节。 太元十五年薨，追赠车骑将军。 四子：尚之、恢之、允之、休之。 尚之立。 忠王尚之，字伯道，初拜秘书郎，迁散骑侍郎。 恬镇京口，尚之为振威将军、广陵相，父忧去职。 服阕，为骠骑谘议参军。 宗室之内，世有人物。 王国宝之诛也，散骑常侍刘镇之、彭城内史刘涓子，徐州别驾徐放并以同党被收，将加大辟。 尚之言于会稽王道子曰： 刑狱不可广，宜释镇之等。 道子以尚之昆季并居列职，每事仗焉，乃从之。 兗州刺史王恭忌其盛也，与豫州刺史庾楷并称兵，以讨尚之为名，南连荆州刺史殷仲堪、南郡公桓玄等。 道子命前将军王珣、右将军谢琰讨恭，尚之距楷。 允之与楷子鸿战于当利，鸿败走，斩楷将段方，楷单马奔于桓玄。 道子以尚之为建威将军、豫州刺史、假节，一依楷故事，寻进号前将军；允之为吴国内史；恢之骠骑司马、丹杨尹；休之襄城太守。 各拥兵马，势倾朝廷。 后将军元显执政，亦倚以为援。
target_text: Sima Shangzhi, King Zhong, served as Secretary-General and Sanqi Shilang. He guarded Jingkou as General Zhenwei and Prime Minister Guangling. After his father's death, he served as Hussar Consultant. Within the clan, outstanding figures appeared generation after generation. When Wang Guobao was executed, Shangzhi advised King Daozi of Kuaiji to release Liu Zhenzhi and others. Daozi obeyed. Wang Gong, Governor of Yanzhou, jealous of Shangzhi's power, raised troops with Yu Kai and others. Daozi ordered Shangzhi to resist Yu Kai. Shangzhi defeated Yu Kai's forces. Daozi appointed Shangzhi as General Jianwei and Governor of Yuzhou. Shangzhi's power surpassed others. Later, Yuan Xian came to power and relied on him. Shangzhi scolded Yuan Xian's favorite Zhang Fashun, earning Yuan Xian's resentment. When Yuan Xian attacked Huan Xuan, Shangzhi was ordered to be vanguard. Huan Xuan attacked, Shangzhi's army collapsed, and Huan Xuan had Shangzhi killed. The emperor posthumously awarded General Wei to Shangzhi. His cousin Kangzhi was renamed King of Qiao County. Later, Wensi, Xiuzhi's eldest son, succeeded Shangzhi but was cruel and rebellious. Liu Yu killed him, and the feudal state was cancelled.

input_text: 大将军武陵王令曰： 前龙骧将军休之，才干贞审，功业既成。 历阳之战，事在机捷。 及至势乖力屈，奉身出奔，犹鸠集义徒，崎岖险阻。 既应亲贤之举，宜委分陕之重。 可监荆益梁宁秦雍六州军事、领护南蛮校尉、荆州刺史、假节。 到镇无几，桓振复袭江陵，休之战败，出奔襄阳。 宁朔将军张暢之、高平相刘怀肃自沔攻振，走之。 休之还镇，御史中丞王桢之奏休之失戍，免官。 朝廷以豫州刺史魏咏之代之，征休之还京师，拜后将军、会稽内史。 御史中丞阮歆之奏休之与尚书虞啸父犯禁嬉戏，降号征虏将军，寻复为后将军。 及卢循作逆，加督渐江东五郡军事，坐公事免。 刘毅诛，复以休之都督荆雍梁秦宁益六州军事、平西将军、荆州刺史、假节。 以子文思为乱，上疏谢曰： 文思不能聿修，自贻罪戾，忧惧震惶，惋愧交集。
target_text: Sima Huizhi served as Commander of Hsiao Cavalry and Danyang Yin. After Shangzhi was killed, Huan Xuan moved Huizhi and others to Guangzhou, killing them on the way. Emperor An posthumously awarded him General Fujun. Sima Xiuzhi served as General Longxiang and Governor of Xiangcheng. When Shangzhi was defeated, Xiuzhi fought hard but failed, then joined Murong Chao. He returned to the capital hearing of the rebel army's rise. He was appointed to supervise military affairs of six states and serve as Governor of Jingzhou. Huan Zhen attacked Jiangling, Xiuzhi was defeated and fled to Xiangyang. He returned to his post but was later relieved. He served as General of the Empress and Internal Secretary of Kuaiji. He was demoted for violating the ban. When Lu Xun rebelled, he was appointed military commander. He was dismissed due to official crimes. Later, he was appointed Governor of Jingzhou. Because his son Wensi made trouble, Xiuzhi apologized and asked to be relieved. The emperor forbade it. Later, Xiuzhi colluded with Lu Zongzhi to kill those in power. Liu Yu personally conquered Xiuzhi. Xiuzhi was defeated and defected to Yao Xing with Zongzhi. Liu Yu pacified Yao Hong, and Xiuzhi defected to Wei but died on the road.

input_text: 以平西之至德，宁可无授命之臣乎！ 假令天长丧乱，九流浑浊，当与臧洪游于地下耳。 裕得书叹息，以示诸佐曰： 事人当应如此！ 宗之闻裕向荆州，自襄阳就休之共屯江陵。 使文思及宗之子轨以兵距裕，战于江津。 休之大败，遂与宗之俱奔于姚兴。 裕平姚泓，休之将奔于魏，未至，道死。 允之字季度，出后叔父愔，袭爵广晋伯，历位辅国将军、吴国宣城谯梁内史。 王恭、庾楷、桓玄等内伐也，会稽王道子命允之兄弟距楷，破之。 元兴初，与兄恢之同徙广州，于道被害。 义军起，追赠太常卿。 从弟康之以子文惠袭爵。 宋受禅，国除。 韩延之，字显宗，南阳赭阳人，魏司徒暨之后也。 少以分义称。 安帝时为建威将军、荆州治中，转平西府录事参军。 以刘裕父名翘字显宗，延之遂字显宗，名兒为翘，以示不臣刘氏。 与休之俱奔姚兴。 刘裕入关，又奔于魏。 愔字敬王，初封广晋伯。 早卒，无子，兄恬以子允之嗣。 高阳王睦，字子友，谯王逊之弟也。 魏安平亭侯，历侍御史。 武帝受禅，封中山王，邑五千二百户。 睦自表乞依六蓼祀皋陶，鄫杞祀相立庙。
target_text: Sima Yunzhi passed to his uncle Sima Qing, inherited the title of Guangjin Bo, served as General of the Auxiliary State. When Wang Gong, Yu Kai, and Huan Xuan conquered the country, Yunzhi's brothers resisted but were defeated. He and his elder brother were moved to Luzhou and killed on the road. The rebel army arose, and he was posthumously awarded Taichang Qing. His cousin Chenzhi let his son Wenhui inherit the title. After Song accepted abdication, the feudal state was cancelled.

input_text: 其贬睦为县侯。 乃封丹水县侯。 及吴平，太康初诏复爵。 有司奏封江阳王，帝曰： 睦退静思愆，改修其德，今有爵土，不但以赦。 江阳险远，其以高阳郡封之。 乃封为高阳王。 元康元年，为宗正。 薨于位，世子蔚早卒，孙毅立。 拜散骑侍郎，永嘉中没于石勒。 隆安元年，诏以谯敬王恬次子恢之子文深继毅后。 立五年，薨，无嗣，复以高密王纯之子法莲继之。 宋受禅，国除。 任城景王陵，字子山，宣帝弟魏司隶从事安城亭侯通之子也。 初拜议郎。 泰始元年封北海王，邑四千七百户。 三年，转封任城王，之国。 咸宁五年薨，子济立。 拜散骑侍郎、给事中、散骑常侍、辅国将军。 随东海王越在项，为石勒所害，二子俱没。 有二弟：顺、斌。 顺字子思，初封习阳亭侯。 及武帝受禅，顺叹曰： 事乖唐虞，而假为禅名！
target_text: Sima Mu, King of Gaoyang, was younger brother of Sima Xun, King of Qiao. In Wei, he was Marquis of Anpingting, served as Imperial Censor. Emperor Wu made him King of Zhongshan with 5,200 households. Sima Mu petitioned to build an ancestral temple according to Liu Liao's sacrifice to Gao Tao. The matter was left to Taichang for review. Doctors offered wine to Liu Bang and others discussed the etiquette. The edict said the provisions were unclear and should be reviewed. In the third year of Xianning, Sima Mu recruited more than 700 migrants, and Du You, Governor of Jizhou, reported him. The relevant officials said the incident occurred before amnesty and should be forgiven. The emperor demoted Sima Mu to Marquis of Danshui County. After Wu was pacified, the edict restored his title. He was named King of Gaoyang. In the first year of Yuankang, he was appointed Zongzheng. He died in office, his eldest son Sima Wei died early, and his grandson Sima Yi succeeded. Sima Yi served as Sanqi Shilang, died in Shile during Yongjia period. In the first year of Long'an, Wen Shen, son of Huizhi, second son of Sima Tian, was appointed as Sima Yi's successor. He died without sons after five years, succeeded by Fa Lian, son of King Sima Chun of Gaomi. Song accepted abdication and the feudal state was cancelled.

input_text: 其贬睦为县侯。 乃封丹水县侯。 及吴平，太康初诏复爵。 有司奏封江阳王，帝曰： 睦退静思愆，改修其德，今有爵土，不但以赦。 江阳险远，其以高阳郡封之。 乃封为高阳王。 元康元年，为宗正。 薨于位，世子蔚早卒，孙毅立。 拜散骑侍郎，永嘉中没于石勒。 隆安元年，诏以谯敬王恬次子恢之子文深继毅后。 立五年，薨，无嗣，复以高密王纯之子法莲继之。 宋受禅，国除。 任城景王陵，字子山，宣帝弟魏司隶从事安城亭侯通之子也。 初拜议郎。 泰始元年封北海王，邑四千七百户。 三年，转封任城王，之国。 咸宁五年薨，子济立。 拜散骑侍郎、给事中、散骑常侍、辅国将军。 随东海王越在项，为石勒所害，二子俱没。 有二弟：顺、斌。 顺字子思，初封习阳亭侯。 及武帝受禅，顺叹曰： 事乖唐虞，而假为禅名！
target_text: Sima Ling, King of Renchengjing, was son of Sima Tong, younger brother of Emperor Xuan. He was Tinghou of Ancheng. Initially, he served as Yilang. In the first year of Taishi, he was granted title of King of Beihai with 4,700 households. In the third year, he was transferred to King of City. He died in the fifth year of Xianning, succeeded by his son Sima Ji. Sima Ji served as Sanqi Shilang and Auxiliary General. Following Sima Yue, King of Shuhai, in Xiangdi, he was killed by Shi Le, and his two sons died. He had two younger brothers: Sima Shun and Sima Bin. Sima Shun, courtesy name Zisi, was initially Marquis of Xiyangting. When Emperor Wu accepted abdication, Sima Shun sighed and cried sadly, saying the matter was contrary to Lu and Yu. He was deposed and moved to Guzang County, Wuwei. He persisted in his views until death. Sima Bin, King Mu of Xihe, was Zhonglang of Wei. Emperor Wu made him King Chen with 1,710 households. Three years later, it was renamed Xihe. He died in the fourth year of Xianning, succeeded by his son Yinli. When Yinli died, his son succeeded.

input_text: 遂悲泣。 由是废黜，徙武威姑臧县。 虽受罪流放，守意不移而卒。 西河缪王斌，字子政，魏中郎。 武帝受禅，封陈王，邑千七百一十户。 三年，改封西河。 咸宁四年薨，子隐立。 薨，子立。 史臣曰：泰始之初，天下少事，革魏余弊，遵周旧典，并建宗室，以为籓翰。 诸父同虞虢之尊，兄弟受鲁卫之祉，以为历纪长久，本支百世。 安平风度宏邈，器宇高雅，内弘道义，外阐忠贞。 洎高贵薨殂，则枕尸流恸；陈留就国，则拜辞陨涕。 语曰 疾风彰劲草 ，献王其有焉。 故能位班上列，享年眉寿，清徽至范，为晋宗英，子孙遵业，世笃其庆。 高密风监清远，简素寡欲，孝以承亲，忠以奉上，方诸枝庶，实谓国桢。 新蔡、南阳，俱莅方岳。
target_text: The historical commentary notes that in the early years of Taishi, the clan was established as a barrier to protect the country. Anping's demeanor was majestic and elegant, promoting morality internally and demonstrating loyalty externally. When Duke Gaogui was killed, he wept bitterly. When King Chenliu went to Jinyong City, he bid farewell tearfully. He could be ranked among top ministers, enjoy a long life, and be a model of extreme beauty. The King of Gaomi had a quiet style, simple and without desires, filial to relatives and loyal to the court. King Xincai and King Nanyang both ruled one side. During the royal family's trouble, they showed loyalty and made achievements in difficult times. King Qiao Min was brave and resourceful, guarding the south. When evil spirits rebelled, he raised righteousness in Xiangzhou. Although without meritorious service, he showed loyalty and left achievements to future generations. Sima Xun was entrusted with the clan but had a violent nature, betraying the king and failing to live up to kindness. His treacherous plot deepened, and he was eventually pacified. Marquis Xiyang Ting was frugal and reclusive, putting emotions aside from the world, valuing the principles of being knowledgeable and ethical.

input_text: 王祥郑冲何曾 石苞 王祥，字休徵，琅邪临沂人，汉谏议大夫吉之后也。 祖仁，青州刺史。 父融，公府辟不就。 祥性至孝。 早丧亲，继母硃氏不慈，数谮之，由是失爱于父。 每使扫除牛下，祥愈恭谨。 父母有疾，衣不解带，汤药必亲尝。 母常欲生鱼，时天寒冰冻，祥解衣将剖冰求之，冰忽自解，双鲤跃出，持之而归。 母又思黄雀灸，复有黄雀数十飞入其幕，复以供母。 乡里惊叹，以为孝感所致焉。 有丹柰结实，母命守之，每风雨，祥辄抱树而泣。 其笃孝纯至如此。 汉未遭乱，扶母携弟览避地庐江，隐居三十余年，不应州郡之命。 母终，居丧毁瘁，杖而后起。
target_text: Wang Xiang, courtesy name Xiuzheng, was from Linyi, Langye, a descendant of Han official Wang Ji. His grandfather Wang Ren served as Qingzhou governor, while his father Wang Rong refused government service. Wang Xiang was exceptionally filial. After his mother died young, his stepmother Zhu treated him poorly and spoke ill of him, causing his father to lose affection for him. Despite being ordered to clean cattle pens, Wang Xiang remained respectful. When his parents fell ill, he personally tasted their medicine. During freezing weather, his stepmother desired live fish; Wang Xiang removed his clothes to break ice, and two carps leaped out spontaneously. When she wanted roasted oriole, dozens flew into his tent. Villagers attributed these events to his filial piety. During late Han warfare, he supported his mother and younger brother Wang Lan while hiding in Lujiang for over twenty years, refusing official appointments. After his mother's death, he became ill from grief. At nearly sixty, he initially refused Governor Lu Qian's invitation but eventually accepted after Wang Lan's persuasion. He defeated bandits, brought peace to the state, and was praised in song. Wang Xiang held various official positions including Wen Ling, Da Sinong, and was named Guannei Marquis. He served as Sili Xiaowei, Taichang, and Marquis of Wansui Ting. The emperor appointed him as third elder at the Imperial Academy, where he taught political education. He was promoted to Sikong, Taiwei, and Shizhong, eventually becoming Suiling Marquis with 1,600 households. When Emperor Wen became King of Jin, Wang Xiang refused to kneel, stating that as a Wei official, he would not bow to others. Emperor Wu appointed him Taibao and promoted him to Duke. Despite repeated retirement requests due to age, the emperor refused, granting him privileges including exemption from court attendance. Upon critical illness, Wang Xiang instructed his descendants on simple burial, forbidding elaborate ceremonies and expensive items. He died in the fourth year of Taishi at age eighty-five. His sons included Wang Zhao, Wang Xia, Wang Fu, Wang Lie, and Wang Fen.

input_text: 及魏文帝为太子，搜扬侧陋，命冲为文学，累迁尚书郎，出补陈留太守。 冲以儒雅为德，莅职无干局之誉，箪食缊袍，不营资产，世以此重之。 大将军曹爽引为从事中郎，转散骑常侍、光禄勋。 嘉平三年，拜司空。 及高贵乡公讲《尚书》，冲执经亲授，与侍中郑小同俱被赏赐。 俄转司徒。 常道乡公即位，拜太保，位在三司之上，封寿光侯。 冲虽位阶台辅，而不预世事。 时文帝辅政，平蜀之后，命贾充、羊祜等分定礼仪、律令，皆先谘于冲，然后施行。 及魏帝告禅，使冲奉策。 武帝践阼，拜太傅，进爵为公。 顷之，司隶李憙、中丞侯史光奏冲及何曾，荀顗等各以疾病，俱应免官。 帝不许。 冲遂不视事，表乞骸骨。 优诏不许，遣使申喻。 冲固辞，上貂蝉印绶，诏又不许。
target_text: Zheng Chong, courtesy name Wenhe, was from Kaifeng, Rongyang. Born poor, he established moral integrity, was quiet with few desires, and extensively studied Confucian classics. He followed etiquette strictly and did not seek local fame. Emperor Wen of Wei appointed him literary minister, later promoting him to Shangshulang and Chenliu prefect. He valued elegance over wealth, earning respect. Cao Shuang recommended him as lieutenant, then Sanqi Changshi and Guang Luxun. In Jiaping's third year, he became Sikong, later Situ. He was appointed Taibao and named Shouguang Hou. Though holding prime ministerial rank, he avoided worldly affairs. When Emperor Wei abdicated, Zheng Chong presented the policy letter. Emperor Wu appointed him Taifu and promoted him to Duke. Despite illness-related requests for removal, the emperor refused. In the sixth year of Taishi, the emperor praised Zheng Chong, He Zeng, and Xun Hao for their virtue and service. Zheng Chong repeatedly resigned, and the emperor eventually allowed him to return to his mansion as Duke Shouguang with full privileges. He died the following year, receiving posthumous honors. Zheng Chong compiled "Collected Commentary of the Analects of Confucius" with others. Having no sons, his nephew Zheng Hui inherited his title.

input_text: 统字弘绪，历位射声校尉、大鸿胪。 子顺，为尚书郎。 越字弘伦，早卒。 乔字弘祖，历尚书郎、散骑侍郎。 帝既召乔不得，深疑苞反。 及苞至，有惭色，谓之曰 卿子几破卿门 。 苞遂废之，终身不听仕。 又以有秽行，徙顿丘，与弟崇同被害。 二子超、熙亡走得免。 成都王颖之起义也，以超为折冲将军，讨孙秀，以功封侯。 又为振武将军，征荆州贼李辰。 颖与长沙王乂相攻，超常为前锋，迁中护军。 陈等挟惠帝北伐，超走还鄴。 颖使超距帝于荡阴，王师败绩，超逼帝幸鄴宫。 会王浚攻颖于鄴，颖以超为右将军以距浚，大败而归。 从驾之洛阳，西迁长安。 河间王颙以超领北中郎将，使与颖共距东海王越。 超于荥阳募兵，右将军王阐与典兵中郎赵则并受超节度，为豫州刺史刘乔继援。 范阳王虓逆击斩超，而熙得走免。 永嘉中，为太傅越参军。 浚字景伦，清俭有鉴识，敬爱人物。 位至黄门侍郎，为当世名士，早卒。 俊字彦伦，少有名誉，议者称为令器。 官至阳平太守，早卒。 崇字季伦，生于青州，故小名齐奴。
target_text: He Zeng, courtesy name Yingkao, was from Yangxia, Chen State. His father He Kui was Taipu of Wei. He Zeng inherited his title young, was eager to learn, and gained reputation. He served as Sanqi Changshi, Diannong General, and Huangmen Shilang. He submitted memorials advising careful selection of county governors. He served as governor of Hanoi with majestic reputation. As Sili Xiaowei, he impeached the favored official Yin Mo. He criticized Ruan Ji's dissolute behavior during mourning. He held various positions including Zhenbei General and was granted Marquis of Yingchang Township. Emperor Wu appointed him Taibao and later Taifu. He was known for filial piety, treating his wife with formal respect. However, he was extremely extravagant, spending ten thousand on daily meals, with luxurious carriages and clothing exceeding imperial standards. He died at age eighty, receiving the posthumous name Xiao. His sons He Zun and He Shao inherited his wealth. He Shao served as prince's grand master and Situ, maintaining similar extravagance.

target_text: Shi Bao, courtesy name Zhongrong, was from Nanpi, Bohai. Known for beauty and intelligence, he was discovered by Guo Xuanxin who predicted his future as minister. He served as Sima of Emperor Jing's Imperial Guard. Despite concerns about his character, Emperor Jing defended him, comparing him to Guan Zhong and Chen Ping. He served as Ye Diannong Zhonglang Jiang, governor of Donglai and Langye, and Xuzhou governor. During Zhuge Dan's rebellion, Shi Bao led troops and defeated Wu forces. He was granted Marquis of Shuguang and later promoted to Grand Sima and Duke of Leling County. Suspected of rebellion due to rumors, he was dismissed but later reinstated as Situ. He focused on agricultural policies and died in the eighth year of Taishi. His sons included Shi Yue, Shi Qiao, Shi Tong, Shi Jun, Shi Jun, and Shi Chong. Shi Chong, known for wealth and extravagance, competed with royal relatives in luxury, owning numerous slaves and treasures. He was executed at age fifty-two during political conflicts, with his entire family killed.

input_text: 王沈，字处道，太原晋阳人也。 祖柔，汉匈奴中郎将。 父机，魏东郡太守。 沈少孤，养于从叔司空昶，事昶如父。奉继母寡嫂以孝义称。 好书，善属文。 大将军曹爽辟为掾，累迁中书门下侍郎。 及爽诛，以故吏免。 后起为治书侍御史，转秘书监。 正元中，迁散骑常侍、侍中，典著作。 与荀顗、阮籍共撰《魏书》，多为时讳，未若陈寿之实录也。 时魏高贵乡公好学有文才，引沈及裴秀数于东堂讲宴属文，号沈为文籍先生，秀为儒林丈人。 及高贵乡公将攻文帝，召沈及王业告之，沈、业驰白帝，以功封安平侯，邑二千户。 沈既不忠于主，甚为众论所非。 寻迁尚书，出监豫州诸军事、奋武将军、豫州刺史。 至镇，乃下教曰： 自古贤圣，乐闻诽谤之言，听舆人之论，刍荛有可录之事，负薪有廊庙之语故也。
target_text: Wang Chen, courtesy name Chudao, was born in Jinyang, Taiyuan. His grandfather Wang Rou served as a lieutenant general of the Huns in the Han Dynasty, and his father Wang Ji was the prefect of Wei Dong County. Orphaned young, Wang Chen was adopted by his cousin Sikong Wang Chang, whom he served as a biological father, gaining fame for his filial piety toward his stepmother and widowed sister-in-law. He was well-read and skilled in writing. General Cao Shuang recruited him as a subordinate officer, and he gradually rose to minister under Zhongshu's family. After Cao Shuang's execution, Wang Chen was dismissed as an old official but later reappointed as censor of the book administration department and transferred to secretary supervisor. During the Zhengyuan period, he was promoted to Sanqi Changshi and Shizhong, overseeing writings. Together with Xunjie and Ruan Ji, he compiled the "Book of Wei," though he often concealed taboos and did not record events as truthfully as Chen Shou.

input_text: 王沈，字处道，太原晋阳人也。 祖柔，汉匈奴中郎将。 父机，魏东郡太守。 沈少孤，养于从叔司空昶，事昶如父。奉继母寡嫂以孝义称。 好书，善属文。 大将军曹爽辟为掾，累迁中书门下侍郎。 及爽诛，以故吏免。 后起为治书侍御史，转秘书监。 正元中，迁散骑常侍、侍中，典著作。 与荀顗、阮籍共撰《魏书》，多为时讳，未若陈寿之实录也。 时魏高贵乡公好学有文才，引沈及裴秀数于东堂讲宴属文，号沈为文籍先生，秀为儒林丈人。 及高贵乡公将攻文帝，召沈及王业告之，沈、业驰白帝，以功封安平侯，邑二千户。 沈既不忠于主，甚为众论所非。 寻迁尚书，出监豫州诸军事、奋武将军、豫州刺史。 至镇，乃下教曰： 自古贤圣，乐闻诽谤之言，听舆人之论，刍荛有可录之事，负薪有廊庙之语故也。
target_text: Duke Gaogui of Wei, eager to learn and talented, frequently invited Wang Chen and Pei Xiu to lectures and banquets in Shutang. When the Duke planned to attack Emperor Wen, he summoned Wang Chen and Wang Ye to inform them, but Wang Chen and Wang Ye quickly reported to Emperor Wen. For this, they were granted the title of Marquis of Anping with two thousand households. Wang Chen's disloyalty to his master drew public criticism. He was soon promoted to minister and sent to supervise military affairs in Yuzhou as General Fenwu and governor. Upon arrival, he issued a decree encouraging criticism and recommendations, offering rewards of grain for those who exposed corruption or proposed beneficial policies. His chief registrars, Chen Chang and Chu Bi, advised caution, fearing that rewards might deter honest people or attract greedy ones. Wang Chen initially insisted on his sincerity but eventually relented, following Chu Bi's advice. He then focused on good governance, implementing legal prohibitions established since Jia Kui and promoting education to reform declining customs.

input_text: 沈无以夺之，遂从议。 沈探寻善政，案贾逵以来法制禁令，诸所施行，择善者而从之。 又教曰： 后生不闻先王之教，而望政道日兴，不可得也。 文武并用，长久之道也。 俗化陵迟，不可不革。 革俗之要，实在敦学。 昔原伯鲁不悦学，闵马父知其必亡。 将吏子弟，优闲家门，若不教之，必致游戏，伤毁风俗矣。 于是九郡之士，咸悦道教，移风易俗。 迁征虏将军、持节、都督江北诸军事。 五等初建，封博陵侯，班在次国。 平蜀之役，吴人大出，声为救蜀，振荡边境，沈镇御有方，寇闻而退。 转镇南将军。 武帝即王位，拜御史大夫，守尚书令，加给事中。 沈以才望，显名当世，是以创业之事，羊祜、荀勖、裴秀、贾充等，皆与沈谘谋焉。
target_text: Wang Chen was promoted to General Zhenglu and Commander-in-Chief of all military affairs north of the Yangtze River. When the fifth-class title system was established, he was granted the title of Marquis of Boling. During the pacification of Shu, Wu forces threatened the border, but Wang Chen defended well, causing the enemy to retreat. He was later transferred to General Zhennan. After Emperor Wu ascended the throne, Wang Chen became imperial censor and abided by the Shangshu order. Known for his talent and fame, he consulted with Yang Hu, Xun Xu, Pei Xiu, and Jia Chong on state affairs. For his role in the abdication, he was promoted to general of hussars and granted the title of Duke of Boling County, which he initially refused but later accepted with 1,800 households. He died in the second year of Taishi, and the emperor mourned him with lavish gifts. Posthumously, he was given the title of Sikong Gong. Wang Chen was always honest and frugal, leaving no property. His son Wang Jun succeeded him.

input_text: 及赵王伦篡位，三王起义兵，浚拥众挟两端，遏绝檄书，使其境内士庶不得赴义，成都王颖欲讨之而未暇也。 伦诛，进号安北将军。 及河间王颙、成都王颖兴兵内向，害长沙王乂，而浚有不平之心。 颖表请幽州刺史石堪为右司马，以右司马和演代堪，密使演杀浚，并其众。 演与乌丸单于审登谋之，于是与浚期游蓟城南清泉水上。 蓟城内西行有二道，演浚各从一道。 演与浚欲合卤簿，因而图之。 值天暴雨，兵器沾湿，不果而还。 单于由是与其种人谋曰： 演图杀浚，事垂克而天卒雨，使不得果，是天助浚也。 违天不祥，我不可久与演同。 乃以谋告浚。 浚密严兵，与单于围演。 演持白幡诣浚降，遂斩之，自领幽州。 大营器械，召务勿尘，率胡晋合二万人，进军讨颖。 以主溥祁弘为前锋，遇颖将石超于平棘，击败之。 浚乘胜遂克鄴城，士众暴掠，死者甚多。 鲜卑大略妇女，浚命敢有挟藏者斩，于是沉于易水者八千人。 黔庶荼毒，自此始也。
target_text: Wang Jun, courtesy name Peng Zu, was born to a poor mother from a common family. Initially despised by his father, he became heir at fifteen after Wang Chen's death. He served as Prince Consort and later held various military and civil posts. During the chaos of the court, he allied with Yi Di, marrying his daughters to Xianbei leaders for safety. After King Sima Lun of Zhao usurped the throne, Wang Jun led troops to wait and see. He later killed He Yan, who plotted against him, and occupied Youzhou. He built equipment and led 20,000 Hu and Jin troops against Sima Ying, defeating his general and capturing Yecheng, where his soldiers looted brutally. Wang Jun's power grew, and he was promoted to General Hussar and Commander-in-Chief of Hebei. During the Yongjia period, he fought Shi Le and Liu Kun, but his harsh rule led to defections. He planned to become emperor based on prophecies, killing those who advised against it. Shi Le pretended to surrender, and Wang Jun, trusting him, was captured and killed. Wang Jun had no sons, and his title passed to his nephew Daosu.

input_text: 幼为姊婿陈群所赏。 性至孝，总角知名，博学洽闻，理思周密。 魏时以父勋除中郎。 宣帝辅政，见顗奇之，曰： 荀令君之子也。 擢拜散骑侍郎，累迁侍中。 为魏少帝执经，拜骑都尉，赐爵关内侯。 难钟会《易》无互体，又与扶风王骏论仁孝孰先，见称于世。 时曹爽专权，何晏等欲害太常傅嘏，顗营救得免。 及高贵乡公立，顗言于景帝曰： 今上践阼，权道非常，宜速遣使宣德四方，且察外志。 毌丘俭、文钦果不服，举兵反。 顗预讨俭等有功，进爵万岁亭侯，邑四百户。 文帝辅政，迁尚书。 帝征诸葛诞，留顗镇守。 顗甥陈泰卒，顗代泰为仆射，领吏部，四辞而后就职。 顗承泰后，加之淑慎，综核名实，风俗澄正。 咸熙中，迁司空，进爵乡侯。 顗年逾耳顺，孝养蒸蒸，以母忧去职，毁几灭性，海内称之。 文帝奏，宜依汉太傅胡广丧母故事，给司空吉凶导从。 及蜀平，兴复五等，命顗定礼仪。 顗上请羊祜、任恺、庚峻、应贞、孔颢共删改旧文，撰定晋礼。 咸熙初，封临淮侯。 武帝践阼，进爵为公，食邑一千八百户。
target_text: Xunjie, courtesy name Jingqian, was from Yingchuan and the sixth son of Wei Taiwei Xun You. Known for filial piety and extensive knowledge, he served as Zhonglang and later Sanqi Shilang. He taught the young emperor of Wei and was granted the title of Marquis of Guannei. He rescued Fu Gu from Cao Shuang's harm and advised Emperor Jing to declare benevolence after Gao Guixiang Gong's ascension. He participated in suppressing rebellions and was promoted to Marquis of Wansuiting. Under Emperor Wen, he became Shangshu and later Sikong. He was filial, resigning for his mother's funeral, and was praised nationwide. He formulated Jin etiquette and was promoted to Duke of Linhuai. He served as Crown Prince Tutor and Taiwei, settling music before dying in the tenth year of Taishi. The emperor mourned him greatly. Xunjie understood the "Three Rites" but lacked upright moral integrity, catering to Xun Xu and Jia Chong. He had no sons, and his title passed to his grandnephew Xun Hui.

input_text: 转司隶校尉，加特进、光禄大夫，常侍如故。 于时天下已乱，组兄弟贵盛，惧不容于世，虽居大官，并讽议而已。 永嘉末，复以组为侍中，领太子太保。 未拜，会刘曜、王弥逼洛阳，组与籓俱出奔。 怀帝蒙尘，司空王浚以组为司隶校尉。 组与籓移檄天下，以琅邪王为盟主。 愍帝称皇太子，组即太子之舅，又领司隶校尉，行豫州刺史事，与籓并保荥阳之开封。 建兴初，诏籓行留台事。 俄而籓薨，帝更以组为司空，领尚书左仆射，又兼司隶，复行留台事，州征郡守皆承制行焉。 进封临颍县公，加太夫人、世子印绶。 明年，进位太尉，领豫州牧、假节。 元帝承制，以组都督司州诸军，加散骑常侍，余如故。 顷之，又除尚书令，表让不拜。 及西都不守，组乃遣使移檄天下共劝进。 帝欲以组为司徒，以问太常贺循。 循曰： 组旧望清重，忠勤显著，迁训五品，实允众望。 于是拜组为司徒。 组逼于石勒，不能自立。 太兴初，自许昌率其属数百人渡江，给千兵百骑，组先所领仍皆统摄。 顷之，诏组与太保、西阳王羕并录尚书事，各加班剑六十人。 永昌初，迁太尉，领太子太保。 未拜，薨，年六十五。 谥曰元。 子奕嗣。 奕字玄欣。 少拜太子舍人、驸马都尉，侍讲东宫。 出为镇东参军，行扬武将军、新汲令。 愍帝为皇太子，召为中舍人，寻拜散骑侍郎，皆不就。 随父渡江。 元帝践阼，拜中庶子，迁给事黄门郎。 父忧去职，服阕，补散骑常侍、侍中。
target_text: Xun Xu, courtesy name Gongzeng, was from Yingyin, Yingchuan, and the great-grandson of Han Sikong Xun Shuang. Orphaned young, he was raised by his uncle. He was intelligent and wrote articles in his teens. He served under Cao Shuang and later became Zhongshu Tongshilang. After Cao Shuang's death, he alone attended the funeral, earning respect. He served as Anyang Order and later Tingweizheng, participating in Emperor Wen's military affairs. He advised against assassins and warned of Zhong Hui's rebellion. He wrote documents to Sun Hao of Wu, which were praised as better than a hundred thousand troops. After Emperor Wu's abdication, he was granted the title of Duke of Jibei County but refused, becoming a marquis. He served as Zhongshu Supervisor and jointly formulated laws with Jia Chong. He helped secure Jia Chong's daughter as crown prince's concubine, drawing criticism. He revised music rhythms and compiled classics. He opposed the attack on Wu but was overruled. He advised against sending princes to feudal states and discussed reducing officials. He praised the prince's character, leading to respect for He Jiao and disdain for him. He died in the tenth year of Taikang, with ten sons, including Xun Ji, Xun Fan, and Xun Zu. Xun Xu's descendants continued his legacy, with Xun Sui and Xun He crossing the river eastward during the chaos.

input_text: 承颜悦色，宠爱日隆。贾充、荀勖并与之亲善。 充女之为皇太子妃也，紞有力焉。 及妃之将废，紞、勖干没救请，故得不废。 伐吴之役，紞领汝南太守，以郡兵随王浚入秣陵。 迁御史中丞，转侍中。 帝病笃得愈，紞与勖见朝野之望，属在齐王攸。攸素薄勖。 勖以太子愚劣，恐攸得立，有害于己，乃使紞言于帝曰： 陛下前者疾若不差，太子其废矣。 齐王为百姓所归，公卿所仰，虽欲高让，其得免乎！ 宜遣还籓，以安社稷。 帝纳之。 及攸薨，朝野悲恨。 初，帝友于之情甚笃，既纳紞、勖邪说，遂为身后之虑，以固储位。 既闻攸殒，哀恸特深。 紞侍立，因言曰： 齐王名过于实，今得自终，此乃大晋之福。 陛下何乃过哀！ 帝收泪而止。
target_text: Feng You, courtesy name Shaozhou, was from Anping. He read extensively and was eloquent. He served as prefect of Wei County and later General Zuowei, favored by Emperor Wu. He befriended Jia Chong and Xun Xu, helping Jia Chong's daughter become dowager. He opposed the attack on Wu but later followed Wang Jun into Moling. He advised the emperor to send Qi King Sima You to his feudal state, leading to Sima You's death. He hated Zhang Hua and prevented his promotion. He died in the seventh year of Taikang, leaving two sons, Feng Bo and Feng Xiong. The historian comments that Wang Chen's disloyalty and Wang Jun's violence brought disaster, while Xunjie and Xun Xu, despite their talents, contributed to court strife. Feng You's flattery led to Sima You's death and Jia's rise, causing endless civil unrest.

input_text: 后妃下元敬虞皇后豫章君明穆庾皇后成恭杜皇后 章太妃康献褚皇后穆章何皇后哀靖王皇后 废帝孝庾皇后简文宣郑太后简文顺王皇 后孝武文李太后孝武定王皇后安德陈太后安僖王皇后恭思褚皇后 元敬虞皇后，讳孟母，济阳外黄人也。 父豫，见《外戚传》。 帝为琅邪王，纳后为妃，无子。 永嘉六年薨，时年三十五。 帝为晋王，追尊为王后。 有司奏王后应别立庙。 令曰： 今宗庙未成，不宜更兴作，便修饰陵上屋以为庙。 太兴三年，册曰： 皇帝咨前琅邪王妃虞氏：朕祗顺昊天成命，用陟帝位，悼妃夙徂，徽音潜翳，御于家邦，靡所仪刑，阴教有亏，用伤于怀。 追号制谥，先王之典。 今遣使持节兼太尉万胜奉册赠皇后玺绶，祀以太牢。 魂而有灵，嘉兹宠荣。 乃祔于太庙，葬建平陵。 太宁初，明帝追怀母养之恩，赠豫妻王氏为云阝阳县君，从母散骑常侍新野王罕妻为平阳乡君。 豫章君荀氏，元帝宫人也。 初有宠，生明帝及琅邪王裒，由是为虞后所忌。 自以位卑，每怀怨望，为帝所谴，渐见疏薄。 及明帝即位，封建安君，别立第宅。 太宁元年，帝迎还台内，供奉隆厚。 及成帝立，尊重同于太后。 咸康元年薨。 诏曰： 朕少遭悯凶，慈训无禀，抚育之勤，建安君之仁也。
target_text: A detailed account of the empresses, consorts, and dowagers of the Jin Dynasty, chronicling their lives, titles, deaths, and roles in court politics. Empress Xia Yuan Jing Yu, who died young before her husband became emperor, and was later posthumously honored. Her rival, Concubine Zhang, bore Emperor Ming but was hated by Empress Yu and neglected by Emperor Yuan; she was later honored by her son. Empress Ming Mu Yu, known for her virtue, served as regent for her young son, Emperor Cheng, during a rebellion, and died in distress. Empress Cheng Gong Du, from a virtuous family, died young without children, and her funeral was kept simple by imperial decree.

target_text: The text then covers Empress Kang Xian Chu, who served as regent for Emperor Mu, and later for Emperor Ai and Duke Haixi, including her role in the deposition of the latter. Empress Mu Zhang He, from a notable family, was captured during Huan Xuan's usurpation and later returned to the capital. Empress Ai Jing, originally a concubine, died childless. The deposed Emperor's Empress Xiao Yu was demoted after her husband's deposition. Empress Dowager Jian Wen Xuan Zheng, a widow who remarried Emperor Yuan, was posthumously honored by her son, Emperor Jian Wen, and later by Emperor Xiao Wu, despite debates over her proper sacrificial status.

input_text: 后妃下元敬虞皇后豫章君明穆庾皇后成恭杜皇后 章太妃康献褚皇后穆章何皇后哀靖王皇后 废帝孝庾皇后简文宣郑太后简文顺王皇 后孝武文李太后孝武定王皇后安德陈太后安僖王皇后恭思褚皇后 元敬虞皇后，讳孟母，济阳外黄人也。 父豫，见《外戚传》。 帝为琅邪王，纳后为妃，无子。 永嘉六年薨，时年三十五。 帝为晋王，追尊为王后。 有司奏王后应别立庙。 令曰： 今宗庙未成，不宜更兴作，便修饰陵上屋以为庙。 太兴三年，册曰： 皇帝咨前琅邪王妃虞氏：朕祗顺昊天成命，用陟帝位，悼妃夙徂，徽音潜翳，御于家邦，靡所仪刑，阴教有亏，用伤于怀。 追号制谥，先王之典。 今遣使持节兼太尉万胜奉册赠皇后玺绶，祀以太牢。 魂而有灵，嘉兹宠荣。 乃祔于太庙，葬建平陵。 太宁初，明帝追怀母养之恩，赠豫妻王氏为云阝阳县君，从母散骑常侍新野王罕妻为平阳乡君。 豫章君荀氏，元帝宫人也。 初有宠，生明帝及琅邪王裒，由是为虞后所忌。 自以位卑，每怀怨望，为帝所谴，渐见疏薄。 及明帝即位，封建安君，别立第宅。 太宁元年，帝迎还台内，供奉隆厚。 及成帝立，尊重同于太后。 咸康元年薨。 诏曰： 朕少遭悯凶，慈训无禀，抚育之勤，建安君之仁也。
target_text: Empress Jian Wen Shun Wang, who lost favor and was deposed with her son, was posthumously restored. Empress Dowager Xiao Wu Wen Li, of humble origin, was chosen by a physiognomist and bore Emperor Xiao Wu and others, eventually being honored as empress dowager. Empress Xiao Wu Ding Wang, chosen for her beauty and virtue, was jealous and died young. Empress Dowager An De Chen, a concubine who bore two emperors, was posthumously honored. Empress An Xi Wang, married as crown princess, died childless. Empress Gong Si Chu, demoted after her husband's abdication, died later.

input_text: 各免华阳之衅，竟蹑和熹之踪，保陵迟以克终，所幸实为多矣。 赞曰：二妃光舜，三母翼周。 末升夷癸，褒进亡幽。 家邦兴灭，职此之由。 穆后沈断，忘情执爨。 故剑辞恩，池蒲起叹。 崇化繁祉，肇基商乱。 二杨继宠，福极灾生。 南风炽虐，国丧身倾。 献容幸乱，居辱疑荣。 援笔废主，持尺威帝。 契阔终罹，殷忧以毙。 芬实窈窕，芳菲婉嫕。 吕妾变嬴，黄姬化羋。 石文远著，金行潜徙。 妇德倾城，迷硃夺紫。
target_text: The text concludes with a historian's commentary, praising virtuous empresses who aided the dynasty's rise, while condemning those like Empress Jia Nanfeng for causing decline. It notes the unusual practice of empress dowagers acting as regents, which was not an ancient custom, and reflects on the rise and fall of dynasties being tied to the influence of women.

input_text: 陈骞子舆裴秀子頠秀从弟楷楷子宪 陈骞，临淮东阳人也。 父矫，魏司徒。 矫本广陵刘氏，为外祖陈氏所养，因而改焉。 骞沈厚有智谋。 初，矫为尚书令，侍中刘晔见幸于魏明帝，谮矫专权。 矫忧惧，以问骞。 骞曰： 主上明圣，大人大臣，今若不合意，不过不作公耳。 后帝意果释，骞尚少，为夏侯玄所侮，意色自若，玄以此异之。 起家尚书郎，迁中山、安平太守，并著称绩。 征为相国司马、长史、御吏中丞，迁尚书，封安国亭侯。 蜀贼寇陇右，以尚书持节行征蜀将军，破贼而还。 会诸葛诞之乱，复以尚书行安东将军。 寿春平，拜使持节、都督淮北诸军事、安东将军，进爵广陵侯。 转都督豫州诸军事、豫州刺史，持节、将军如故。 又转都督江南诸军事，徙都督荆州诸军事、征南大将军，封郯侯。 武帝受禅，以佐命之勋，进车骑将军，封高平郡公，迁侍中、大将军，出为都督扬州诸军事，余如故，假黄钺。 攻拔吴枳里城，破涂中屯戍。赐骞兄子惺爵关中侯。 咸宁初，迁太尉，转大司马。 骞因入朝，言于帝曰： 胡烈、牵弘皆勇而无谋，强于自用，非绥边之材，将为国耻。
target_text: Chen Qian, a native of Shuyang, Linhuai, was the son of Chen Jiao, a Situ of Wei. Chen Jiao, originally from the Liu family, was raised by his maternal grandfather and changed his surname. Chen Qian was known for his depth and resourcefulness. Early in his career, he advised his father during a false accusation by Liu Ye, which was later resolved. As a youth, he remained calm when insulted by Xia Houxuan, impressing him. He served as Shangshu Lang, Grand Administrator of Zhongshan and Anping, achieving remarkable success. He rose to Sima, Changshi, and Yushi Zhongcheng, then Shangshu, and was granted the title of Tinghou of Anguo. During the Shu invasion of Longyou, he led forces to victory. He also acted against the Zhuge Dan rebellion. After pacifying Shouchun, he was appointed envoy Chijie, commander of Huaibei military affairs, and General Andong, with his title promoted to Marquis of Guangling. He later governed Yuzhou and was transferred to command military affairs south of the Yangtze and in Jingzhou, becoming General of the Conquest of the South and Marquis of Tan.

input_text: 陈骞子舆裴秀子頠秀从弟楷楷子宪 陈骞，临淮东阳人也。 父矫，魏司徒。 矫本广陵刘氏，为外祖陈氏所养，因而改焉。 骞沈厚有智谋。 初，矫为尚书令，侍中刘晔见幸于魏明帝，谮矫专权。 矫忧惧，以问骞。 骞曰： 主上明圣，大人大臣，今若不合意，不过不作公耳。 后帝意果释，骞尚少，为夏侯玄所侮，意色自若，玄以此异之。 起家尚书郎，迁中山、安平太守，并著称绩。 征为相国司马、长史、御吏中丞，迁尚书，封安国亭侯。 蜀贼寇陇右，以尚书持节行征蜀将军，破贼而还。 会诸葛诞之乱，复以尚书行安东将军。 寿春平，拜使持节、都督淮北诸军事、安东将军，进爵广陵侯。 转都督豫州诸军事、豫州刺史，持节、将军如故。 又转都督江南诸军事，徙都督荆州诸军事、征南大将军，封郯侯。 武帝受禅，以佐命之勋，进车骑将军，封高平郡公，迁侍中、大将军，出为都督扬州诸军事，余如故，假黄钺。 攻拔吴枳里城，破涂中屯戍。赐骞兄子惺爵关中侯。 咸宁初，迁太尉，转大司马。 骞因入朝，言于帝曰： 胡烈、牵弘皆勇而无谋，强于自用，非绥边之材，将为国耻。
target_text: When Emperor Wu accepted the abdication, Chen Qian was promoted to General of Chariots and Cavalry for his merits, granted the title of Duke of Gaoping County, and served as Shizhong, Grand General, and commander of Yangzhou military affairs. He captured Zhili in Wu and defeated Tu Zhong's forces. In the early Xianning years, he was promoted to Taiwei and then Grand Sima. He warned the emperor about Hu Lie and Qian Hong's overconfidence, but the emperor dismissed his concerns. Both later died in conflict with the Qiang Rong, leading the emperor to regret his decision. Chen Qian was magnanimous and achieved success in all positions. He surpassed colleagues like Maichong, Shi Bao, and Pei Xiu in resourcefulness. He held high office beyond retirement age and eventually retired, receiving honors and gifts from the emperor. He died at eighty-one, with the emperor attending his funeral.

input_text: 秀年十余岁，有诣徽者，出则过秀。 然秀母贱，嫡母宣氏不之礼，尝使进馔于客，见者皆为之起。 秀母曰： 微贱如此，当应为小兒故也。 宣氏知之，后遂止。 时人为之语曰： 后进领袖有裴秀。 渡辽将军毌丘俭尝荐秀于大将军曹爽，曰： 生而岐嶷，长蹈自然，玄静守真，性入道奥；博学强记，无文不该；孝友著于乡党，高声闻于远近。 诚宜弼佐谟明，助和鼎味，毗赞大府，光昭盛化。 非徒子奇、甘罗之俦，兼包颜、冉、游、夏之美。 爽乃辟为掾，袭父爵清阳亭侯，迁黄门侍郎。 爽诛，以故吏免。 顷之，为廷尉正，历文帝安东及卫将军司马，军国之政，多见信纳。 迁散骑常侍。 帝之讨诸葛诞也，秀与尚书仆射陈泰、黄门侍郎锺会以行台从，豫参谋略。
target_text: Pei Xiu, courtesy name Ji Yan, was from Wenxi, Hedong. His grandfather Pei Mao and father Pei Qian were ministers. Pei Xiu was eager to learn and wrote articles at eight. His uncle Pei Hui had many guests, and Pei Xiu's mother was once humiliated by her aunt, but Pei Xiu's reputation grew. He was recommended to Cao Shuang, who recruited him. After Cao Shuang's death, he was dismissed but later served as Tingweizheng and Wei Sima, with his policies adopted. He participated in the campaign against Zhuge Dan and was promoted to Minister and Marquis of Luyang Township. He helped establish the throne and was promoted to County Marquis. In the Xianxi era, he reformed the official system, proposing the fifth-class title. He was granted the title of Marquis of Jichuan. He advised Emperor Wen on the heir, supporting Emperor Wu. After Emperor Wu's ascension, he became Shangshu Ling and Duke of Julu County. He faced accusations but was defended by the emperor. He was later made Sikong.

input_text: 咸宁初，与石苞等并为王公，配享庙庭。 有二子：浚、頠。 浚嗣位，至散骑常侍，早卒。 浚庶子憬不惠，别封高阳亭侯，以浚少弟頠嗣。 頠字逸民。 弘雅有远识，博学稽古，自少知名。 御史中丞周弼见而叹曰： 頠若武库，五兵纵横，一时之杰也。 贾充即頠从母夫也，表 秀有佐命之勋，不幸嫡长丧亡，遗孤稚弱。 頠才德英茂，足以兴隆国嗣。 诏頠袭爵，頠固让，不许。 太康二年，徵为太子中庶子，迁散骑常侍。 惠帝既位，转国子祭酒，兼右军将军。 初，頠兄子憬为白衣，頠论述世勋，赐爵高阳亭侯。 杨骏将诛也，骏党左军将军刘豫陈兵在门，遇頠，问太傅所在。 頠绐之曰： 向于西掖门遇公乘素车，从二人西出矣。
target_text: Pei Xiu was knowledgeable and compiled the "Yugong Regional Circle," a map with six principles: ratio, accurate observation, road, high-low, fangxie, and roundabout. He established court礼仪 and criminal laws. He died at forty-eight, and the emperor mourned deeply. His son Pei Jun died early, and his younger son Pei Dian succeeded him. Pei Dian, courtesy name Yimin, was elegant and knowledgeable. He served as crown prince's concubine and Sanqi Changshi. He advised against Yang Jun's rebellion and was promoted. He discussed the prince's education and medical standards. He wrote the "Chongyou Lun" against nihilism, arguing for the importance of existence and ritual. He was killed by Sima Lun at thirty-four. His sons Pei Song and Pei Gai were exiled but later restored.

input_text: 少袭父爵，官至散骑侍郎，卒谥曰简。 瓚字国宝，中书郎，风神高迈，见者皆敬之。 特为王绥所重，每从其游。 绥父戎谓之曰： 国宝初不来，汝数往，何也？ 对曰： 国宝虽不知绥，绥自知国宝。 杨骏之诛，为乱兵所害。 宪字景思。 少而颖悟，好交轻侠。 及弱冠，更折节严重，修尚儒学，足不逾阈者数年。 陈郡谢鲲、颍川庾敳皆俊郎士也，见而奇之，相谓曰： 裴宪鲠亮宏达，通机识命，不知其何如父；至于深弘保素，不以世物婴心者，其殆过之。 初，侍讲东宫，历黄门吏部郎、侍中。 东海王越以为豫州刺史、北中郎将、假节。 王浚承制，以宪为尚书。 永嘉末，王浚为石勒所破，枣嵩等莫不谢罪军门，贡赂交错，惟宪及荀绰恬然私室。 勒素闻其名，召而谓之曰： 王浚虐暴幽州，人鬼同疾。
target_text: Pei Kai, courtesy name Shuze, was Pei Hui's son. He was intelligent and famous young, proficient in "Laozi" and "Yijing." He served as Shangshu Lang and Ding Kelang. He was known as the "Jade Man" for his elegance. He advised Emperor Wu during a divination, calming him. He served as Sanqi Minister and other posts. He was generous, giving away possessions. He criticized Jia Chong's presence in court. He survived the Yang Jun rebellion by hiding. He later served as Zhongshu Ling. He died at fifty-five. His sons included Pei Yu, Pei Zan, Pei Xian, Pei Li, and Pei Xun. Pei Xian, courtesy name Jingsi, was upright and served as Yuzhou governor. He was captured by Shi Le but praised for his integrity. He later served under Shi Le and Jilong, but his sons were killed, and he was dismissed. He died in the Shi family's hands.

input_text: 其性虚和如此。 东海王越引为主簿，后为越子毗所害。 初，裴、王二族盛于魏晋之世，时人以为八裴方八王：徽比王祥，楷比王衍，康比王绥，绰比王澄，瓚比王敦，遐比王导，頠比王戎，邈比王玄云。 史臣曰：周称多士，汉曰得人，取类星象，颉颃符契。 时乏名流，多以干翮相许，自家光国，岂陈骞之谓欤！ 秀则声盖朋僚，称为领袖。 楷则机神幼发，目以清通。 俱为晋氏名臣，良有以也。 赞曰：世既顺才，才膺世至。 高平沈敏，蕴兹名器。 钜鹿自然，亦云经笥。 娲皇炼石，晋图开秘。 頠有清规，承家来媚。
target_text: The Pei family was prominent in Wei and Jin, with eight members compared to the eight Wangs. The text praises Chen Qian and Pei Xiu as famous officials of the Jin Dynasty.

input_text: 宣帝九男，穆张皇后生景帝、文帝、平原王干，伏夫人生汝南文成王亮、琅邪武王伷、清惠亭侯京、扶风武王骏，张夫人生梁王肜，柏夫人生赵王伦。 亮及伦别有传。 平原王榦，字子良。 少以公子魏时封安阳亭侯，稍迁抚军中郎将，进爵平阳乡侯。 五等建，改封定陶伯。 武帝践阼，封平原王，邑万一千三百户，给鼓吹、驸马二匹，加侍中之服。 咸宁初，遣诸王之国，干有笃疾，性理不恆，而颇清虚静退，简于情欲，故特诏留之。 太康末，拜光禄大夫，加侍中，特假金章紫绶，班次三司。 惠帝即位，进左光禄大夫，侍中如故，剑履上殿，入朝不趋。 榦虽王大国，不事其务，有所调补，必以才能。 虽有爵禄，若不在己，秩奉布帛，皆露积腐烂。
target_text: Emperor Xuan had nine sons from various consorts. Queen Mu Zhang bore Emperor Jing, Emperor Wen, and Sima Qian (King of Pingyuan). Mrs. Fu gave birth to Sima Liang (King of Wencheng in Runan), Sima Nian (King of Langye Wu), Sima Jing (Marquis of Huiting in Qing Dynasty), and Sima Jun (King of Fufeng Wu). Mrs. Zhang bore Sima Xu (King of Liang), while Mrs. Bai bore Sima Lun (King of Zhao).

input_text: 宣帝九男，穆张皇后生景帝、文帝、平原王干，伏夫人生汝南文成王亮、琅邪武王伷、清惠亭侯京、扶风武王骏，张夫人生梁王肜，柏夫人生赵王伦。 亮及伦别有传。 平原王榦，字子良。 少以公子魏时封安阳亭侯，稍迁抚军中郎将，进爵平阳乡侯。 五等建，改封定陶伯。 武帝践阼，封平原王，邑万一千三百户，给鼓吹、驸马二匹，加侍中之服。 咸宁初，遣诸王之国，干有笃疾，性理不恆，而颇清虚静退，简于情欲，故特诏留之。 太康末，拜光禄大夫，加侍中，特假金章紫绶，班次三司。 惠帝即位，进左光禄大夫，侍中如故，剑履上殿，入朝不趋。 榦虽王大国，不事其务，有所调补，必以才能。 虽有爵禄，若不在己，秩奉布帛，皆露积腐烂。
target_text: Sima Qian, King of Pingyuan, was granted the title of Anyang Tinghou in the Wei Dynasty and later became King of Pingyuan under Emperor Wu with 11,300 households. He suffered from severe illness and was allowed to remain in the capital rather than go to his feudal state. He held various official positions including Guanglu大夫 and served as a servant. Although a great feudal lord, he did not care for government affairs. His salary and goods were left to rot in the open air. He was known for eccentric behavior, such as keeping his concubines' coffins unsealed in empty rooms and opening them to look at them periodically. During the rebellion of King Zhao Sima Lun, Sima Qian was appointed as General Wei and later Taibao. When Sima Tong of Qi pacified Sima Lun, Sima Qian congratulated him with a hundred coins. He died in the fifth year of Yongjia at age eighty.

input_text: 转征虏将军、假节，武帝践阼，封东莞郡王，邑万六百户。 始置二卿，特诏诸王自选令长。 伷表让，不许。 入为尚书右仆射、抚军将军，出为镇东大将军、假节、徐州诸军事，代卫瓘镇下邳。 伷镇御有方，得将士死力，吴人惮之。 加开府仪同三司，改封琅邪王，以东莞益其国。 平吴之役，率众数万出涂中，孙皓奉笺送玺绶，诣伷请降，诏曰： 琅邪王伷督率所统，连据涂中，使贼不得相救。 又使琅邪相刘弘等进军逼江，贼震惧，遣使奉伪玺绶。 又使长史王恆率诸军渡江，破贼边守，获督蔡机，斩道降附五六万计，诸葛靓、孙奕皆归命请死，功勋茂著。其封子二人为亭侯，各三千户，赐绢六千匹。 顷之，并督青州诸军事，加侍中之服。 进拜大将军、开府仪同三司。 伷既戚属尊重，加有平吴之功，克己恭俭，无矜满之色，僚吏尽力，百姓怀化。 疾笃，赐床帐、衣服、钱帛、秔梁等物，遣侍中问焉。
target_text: Sima Dian, King of Langye Wu, was talented and famous from an early age. He served as General Ningshuo guarding Yecheng and later as General Zhenshu guarding Xiapi, where he defended well against the Wu people. During the pacification of Wu, Sun Hao surrendered to Sima Dian, who sent troops across the Yangtze River, capturing enemy officials and securing the surrender of 50,000 to 60,000 people. His two sons were made marquises. He died in the fourth year of Taikang at age fifty-seven. His descendants included Sima Rui, who later became Emperor Yuan, and several others who successively held the title of King of Langye.

input_text: 转前将军、中护军。 性忌害，无孝友之行。 弟东安王繇有令名，为父母所爱，澹恶之如仇，遂谮繇于汝南王亮，亮素与繇有隙，奏废徙之。 赵王伦作乱，以澹为领军将军。 澹素与河内郭俶、俶弟侃亲善。 酒酣，俶等言张华之冤，澹性酗酒，因并杀之，送首于伦，其酗虐如此。 澹妻郭氏，贾后内妹也。 初恃势，无礼于澹母。 齐王冏辅政，澹母诸葛太妃表澹不孝，乞还繇，由是澹与妻子徙辽东。 其子禧年五岁，不肯随去，曰： 耍当为父求还，无为俱徙。 陈诉历年，太妃薨，繇被害，然后得还。 拜光禄大夫、尚书、太子太傅，改封武陵王。 永嘉末为石勒所害，子哀王喆立。
target_text: Sima Dan, King of Wulingzhuang, was jealous and harmful by nature with no filial character. He hated his brother Sima Yao and spoke ill of him to Sima Liang. During Sima Lun's rebellion, Sima Dan served as leading general. He killed two men while drunk and gave their heads to Sima Lun. His mother complained of his unfilial behavior, and he was moved to Liaosai with his family. He was later killed by Shi Le in the late Yongjia period.

input_text: 喆字景林，拜散骑常侍，亦为勒所害。 无子，其后元帝立皇子晞为武陵王，以奉澹祀焉。 东安王繇字思玄。 初拜东安公，历散骑黄门侍郎，迁散骑常侍。 美须髯，性刚毅，有威望，博学多才，事亲孝，居丧尽礼。 诛杨骏之际，繇屯云龙门，兼统诸军，以功拜右卫将军，领射声校尉，进封郡王，邑二万户，加侍中，兼典军大将军，领右卫如故。 迁尚书右仆射，加散骑常侍。 是日诛赏三百余人，皆自繇出。 东夷校尉文俶父钦为繇外祖诸葛诞所杀，繇虑俶为舅家之患，是日亦以非罪诛俶。 繇兄澹屡构繇于汝南王亮，亮不纳。 至是以繇专行诛赏，澹因隙谮之，亮惑其说，遂免繇官，以公就第，坐有悖言，废徙带方。 永康初，征繇，复封，拜宗正卿，迁尚书，转左仆射。 惠帝之讨成都王颖，时繇遭母丧在鄴，劝颖解兵而降。 及王师败绩，颖怨繇，乃害之。 后立琅邪王觐子长乐亭侯浑为东安王，以奉繇祀。
target_text: Sima Yao, King of Dong'an, was resolute, authoritative, and learned, with filial piety in serving relatives. He was granted 20,000 households and held various positions. He was arbitrary in punishments and rewards, leading to his dismissal and exile to Daifang. He was later restored but killed by Sima Ying after the emperor's army was defeated.

input_text: 及长，清贞守道，宗室之中最为俊望，魏景初中，封平阳亭侯。 齐王芳立，骏年八岁，为散骑常侍侍讲焉。 寻迁步兵、屯骑校尉，常侍如故。 进爵乡侯，出为平南将军、假节、都督淮北诸军事，改封平寿侯，转安东将军。 咸熙初，徙封东牟侯，转安东大将军，镇许昌。 武帝践阼，进封汝阴王，邑万户，都督豫州诸军事。 吴将丁奉寇芍陂，骏督诸军距退之。 迁使持节、都督扬州诸军事，代石苞镇寿春。 寻复都督豫州，还镇许昌。 迁镇西大将军、使持节、都督雍凉等州诸军事，代汝南王亮镇关中，加衮冕侍中之服。 骏善扶御，有威恩，劝督农桑，与士卒分役，已及僚佐并将帅兵士等人限田十亩，具以表闻。
target_text: Sima Jun, King of Fufeng Wu, was clever from childhood, able to write memorials and recite scriptures at age five or six. He was quiet, upright, and had the best reputation in the clan. He served as General of Zhenxi, guarding Guanzhong, and was skilled at appeasing rulers. He promoted agriculture and shared labor with soldiers. He suppressed Qiang rebellions and received surrenders from various tribes. He was filial to his mother and eager to learn, writing treatises on benevolence and filial piety. When he died, people wept for him and erected monuments.

input_text: 昌至樊城，歆出距之，众溃，为昌所害。 追赠骠骑将军。 无子，以兄子劭为后，永嘉末没于石勒。 梁孝王肜，字子徽，清修恭慎，无他才能，以公子封平乐亭侯。 及五等建，改封开平子。 武帝践阼，封梁王，邑五千三百五十八户。 及之国，迁北中郎将，督鄴城守事。 时诸王自选官属，肜以汝阴上计吏张蕃为中大夫。 蕃素无行，本名雄，妻刘氏解音乐，为曹爽教伎，蕃又往来何晏所，而恣为奸淫。 晏诛，徙河间，乃变名自结于肜。 为有司所奏，诏削一县。 咸宁中，复以陈国、汝南南顿增封为次国。 太康中，代孔洵监豫州军事，加平东将军，镇许昌。 顷之，又以本官代下邳王晃监青徐州军事，进号安东将军。 元康初，转征西将军，代秦王柬都督关中军事，领护西戎校尉。 加侍中，进督梁州。 寻征为卫将军、录尚书事，行太子太保，给千兵百骑。 久之，复为征西大将军，代赵王伦镇关中，都督凉、雍诸军事，置左右长史、司马。 又领西戎校尉，屯好畤，督建威将军周处、振威将军卢播等伐氐贼齐万年于六陌。 肜与处有隙，促令进军而绝其后，播又不救之，故处见害。 朝廷尤之。 寻征拜大将军、尚书令、领军将军、录尚书事。
target_text: Sima Xu, King of Liang, practiced quietness and was respectful and prudent. He served as General of Zhengxi guarding Guanzhong and later as Grand Administrator and Situ. During Sima Lun's usurpation, he served as prime minister. After his death, there was debate over his posthumous name, with some criticizing him for failing to take a stand during crises. He had no sons, and his title passed through various relatives.

input_text: 及长，清和平允，亲贤好施，爱经籍，能属文，善尺牍，为世所楷。 才望出武帝之右，宣帝每器之。 景帝无子，命攸为嗣。 从征王凌，封长乐亭侯。 及景帝崩，攸年十岁，哀动左右，大见称叹。 袭封舞阳侯。 奉景献羊后于别第，事后以孝闻。 复历散骑常侍、步兵校尉，时年十八，绥抚营部，甚有威惠。 五等建，改封安昌侯，迁卫将军。 居文帝丧，哀毁过礼，杖而后起。 左右以稻米干饭杂理中丸进之，攸泣而不受。 太后自往勉喻曰： 若万一加以他疾，将复如何！ 宜远虑深计，不可专守一志。 常遣人逼进饮食，司马嵇喜又谏曰： 毁不灭性，圣人之教。 且大王地即密亲，任惟元辅。
target_text: Sima You, King of Qi Xian, was wise from youth, calm, kind, and fond of classical books. He was made heir to Emperor Jing and inherited the title of Wuyang Hou. Under Emperor Wu, he was made King of Qi and managed military affairs. He was known for his filial piety and moral conduct. He advised on agricultural policies and government administration. He was especially favored by Emperor Wen, who nearly made him crown prince. However, due to the machinations of Xun Xu and Feng Shou, Emperor Wu sent him to his feudal state. Sima You became ill from resentment and died at age thirty-six while traveling. His son Sima Tong succeeded him.

input_text: 卫瓘子恆孙璪玠张华子祎韪刘卞卫瓘，字伯玉，河东安邑人也。 高祖暠，汉明帝时，以儒学自代郡征，至河东安邑卒，因赐所亡地而葬之，子孙遂家焉。 父觊，魏尚书。 瓘年十岁丧父，至孝过人。 性贞静有名理，以明识清允称。 袭父爵阌乡侯。 弱冠为魏尚书郎。 时魏法严苛，母陈氏忧之，瓘自请得徙为通事郎，转中书郎。 时权臣专政，瓘优游其间，无所亲疏，甚为傅嘏所重，谓之甯武子。 在位十年，以任职称，累迁散骑常侍。 陈留王即位，拜侍中，持节慰劳河北。 以定议功，增邑户。 数岁转廷尉卿。 瓘明法理，每至听讼，小大以情。
target_text: Wei Guan, courtesy name Boyu, was from Anyi, Hedong. His ancestor Wei Hao was recruited for his Confucian learning during the Han Dynasty, and his father Wei Jian served as a minister. Orphaned at ten, Wei Guan was known for his filial piety, quiet temperament, and fairness. He inherited his father's marquis title and began his official career at twenty. He served in various positions, including as a regular attendant, and was known for his competence and legal expertise, judging cases based on reason.

input_text: 于是士卒思归，内外骚动，人情忧惧。 会留瓘谋议，乃书版云 欲杀胡烈等 ，举以示瓘，瓘不许，因相疑贰。 瓘如厕，见胡烈故给使，使宣语三军，言会反。 会逼瓘定议，经宿不眠，各横刀膝上。 在外诸军已潜欲攻会。瓘既不出，未敢先发。 会使瓘慰劳诸军。 瓘心欲去，且坚其意，曰： 卿三军主，宜自行。 会曰： 卿监司，且先行，吾当后出。 瓘便下殿。 会悔遣之，使呼瓘。 瓘辞眩疾动，诈仆地。 比出阁，数十信追之。 瓘至外解，服盐汤，大吐。 瓘素羸，便似困笃。 会遣所亲人及医视之，皆言不起，会由是无所惮。 及暮，门闭，瓘作檄宣告诸军。 诸军并已唱义，陵旦共攻会。 会率左右距战，诸将击败之，唯帐下数百人随会绕殿而走，尽杀之。 瓘于是部分诸将，群情肃然。 邓艾本营将士复追破槛车出艾，还向成都。 瓘自以与会共陷艾，惧为变，又欲专诛会之功，乃遣护军田续至绵竹，夜袭艾于三造亭，斩艾及其子忠。 初，艾之入江由也，以续不进，将斩之，既而赦焉。 及瓘遣续，谓之曰： 可以报江由之辱矣。
target_text: During the conquest of Shu, Wei Guan supervised the armies of Deng Ai and Zhong Hui. Zhong Hui, harboring rebellious intentions, plotted to have Deng Ai kill Wei Guan. Wei Guan, aware of the danger, arrested Deng Ai at night by issuing a false imperial edict. After Zhong Hui rebelled and was killed, Wei Guan, fearing repercussions from his involvement with Zhong Hui, ordered the assassination of Deng Ai and his son. Despite his role, Wei Guan refused credit for the conquest, attributing it to the generals. He was later appointed to high military positions, including General of Zhenxi and Governor of Qingzhou, where he achieved political successes and pacified border tribes like the Wuhuan.

input_text: 咸宁初，征拜尚书令，加侍中。 性严整，以法御下，视尚书若参佐，尚书郎若掾属。 瓘学问深博，明习文艺，与尚书郎敦煌索靖俱善草书，时人号为 一台二妙 。 汉末张芝亦善草书，论者谓瓘得伯英筋，靖得伯英肉。 太康初，迁司空，侍中、令如故。 为政清简，甚得朝野声誉。 武帝敕瓘第四子宣尚繁昌公主。 瓘自以诸生之胄，婚对微素，抗表固辞，不许。 又领太子少傅，加千兵百骑鼓吹之府。 以日蚀，瓘与太尉汝南王亮、司徒魏舒俱逊位，帝不听。 瓘以魏立九品，是权时之制，非经通之道，宜复古乡举里选。 与太尉亮等上疏曰： 昔圣王崇贤，举善而教，用使朝廷德让，野无邪行。
target_text: Wei Guan was a strict administrator and a scholar, skilled in cursive calligraphy alongside Suo Jing. He advocated for the abolition of the nine-rank system in favor of ancient rural selection, but his proposal was not implemented. He also attempted to advise Emperor Wu against appointing the simple-minded Crown Prince, but his hints were dismissed. This led to resentment from Empress Jia. Later, due to his son's marital issues and political conflicts, Wei Guan requested retirement and was granted the title of Taibao.

input_text: 给亲兵百人，置长史、司马、从事中郎掾属；及大车、官骑、麾盖、鼓吹诸威仪，一如旧典。 给厨田十顷、园五十亩、钱百万、绢五百匹；床帐簟褥，主者务令优备，以称吾崇贤之意焉。 有司又奏收宣付廷尉，免瓘位，诏不许。 帝后知黄门虚构，欲还复主，而宣疾亡。 惠帝即位，复瓘千兵。 及杨骏诛，以瓘录尚书事，加绿綟绶，剑履上殿，入朝不趋，给骑司马，与汝南王亮共辅朝政。 亮奏遣诸王还籓，与朝臣廷议，无敢应者，唯瓘赞其事，楚王玮由是憾焉。 贾后素怨瓘，且忌其方直，不得骋己淫虐；又闻瓘与玮有隙，遂谤瓘与亮欲为伊霍之事，启帝作手诏，使玮免瓘等官。 黄门赍诏授玮，玮性轻险，欲聘私怨，夜使清河王遐收瓘。 左右疑遐矫诏，咸谏曰： 礼律刑名，台辅大臣，未有此比，且请距之。 须自表得报，就戮未晚也。
target_text: After Emperor Hui ascended, Wei Guan was restored to power but clashed with Prince Sima Zhang of Chu. Empress Jia, resenting Wei Guan's integrity, falsely accused him of plotting rebellion. Sima Zhang arrested Wei Guan and his family, executing them despite his subordinates' advice to resist. Wei Guan was 72. His grandsons Wei Cao and Wei Jie escaped. Du Yu had predicted Wei Guan's downfall due to his role in Deng Ai's death.

input_text: 瓘不从，遂与子恆、岳、裔及孙等九人同被害，时年七十二。 恆二子璪、玠，时在医家得免。 初，杜预闻瓘杀邓艾，言于众曰： 伯玉其不免乎！ 身为名士，位居总帅，既无德音，又不御下以正，是小人而乘君子之器，当何以堪其责乎？ 瓘闻之，不俟驾而谢。 终如预言。 初，瓘家人炊饭，堕地尽化为螺，岁余而及祸。 太保主簿刘繇等冒难收瓘而葬之。 初，瓘为司空，时帐下督荣晦有罪，瓘斥遣之。 及难作，随兵讨瓘，故子孙皆及于祸。 楚王玮之伏诛也，瓘女与国臣书曰： 先公名谥未显，无异凡人，每怪一国蔑然无言。 《春秋》之失，其咎安在？ 悲愤感慨，故以示意。 于是繇等执黄幡，挝登闻鼓，上言曰： 初，矫诏者至，公承诏当免，即便奉送章绶，虽有兵仗，不施一刃，重敕出第，单车从命。
target_text: Wei Guan's son Wei Heng, a calligrapher, wrote extensively on the history of Chinese scripts, from ancient characters to seal, clerical, and cursive styles. He was also killed in the purge. Wei Guan's other son Wei Zhan served as an official and petitioned to abolish cruel interrogation methods. Wei Jie, Wei Guan's grandson, was a renowned beauty and philosopher, known for his eloquence and admired by contemporaries. He died young at 27.

input_text: 数岁，拜中书令，后加散骑常侍。 遭母忧，哀毁过礼，中诏勉励，逼令摄事。 初，帝潜与羊祜谋伐吴，而群臣多以为不可，唯华赞成其计。 其后，祜疾笃，帝遣华诣祜，问以伐吴之计，语在《祜传》。 及将大举，以华为度支尚书，乃量计运漕，决定庙算。 众军既进，而未有克获，贾充等奏诛华以谢天下。 帝曰： 此是吾意，华但与吾同耳。 时大臣皆以为未可轻进，华独坚执，以为必克。 及吴灭，诏曰： 尚书、关内侯张华，前与故太傅羊祜共创大计，遂典掌军事，部分诸方，算定权略，运筹决胜，有谋谟之勋。 其进封为广武县侯，增邑万户，封子一人为亭侯，千五百户，赐绢万匹。 华名重一世，众所推服，晋史及仪礼宪章并属于华，多所损益。当时诏诰皆所草定，声誉益盛，有台辅之望焉。 而荀勖自以大族，恃帝恩深，憎疾之，每伺间隙，欲出华外镇。 会帝问华： 谁可托寄后事者？ 对曰： 明德至亲，莫如齐王攸。
target_text: Zhang Hua, courtesy name Maoxian, was from Fangcheng. Orphaned and poor, he herded sheep but was recognized for his talent. He was learned and wrote the "Ode to the Quail," which gained him fame. He served as a key advisor to Emperor Wu, supporting the conquest of Wu and overseeing logistics. After Wu's fall, he was rewarded but later fell out of favor due to his support for Prince Sima You. He was sent to Youzhou, where he pacified border tribes and received tribute from distant states.

input_text: 上从之，玮兵果败。 及玮诛，华以首谋有功，拜右光禄大夫、开府仪同三司、侍中、中书监，金章紫绶。 固辞开府。 贾谧与后共谋，以华庶族，儒雅有筹略，进无逼上之嫌，退为众望所依，欲倚以朝纲，访以政事。 疑而未决，以问裴頠，頠素重华，深赞其事。 华遂尽忠匡辅，弥缝补阙，虽当暗主虐后之朝，而海内晏然，华之功也。 华惧后族之盛，作《女史箴》以为讽。 贾后虽凶妒，而知敬重华。 久之，论前后忠勋，进封壮武郡公。 华十余让，中诏敦譬，乃受。 数年，代下邳王晃为司空，领著作。 及贾后谋废太子，左卫率刘卞甚为太子所信遇，每会宴，卞必预焉。 屡见贾谧骄傲，太子恨之，形于言色，谧亦不能平。 卞以贾后谋问华，华曰： 不闻。 卞曰： 卞以寒悴，自须昌小吏受公成拔，以至今日。 士感知己，是以尽言，而公更有疑于卞邪！ 华曰： 假令有此，君欲如何？
target_text: Recalled to court, Zhang Hua became a central figure under Emperor Hui, stabilizing the government despite Empress Jia's tyranny. He opposed the deposition of the crown prince, arguing for caution, but was overruled. He also thwarted a coup by Prince Sima Zhang of Chu. However, his refusal to join Prince Sima Lun of Zhao's rebellion led to his arrest and execution at 69, along with his family. He was known for his vast knowledge, collecting rare books, and his expertise in astronomy and strange phenomena, such as identifying dragon meat and predicting chaos from a bird feather.

input_text: 上从之，玮兵果败。 及玮诛，华以首谋有功，拜右光禄大夫、开府仪同三司、侍中、中书监，金章紫绶。 固辞开府。 贾谧与后共谋，以华庶族，儒雅有筹略，进无逼上之嫌，退为众望所依，欲倚以朝纲，访以政事。 疑而未决，以问裴頠，頠素重华，深赞其事。 华遂尽忠匡辅，弥缝补阙，虽当暗主虐后之朝，而海内晏然，华之功也。 华惧后族之盛，作《女史箴》以为讽。 贾后虽凶妒，而知敬重华。 久之，论前后忠勋，进封壮武郡公。 华十余让，中诏敦譬，乃受。 数年，代下邳王晃为司空，领著作。 及贾后谋废太子，左卫率刘卞甚为太子所信遇，每会宴，卞必预焉。 屡见贾谧骄傲，太子恨之，形于言色，谧亦不能平。 卞以贾后谋问华，华曰： 不闻。 卞曰： 卞以寒悴，自须昌小吏受公成拔，以至今日。 士感知己，是以尽言，而公更有疑于卞邪！ 华曰： 假令有此，君欲如何？
target_text: Zhang Hua's son Zhang Yi was also killed. His grandson Zhang Yu survived. Liu Bian, a loyal official, warned Zhang Hua of Empress Jia's plots but was not heeded. He later died by poison to avoid execution. The text concludes with a lament for Wei Guan and Zhang Hua, praising their loyalty but noting their tragic ends in a time of chaos.

input_text: 毓初不知其善射。 舒容范闲雅，发无不中，举坐愕然。 莫有敌者。毓叹而谢曰： 吾之不足以尽卿才，有如此射矣，岂一事哉！ 转相国参军，封剧阳子。 府朝碎务，未尝见是非；至于废兴大事，众人莫能断者，舒徐为筹之，多出众议之表。 文帝深器重之，每朝会坐罢，目送之曰： 魏舒堂堂，人之领袖也。 迁宜阳、荥阳二郡太守，甚有声称。 征拜散骑常侍。 出为冀州刺史，在州三年，以简惠称。 入为侍中。 武帝以舒清素，特赐绢百匹。 迁尚书，以公事当免官，诏以赎论。 舒三娶妻皆亡，是岁自表乞假还本郡葬妻，诏赐葬地一顷，钱五十万。 太康初，拜右仆射。 舒与卫瓘、山涛、张华等以六合混一，宜用古典封禅东岳，前后累陈其事，帝谦让不许。
target_text: Wei Shu, courtesy name Yangyuan, was born in Renchengfan. Orphaned young, he was raised by his maternal grandfather’s Ning family. A feng shui master predicted a noble nephew would be born, and Wei Shu’s intelligence led his grandmother to believe he fulfilled this prophecy. Tall and majestic, he was slow and simple, not valued by villagers. His uncle Wei Heng underestimated him, but Wei Shu remained unbothered. He enjoyed riding, archery, and hunting. Wang Yi of Taiyuan predicted he would become prime minister and supported him. Wei Shu once witnessed a prophecy about a boy who died at fifteen from an ax wound, which later came true. At forty, he studied for a hundred days, passed exams, and became Chief of Mianchi. He later served as Shangshu Lang, where he voluntarily resigned when incompetent officials were dismissed. He excelled in archery, surprising his superior Zhong Yu. As Prime Minister’s aide, he planned wisely on major issues. Emperor Wen valued him, and he governed Yiyang and Rongyang with a good reputation. He served as governor of Jizhou for three years, known for simplicity and benevolence. Emperor Wu rewarded him for honesty. He married three times, all wives predeceased him. In the Taikang era, he advocated for the Fengshan ceremony but was refused. He served as Zuopushe and managed the official department, proposing reforms for imperial marriage gifts. He became Situ and was known for distributing his salary to relatives, leaving no surplus. He appointed Zhou Zhen, who had been avoided due to a superstitious nickname, without disaster. He repeatedly resigned due to illness, eventually being allowed to retire as Juyangzi with honors. He died at eighty-two, posthumously named Kang. His son Wei Hun died young, and his great-nephew Wei Huang succeeded him.

input_text: 憙少有高行，博学研精，与北海管宁以贤良征，不行。 累辟三府，不就。 宣帝复辟憙为太傅属，固辞疾，郡县扶舆上道，时憙母疾笃，乃窃逾泫氏城而徒还，遂遭母丧，论者嘉其志节。 后为并州别驾，时骁骑将军秦朗过并州，州将毕轨敬焉。令乘车至阁。 憙固谏以为不可，轨不得已从之。 景帝辅政，命憙为大将军从事中郎，憙到，引见，谓憙曰： 昔先公辟君而君不应，今孤命君而君至，何也？ 对曰： 先君以礼见待，憙得以礼进退。 明公以法见绳，憙畏法而至。 帝甚重之。 转司马，寻拜右长史。 从讨毌丘俭还，迁御史中丞。 当官正色，不惮强御，百僚震肃焉。 荐乐安孙璞，亦以道德显，时人称为知人。
target_text: Li Xi, courtesy name Jihe, was from Shangdang Tongtian. He had good conduct, studied widely, and refused recruitment by Guan Ning and others. Emperor Xuan summoned him, but he declined due to his mother’s illness. He later served as a special chariot in Bingzhou, advising Bi Gui against improper conduct. Emperor Jing appointed him as a lieutenant; when asked why he accepted, Li Xi replied he feared the law. He became censor Zhongcheng, feared for his uprightness. He recommended Sun Pu, praised for identifying talent. He was dismissed as Grand Sima but later served as governor of Liangzhou, stabilizing the region and defeating Qiang invaders without prior approval, compared to Han generals. He returned to Beijing, then governed Jizhou and became Sili Xiaowei. When Wei surrendered to Jin, he assisted in ceremonies. He was made Marquis of Qi and accused officials of occupying public rice fields, leading to punishment for Liu You. He served as crown prince’s tutor, teaching diligently. He resigned due to old age, receiving honors. He advocated attacking Liangzhou invaders but was overruled, leading to Liangzhou’s destruction. He was honest and frugal, sharing with relatives. He died, posthumously named Taibao. His son Li Zan succeeded him.

input_text: 尤精《三传》，辨正《公羊》，以为卫辄不应辞以王父命，祭仲失为臣之节，举此二端以明臣子之体，遂行于世。 又撰《春秋条例》二十卷。 有二子，跻、夏。 跻字景云，官至散骑常侍。 夏以贪污弃放于世。 弟智，字子房，贞素有兄风。 少贫窭，每负薪自给，读诵不辍，竟以儒行称。 历中书黄门吏部郎，出为颍川太守。 平原管辂尝谓人曰： 吾与刘颍川兄弟语，使人神思清发，昏不假寐。 自此之外，殆白日欲寝矣。 入为秘书监，领南阳王师，加散骑常侍，迁侍中、尚书、太常。 著《丧服释疑论》，多所辨明。 太康末卒，谥曰成。 高光，字宣茂，陈留圉城人，魏太尉柔之子也。 光少习家业，明练刑理。
target_text: Liu Yi, courtesy name Zizhen, was from Gaotang, Pingyuan. Poor in youth, he sold cow clothes but studied diligently. He was recommended as Xiaolian but refused. He served as Shangshu Lang and Tingweizheng. He predicted Zhong Hui and Deng Ai would conquer Shu but not return, which came true. He wrote “On Chong Rang Lun” advocating humility to correct worldly competition. He argued that humility reveals talent, reduces slander, and stabilizes governance. He criticized the lack of humility in official appointments, leading to mediocrity and corruption. He proposed that officials should recommend the worthy, with selection based on collective recommendations rather than seniority. He served as Taichang and Shangshu. His son Liu Xia’s bribery led to his dismissal. He later served as crown prince’s mentor and Taibao. He resigned at ninety-one, dying soon after. He was frugal, once mistaking Shi Chong’s luxurious toilet for a bedroom. He studied the “Three Biographies” and wrote “Spring and Autumn Regulations.” His sons Liu Ji and Liu Xia were noted, with Liu Xia disgraced for corruption.

input_text: 初以太子舍人累迁尚书郎，出为幽州刺史、颍州太守。 是时武帝置黄沙狱，以典诏囚。 以光历世明法，用为黄沙御史，秩与中丞同，迁廷尉。 元康中，拜尚书，典三公曹。 时赵王伦篡逆，光于其际，守道全贞。 及伦赐死，齐王冏辅政，复以光为廷尉，迁尚书，加奉车都尉。 后从驾讨成都王颖有勋，封延陵县公，邑千八百户。 于时朝廷咸推光明于用法，故频典理官。 惠帝为张方所逼，幸长安，朝臣奔散，莫有从者，光独侍帝而西。 迁尚书左仆射，加散骑常侍。 光兄诞为上官巳等所用，历徐、雍二州刺史。 诞性任放无伦次，而决烈过人，与光异操。 常谓光小节，恆轻侮之，光事诞愈谨。 帝既还洛阳，时太弟新立，重选傅训，以光为少傅，加光禄大夫，常侍如故。 及怀帝即位，加光禄大夫金章紫绶，与傅祗并见推崇。 寻为尚书令，本官如故。 以疾卒，赠司空、侍中。 属京洛倾覆，竟未加谥。 子韬字子远，放佚无检。 光为廷尉时，韬受货赇，有司奏案之，而光不知。 时人虽非光不能防闲其子，以其用心有素，不以为累。 初，光诣长安留台，以韬兼右卫将军。 韬与殿省小人交通，及光卒，仍于丧中往来不绝。 时东海王越辅政，不朝观。 韬知人心有望，密与太傅参军姜赜、京兆杜概等谋讨越，事泄伏诛。
target_text: Gao Guang, courtesy name Xuan Mao, was from Chenliu. He knew law from youth, serving as Shangshu Lang and governor of Youzhou and Yingchuan. He was appointed Huangsha Yushi for legal expertise. During Sima Lun’s rebellion, he stayed loyal. He served as Tingwei and Shangshu, later following Emperor Hui to Chang'an when others fled. He became Zuopushe and young master. He died of illness, posthumously named Sikong. His son Gao Tao was corrupt and plotted against Sima Yue, leading to his execution. The historian praised Wei Shu and Liu Yi for their wisdom, Li Xi for his boldness, and Gao Guang for his integrity, noting Liu Xia’s corruption as a flaw.

input_text: 傅玄，字休奕，北地泥阳人也。 祖燮，汉汉阳太守。 父干，魏扶风太守。 玄少孤贫，博学善属文，解钟律。 性刚劲亮直，不能容人之短。 郡上计吏再举孝廉，太尉辟，皆不就。 州举秀才，除郎中，与东海缪施俱以时誉选入著作，撰集魏书。 后参安东、卫军军事，转温令，再迁弘农太守，领典农校尉。 所居称职，数上书陈便宜，多所匡正。 五等建，封鹑觚男。 武帝为晋王，以玄为散骑常侍。 及受禅，进爵为子，加附马都尉。 帝初即位，广纳直言，开不讳之路，玄及散骑常侍皇甫陶共掌谏职。
target_text: Fu Xuan, courtesy name Xiu Yi, was from Niyang in the north. His grandfather Fu Xie was a Han prefect, and his father Fu Qian was a Wei governor. Orphaned and poor in youth, Fu Xuan was erudite, skilled in writing, and knowledgeable in music. He had a strong, upright character and could not tolerate others' faults. He was appointed as a county planner, recommended as Xiaolian twice, and recruited by the Taiwei, but did not take the post. He passed the scholar examination, became a doctor, and was selected with Donghai Mushi to compile Wei books. He later held various military and civil posts, including prefect of Hongnong and captain of Diannong School, and was known for his competent governance and many petitions. After the fifth-grade system was established, he was granted the title of Baron Quail. Under Emperor Wu of Jin, he was promoted to viscount and Prince Consort and Commander-in-Chief.

input_text: 今圣明之政资始，而汉、魏之失未改，散官众而学校未设，游手多而亲农者少，工器不尽其宜。 臣以为亟定其制，通计天下若干人为士，足以副在官之吏；若干人为农，三年足有一年之储；若干人为工，足其器用；若干人为商贾，足以通货而已。 尊儒尚学，贵农贱商，此皆事业之要务也。 前皇甫陶上事，欲令赐拜散官皆课使亲耕，天下享足食之利。 禹、稷躬稼，祚流后世，是以《明堂》、《月令》著帝藉之制。 伊尹古之名臣，耕于有莘；晏婴齐之大夫，避庄公之难，亦耕于海滨。 昔者圣帝明王，贤佐俊士，皆尝从事于农矣。 王人赐官，冗散无事者，不督使学，则当使耕，无缘放之使坐食百姓也。 今文武之官既众，而拜赐不在职者又多，加以服役为兵，不得耕稼，当农者之半，南面食禄者参倍于前。 使冗散之官农，而收其租税，家得其实，而天下之谷可以无乏矣。 夫家足食，为子则孝，为父则慈，为兄则友，为弟则悌。 天下足食，则仁义之教可不令而行也。 为政之要，计人而置官，分人而授事，士农工商之分不可斯须废也。
target_text: As an admonishment officer, Fu Xuan submitted a memorial criticizing the decline of benevolence and righteousness since the Qin and Wei dynasties, praising Emperor Wu's virtue, and urging the recommendation of courteous ministers and removal of hypocritical ones. The emperor agreed and asked him to draft an edict. Fu Xuan further wrote on the importance of proper official appointments, advocating for long-term positions and the division of labor among scholars, farmers, workers, and merchants. He stressed the need for a system to plan the number of people in each class, emphasizing agriculture and Confucian education. He also proposed that idle officials should farm, and that the government should evaluate officials every three years, with promotions after nine years. The emperor praised his sincerity and ordered further study of his proposals.

input_text: 诏曰： 得所陈便宜，言农事得失及水官兴废，又安边御胡政事宽猛之宜，申省周备，一二具之，此诚为国大本，当今急务也。 如所论皆善，深知乃心，广思诸宜，动静以闻也。 五年，迁太仆。 时比年不登，羌胡扰边，诏公卿会议。 玄应对所问，陈事切直，虽不尽施行，而常见优容。 转司隶校尉。 献皇后崩于弘训宫，设丧位。 旧制，司隶于端门外坐，在诸卿上，绝席。 其入殿，按本品秩在诸卿下，以次坐，不绝席。 而谒者以弘训宫为殿内，制玄位在卿下。 玄恚怒，厉声色而责谒者。 谒者妄称尚书所处，玄对百僚而骂尚书以下。 御史中丞庾纯奏玄不敬，玄又自表不以实，坐免官。
target_text: In the fourth year of Taishi, Fu Xuan became Yushi Zhongcheng. During floods and droughts, he submitted five proposals: adjusting the share of harvest for soldiers using government cattle; enforcing Han-era laws to punish negligent officials; improving water conservancy by dividing responsibilities; reforming land tax to rest labor; and establishing a new county in Gaopingchuan to manage the Xianbei tribe and prevent border unrest. The emperor approved these as fundamental to governance. In the fifth year of Taishi, Fu Xuan became a servant. Despite grain shortages and border troubles, his sincere advice was often tolerated. He later became Sili Xiaowei, but was dismissed after a dispute over seating at a mourning ceremony. He died at home at age sixty-two, posthumously titled Gang.

input_text: 然玄天性峻急，不能有所容；每有奏劾，或值日暮，捧白简，整簪带，竦踊不寐，坐而待旦。 于是贵游慑伏，台阁生风。 寻卒于家，时年六十二，谥曰刚。 玄少时避难于河内，专心诵学，后虽显贵，而著述不废。 撰论经国九流及三史故事，评断得失，各为区例，名为《傅子》，为内、外、中篇，凡有四部、六录，合百四十首，数十万言，并文集百余卷行于世。 玄初作内篇成，子咸以示司空王沈。 沈与玄书曰： 省足下所著书，言富理济，经纶政体，存重儒教，足以塞杨、墨之流遁，齐孙、孟于往代。 每开卷，未尝不叹息也。 不见贾生，自以过之，乃今不及 ，信矣！ 其后追封清泉侯。子咸嗣。 咸字长虞，刚简有大节。 风格峻整，识性明悟，疾恶如仇，推贤乐善，常慕季文子、仲山甫之志。 好属文论，虽绮丽不足，而言成规鉴。 颍川庾纯常叹曰： 长虞之文近乎诗人之作矣！ 咸宁初，袭父爵，拜太子洗马，累迁尚书右丞。出为冀州刺史，继母杜氏不肯随咸之官，自表解职。 三旬之间，迁司徒左长史。 时帝留心政事，诏访朝臣政之损益。 咸上言曰： 陛下处至尊之位，而修布衣之事，亲览万机，劳心日昃。 在昔帝王，躬自菲薄，以利天下，未有逾陛下也。
target_text: Fu Xuan wrote "Fu Zi," a book on governance and the three religions, divided into internal, external, and middle chapters, with over 100 volumes. His son Fu Xian inherited his title. Fu Xian, courtesy name Yu, was upright, strict, and hated evil. He served as Prince Xima, Shangshu Youcheng, and governor of Jizhou, but resigned when his stepmother refused to accompany him. Later, as Situ Zuo Changshi, he criticized the emperor for overworking himself and proposed consolidating official positions, simplifying affairs, and promoting agriculture. He also petitioned against extravagance, citing ancient frugality. During Emperor Hui's reign, he advised Yang Jun on regency matters and later criticized Sima Liang for excessive rewards. Fu Xian was known for his fearless impeachments, including against Wang Rong, and his advocacy for long-term official tenures. He died in office at age fifty-six, posthumously titled Zhen. He had three sons: Fu Fu, Fu Rixi, and Fu Zuan.

input_text: 山涛，字巨源，河内怀人也。 父曜，宛句令。 涛早孤，居贫，少有器量，介然不群。 性好《庄》《老》，每隐身自晦。 与嵇康、吕安善，后遇阮籍，便为竹林之交，著忘言之契。康后坐事，临诛，谓子绍曰： 巨源在，汝不孤矣。 涛年四十，始为郡主簿、功曹、上计掾。 举孝廉，州辟部河南从事。 与石鉴共宿，涛夜起蹴鉴曰： 今为何等时而眠邪！ 知太傅卧何意？ 鉴曰： 宰相三不朝，与尺一令归第，卿何虑也！ 涛曰： 咄！石生无事马蹄间邪！ 投传而去。 未二年，果有曹爽之事，遂隐身不交世务。 与宣穆后有中表亲，是以见景帝。 帝曰： 吕望欲仕邪？ 命司隶举秀才，除郎中。 转骠骑将军王昶从事中郎。 久之，拜赵国相，迁尚书吏部郎。 文帝与涛书曰： 足下在事清明，雅操迈时。 念多所乏，今致钱二十万、谷二百斛。 魏帝尝赐景帝春服，帝以赐涛。 又以母老，并赐藜杖一枚。 晚与尚书和逌交，又与钟会、裴秀并申款昵。 以二人居势争权，涛平心处中，各得其所，而俱无恨焉。
target_text: Shantao, also known as Juyuan, was a man of Hanoi who lost his father early and grew up in poverty. He was thoughtful from a young age, favored the works of Zhuangzi and Laozi, and often concealed his talents. He formed deep friendships with Ji Kang, Lu An, and later Ruan Ji, becoming one of the Seven Sages of the Bamboo Forest. At forty, he began his official career, serving in various roles such as the princess's administrator and chief planner. He was known for his integrity and wisdom, once warning Shi Jian about the dangers of Cao Shuang's rebellion. After Cao Shuang's downfall, Shantao withdrew from public life for a time.

input_text: 山涛，字巨源，河内怀人也。 父曜，宛句令。 涛早孤，居贫，少有器量，介然不群。 性好《庄》《老》，每隐身自晦。 与嵇康、吕安善，后遇阮籍，便为竹林之交，著忘言之契。康后坐事，临诛，谓子绍曰： 巨源在，汝不孤矣。 涛年四十，始为郡主簿、功曹、上计掾。 举孝廉，州辟部河南从事。 与石鉴共宿，涛夜起蹴鉴曰： 今为何等时而眠邪！ 知太傅卧何意？ 鉴曰： 宰相三不朝，与尺一令归第，卿何虑也！ 涛曰： 咄！石生无事马蹄间邪！ 投传而去。 未二年，果有曹爽之事，遂隐身不交世务。 与宣穆后有中表亲，是以见景帝。 帝曰： 吕望欲仕邪？ 命司隶举秀才，除郎中。 转骠骑将军王昶从事中郎。 久之，拜赵国相，迁尚书吏部郎。 文帝与涛书曰： 足下在事清明，雅操迈时。 念多所乏，今致钱二十万、谷二百斛。 魏帝尝赐景帝春服，帝以赐涛。 又以母老，并赐藜杖一枚。 晚与尚书和逌交，又与钟会、裴秀并申款昵。 以二人居势争权，涛平心处中，各得其所，而俱无恨焉。
target_text: Shantao later served under Emperor Jing and Emperor Wen, holding positions such as Zhao Guoxiang and minister of official affairs. He was praised for his honesty and intelligence, receiving generous gifts from the emperor. In his later years, he interacted with high-ranking officials like Zhong Hui and Pei Xiu, maintaining harmony among them. He was promoted to general and lieutenant, and during the campaign against Shu, he was entrusted with guarding Ye. In the early years of Xianxi, he was named Xin Da Zi and later served as Prime Minister Zuo Changshi.

input_text: 迁大将军从事中郎。 钟会作乱于蜀，而文帝将西征。 时魏氏诸王公并在鄴，帝谓涛曰： 西偏吾自了之，后事深以委卿。 以本官行军司马，给亲兵五百人，镇鄴。 咸熙初，封新沓子。 转相国左长史，典统别营。 时帝以涛乡闾宿望，命太子拜之。 帝以齐王攸继景帝后，素又重攸，尝问裴秀曰： 大将军开建未遂，吾但承奉后事耳。 故立攸，将归功于兄，何如？ 秀以为不可，又以问涛。 涛对曰： 废长立少，违礼不祥。 国之安危，恆必由之。 太子位于是乃定。 太子亲拜谢涛。 及武帝受禅，以涛守大鸿胪，护送陈留王诣鄴。 泰始初，加奉车都尉，进爵新沓伯。 及羊祜执政，时人欲危裴秀，涛正色保持之。 由是失权臣意，出为冀州刺史，加宁远将军。 冀州俗薄，无相推毂。 涛甄拔隐屈，搜访贤才，旌命三十余人，皆显名当时。
target_text: When Emperor Wu succeeded, Shantao advised against appointing Sima You, citing the importance of proper succession. He served as Dahonglu and later as Fengche Captain. As governor of Jizhou, he reformed local customs by recommending talented individuals. He resigned multiple times due to his mother's age, but was eventually persuaded to return to office. He served as Shangshu of the Ministry of Personnel, selecting officials based on merit. Despite facing criticism, he continued his work, earning the title "Monkey Announcement" for his screening methods.

input_text: 涛辞不获已，乃起视事。 涛再居选职十有余年，每一官缺，辄启拟数人，诏旨有所向，然后显奏，随帝意所欲为先。 故帝之所用，或非举首，众情不察，以涛轻重任意。 或谮之于帝，故帝手诏戒涛曰： 夫用人惟才，不遗疏远单贱，天下便化矣。 而涛行之自若，一年之后众情乃寝。 涛所奏甄拔人物，各为题目，时称《山公启事》。 涛中立于朝，晚值后党专权，不欲任杨氏，多有讽谏，帝虽悟而不能改。 后以年衰疾笃，上疏告退曰： 臣年垂八十，救命旦夕，若有毫末之益，岂遗力于圣时，迫以老耄，不复任事。 今四海休息，天下思化，从而静之，百姓自正。 但当崇风尚教以敦之耳，陛下亦复何事。 臣耳目聋瞑，不能自励。 君臣父子，其间无文，是以直陈愚情，乞听所请。
target_text: In his later years, Shantao faced the dictatorship of the Hou party and advised the emperor without success. He resigned due to old age and illness, but was repeatedly called back to service. He was promoted to Youpuse and Guanglu doctor, but continued to decline due to health. After Wu was pacified, he advised against withdrawing military forces, a warning that proved prescient during later chaos. He was appointed Situ but refused, eventually dying at seventy-nine. He was given posthumous honors and his family was provided for by the emperor.

input_text: 涛乃取丝付吏，积年尘埃，印封如初。 涛饮酒至八斗方醉，帝欲试之，乃以酒八斗饮涛，而密益其酒，涛极本量而止。 有五子：该、淳、允、谟、简。 该字伯伦，嗣父爵，仕至并州刺史、太子左率，赠长水校尉。 该子玮字彦祖，翊军校尉。 次子世回，吏部郎、散骑常侍。 淳字子玄，不仕，允字叔真，奉车都尉，并少尪病，形甚短小，而聪敏过人。 武帝闻而欲见之，涛不敢辞，以问于允。 允自以尪陋，不肯行。 涛以为胜己，乃表曰： 臣二子尪病，宜绝人事，不敢受诏。 谟字季长，明惠有才智，官至司空掾。 简字季伦。 性温雅，有父风，年二十余，涛不之知也。 简叹曰： 吾年几三十，而不为家公所知！ 后与谯国嵇绍、氵市郡刘谟、弘农杨准齐名。
target_text: Shantao was known for his frugality and loyalty, never taking concubines despite his high status. He distributed his salary to relatives and friends. He once accepted silk from a corrupt official but kept it sealed, later returning it when the official's crimes were exposed. He had five sons: Shan Gai, Shan Chun, Shan Yun, Shan Mo, and Shan Jian. Shan Gai inherited his title and served as governor of Bingzhou. Shan Jian, known for his gentle temperament, became a prominent official, serving as minister and governor of various regions.

input_text: 有庶子兴，戎所不齿。 以从弟阳平太守愔子为嗣。 衍字夷甫，神情明秀，风姿详雅。 总角尝造山涛，涛嗟叹良久，既去，目而送之曰： 何物老妪，生宁馨兒！ 然误天下苍生者，未必非此人也。 父乂，为平北将军，常有公事，使行人列上，不时报。 衍年十四，时在京师，造仆射羊祜，申陈事状，辞甚清辩。 祜名德贵重，而衍幼年无屈下之色，众咸异之。 杨骏欲以女妻焉，衍耻之，遂阳狂自免。 武帝闻其名，问戎曰： 夷甫当世谁比？ 戎曰： 未见其比，当从古人中求之。 泰始八年，诏举奇才可以安边者，衍初好论从横之术，故尚书卢钦举为辽东太守。 不就，于是口不论世事，唯雅咏玄虚而已。 尝因宴集，为族人所怒，举累掷其面。 衍初无言，引王导共载而去。 然心不能平，在车中揽镜自照，谓导曰： 尔看吾目光乃在牛背上矣。 父卒于北平，送故甚厚，为亲识之所借贷，因以舍之。 数年之间，家资罄尽，出就洛城西田园而居焉。后为太子舍人，还尚书郎。 出补元城令，终日清谈，而县务亦理。 入为中庶子、黄门侍郎。 魏正始中，何晏、王弼等祖述《老》《庄》，立论以为： 天地万物皆以无为本。
target_text: Wang Rong, courtesy name Junchong, was from Linyi. He was known for his intelligence and calmness from a young age, once standing unafraid during a tiger's roar. He was friends with Ruan Ji and others, and was known for his insight. He served in various official roles, including governor of Jingzhou and Yuzhou, and was involved in the conquest of Wu. He was known for his filial piety, though he did not strictly adhere to rituals. He was criticized for his greed and stinginess, often calculating his wealth day and night. He died at seventy-two, posthumously named Yuan.
