target_text: His son Chen Zhao was heir. Fifth son Chen Ting, courtesy name Junzhang, could ride and shoot at seven. At twelve, he followed his father to Luoyang but fell ill. He impressed Zhu Yi by drawing maps in soil. In Datong's fourth year, he was appointed Changshi and leader of the right guard, sent to Yiyang. He defeated Yao Xiong, a fierce Wei general. In the sixth year, he was titled General Weiyuan and Lord of Xiaoxian. In the tenth year, he pacified the demon thief Wang Qinzong. In Taiqing's second year, Hou Jing surrounded Liyang. Chen Ting advised guarding the quarry but was captured by Hou Jing. Hou Jing tried to use him, but Chen Ting refused. He was killed by Hou Jing at thirty-three. Lanqin, courtesy name Xiu Ming, was from Zhongchang Wei. His father Lan Yun served as governor of Jizhou. Lanqin was decisive and agile, following his father in the northern expedition. In Datong's first year, he attacked Wei Xiao City and defeated various generals. He captured Juegu and defeated Liu Haiyou. He pacified barbarians in Guiyang and Yangshan, was titled male in Anhuai County. He defeated Duiqi Manshuai and rescued Yuan Qinghe. He was granted command of four states, captured Tongsheng, and pacified Luan and Yi. He was promoted to General Zhiwu. Later, as governor of Hengzhou, he defeated Wei's Dong Shao and Zhang Xian. He governed Guangzhou, defeating Chen Wenche. In Hengzhou, he was promoted to General Zinan and Duke of Qujiang County. Officials requested a monument for his virtues. He was recruited as a regular servant but was poisoned by a cook at forty-two. His son Zi Xia Li attacked Hou Jing at Liyang and died. The historian comments that Chen Qingzhi and Lanqin rivaled ancient generals in military strategy. Qingzhi was intelligent and served Zhidan long, earning honors through caution and respect.

input_text: 萧子恪，字景冲，兰陵人，齐豫章文献王嶷第二子也。 永明中，以王子封南康县侯。 年十二，和从兄司徒竟陵王《高松赋》，卫军王俭见而奇之。 初为宁朔将军、淮陵太守，建武中，迁辅国将军、吴郡太守。 大司马王敬则于会稽举兵反，以奉子恪为名，明帝悉召子恪兄弟亲从七十余人入西省，至夜当害之。 会子恪弃郡奔归，是日亦至，明帝乃止，以子恪为太子中庶子。 东昏即位，迁秘书监，领右军将军，俄为侍中。 中兴二年，迁辅国谘议参军。 天监元年，降爵为子，除散骑常侍，领步兵校尉，以疾不拜，徙为光禄大夫，俄为司徒左长史。 子恪与弟子范等，尝因事入谢，高祖在文德殿引见之，从容谓曰： 我欲与卿兄弟有言。 夫天下之宝，本是公器，非可力得。 苟无期运，虽有项籍之力，终亦败亡。 所以班彪《王命论》云： 所求不过一金，然终转死沟壑 。
target_text: Xiao Zike, courtesy name Jingchong, was the second son of Xiao Yi, King Wen of Yuzhang in the Qi Dynasty. During the Yongming era, he was named Marquis of Nankang County. At age twelve, he co-wrote "Gaosong Fu" with his cousin, King Jingling of Situ, earning admiration from the guard Gongjian. He began his career as General Ningshuo and Grand Administrator of Jinduo, later moving to General Fuguo and Grand Administrator of Wujun during the Jiangan period. When Grand Sima Wang Jingze rebelled in Kuaiji, Zike fled to the capital, avoiding harm from Emperor Ming, who appointed him as the crown prince's concubine. Under Donghunhou, he became Secretary Supervisor, Right Army General, and Minister. In the second year of Zhongxing, he served as Auxiliary to Consult the Country. In the first year of Tianjian, he was demoted to Viscount, appointed as Regular Attendant of the Cavalry and Infantry Captain, but declined due to illness. He later held posts including Guanglu Doctor and Chief Historian of Situ Zuo.

input_text: 卿不应不读此书。 宋孝武为性猜忌，兄弟粗有令名者，无不因事鸩毒，所遗唯有景和。 至于朝臣之中，或疑有天命而致害者，枉滥相继，然而或疑有天命而不能害者，或不知有天命而不疑者，于时虽疑卿祖，而无如之何。 此是疑而不得。 又有不疑者，如宋明帝本为庸常被免，岂疑而得全？ 又复我于时已年二岁，彼岂知我应有今日？ 当知有天命者，非人所害，害亦不能得。 我初平建康城，朝廷内外皆劝我云： 时代革异，物心须一，宜行处分。 我于时依此而行，谁谓不可！ 我政言江左以来，代谢必相诛戮，此是伤于和气，所以国祚例不灵长。 所谓 殷鉴不远，在夏后之世。 此是一义。 二者，齐梁虽曰革代，义异往时。
target_text: Emperor Gaozu, in a conversation with Zike's disciples, emphasized that fame and fortune cannot be forced, citing historical examples like Xiang Ji's failure. He contrasted the jealous nature of Emperor Xiaowu of Song, who poisoned talented brothers, with the survival of Liu Ziye. Gaozu noted that those with destiny cannot be harmed, referencing his own rise. He advised against killing during dynastic changes, warning it damages harmony, and stressed the close clan relationship between Qi and Liang, urging loyalty. He also instructed Zhao Shuzu to reassure the princes of Beidi of his intentions.

input_text: 四年，转吏部。 六年，迁太子詹事。 大通二年，出为宁远将军、吴郡太守。 三年，卒于郡舍，时年五十二。 诏赠侍中、中书令。 谥曰恭。 子恪兄弟十六人，并仕梁。 有文学者，子恪、子质、子显、子云、子晖五人。 子恪尝谓所亲曰： 文史之事，诸弟备之矣，不烦吾复牵率，但退食自公，无过足矣。 子恪少亦涉学，颇属文，随弃其本，故不传文集。 子瑳，亦知名太清中，官至吏部郎，避乱东阳，后为盗所害。 子范字景则，子恪第六弟也。 齐永明十年，封祁阳县侯，拜太子洗马。 天监初，降爵为子，除后军记室参军，复为太子洗马，俄迁司徒主簿，丁所生母忧去职。 子范有孝性，居丧以毁闻。
target_text: Zike later served as Prefect of Yongjia, Guanglu Qing, Secretary Supervisor, General Mingwei, Prefect of Lingling, Regular Attendant of Sanqi, General of the Auxiliary Country, Zong Zhengqing, Du Guan Shangshu, Minister of Personnel, and Prince Zhan Shi. In the second year of Datong, he became General Ningyuan and Prefect of Yuxing, dying at age fifty-two in 536. He was posthumously given the titles Shi Zhong and Zhong Shu Ling, with the posthumous name Gong. His sixteen brothers all served in Liang, with five talented ones: Zike, Zizhi, Zixian, Ziyun, and Zihui. Wang Deng, another brother, praised their literary skills but abandoned his own writing.

input_text: 寻复为宣惠武陵王司马，不就，仍除中散大夫，迁光禄、廷尉卿。 出为戎昭将军、始兴内史。 还除太中大夫，迁秘书监。 太宗即位，召为光禄大夫，加金章紫绶，以逼贼不拜。 其年葬简皇后，使与张缵俱制哀策文，太宗览读之，曰： 今葬礼虽阙，此文犹不减于旧。 寻遇疾卒，时年六十四。 贼平后，世祖追赠金紫光禄大夫。 谥曰文。 前后文集三十卷。 二子滂、确，并少有文章。 太宗东宫时，尝与邵陵王数诸萧文士，滂、确亦预焉。 滂官至尚书殿中郎，中军宣城王记室，先子范卒。 确，太清中历官宣城王友，司徒右长史。 贼平后，赴江陵，因没关西。 子显字景阳，子恪第八弟也。 幼聪慧，文献王异之，爱过诸子。 七岁，封宁都县侯。 永元末，以王子例拜给事中。 天监初，降爵为子。 累迁安西外兵，仁威记室参军，司徒主簿，太尉录事。 子显伟容貌，身长八尺。
target_text: Zifan, Zike's sixth younger brother, was named Marquis of Qiyang County in the tenth year of Yongming. In Tianjian, he was demoted to Viscount and held various posts, including Prince Xi Ma and Master Situ. Known for filial piety, he mourned excessively for his mother. He later served as Chief Secretary of Situ, Yan Yin Cheng, Prefect of Jian'an, and Grand Sima of the Imperial Household. He loved literary talents, favoring Wang Yan, and compiled the "Thousand-Character Essay." After Wang's death, Zifan moved to Xuanhui to consult and join the army. He felt undervalued compared to his brothers, often comparing himself to Du Xu's middle brother. He later became Sima, Zhongsan Doctor, Guanglu, Tingweiqing, General Rong Zhao, and Direct Internal History of Zhou. He returned to the capital as Taizhong Doctor and Secretary Supervisor. Under Taisai, he was appointed Guanglu Doctor but declined due to thieves. He died at sixty-four, posthumously given Jinzi Guanglu and the posthumous name Wen. His collected works totaled thirty volumes. His sons, Xiao Pang and Xiao Que, were early writers, with Xiao Pang serving as a lieutenant and Xiao Que as an official in Taiqing.

input_text: 好学，工属文。 尝著《鸿序赋》，尚书令沈约见而称曰： 可谓得明道之高致，盖《幽通》之流也。 又采众家《后汉》，考正同异，为一家之书。 又启撰《齐史》，书成，表奏之，诏付秘阁。 累迁太子中舍人，建康令，邵陵王友，丹阳尹丞，中书郎，守宗正卿。 出为临川内史，还除黄门郎。 中大通二年，迁长兼侍中。 高祖雅爱子显才，又嘉其容止吐纳，每御筵侍坐，偏顾访焉。 尝从容谓子显曰： 我造《通史》，此书若成，众史可废。 子显对曰： 仲尼赞《易》道，黜《八索》，述职方，除《九丘》，圣制符同，复在兹日。 时以为名对。 三年，以本官领国子博士。 高祖所制经义，未列学官，子显在职，表置助教一人，生十人。 又启撰高祖集，并《普通北伐记》。 其年迁国子祭酒，又加侍中，于学递述高祖《五经义》。 五年，迁吏部尚书，侍中如故。
target_text: Xiao Ti, Zike's eighth younger brother, was intelligent and valued by his father. At seven, he was named Kongdu Tibao. In Tianjian, his title was reduced to Viscount. He held posts including Foreign Soldier in Anxi, Wei Jishi, and Taiwei Recorder. Tall and handsome, he wrote "Hongxu Fu," praised by Shen Yue, and compiled "Hou Mo" and "History of Qi." He later served as Prince Zhongsheren, Jianchenling, Shaoling Wangyou, Danyan Yincheng, Zhongshulang, and Zong Zhengqing. In the second year of Zhongdatong, he became Chief and Minister. Emperor Gaozu admired his talent and manner, once asking him about compiling "General History." In three years, he became a Doctor of Guozi, later moving to Guozi Jijiu and Minister of Civil Affairs. He was proud and solemn, often ignoring guests. He died at forty-nine in the third year of Datong, posthumously given Shizhong and Zhongshu Ling, with the posthumous name Mi. His works include "Houmo Shu," "Qi Shu," "Ordinary Northern Expedition," "Guijian Biography," and collected works. His sons, Xiao Xu and Xiao Kai, were early achievers, with Xiao Kai praised by Taizong for his poetry.

input_text: 迁太子舍人，撰《东宫新记》，奏之，敕赐束帛。 累迁北中郎外兵参军，晋安王文学，司徒主簿，丹阳尹丞。 时湘东王为京尹，深相赏好，如布衣之交。 迁北中郎庐陵王谘议参军，兼尚书左丞。 大通元年，除黄门郎，俄迁轻车将军，兼司徒左长史。 二年，入为吏部。 三年，迁长兼侍中。 中大通元年，转太府卿。 三年，出为贞威将军、临川内史。 在郡以和理称，民吏悦之。 还除散骑常侍，俄复为侍中。 大同二年，迁员外散骑常侍、国子祭酒，领南徐州大中正。 顷之，复为侍中，祭酒、中正如故。
target_text: Ziyun, Zike's ninth younger brother, was named Marquis of Xinpu County at twelve in the fourth year of Jianwu. In Tianjian, his title was reduced to Viscount. Diligent in study, he began writing at twenty. Quiet and reluctant to serve, he was recruited as a secretary at thirty. He held posts including Prince Sheren, Beizhong Lang, and Danyang Yin Cheng. King Shu of Xiang appreciated him. He later served as Huang Menlang, General Qingche, and Minister of Civil Affairs. In the first year of Zhongdatong, he became Taifuqing, then General Zhenwei and Internal History of Linchuan. He returned as Regular Attendant of Sanqi and Minister of State. He proposed revising sacrificial music lyrics, replacing Shen Yue's works with classical references. Skilled in cursive calligraphy, he imitated Zhong Yao and Wang Xizhi, earning Emperor Gaozu's praise. In the seventh year, he served as General Renwei and Prefect of Shuyang. In the first year of Taiqing, he became Shizhong and Guozi Jijiu. In the second year, Hou Jing invaded, and Ziyun fled, dying of starvation at sixty-three in 549. His works include "Book of Jin" and "New Records of the East Palace." His son Xiao Te, skilled in calligraphy, died at twenty-five.

input_text: 三年三月，宫城失守，东奔晋陵，馁卒于显灵寺僧房，年六十三。 所著《晋书》一百一十卷，《东宫新记》二十卷。 第二子特，字世达。 早知名，亦善草隶。 高祖尝谓子云曰： 子敬之书，不及逸少。 近见特迹，遂逼于卿。 历官著作佐郎，太子舍人，宣惠主簿，中军记室。 出为海盐令，坐事免。 年二十五，先子云卒。 子晖字景光，子云弟也。 少涉书史，亦有文才。 起家员外散骑侍郎，迁南中郎记室。 出为临安令。 性恬静，寡嗜好，尝预重云殿听制讲《三慧经》，退为《讲赋》奏之，甚见称赏。 迁安西武陵王谘议，带新繁令，随府转仪同从事、骠骑长史，卒。
target_text: Zihui, Ziyun's younger brother, was talented in literature. He started as a member of the imperial family and served as Sanqi Minister and Lin'an Order. Quiet and reserved, he wrote "Lectures on Fu" after attending a lecture. He later served as Consultant to King Wuling and Chief Historian of Hussar, dying in office. Chen Libu Shangshu Yao Chari noted that the Liang Dynasty, unlike previous dynasties, did not suppress former clans, allowing Zike's brothers to hold positions, reflecting Emperor Gaozu's magnanimity.

input_text: 朱异贺琛朱异，字彦和，吴郡钱唐人也。 父巽，以义烈知名，官至齐江夏王参军、吴平令。 异年数岁，外祖顾欢抚之，谓异祖昭之曰： 此儿非常器，当成卿门户。 年十余岁，好群聚蒲博，颇为乡党所患。 既长，乃折节从师，遍治《五经》，尤明《礼》、《易》，涉猎文史，兼通杂艺，博弈书算，皆其所长。 年二十，诣都，尚书令沈约面试之，因戏异曰： 卿年少，何乃不廉？ 异逡巡未达其旨。 约乃曰： 天下唯有文义棋书，卿一时将去，可谓不廉也。 其年，上书言建康宜置狱司，比廷尉。敕付尚书详议，从之。 旧制，年二十五方得释褐。 时异适二十一，特敕擢为扬州议曹从事史。 寻有诏求异能之士，《五经》博士明山宾表荐异曰： 窃见钱唐硃异，年时尚少，德备老成。在独无散逸之想，处暗有对宾之色，器宇弘深，神表峰峻。
target_text: Zhu Yi, courtesy name Yanhe, was from Qiantang, Wu County. His father, Zhu Xun, served as an official in the Qi Dynasty. As a child, Zhu Yi was fond of gambling and was disliked by his community. In his youth, he reformed his habits, studied the Five Classics—especially the "Li" and "Yi"—and became skilled in literature, history, chess, calligraphy, and arithmetic. At age twenty, he went to the capital, where Shen Yue interviewed him and remarked on his diverse talents. Despite the rule that officials must be at least twenty-five, Zhu Yi was appointed at twenty-one as Yangzhou Councilor due to an imperial exception. Doctor Mingshan of the Five Classics recommended him, praising his moral character and intellect. Emperor Gaozu summoned Zhu Yi to explain the "Book of Filial Piety" and the "Book of Changes," was pleased, and appointed him to the Western Province and later as a doctor of Imperial College. He rose through various posts, including Hongluqing and prince's right guard.

input_text: 并抑而不奏，故朝廷不为之备。 及寇至，城内文武咸尤之。 皇太子又制《围城赋》，其末章云： 彼高冠及厚履，并鼎食而乘肥，升紫霄之丹地，排玉殿之金扉，陈谋谟之启沃，宣政刑之福威，四郊以之多垒，万邦以之未绥。 问豺狼其何者？ 访虺蜴之为谁？ 盖以指异。 异因惭愤，发病卒，时年六十七。 方赞朝经，永申寄任。奄先物化，恻悼兼怀。 可赠侍中、尚书右仆射，给秘器一具。 凶事所须，随由资办。 旧尚书官不以为赠，及异卒，高祖惜之，方议赠事。左右有善异者，乃启曰： 异忝历虽多，然平生所怀，愿得执法。 高祖因其宿志，特有此赠焉。 异居权要三十余年，善窥人主意曲，能阿谀以承上旨，故特被宠任。 历官自员外常侍至侍中，四官皆珥貂，自右卫率至领军，四职并驱卤簿，近代未之有也。
target_text: In the fifth year of the Ordinary Period, during a northern expedition, Yuan Faseng of the Northern Wei sought to surrender. Zhu Yi confirmed the sincerity of the surrender, and Emperor Gaozu placed him in command. After Zhou She's death, Zhu Yi managed court affairs, military appointments, and imperial edicts. He was known for his efficiency in handling documents. In the sixth year of Datong, he lectured on the "Laozi Yi" to over a thousand listeners. He later served as a servant and general. When Hou Jing surrendered, Zhu Yi advised Emperor Gaozu to accept him, citing a dream of unification. Despite warnings from officials like Xie Li, the emperor followed Zhu Yi's advice. Hou Jing later rebelled, blaming Zhu Yi, who raised troops to defend the capital. Zhu Yi had suppressed earlier reports of Hou Jing's conspiracy, leading to the city's siege. The crown prince's poem criticized Zhu Yi, who fell ill and died at sixty-seven. Emperor Gaozu mourned him deeply and granted posthumous honors. Zhu Yi held power for over thirty years, was skilled at flattering the emperor, and amassed wealth through gifts. He was stingy, never sharing with others, and wrote over 100 works, many lost in war.

input_text: 异及诸子自潮沟列宅至青溪，其中有台池玩好，每暇日与宾客游焉。 四方所馈，财货充积。 性吝啬，未尝有散施。 厨下珍羞腐烂，每月常弃十数车，虽诸子别房亦不分赡。 所撰《礼》、《易》讲疏及仪注、文集百余篇，乱中多亡逸。 长子肃，官至国子博士；次子闰，司徒掾。 并遇乱卒。 贺琛，字国宝，会稽山阴人也。 伯父蒨，步兵校尉，为世硕儒。 琛幼，蒨授其经业，一闻便通义理。 蒨异之，常曰： 此儿当以明经致贵。 蒨卒后，琛家贫，常往还诸暨，贩粟以自给。 闲则习业，尤精《三礼》。 初，蒨于乡里聚徒教授，至是又依琛焉。 普通中，刺史临川王辟为祭酒从事史。 琛始出都，高祖闻其学术，召见文德殿，与语悦之，谓仆射徐勉曰： 琛殊有世业。 仍补王国侍郎，俄兼太学博士，稍迁中卫参军事、尚书通事舍人，参礼仪事。 累迁通直正员郎，舍人如故。 又征西鄱阳王中录事，兼尚书左丞，满岁为真。 诏琛撰《新谥法》，至今施用。
target_text: He Chen, courtesy name Guobao, was from Shanyin. His uncle He Chang taught him Confucian classics, and he excelled in the "Three Rites." After He Chang's death, He Chen sold millet to support himself. He later taught economics and was summoned by the governor of Linchuan. Emperor Gaozu appointed him as a minister and doctor of Taixue. He Chen compiled the "New Mi Law" and debated ritual matters, such as whether one could marry during mourning. He argued that rituals should not interfere with mourning, and his views were accepted. He served as a regular attendant and censor, but was dismissed for buying the princess's house. He later held various posts, including Huangmen minister and Guozi doctor. He Chen was known for his elegant demeanor and was called "He Ya" in the palace. He submitted a sealed memorial criticizing current affairs, including the decline in household registrations due to corrupt officials, extravagant feasts and entertainments, and the need for frugality. He also criticized the emperor's reliance on flattering officials and the waste of resources. Emperor Gaozu responded angrily, defending his own frugality and questioning He Chen's claims. He Chen apologized and did not criticize again. He later served as Taifuqing and general. During Hou Jing's rebellion, He Chen was captured and forced to persuade officials to surrender. He fled home after Taicheng fell but was recaptured and appointed as Doctor Jin Ziguanglu. He died at sixty-nine, leaving over 100 chapters of works.

input_text: 久之，迁太府卿。 太清二年，迁云骑将军、中军宣城王长史。 侯景举兵袭京师，王移入台内，留琛与司马杨曒守东府。 贼寻攻陷城，放兵杀害，琛被枪未至死，贼求得之，轝至阙下，求见仆射王克、领军硃异，劝开城纳贼。 克等让之，涕泣而止，贼复轝送庄严寺疗治之。 明年，台城不守，琛逃归乡里。 其年冬，贼进寇会稽，复执琛送出都，以为金紫光禄大夫。 后遇疾卒，年六十九。 琛所撰《三礼讲疏》、《五经滞义》及诸仪法，凡百余篇。 子诩，太清初，自仪同西昌侯掾，出为巴山太守，在郡遇乱卒。 陈吏部尚书姚察云：夏侯胜有言曰： 士患不明经术；经术明，取青紫如拾地芥耳。 硃异、贺琛并起微贱，以经术逢时，致于贵显，符其言矣。 而异遂徼宠幸，任事居权，不能以道佐君，苟取容媚。 及延寇败国，实异之由。
target_text: Yao Cha commented that Zhu Yi and He Chen rose from humble backgrounds through their knowledge of Confucian classics. However, Zhu Yi's flattery and failure to assist the emperor properly led to national disaster. Despite his guilt, he received special favors after death, which Yao Cha criticized as unjust governance.

input_text: 孔休源江革孔休源，字庆绪，会稽山阴人也。 晋丹阳太守冲之八世孙。 曾祖遥之，宋尚书水部郎。 父珮，齐庐陵王记室参军，早卒。 休源年十一而孤，居丧尽礼，每见父手所写书，必哀恸流涕，不能自胜，见者莫不为之垂泣。 后就吴兴沈驎士受经，略通大义。 建武四年，州举秀才，太尉徐孝嗣省其策，深善之，谓同坐曰： 董仲舒、华令思何以尚此，可谓后生之准也。 观其此对，足称王佐之才。 琅邪王融雅相友善，乃荐之于司徒竟陵王，为西邸学士。 梁台建，与南阳刘之遴同为太学博士，当时以为美选。 休源初到京，寓于宗人少府卿孔登宅，曾以祠事入庙，侍中范云一与相遇，深加褒赏，曰： 不期忽觏清颜，顿袪鄙吝，观天披雾，验之今日。 后云命驾到少府门，登便拂筵整带，谓当诣己，既而独造休源，高谈尽日，同载还家，登深以为愧。 尚书令沈约当朝贵显，轩盖盈门，休源或时后来，必虚襟引接，处之坐右，商略文义。 其为通人所推如此。
target_text: Kong Xiuyuan, courtesy name Qingxu, was from Shanyin, Kuaiji, and a descendant of Jin Dynasty official Kong Chong. Orphaned at eleven, he strictly observed mourning rites and was deeply moved by his father's handwriting. He studied Confucian classics under Xuan Diezao in Wuxing. In the fourth year of Jianwu, his policy essays impressed Taiwei Tu Cunqi, who compared him favorably to Dong Zhongshu and Hua Lingsi. Wang Rong of Longxie recommended him as a bachelor of Xili to King Situ Jingling. Upon arriving in the capital, he stayed with Minister Kong Deng, where Attendant Fan Yun praised him highly. Later, when Renzhao prepared a banquet expecting many guests, he visited only Xiuyuan, causing Kong Deng shame. Shangshu Ling Shen Yue, a powerful court figure, received Xiuyuan humbly and seated him at his right to discuss literature.

input_text: 俄除临川王府行参军。 高祖尝问吏部尚书徐勉曰： 今帝业初基，须一人有学艺解朝仪者，为尚书仪曹郎。 为朕思之，谁堪其选？ 勉对曰： 孔休源识具清通，谙练故实，自晋、宋《起居注》诵略上口。 高祖亦素闻之，即日除兼尚书仪曹郎中。 是时多所改作，每逮访前事，休源即以所诵记随机断决，曾无疑滞。 吏部郎任昉常谓之为 孔独诵 。 迁建康狱正，及辨讼折狱，时罕冤人。 后有选人为狱司者，高祖尚引休源以励之。 除中书舍人，司徒临川王府记室参军，迁尚书左丞，弹肃礼闱，雅允朝望。 时太子詹事周舍撰《礼疑义》，自汉魏至于齐梁，并皆搜采，休源所有奏议，咸预编录。 除给事黄门侍郎，迁长兼御史中丞，正色直绳，无所回避，百僚莫不惮之。 除少府卿，又兼行丹阳尹事。
target_text: Xiuyuan was appointed Prince of Linchuan's army adjutant. During Emperor Gaozu's reign, Xu Mian recommended him as Minister Cao Lang for his knowledge of Jin and Song court rituals. He served as Doctor Cao and Minister of Book Yi, answering historical questions from memory without hesitation. Renfang, an official, called him "Kong Dusong." He moved to Kangyuanzheng, where he judged cases fairly. Later, as Zhongshu Sheren and Zuocheng, he rectified the Shangshu Province. He compiled "The Book of Rites" with Prince Zhan Shizhou She, including his own memorials. As Shilang of Huangmen and Censor Zhongcheng, he enforced laws strictly, intimidating officials. He served as Shaofu Qing and Danyang Yin, then as chief historian of Xuanhui Jin'an Palace and Prefect of Nanjun, overseeing Jingzhou. Emperor Gaozu entrusted his young son to him, comparing him to Zhou Chang. Xiuyuan served with distinction, rejecting favor-seeking. He later held posts including Standing Attendant, Yulin Supervisor, and Secretary Supervisor. King Jin'an reserved a special seat for him. In the seventh year of the ordinary year, he became Governor of Yangzhou after Wang Hong's death, praised for his talent and knowledge. In the second year of Zhongdatong, he was awarded Doctor Jin Ziguanglu. He died in May at sixty-four, mourned by Emperor Gaozu, who granted posthumous honors and a frugal burial. His collection included over 7,000 volumes and fifteen volumes of impeachment proceedings.

input_text: 徙仁威庐陵王长史，太守、行事如故，以清严为百城所惮。 时少王行事多倾意于签帅，革以正直自居，不与签帅等同坐。 俄迁左光禄大夫、南平王长史、御史中丞，弹奏豪权，一无所避。 除少府卿，出为贞威将军、北中郎南康王长史、广陵太守，改授镇北豫章王长史，将军、太守如故。 时魏徐州刺史元法僧降附，革被敕随府王镇彭城。 城既失守，革素不便马，乃泛舟而还，途经下邳，遂为魏人所执。 魏徐州刺史元延明闻革才名，厚加接待。革称患脚不拜，延明将加害焉，见革辞色严正，更相敬重。 时祖芃同被拘执，延明使芃作《欹器》、《漏刻铭》，革骂芃曰： 卿荷国厚恩，已无报答，今乃为虏立铭，孤负朝廷。 延明闻之，乃令革作丈八寺碑并祭彭祖文，革辞以囚执既久，无复心思。 延明逼之逾苦，将加箠扑。 革厉色而言曰： 江革行年六十，不能杀身报主，今日得死为幸，誓不为人执笔。 延明知不可屈，乃止。 日给脱粟三升，仅余性命。 值魏主讨中山王元略反北，乃放革及祖芃还朝。 诏曰： 前贞威将军、镇北长史、广陵太守江革，才思通赡，出内有闻，在朝正色，临危不挠，首佐台铉，实允佥谐。 可太尉临川王长史。 时高祖盛于佛教，朝贤多启求受戒，革精信因果，而高祖未知，谓革不奉佛教，乃赐革《觉意诗》五百字，云 惟当勤精进，自强行胜修；岂可作底突，如彼必死囚。 以此告江革，并及诸贵游。 又手敕云： 世间果报，不可不信，岂得底突如对元延明邪？ 革因启乞受菩萨戒。 重除少府卿、长史、校尉。
target_text: Jiang Ge, courtesy name Xiuying, was from Kaocheng, Jiyang. His father died when he was nine, and his mother when he was sixteen, after which he and his brother Jiang Guan studied at Taixue, excelling. Wang Rong and Xie Chui respected them. Once, Ji Ji saw Jiang Ge studying in ragged clothes during a snowstorm and gave him half a felt. King Situ Jingling made him a bachelor. At twenty, he was elected a scholar in Xuzhou. He served as an official, with Pu She Jiang Zhe introducing him. He kept his role in handling imperial edicts secret, avoiding implication in Liao Tuo's death. In the first year of Zhongxing, Emperor Gaozu appreciated his impromptu letter to Yuan Ang. He served under King Jian'an in Yongzhou, but his brother Jiang Guan died en route. He held various posts, including Zhongshu Sheren and Yushi Zhongcheng, impeaching the powerful. During a Wei invasion, he was captured but refused to write inscriptions for the enemy, even under threat of beating. He was given three liters of millet daily. Emperor Gaozu later praised his integrity and appointed him to high offices. As governor of Dongzhou, he refused gifts, handled cases efficiently, and punished corruption. He left office with only a small boat, using stones for ballast. In Wu County, he quelled thieves through kindness. He served as Minister of Ren Duzhi, supporting commoners and juniors. He died in February of the first year of Datong, leaving a collection of twenty volumes. He served eight palaces and four kings without acquiring concubines, living frugally. His sons Xingmin and Cong Jian died early, the latter killed by Hou Jing's rebels. The historian noted that Emperor Gaozu valued Kong Xiuyuan's insights, while Jiang Ge was known for his intelligence and straightforwardness.

input_text: 殿中郎缺，高祖谓徐勉曰： 此曹旧用文学，且居鹓行之首，宜详择其人。 勉举缅充选。 顷之，出为武陵太守，还拜太子洗马，中舍人。 缅母刘氏，以父没家贫，葬礼有阙，遂终身不居正室，不随子入官府。 缅在郡所得禄俸不敢用，乃至妻子不易衣裳，及还都，并供其母赈赡亲属，虽累载所畜，一朝随尽，缅私室常阒然如贫素者。 累迁北中郎谘议参军、宁远长史。 出为豫章内史。 缅为政任恩惠，不设钩距，吏人化其德，亦不敢欺，故老咸云 数十年未之有也 。 大通元年，征为司徒左长史，以疾不拜，改为太子中庶子，领羽林监。 俄迁御史中丞，坐收捕人与外国使斗，左降黄门郎，兼领先职，俄复为真。 缅居宪司，推绳无所顾望，号为劲直。高祖乃遣画工图其形于台省，以励当官。 中太通三年，迁侍中，未拜，卒，时年四十二。 诏赠侍中，加贞威将军，侯如故。
target_text: Zhang Mian, also known as Yuan Chang, was the son of General Hong Ce. As a child, his maternal grandfather Liu Zhongde recognized his exceptional nature, declaring him a noble person of the Zhang family. During the Qi Dynasty's Yongyuan period, when his father followed Gaozu to war, ten-year-old Zhang Mian was left in Xiangyang, where his emotions mirrored the army's victories and defeats. After his father was killed by demon thieves in the first year of Tianjian, Zhang Mian mourned excessively, beyond normal rituals. Upon completing mourning, he inherited the title of Marquis of Taoyang County. At eighteen, he was appointed governor of Huainan. Concerned about his youth, his superior sent a master to evaluate him but was impressed by his appropriate decisions. Returning to the capital, he served as Prince Sheren and later as a foreign soldier joining the army. Zhang Mian studied diligently, mastered required readings, and wrote extensively, clearly critiquing various academic schools. He answered guests' questions without omission. When a palace position became vacant, the chief minister recommended Zhang Mian for his literary talent. He later served as prefect of Wuling and Prince Xima. His mother Liu Ya, due to his father's poor burial, never lived as the main wife or in official residences. Zhang Mian did not use his salary for personal gain, giving it all to his mother, leaving his household as frugal as a poor family. He was promoted to Beizhonglang and served as internal history of Yuzhang, governing with favor and without suspicion, inspiring officials and people not to commit fraud. Elders noted no such governance in decades. In the first year of Datong, he was summoned as Situ Zuo Changshi but declined due to illness, later becoming the prince's concubine and Yulin Supervisor. He was moved to Yushi Zhongcheng but demoted for arresting people and fighting with foreign envoys. As imperial censor, he was fearless and upright, prompting Gaozu to have his portrait painted to encourage officials. In the third year of Zhongdatong, he was moved to serve as a minister but died at forty-two. Gaozu wept bitterly, and Prince Zhaoming mourned, praising Zhang Mian's knowledge and official skills in a letter to his brother. Zhang Mian loved classical books, collecting over 10,000 volumes, and compiled "Hou Han Ji" and "Jin Chao" along with "Jiangzuo Collection," though unfinished. His son Fu inherited his title.

input_text: 累迁太尉谘议参军，尚书吏部郎，俄为长史兼侍中，时人以为早达。 河东裴子野曰： 张吏部在喉舌之任，已恨其晚矣。 子野性旷达，自云 年出三十，不复诣人。 初未与缵遇，便虚相推重，因为忘年之交。 大通元年，出为宁远华容公长史，行琅邪、彭城二郡国事。 二年，仍迁华容公北中郎长史、南兰陵太守，加贞威将军，行府州事。 三年，入为度支尚书，母忧去职。 服阕，出为吴兴太守。 缵治郡，省烦苛，务清静，民吏便之。 大同二年，征为吏部尚书。 缵居选，其后门寒素，有一介皆见引拔，不为贵要屈意，人士翕然称之。 五年，高祖手诏曰： 缵外氏英华，朝中领袖，司空以后，名冠范阳。 可尚书仆射。 初，缵与参掌何敬容意趣不协，敬容居权轴，宾客辐凑，有过诣缵者，辄距不前，曰： 吾不能对何敬容残客。 及是迁，为表曰： 自出守股肱，入尸衡尺，可以仰首伸眉，论列是非者矣。 而寸衿所滞，近蔽耳目，深浅清浊，岂有能预。 加以矫心饰貌，酷非所闲，不喜俗人，与之共事。
target_text: Zhang Zan, courtesy name Boxu, was Zhang Mian's third brother, adopted by his uncle Hong Ji. At eleven, he married Princess Fuyang, Emperor Gaozu's fourth daughter, becoming Prince Consort Duwei. At seventeen, he was recruited as a secretary. Standing seven feet four inches tall with handsome features, Gaozu found him remarkable. Zhang Zan was eager to learn, reading his brother's vast collection day and night. As one of four Secretary Langs, he firmly requested not to move positions to read all books in the pavilion. He was later moved to Prince Sheren and then Xima and Zhongsheren, managing records. He was as famous as Wang Xi. In the early Tongren years, Northern Wei's Liu Shanming admired him greatly. Zhang Zan was promoted to Taiwei and Minister of Libu Lang, becoming commander and minister at a young age. Pei Ziye praised him as a mouthpiece but regretted his late appointment. In the first year of Datong, he served as official historian of Ningyuan Huarong and managed Langye and Pengcheng counties. He later became Huarong Gongbeizhonglang Changshi and Mu Lanling prefect. In the third year, he entered the court as minister of the branch but resigned when his mother died. After mourning, he became prefect of Wuxing, simplifying administration for the people's convenience. In the second year of Datong, he was recruited as Minister of the Ministry of Personnel, promoting upright people without changing for the powerful. In the fifth year, Gaozu praised him as the leader of the imperial court. Zhang Zan had conflicts with He Jingrong, refusing to treat his guests. In office, he proposed suitable ancient and modern reforms for court uniforms. In the ninth year, he was transferred to General Xuanhui and Danyang Yin but was appointed as envoy Chijie and governor Yu Guasai. On his way, he wrote "Ode to the Southern Expedition," reflecting on his journey, governance, and historical reflections. He managed Xiangzhou effectively, increasing household registration by over 100,000 and bringing peace. In the second year of Taiqing, he was recruited as leader and later as governor of multiple regions. He had conflicts with Xiao Shu and Xiao Yu, leading to his arrest and forced shaving as a Taoist priest. He was killed at fifty-one. Emperor Yuan posthumously honored him as Jian Xian Gong. Zhang Zan wrote one hundred volumes of "Hongbao" and twenty volumes of collected works. His son Zhang Wang married Princess Haiyan.

input_text: 十年，复为御史中丞，加通直散骑常侍。 绾再为宪司，弹纠无所回避，豪右惮之。 是时城西开士林馆聚学者，绾与右卫硃异、太府卿贺琛递述《制旨礼记中庸》义。 太清二年，迁左卫将军。 会侯景寇至，入守东掖门。 三年，迁吏部尚书。 宫城陷，绾出奔，外转至江陵。湘东王承制，授侍中、左卫将军、相国长史，侍中如故。 出为持节、云麾将军、湘东内史。 承圣二年，征为尚书右仆射，寻加侍中。 明年，江陵陷，朝士皆俘入关，绾以疾免，后卒于江陵，时年六十三。 次子交，字少游，颇涉文学，选尚太宗第十一女安阳公主。 承圣二年，官至太子洗马，秘书丞，掌东宫管记。
target_text: Zhang Wan, courtesy name Xiaoqing, was Zhang Zan's fourth brother. Excelling in shooting as a first-year student, he was recruited as chief and secretary, later moving to Prince Sheren and other roles. He was promoted to Zhongshu Lang and Doctor of Guozi, serving as Lang Changshi of Beizhong and Grand Administrator of Lanling. During the Han Dynasty, he managed Danyang Yin's affairs due to Xiao Yuanzao's illness. He moved to Zhongcheng, where Gaozu praised his legal uprightness. In the fourth year of Datong, he and his brother Zhang Zan served as servants, an unprecedented situation praised by contemporaries. He became internal history of Yuzhang, lecturing on "The Right Statement of the Book of Rites" to hundreds. In the eighth year, when Liu Jinggong held Ao Dao hostage, Zhang Wan ignored advice to flee, built defenses, recruited over 10,000 brave men, and pacified the thieves with Wang Sengbian's help. Ten years later, he again served as censor Zhongcheng, unstoppable and feared by the powerful. He opened a scholar's hall in the city. In the second year of Taiqing, he was promoted to Zuowei General, guarding Shuye Gate during Hou Jing's invasion. Three years later, he became Minister of the Ministry of Personnel. After the palace fell, he fled to Jiangling, where King Xiangshu granted him titles. He served as Chijie and Internal History of Eastern Hunan. In the second year of Chengsheng, he was recruited as Minister Youpushe and later Shizhong. When Jiangling fell, he survived due to illness and died at sixty-three. His son Zhang Jiao married Princess Anyang. Yao Cha commented that during the Taiqing period, Zhang Zan's personal grudges led to discord among kings, contributing to the Liang Dynasty's chaos.

input_text: 王茂曹景宗柳庆远 王茂，字休远，太原祁人也。祖深，北中郎司马。 父天生，宋末为列将，于石头克司徒袁粲，以勋至巴西、梓潼二郡太守，上黄县男。 茂年数岁，为大父深所异，常谓亲识曰： 此吾家之千里驹，成门户者必此儿也。 及长，好读兵书，驳略究其大旨。 性沈隐，不妄交游，身长八尺，洁白美容观。 齐武帝布衣时，见之叹曰： 王茂年少，堂堂如此，必为公辅之器。 宋升明末，起家奉朝请，历后军行参军，司空骑兵，太尉中兵参军。 魏将李乌奴寇汉中，茂受诏西讨。 魏军退，还为镇南司马，带临湘令。 入为越骑校尉。 魏寇兗州，茂时以宁朔将军长史镇援北境，入为前军将军江夏王司马。 又迁宁朔将军、江夏内史。
target_text: Wang Mao, courtesy name Xiuyuan, was born in Qi, Taiyuan. His grandfather Wang Shen served as Beizhonglang Sima, and his father served as a general in the late Song Dynasty, defeating Situ Yuancan at Shitou and becoming prefect of Brazil and Zitong counties. As a child, Wang Mao was valued by his grandfather, who predicted he would establish the family. He grew to eight feet tall with a white and beautiful face, calm and reserved by nature, and fond of military books.

input_text: 王茂曹景宗柳庆远 王茂，字休远，太原祁人也。祖深，北中郎司马。 父天生，宋末为列将，于石头克司徒袁粲，以勋至巴西、梓潼二郡太守，上黄县男。 茂年数岁，为大父深所异，常谓亲识曰： 此吾家之千里驹，成门户者必此儿也。 及长，好读兵书，驳略究其大旨。 性沈隐，不妄交游，身长八尺，洁白美容观。 齐武帝布衣时，见之叹曰： 王茂年少，堂堂如此，必为公辅之器。 宋升明末，起家奉朝请，历后军行参军，司空骑兵，太尉中兵参军。 魏将李乌奴寇汉中，茂受诏西讨。 魏军退，还为镇南司马，带临湘令。 入为越骑校尉。 魏寇兗州，茂时以宁朔将军长史镇援北境，入为前军将军江夏王司马。 又迁宁朔将军、江夏内史。
target_text: During the late Song and Ming Dynasties, Wang Mao served in various military positions. When Wei general Li Wunu invaded, Wang Mao marched westward. After the Wei army retreated, he served as Sima of Zhennan and later as Yue Cavalry School captain. When Wei invaded Yanzhou, he served as General Shi of Ningshuo. In the early Jianwu years, he rescued Sizhou from Wei siege and followed Gaozu to defeat Wei generals. After the Wei retreat, he became chief minister of the auxiliary state and governor of Xiangyang.

input_text: 建武初，魏围司州，茂以郢州之师救焉。 高祖率众先登贤首山，魏将王肃、刘昶来战，茂从高祖拒之，大破肃等。 魏军退，茂还郢，仍迁辅国长史、襄阳太守。 高祖义师起，茂私与张弘策劝高祖迎和帝，高祖以为不然，语在《高祖纪》。 高祖发雍部，每遣茂为前驱。 师次郢城，茂进平加湖，破光子衿、吴子阳等，斩馘万计，还献捷于汉川。 郢、鲁既平，从高祖东下，复为军锋。 师次秣陵，东昏遣大将王珍国，盛兵硃雀门，众号二十万，度航请战。 茂与曹景宗等会击，大破之。 纵兵追奔，积尸与航栏等，其赴淮死者，不可胜算。 长驱至宣阳门。 建康城平，以茂为护军将军，俄迁侍中、领军将军。 群盗之烧神虎门也，茂率所领到东掖门应赴，为盗所射，茂跃马而进，群盗反走。 茂以不能式遏奸盗，自表解职，优诏不许。 加镇军将军，封望蔡县公，邑二千三百户。 是岁，江州刺史陈伯之举兵叛，茂出为使持节、散骑常侍、都督江州诸军事、征南将军、江州刺史，给鼓吹一部，南讨伯之。 伯之奔于魏。 时九江新罹军寇，民思反业，茂务农省役，百姓安之。 四年，魏侵汉中，茂受诏西讨，魏乃班师。
target_text: When Emperor Gaozu raised a righteous army, Wang Mao consulted with Zhang Hongce about welcoming Emperor He, but Gaozu disagreed. Wang Mao served as vanguard, pacifying Jiahu and defeating Guangzijin and Wu Ziyang, beheading tens of thousands. After Jiankang City was pacified, he became general guarding the army, then Shizhong and leading general. He was granted the title of Duke of Wangcai County with 2,300 households. In the first year of the Han Dynasty, he conquered the rebellious Chen Bozhi. He later served as right servant of Shangshu, general of chariots and cavalry, and Kaifu Yitong Sansi. He died at sixty, receiving posthumous honors and the title Zhonglie.

input_text: 俄而病，少日卒。 子贞秀嗣，以居丧无礼，为有司奏，徙越州。后有诏留广州，乃潜结仁威府中兵参军杜景，欲袭州城，刺史萧昂讨之。 景，魏降人，与贞秀同戮。 曹景宗，字子震，新野人也。 父欣之，为宋将，位至征虏将军、徐州刺史。 景宗幼善骑射，好畋猎。常与少年数十人泽中逐麞鹿，每众骑赴鹿，鹿马相乱，景宗于众中射之，人皆惧中马足，鹿应弦辄毙，以此为乐。 未弱冠，欣之于新野遣出州，以匹马将数人，于中路卒逢蛮贼数百围之。 景宗带百余箭，乃驰骑四射，每箭杀一蛮，蛮遂散走，因是以胆勇知名。 颇爱史书，每读《穰苴》、《乐毅传》，辄放卷叹息曰： 丈夫当如是！ 辟西曹不就。
target_text: Cao Jingzong, courtesy name Zizhen, was a new savage. His father Cao Xinzhi was a military general in the Song Dynasty. Young Cao Jingzong excelled at horseback archery and hunting. At twenty, while traveling alone with few followers, he was surrounded by hundreds of barbarians but fought them off with arrows, gaining fame for courage. He loved reading history books, particularly admiring Rang Ju and Le Yi.

input_text: 建武二年，魏主托跋宏寇赭阳，景宗为偏将，每冲坚陷阵，辄有斩获，以勋除游击将军。 四年，太尉陈显达督众军北围马圈，景宗从之，以甲士二千设伏，破魏援托跋英四万人。 及克马圈，显达论功，以景宗为后，景宗退无怨言。 魏主率众大至，显达宵奔，景宗导入山道，故显达父子获全。 五年，高祖为雍州刺史，景宗深自结附，数请高祖临其宅。 时天下方乱，高祖亦厚加意焉。 永元初，表为冠军将军、竟陵太守。 及义师起，景宗聚众，遣亲人杜思冲劝先迎南康王于襄阳即帝位，然后出师，为万全计。 高祖不从，语在《高祖纪》。 高祖至竟陵，以景宗与冠军将军王茂济江，围郢城，自二月至于七月，城乃降。 复帅众前驱至南州，领马步军取建康。 道次江宁，东昏将李居士以重兵屯新亭，是日选精骑一千至江宁行顿，景宗始至，安营未立；且师行日久，器甲穿弊，居士望而轻之，因鼓噪前薄景宗。 景宗被甲驰战，短兵裁接，居士弃甲奔走，景宗皆获之，因鼓而前，径至皁荚桥筑垒。景宗又与王茂、吕僧珍掎角，破王珍国于大航。 茂冲其中坚，应时而陷，景宗纵兵乘之。 景宗军士皆桀黠无赖，御道左右，莫非富室，抄掠财物，略夺子女，景宗不能禁。
target_text: During the Southern Qi Dynasty, Cao Jingzong served as prefect of Tianshui and fought against barbarian uprisings. He showed loyalty by retrieving the body of his friend Zhang Daomen after Zhang's father was killed. In the Jianwu years, he fought against Northern Wei invasions, defeating Tuoba Ying's 40,000 reinforcements with 2,000 ambush soldiers. He became close friends with Xiao Yan (Emperor Wu of Liang) when Xiao served as governor of Yongzhou.

input_text: 及高祖入顿新城，严申号令，然后稍息。 复与众军长围六门。 城平，拜散骑常侍、右卫将军，封湘西县侯，食邑一千六百户。 仍迁持节、都督郢、司二州诸军事、左将军、郢州刺史。 天监元年，进号平西将军，改封竟陵县侯。 景宗在州，鬻货聚敛。于城南起宅，长堤以东，夏口以北，开街列门，东西数里，而部曲残横，民颇厌之。 二年十月，魏寇司州，围刺史蔡道恭。 时魏攻日苦，城中负板而汲，景宗望门不出，但耀军游猎而已。 及司州城陷，为御史中丞任昉所奏。高祖以功臣寝而不治，征为护军。 既至，复拜散骑常侍、右卫将军。 五年，魏托跋英寇钟离，围徐州刺史昌义之。高祖诏景宗督众军援义之，豫州刺史韦睿亦预焉，而受景宗节度。 诏景宗顿道人洲，待众军齐集俱进。 景宗固启，求先据邵阳洲尾，高祖不听。 景宗欲专其功，乃违诏而进，值暴风卒起，颇有淹溺，复还守先顿。 高祖闻之，曰： 此所以破贼也。景宗不进，盖天意乎！ 若孤军独往，城不时立，必见狼狈。
target_text: When Emperor Wu raised troops, Cao Jingzong gathered his forces and served as vanguard, besieging Yingcheng for months until surrender. He advanced toward Jiankang, defeating Li Jushi at Jiangning despite his troops' worn equipment. After the city fell, he was made Marquis of Xiangxi County with 1,600 households. In the Tianjian years, he was promoted to General Pingxi and Marquis of Jingling County. During the Northern Wei invasion of Sizhou, he was impeached for not sending timely rescue but was protected by Emperor Wu.

input_text: 六年三月，春水生，淮水暴长六七尺。 睿遣所督将冯道根、李文钊、裴邃、韦寂等乘舰登岸，击魏洲上军尽殪。 景宗因使众军皆鼓噪乱登诸城，呼声震天地，大眼于西岸烧营，英自东岸弃城走。 诸垒相次土崩，悉弃其器甲，争投水死，淮水为之不流。 景宗令军主马广，蹑大眼至濊水上，四十余里，伏尸相枕。 义之出逐英至洛口，英以匹马入梁城。 缘淮百余里，尸骸枕藉，生擒五万余人，收其军粮器械，积如山岳，牛马驴骡，不可胜计。 景宗乃搜军所得生口万余人，马千匹，遣献捷，高祖诏还本军，景宗振旅凯入，增封四百，并前为二千户，进爵为公。 诏拜侍中、领军将军，给鼓吹一部。 景宗为人自恃尚胜，每作书，字有不解，不以问人，皆以意造焉。 虽公卿无所推揖；惟韦睿年长，且州里胜流，特相敬重，同宴御筵，亦曲躬谦逊，高祖以此嘉之。 景宗好内，妓妾至数百，穷极锦绣。
target_text: In the fifth year, when Tuoba Ying invaded Zhongli, Cao Jingzong led rescue forces. Despite imperial orders to wait, he attempted to advance alone but was turned back by storms. He eventually joined Wei Rui at Shaoyangzhou, building fortresses near Wei positions. In the sixth year, during spring floods, they launched a coordinated attack, burning Wei camps and causing massive casualties. Over 50,000 Wei soldiers were captured alive, with countless supplies seized. Cao Jingzong was promoted to Duke with 2,000 households.

input_text: 俄而病，少日卒。 子贞秀嗣，以居丧无礼，为有司奏，徙越州。后有诏留广州，乃潜结仁威府中兵参军杜景，欲袭州城，刺史萧昂讨之。 景，魏降人，与贞秀同戮。 曹景宗，字子震，新野人也。 父欣之，为宋将，位至征虏将军、徐州刺史。 景宗幼善骑射，好畋猎。常与少年数十人泽中逐麞鹿，每众骑赴鹿，鹿马相乱，景宗于众中射之，人皆惧中马足，鹿应弦辄毙，以此为乐。 未弱冠，欣之于新野遣出州，以匹马将数人，于中路卒逢蛮贼数百围之。 景宗带百余箭，乃驰骑四射，每箭杀一蛮，蛮遂散走，因是以胆勇知名。 颇爱史书，每读《穰苴》、《乐毅传》，辄放卷叹息曰： 丈夫当如是！ 辟西曹不就。
target_text: Cao Jingzong was self-reliant and proud, showing respect only to Wei Rui. He was a womanizer with hundreds of concubines, impatient and restless, fond of drinking and hunting. He died at fifty-two while traveling to assume the governorship of Jiangzhou.

input_text: 高祖之临雍州，问京兆人杜恽求州纲，恽举庆远。 高祖曰： 文和吾已知之，所问未知者耳。 因辟别驾从事史。 齐方多难，庆远谓所亲曰： 方今天下将乱，英雄必起，庇民定霸，其吾君乎？ 因尽诚协赞。 及义兵起，庆远常居帷幄为谋主。 中兴元年，西台选为黄门郎，迁冠军将军、征东长史。 从军东下，身先士卒。 高祖行营垒，见庆远顿舍严整，每叹曰： 人人若是，吾又何忧。 建康城平，入为侍中，领前军将军，带淮陵、齐昌二郡太守。 城内尝夜失火，禁中惊惧，高祖时居宫中，悉敛诸钥，问 柳侍中何在 。庆远至，悉付之。 其见任如此。 霸府建，以为太尉从事中郎。 高祖受禅，迁散骑常侍、右卫将军，加征虏将军，封重安侯，食邑千户。
target_text: Liu Qingyuan, named Wenhe, was born in Hedong Jie. He served as chief administrator of Yingzhou and prefect of Wei Xing, where he handled a flood wisely. Emperor Gaozu recruited him as a historian, and Qingyuan became a loyal strategist during Gaozu's rebellion. After Jiankang was pacified, he served as minister and was deeply trusted by Gaozu, who entrusted him with palace keys during a fire.

target_text: After Gaozu ascended the throne, Qingyuan became Marquis of Chong'an with 1,000 households. He served as governor of Yongzhou, where Emperor Gaozu praised him for eliminating western concerns. He later returned to Kyoto and served in various high positions. He died at fifty-seven while serving as governor of Yongzhou again, receiving posthumous honors and the title Zhonghui.

input_text: 重牧西籓，方弘治道，奄至殒丧，伤恸于怀。 宜追荣命，以彰茂勋。 可赠侍中、中军将军、开府仪同三司，鼓吹、侯如故。 谥曰忠惠。 赙钱二十万，布二百匹。 及丧还京师，高祖出临哭。 子津嗣。 初，庆远从父兄卫将军世隆尝谓庆远曰： 吾昔梦太尉以褥席见赐，吾遂亚台司，适又梦以吾褥席与汝，汝必光我公族。 至是，庆远亦继世隆焉。 陈吏部尚书姚察曰：王茂、曹景宗、柳庆远虽世为将家，然未显奇节。 梁兴，因日月末光，以成所志，配迹方、邵，勒勋钟鼎，伟哉！ 昔汉光武全爱功臣，不过朝请、特进，寇、邓、耿、贾咸不尽其器力。 茂等迭据方岳，位终上将，君臣之际，迈于前代矣。
target_text: Yao Cha commented that Wang Mao, Cao Jingzong, and Liu Qingyuan, though military leaders, achieved great success during the Liang Dynasty's rise, with their accomplishments recorded on bells and tripods. Unlike Emperor Guangwu of Han who limited his officials, these men were able to serve as local governors and reach high military positions, demonstrating superior monarch-minister relations.

input_text: 刘季连陈伯之 刘季连，字惠续，彭城人也。父思考，以宋高祖族弟显于宋世，位至金紫光禄大夫。季连有名誉，早历清官。 齐高帝受禅，悉诛宋室近属，将及季连等，太宰褚渊素善之，固请乃免。 建元中，季连为尚书左丞。 永明初，出为江夏内史，累迁平南长沙内史，冠军长史、广陵太守，并行府州事。 入为给事黄门侍郎，转太子中庶子。 建武中，又出为平西萧遥欣长史、南郡太守。 时明帝诸子幼弱，内亲则仗遥欣兄弟，外亲则倚后弟刘暄、内弟江祏。 遥欣之镇江陵也，意寄甚隆；而遥欣至州，多招宾客，厚自封殖，明帝甚恶之。 季连族甥琅邪王会为遥欣谘议参军，美容貌，颇才辩，遥欣遇之甚厚。 会多所慠忽，于公座与遥欣竞侮季连，季连憾之，乃密表明帝，称遥欣有异迹。明帝纳焉，乃以遥欣为雍州刺史。 明帝心德季连，四年，以为辅国将军、益州刺史，令据遥欣上流。 季连父，宋世为益州，贪鄙无政绩，州人犹以义故，善待季连。 季连下车，存问故老，抚纳新旧，见父时故吏，皆对之流涕。 辟遂宁人龚惬为府主簿。 惬，龚颖之孙，累世有学行，故引焉。 东昏即位，永元元年，征季连为右卫将军，道断不至。 季连闻东昏失德，京师多故，稍自骄矜。 本以文吏知名，性忌而褊狭，至是遂严愎酷狠，土人始怀怨望。 其年九月，季连因聚会，发人丁五千人，声以讲武，遂遣中兵参军宋买率之以袭中水。
target_text: Liu Ji, also known as Huixu, was from Pengcheng. His father, Liu Sisi, rose to prominence in the Song Dynasty as a younger brother of Emperor Gaozu, reaching the rank of Jin Ziguanglu. Liu Ji had a strong reputation and served as an upright official early on. After Emperor Qi Gao ascended the throne, he killed many Song relatives, but Liu Ji was spared due to the intervention of Grand Prime Minister Chu Yuan. During the Jianyuan period, Liu Ji became Minister Zuocheng. In the Yongming era, he held various posts, including internal history of Jiangxia and Guangling counties. Later, he served as Huangmen minister and prince's concubine. During the Jianwu period, he was long history of Xiao Yaoxin and prefect of Lu Su.

target_text: Liu Ji's nephew, Ji Xing, was handsome and eloquent, valued by Luwei, but his arrogance led to conflict with Xiao Yaoxin. Liu Ji secretly reported Xiao Yaoxin to Emperor Ming, who then appointed Xiao Yaoxin as governor of Yongzhou. Grateful, Emperor Ming made Liu Ji auxiliary general and governor of Yizhou. Liu Ji's father had been a greedy governor in Yizhou, but the people treated Liu Ji well. Upon taking office, Liu Ji comforted old officials and wept with them. He appointed Gong Sui as chief administrator.

target_text: In the first year of Yongyuan, Liu Ji was recruited as right guard general but did not take office due to road blockages. Hearing of Marquis Shuhun's moral decay, Liu Ji became proud and cruel, causing local resentment. In September, he gathered 5,000 men, claiming to practice martial arts, but sent them to attack Zhongshui. The battle was unfavorable, and many counties rebelled. In October, Le Shichun and Li Nandang killed their governor, with Le Shichun naming himself governor of Nan Qinzhou and Li Nandang governor of Yizhou. In December, Liu Ji sent Cui Maozu with 2,000 soldiers, but they were defeated due to cold and blocked roads, with seven to eight tenths dead.

input_text: 奉伯因独进巴西之东乡讨余贼。 李膺止之曰： 卒惰将骄，乘胜履险，非良策也。 不如小缓，更思后计。 奉伯不纳，悉众入山，大败而出，遂奔还州。 六月，江阳人程延期反，杀太守何法藏。 鲁休烈惧不自保，奔投巴东相萧慧训。 十月，巴西人赵续伯又反，有众二万，出广汉，乘佛舆，以五彩裹青石，诳百姓云： 天与我玉印，当王蜀。 愚人从之者甚众。 季连进讨之，遣长史赵越常前驱。 兵败，季连复遣李奉伯由涪路讨之。 奉伯别军自潺亭与大军会于城，进攻其栅，大破之。 时会稽人石文安字守休，隐居乡里，专行礼让，代季连为尚书左丞，出为江夏内史，又代季连入为御史中丞，与季连相善。
target_text: In the second year, further rebellions occurred. Yong Daoxi led 10,000 thieves to invade Brazil County, but was captured and beheaded by Lu Xiulie and Kui Lu. Li Fengbo pursued remaining thieves against advice and was defeated. In June, Cheng Yanyan rebelled and killed the prefect. In October, Zhao Xubo rebelled with 20,000 people, claiming divine mandate. Liu Ji defeated him with Zhao Yuetang and Li Fengbo. Later, Liu Ji's son, Liu Zhongse, responded to the Zhidan uprising.

input_text: 子仲渊字钦回，闻义师起，率乡人以应高祖。 天监初，拜郢州别驾，从高祖平京邑。 明年春，遣左右陈建孙送季连弟通直郎子渊及季连二子使蜀，喻旨慰劳。 季连受命，饬还装。 高祖以西台将邓元起为益州刺史。 元起，南郡人。 季连为南郡之时，素薄元起。 典签硃道琛者，尝为季连府都录，无赖小人，有罪，季连欲杀之，逃叛以免。 至是说元起曰： 益州乱离已久，公私府库必多秏失，刘益州临归空竭，岂办复能远遣候递。 道琛请先使检校，缘路奉迎；不然，万里资粮，未易可得。 元起许之。 道琛既至，言语不恭，又历造府州人士，见器物辄夺之，有不获者，语曰： 会当属人，何须苦惜。
target_text: In the spring of the next year, the emperor sent Chen Jiansun to escort Liu Ji's brother and sons, announcing the emperor's intent. Liu Ji prepared to return home. Emperor Gaozu appointed Deng Yuanqi as governor of Yiye. Deng Yuanqi, previously mistreated by Liu Ji, was advised by Zhu Daochen to check supplies first. Deng agreed. When Sai Dao arrived, he was disrespectful, causing panic. Liu Ji, fearing Deng would kill him, gathered troops again, killed Zhu Daochen, and summoned Li Ying and Zhu Shilue, who refused. Liu Ji killed Zhu Shilue's three sons.

input_text: 季连食粥累月，饥窘无计。 二年正月，高祖遣主书赵景悦宣诏降季连，季连肉袒请罪。 元起迁季连于城外，俄而造焉，待之以礼。 季连谢曰： 早知如此，岂有前日之事。 元起诛李奉伯并诸渠帅，送季连还京师。 季连将发，人莫之视，惟龚惬送焉。 初，元起在道，惧事不集，无以为赏，士之至者，皆许以辟命，于是受别驾、治中檄者，将二千人。 季连既至，诣阙谢，高祖引见之。 季连自东掖门入，数步一稽颡，以至高祖前。 高祖笑谓曰： 卿欲慕刘备而曾不及公孙述，岂无卧龙之臣乎。 季连复稽颡谢。 赦为庶人。 四年正月，因出建阳门，为蜀人蔺道恭所杀。 季连在蜀，杀道恭父，道恭出亡，至是而报复焉。
target_text: In June of the first year of Tianjian, Deng Yuanqi arrived in Brazil County. Liu Ji sent Li Fengbo to resist, but after a prolonged battle, Li Fengbo retreated to Chengdu. Deng Yuanqi surrounded the city. In winter, a plot to surrender failed, and Liu Ji killed the conspirators. After two years of chaos, food ran out, and people starved or resorted to cannibalism. Liu Ji drank gruel for months. In the first month of the second year, Emperor Gaozu sent Zhao Jingyue to order Liu Ji's surrender. Liu Ji surrendered, and Deng Yuanqi treated him with courtesy. Liu Ji was pardoned but demoted to civilian. In the first month of the fourth year, he was killed by Lin Daogong, whose father he had killed in Shu.

input_text: 王瞻，字思范，琅邪临沂人，宋太保弘从孙也。 祖柳，光禄大夫、东亭侯。 父猷，廷尉卿。 瞻年数岁，尝从师受业，时有伎经其门，同学皆出观，瞻独不视，习诵如初。 从父尚书仆射僧达闻而异之，谓瞻父曰： 吾宗不衰，寄之此子。 年十二，居父忧，以孝闻。 服阕，袭封东亭侯。 瞻幼时轻薄，好逸游，为闾里所患。 及长，颇折节有士操，涉猎书记，于棋射尤善。 起家著作佐郎，累迁太子舍人、太尉主簿、太子洗马。 顷之，出为鄱阳内史，秩满，授太子中舍人。 又为齐南海王友，寻转司徒竟陵王从事中郎，王甚相宾礼。 南海王为护军将军，瞻为长史。 又出补徐州别驾从事史，迁骠骑将军王晏长史。 晏诛，出为晋陵太守。 瞻洁己为政，妻子不免饥寒。 时大司马王敬则举兵作乱，路经晋陵，郡民多附敬则。军败，台军讨贼党，瞻言于朝曰： 愚人易动，不足穷法。 明帝许之，所全活者万数。 征拜给事黄门侍郎，抚军建安王长史，御史中丞。 高祖霸府开，以瞻为大司马相国谘议参军，领录事。 梁台建，为侍中，迁左民尚书，俄转吏部尚书。 瞻性率亮，居选部，所举多行其意。 颇嗜酒，每饮或竟日，而精神益朗赡，不废簿领。 高祖每称瞻有三术，射、棋、酒也。 寻加左军将军，以疾不拜，仍为侍中，领骁骑将军，未拜，卒，时年四十九。
target_text: Wang Zhan, courtesy name Sifan, was from Linyi, Langye, and was the grandson of Wang Hong. His grandfather, Wang Liu, served as Guanglu and the Marquis of Dongting. His father, Wang You, served as Tingweiqing. As a child, Wang Zhan was studious and did not go out to watch an artist pass by, which impressed his uncle. He was known for filial piety after his father's death at age twelve. As a young man, he was frivolous but later exercised self-restraint, becoming well-read and skilled in chess and archery. He held various official positions, including Zuo Lang, Prince Sheren, and internal history of Poyang. He served as a lieutenant for King Jingling, who respected him greatly. As prefect of Jinling, his administration was honest, and his family suffered from hunger and cold. When Wang Jingze rebelled, Wang Zhan advised Emperor Ming against punishing the many people who had followed him, saving tens of thousands. He later served as Minister of Huangmen and Libu Shangshu. He was straightforward in his recommendations and enjoyed drinking, which did not delay his work. Emperor Gaozu noted his three skills: shooting, chess, and drinking. He died at age forty-nine.

input_text: 王瞻，字思范，琅邪临沂人，宋太保弘从孙也。 祖柳，光禄大夫、东亭侯。 父猷，廷尉卿。 瞻年数岁，尝从师受业，时有伎经其门，同学皆出观，瞻独不视，习诵如初。 从父尚书仆射僧达闻而异之，谓瞻父曰： 吾宗不衰，寄之此子。 年十二，居父忧，以孝闻。 服阕，袭封东亭侯。 瞻幼时轻薄，好逸游，为闾里所患。 及长，颇折节有士操，涉猎书记，于棋射尤善。 起家著作佐郎，累迁太子舍人、太尉主簿、太子洗马。 顷之，出为鄱阳内史，秩满，授太子中舍人。 又为齐南海王友，寻转司徒竟陵王从事中郎，王甚相宾礼。 南海王为护军将军，瞻为长史。 又出补徐州别驾从事史，迁骠骑将军王晏长史。 晏诛，出为晋陵太守。 瞻洁己为政，妻子不免饥寒。 时大司马王敬则举兵作乱，路经晋陵，郡民多附敬则。军败，台军讨贼党，瞻言于朝曰： 愚人易动，不足穷法。 明帝许之，所全活者万数。 征拜给事黄门侍郎，抚军建安王长史，御史中丞。 高祖霸府开，以瞻为大司马相国谘议参军，领录事。 梁台建，为侍中，迁左民尚书，俄转吏部尚书。 瞻性率亮，居选部，所举多行其意。 颇嗜酒，每饮或竟日，而精神益朗赡，不废簿领。 高祖每称瞻有三术，射、棋、酒也。 寻加左军将军，以疾不拜，仍为侍中，领骁骑将军，未拜，卒，时年四十九。
target_text: Wang Jin, courtesy name silver carp, was the grandson of Tanzhi and son of Lu. At age nine, he mourned his biological mother with great sorrow. He married Princess Angu, daughter of Emperor Xiaowu of the Song Dynasty. He held various posts, including Prince Consort and Secretary Lang. As internal history of Xuanyue, he was honest and kind. When two men, Zhang Tan and Yu Qing, could not settle a land dispute for years, the elders shamed them into pleading guilty, and the land became wasteland. As prefect of Saichui, he released serious criminals on the winter solstice, and all but one returned. The man explained his delay was due to his wife's pregnancy, which increased the people's admiration. He was praised for his fairness in selecting officials. When the rebel army arrived and Donghunhou was killed, Wang Jin refused to sign the document presenting his head, saying a broken hat could not be worn on the feet. Emperor Gaozu praised him for this. He served as Danyang Yin, governing simply and without harsh decrees. He used his salary to repay a widow's debt for her mother-in-law's burial and gave porridge to the people during a famine. He was content as Zhongshu Ling and often complained of illness. He died at age fifty-four. He was skilled in cursive official script and was called the "Sage of Calligraphy" by Xu Xixiu. He was honest and kind, never impeaching others. When a guest stole his vehicle's curtains, he did not pursue the matter. He had five sons.

input_text: 王瞻，字思范，琅邪临沂人，宋太保弘从孙也。 祖柳，光禄大夫、东亭侯。 父猷，廷尉卿。 瞻年数岁，尝从师受业，时有伎经其门，同学皆出观，瞻独不视，习诵如初。 从父尚书仆射僧达闻而异之，谓瞻父曰： 吾宗不衰，寄之此子。 年十二，居父忧，以孝闻。 服阕，袭封东亭侯。 瞻幼时轻薄，好逸游，为闾里所患。 及长，颇折节有士操，涉猎书记，于棋射尤善。 起家著作佐郎，累迁太子舍人、太尉主簿、太子洗马。 顷之，出为鄱阳内史，秩满，授太子中舍人。 又为齐南海王友，寻转司徒竟陵王从事中郎，王甚相宾礼。 南海王为护军将军，瞻为长史。 又出补徐州别驾从事史，迁骠骑将军王晏长史。 晏诛，出为晋陵太守。 瞻洁己为政，妻子不免饥寒。 时大司马王敬则举兵作乱，路经晋陵，郡民多附敬则。军败，台军讨贼党，瞻言于朝曰： 愚人易动，不足穷法。 明帝许之，所全活者万数。 征拜给事黄门侍郎，抚军建安王长史，御史中丞。 高祖霸府开，以瞻为大司马相国谘议参军，领录事。 梁台建，为侍中，迁左民尚书，俄转吏部尚书。 瞻性率亮，居选部，所举多行其意。 颇嗜酒，每饮或竟日，而精神益朗赡，不废簿领。 高祖每称瞻有三术，射、棋、酒也。 寻加左军将军，以疾不拜，仍为侍中，领骁骑将军，未拜，卒，时年四十九。
target_text: Wang Jun, whose courtesy name is far away, was the grandson of Jing Cong. His grandfather was Zanzhi, and his father was Xianhui. He was graceful and well-behaved as a child. He started his career as Zuo Lang and was appreciated by Wang Ken, the king of Jingling. As internal history of Guiyang, he closed the city gates and meditated during a rebellion, stabilizing the county. Emperor Gaozu liked his demeanor. He served as prefect of Xuancheng, where his administration was clean and peaceful. He had a calm and elegant temperament and no desire to compete. He once agreed with Xie Yu to stop seeking promotion upon reaching the position of servant. After becoming a servant, his conduct was indifferent. He died at age fifty-six.

input_text: 乃东序之秘宝，瑚琏之茂器。 除骠骑从事中郎。 高祖霸府开，引为户曹属，迁司徒左长史。 天监元年，除太子中庶子，领骁骑将军，入为侍中。 出为宁朔将军、中军长史。 又为侍中，领射声校尉，迁五兵尚书，加给事中，出为晋陵太守。 征为吏部尚书，俄领国子祭酒。 暕名公子，少致美称，及居选曹，职事修理；然世贵显，与物多隔，不能留心寒素，众颇谓为刻薄。 迁尚书右仆射，寻加侍中。 复迁左仆射，以母忧去官。 起为云麾将军、吴郡太守。 还为侍中、尚书左仆射，领国子祭酒。 普通四年冬，暴疾卒，时年四十七。 诏赠侍中、中书令、中军将军，给东园秘器，朝服一具，衣一袭，钱十万，布百匹。
target_text: Wang Chen, courtesy name Sihui, was the son of Wang Jian. As a child, he had an outstanding demeanor. He married the eldest princess of Huainan. He was recommended by Wang Gui Yaoguang, who praised his talents and character. He was the son of a famous official and had a good reputation. As Minister of the Ministry of Civil Affairs, his affairs were well-organized, but he was considered cold and ruthless for not paying attention to people of low origin. He died suddenly at age forty-seven. He had four sons.

input_text: 谥曰靖。 有四子，训、承、穉、訏，并通显。 训字怀范，幼聪警有识量，征士何胤见而奇之。 年十三，暕亡忧毁，家人莫之识。 十六，召见文德殿，应对爽彻。 上目送久之，顾谓硃异曰： 可谓相门有相矣。 补国子生，射策高第，除秘书郎，迁太子舍人、秘书丞。 转宣城王文学、友、太子中庶子，掌管记。 俄迁侍中，既拜入见，高祖从容问何敬容曰： 褚彦回年几为宰相？ 敬容对曰： 少过三十。 上曰： 今之王训，无谢彦回。 训美容仪，善进止，文章之美，为后进领袖。 在春宫特被恩礼。 以疾终于位，时年二十六。 赠本官。 谥温子。 王泰，字仲通，志长兄慈之子也。
target_text: Wang Xun, courtesy name Huai Zheng, was Wang Chen's son. He was smart and thoughtful as a child. At thirteen, he mourned his father with great sadness. At sixteen, he responded cheerfully to the emperor's summons. The emperor remarked that there was a prime minister in the prime minister's house. He had a beautiful appearance and was a leader among the younger generation. He died of illness at age twenty-six.

input_text: 累迁给事黄门侍郎、员外散骑常侍，并掌吏部如故，俄即真。 自过江，吏部郎不复典大选，令史以下，小人求竞者辐凑，前后少能称职。 泰为之不通关求，吏先至者即补，不为贵贱请嘱易意，天下称平。 累迁为廷尉，司徒左长史。 出为明威将军、新安太守，在郡和理得民心。 征为宁远将军，安右长史，俄迁侍中。 寻为太子庶子、领步兵校尉，复为侍中。 仍迁仁威长史、南兰陵太守，行南康王府、州、国事。 王迁职，复为北中郎长史、行豫章王府、州、国事，太守如故。 入为都官尚书。 泰能接人士，士多怀泰，每愿其居选官。 顷之，为吏部尚书，衣冠属望，未及选举，仍疾，改除散骑常侍、左骁骑将军，未拜，卒，时年四十五。
target_text: Wang Tai, courtesy name Zhubi, was the son of Wang Jin's eldest brother. As a child, he did not grab dates and chestnuts scattered by his grandmother, saying he would be rewarded without taking them. He was peaceful and gentle as an adult. As Secretary Cheng, he requested to revise and write books after a fire burned the palace books. As Libulang in charge of selection, he did not change his opinion due to requests for intercession, and the world praised his fairness. He was able to accept people, and scholars often hoped he would be in the position of selecting officials. He died before taking office as Zuo Xiaoqi General at age forty-five.

input_text: 王份，字季文，琅邪人也。 祖僧朗，宋开府仪同三司、元公。父粹，黄门侍郎。 份十四而孤，解褐车骑主簿。 出为宁远将军、始安内史。 袁粲之诛，亲故无敢视者，份独往致恸，由是显名。 迁太子中舍人，太尉属。 出为晋安内史。 累迁中书侍郎，转大司农。 份兄奂于雍州被诛，奂子肃奔于魏，份自拘请罪，齐世祖知其诚款，喻而遣之。 属肃屡引魏人来侵疆埸，世祖尝因侍坐，从容谓份曰： 比有北信不？ 份敛容对曰： 肃既近忘坟柏，宁远忆有臣。 帝亦以此亮焉。 寻除宁朔将军、零陵内史。 征为黄门侍郎，以父终于此职，固辞不拜，迁秘书监。 天监初，除散骑常侍、领步兵校尉、兼起部尚书。
target_text: Wang Fen, courtesy name Xingshu, lost his parents at fourteen. He went alone to express condolences when Jinsai was killed, becoming famous for this. When his brother Wang Huan was killed and his son Wang Su fled to Wei, Wang Fen imprisoned himself. When Wang Su led Wei troops to invade, Wang Fen said he could not remember his subordinates since Wang Su had forgotten his family. He refused to take the post of Huangmen Shilang because his father died in that position. He answered Emperor Gaozu's question about action and inaction well. He died at age seventy-nine.

input_text: 幼而警悟，与兄弟受业，至应休散，常独留不起。 年七八岁，犹随公主入宫，高祖嘉其聪敏，常为朝士说之。 精力不倦，致损右目。 公主每节其业，为饰居宇。 虽童稚之中，一无所好。 十二，为国子生。 十四，举清茂，除秘书郎，与范阳张伯绪齐名，俱为太子舍人。 丁父忧，居丧尽礼。 服阕，除太子洗马。 时昭明尚幼，未与臣僚相接。 高祖敕： 太子洗马王锡、秘书郎张缵，亲表英华，朝中髦俊，可以师友事之。 以戚属封永安侯，除晋安王友，称疾不行，敕许受诏停都。 王冠日，以府僚摄事。
target_text: Wang Xi, courtesy name Gonggu, was Wang Lin's second son. He was alert and savvy as a child, studying tirelessly even when his brothers took breaks, which damaged his right eye. At twelve, he became a son of the country. He was appointed Prince Xima. Emperor Gaozu ordered that he and Zhang Lan be respected as teachers and friends for the young Prince Zhaoming. He received Liu Shanming, a Wei envoy, and debated with him, impressing Shanming. He later claimed illness and refused to take office, closing his door and thinking deeply. He died at age thirty-six.

input_text: 乃称疾不拜。 便谢遣胥徒，拒绝宾客，掩扉覃思，室宇萧然。 中大通六年正月，卒，时年三十六。 赠侍中，给东园秘器，朝服一具，衣一袭。 谥贞子。 子泛、湜。 佥字公会，锡第五弟也。 八岁丁父忧，哀毁过礼。 服阕，召补国子生，祭酒袁昂称为通理。 策高第，除长史兼秘书郎中，历尚书殿中郎，太子中舍人，与吴郡陆襄对掌东宫管记。 出为建安太守。 山酋方善、谢稀聚徒依险，屡为民患，佥潜设方略，率众平之，有诏褒美，颁示州郡。 除武威将军、始兴内史，丁所生母忧，固辞不拜。 又除宁远将军、南康内史，属卢循作乱，复转佥为安成内史，以镇抚之。 还除黄门侍郎，寻为安西武陵王长史、蜀郡太守。 佥惮岨嶮，固以疾辞，因以黜免。 久之，除戎昭将军、尚书左丞，复补黄门侍郎，迁太子中庶子，掌东宫管记。 太清二年十二月，卒，时年四十五。 赠侍中，给东园秘器，朝服一具，衣一袭。
target_text: Wang Yu, courtesy name Guild, was Wang Xi's fifth younger brother. He mourned his father with great sadness at age eight. As prefect of Jian'an, he pacified the mountain people leaders Fang Shan and Xie Xi. He refused the post of Shixing Internal History due to his mother's death. He died at age forty-five.

input_text: 后为司徒谘议参军，与琅邪王思远、同郡陆慧晓等，并为司徒竟陵王宾客。 入为中书侍郎，寻转给事黄门侍郎。 明帝作相，以充为镇军长史。 出为义兴太守，为政清静，民吏便之。 寻以母忧去职，服阕，除太子中庶子，迁侍中。 义师近次，东昏召百官入宫省，朝士虑祸，或往来酣宴，充独居侍中省，不出阁。 城内既害东昏，百官集西钟下，召充不至。 高祖霸府开，以充为大司马谘议参军，迁梁王国郎中令、祠部尚书、领屯骑校尉，转冠军将军、司徒左长史。 天监初，除大常卿。 寻迁吏部尚书，居选称为平允。 俄为散骑常侍、云骑将军。 寻除晋陵太守，秩中二千石。 征拜散骑常侍、国子祭酒。 充长于义理，登堂讲说，皇太子以下皆至。 时王侯多在学，执经以拜，充朝服而立，不敢当也。 转左卫将军，祭酒如故。 入为尚书仆射，顷之，除云麾将军、吴郡太守。 下车恤贫老，故旧莫不欣悦。 以疾自陈，征为散骑常侍，金紫光禄大夫，未及还朝，十三年，卒于吴，时年六十六。 诏赠侍中、护军将军。
target_text: Zhang Chong, courtesy name Genwa, was the son of Zhang Xu. As a young man, he liked to have fun. His father saw him hunting and rebuked him. Zhang Chong promised to change the next year, and he did, studying various books. He wrote a letter to Wang Jian, explaining his character and lifestyle. Wang Jian reported to the emperor, and Zhang Chong was deposed for a long time. He later served as prefect of Xianxing, governing with inaction. When the rebel army was near the capital, he stayed alone in Shizhong Province. He was good at righteousness and lectured, with the crown prince and others attending. He died at age sixty-six.

input_text: 时东昏未平，士犹苦战，恽上笺陈便宜，请城平之日，先收图籍，及遵汉祖宽大爱民之义，高祖从之。 会萧颖胄薨于江陵，使恽西上迎和帝，仍除给事黄门侍郎，领步兵校尉，迁相国右司马。 天监元年，除长史、兼侍中，与仆射沈约等共定新律。 恽立行贞素，以贵公子早有令名，少工篇什。 始为诗曰： 亭皋本叶下，陇首秋云飞。 琅邪王元长见而嗟赏，因书斋壁。 至是预曲宴，必被诏赋诗。 尝奉和高祖《登景阳楼》中篇云： 太液沧波起，长杨高树秋。 翠华承汉远，雕辇逐风游。 深为高祖所美。 当时咸共称传。 恽善奕棋，帝每敕侍坐，仍令定棋谱，第其优劣。
target_text: Liu Pang, courtesy name Guiyu, was from Lixun. He was good at playing the qin and was appreciated by King Jingling. He wrote a letter to Emperor Gaozu asking for books to be collected before the city was pacified. He was chaste and simple, devoted to poetry. His poem "Deng Jingyang Tower" was deeply praised by Emperor Gaozu. He was good at chess. As prefect of Wuxing, his administration was clear, and the people missed him. He died at age fifty-three.

input_text: 加信武将军。 征度支尚书，迁中书令。 复为信武将军、晋陵太守。 还，除通直散骑常侍、国子祭酒。 迁吏部尚书，居选，弘简有名称。 又为侍中，领秘书监，转中书令，侍中如故。 普通二年，出为宣毅将军、吴郡太守。 四年，卒，时年五十七。 追赠侍中、金紫光禄大夫、宣惠将军。 谥康子。 子彦熙，历官中书郎，宣城内史。 江蒨，字彦标，济阳考城人。 曾祖湛，宋左光禄、仪同三司；父斅，齐太常卿：并有重名于前世。 蒨幼聪警，读书过目便能讽诵。 选为国子生，通《尚书》，举高第。 起家秘书郎，累迁司徒东阁祭酒、庐陵王主簿。 居父忧以孝闻，庐于墓侧，明帝敕遣齐仗二十人防墓所。
target_text: Cai Lu, courtesy name Jingjie, was the son of Xingzong. He was upright and modest. He built a shed next to his mother's tomb to live in mourning. As prefect of Wuxing, he defeated the rebel Wu Chengbo, who had an army of 20,000, beheading him in battle. He was famous for his magnanimity and simplicity in the department of selecting officials. He died at age fifty-seven.

input_text: 服阕，除太子洗马，累迁司徒左南属，太子中舍人，秘书丞。 出为建安内史，视事期月，义师下次江州，遣宁朔将军刘諓之为郡，蒨帅吏民据郡拒之。 及建康城平，蒨坐禁锢。俄被原，起为后军临川王外兵参军。 累迁临川王友，中书侍郎，太子家令，黄门侍郎，领南兗州大中正。 迁太子中庶子，中正如故。 转中权始兴王长史。 出为伏波将军、晋安内史。 在政清约，务在宽惠，吏民便之。 诏征为宁朔将军、南康王长史，行府、州、国事。 顷之，迁太尉临川王长史，转尚书吏部郎，右将军。 蒨方雅有风格。 仆射徐勉以权重自遇，在位者并宿士敬之，惟蒨及王规与抗礼，不为之屈。 勉因蒨门客翟景为第七儿繇求蒨女婚，蒨不答，景再言之，乃杖景四十，由此与勉有忤。 除散骑常侍，不拜。 是时勉又为子求蒨弟葺及王泰女，二人并拒之。 葺为吏部郎，坐杖曹中干免官，泰以疾假出宅，乃迁散骑常侍，皆勉意也。 初，天监六年，诏以侍中、常侍并侍帷幄，分门下二局入集书，其官品视侍中，而非华胄所悦，故勉斥泰为之。 蒨寻迁司徒左长史。 初，王泰出阁，高祖谓勉云： 江蒨资历，应居选部。 勉对曰： 蒨有眼患，又不悉人物。
target_text: Jiang Bei, courtesy name Yanbiao, was the son of Jiang Wei. He was smart and could recite a book after reading it once. He was known for filial piety. As internal history of Jian'an, he resisted the rebel army. He was upright and had character, refusing to condescend to the powerful Pushe Xu Mian. He refused Xu Mian's marriage proposal for his son, causing a conflict. He was demoted due to Xu Mian's intentions. He loved learning and was familiar with court etiquette, writing thirty volumes of "Jiang Zuo Qian Dian," which was unfinished. He died at age fifty-three.

input_text: 高祖乃止。 迁光禄大夫。 大通元年，卒，时年五十三。 诏赠本官。 谥肃子。 蒨好学，尤悉朝仪故事，撰《江左遗典》三十卷，未就，卒。 文集十五卷。 子紑、经，在《孝行传》。 史臣曰：王氏自姬姓已降，及乎秦汉，继有英哲。 洎东晋王茂弘经纶江左，时人方之管仲。 其后蝉冕交映，台衮相袭，勒名帝籍，庆流子孙，斯为盛族矣。 王瞻等承藉兹基，国华是贵，子有才行，可得而称。 张充少不持操，晚乃折节，在于典选，实号廉平。 柳恽以多艺称，蔡撙以方雅著，江蒨以风格显，俱为梁室名士焉。
target_text: The historian's commentary states that the Wang family had successive outstanding figures from the Zhou Dynasty. Wang Zhan and others inherited this foundation and were valuable national elites. Liu Pang was famous for his versatility, Cai Huan for his integrity, and Jiang Bei for his integrity, all being celebrities of the Liang family.

input_text: 陆倕，字佐公，吴郡吴人也。 晋太尉玩六世孙。 祖子真，宋东阳太守。 父慧晓，齐太常卿。 倕少勤学，善属文。 于宅内起两间茅屋，杜绝往来，昼夜读书，如此者数载。 所读一遍，必诵于口。 尝借人《汉书》，失《五行志》四卷，乃暗写还之，略无遗脱。 幼为外祖张岱所异，岱常谓诸子曰： 此儿汝家之阳元也。 年十七，举本州秀才。 刺史竟陵王子良开西邸延英俊，倕亦预焉。 辟议曹从事参军、庐陵王法曹行参军。 天监初，为右军安成王外兵参军，转主簿。 倕与乐安任昉友善，为《感知己赋》以赠昉，昉因此名以报之曰： 信伟人之世笃，本侯服于陆乡。 缅风流与道素，袭衮衣与绣裳。 还伊人而世载，并三骏而龙光。
target_text: Lu Chui, styled Zuogong, was from Wu County and a sixth-generation descendant of Jin Dynasty Taiwei Lu Wan. He studied diligently from youth, building a two-story thatched house where he isolated himself for years of study. He possessed remarkable memory, once silently reconstructing four lost volumes of the "Han Shu" from memory without error. At seventeen, he became a scholar of the state. Throughout his career, he held various military and civil positions including Yi Cao参军, Luling King Fa Cao参军, and chief secretary. He was highly regarded by contemporaries, with Ren Fang praising him as "a generation of great men." He authored twenty volumes of collected works and died at fifty-seven.

input_text: 子伯淮、仲举。 明山宾，字孝若，平原鬲人也。 父僧绍，隐居不仕，宋末国子博士征，不就。 山宾七岁能言名理，十三博通经传，居丧尽礼。 服阕，州辟从事史。 起家奉朝请。 兄仲璋婴痼疾，家道屡空，山宾乃行干禄。 齐始安王萧遥光引为抚军行参军，后为广阳令，顷之去官。 义师至，高祖引为相府田曹参军。 梁台建，为尚书驾部郎，迁治书侍御史，右军记室参军，掌治吉礼。 时初置《五经》博士，山宾首膺其选。 迁北中郎谘议参军，侍皇太子读。 累迁中书侍郎、国子博士、太子率更令、中庶子，博士如故。 天监十五年，出为持节、督缘淮诸军事、征远将军、北兗州刺史。 普通二年，征为太子右卫率，加给事中，迁御史中丞。 以公事左迁黄门侍郎、司农卿。 四年，迁散骑常侍，领青、冀二州大中正。 东宫新置学士，又以山宾居之，俄以本官兼国子祭酒。 初，山宾在州，所部平陆县不稔，启出仓米以赡人。后刺史检州曹，失簿书，以山宾为耗阙，有司追责，籍其宅入官，山宾默不自理，更市地造宅。 昭明太子闻筑室不就，有令曰： 明祭酒虽出抚大籓，拥旄推毂，珥金拖紫，而恒事屡空。
target_text: Dao Qia, styled Maoyi, was from Pengcheng. At eighteen, he began his official career. Known for his talent and moral character, he impressed Xie Tiao, who praised his civil and military abilities. When offered a position by Xie Peng, he declined, foreseeing chaos in the realm, and built a secluded mountain dwelling. Emperor Gaozu recognized his talents, and he held numerous positions including prince's sacrificer, chief of staff, and censor Zhongcheng. He was known for his integrity, refusing bribes and correcting wrongs without fear of nobles. He died at fifty-one while serving as Xunyang Prefect.

target_text: Mingshan Bin, styled Xiaoruo, was from Pingyuan. His father lived in seclusion. From age seven, Shan Bin could discuss right and wrong, and by thirteen mastered classical texts. He held various academic and official positions, including the first Doctor of the Five Classics. As governor, he once released grain to aid famine victims without proper documentation, losing his house when audited, yet he did not appeal. Prince Zhaoming praised his virtue and provided assistance. He authored 224 volumes of "Notes on Ji Li" and other works, dying at eighty-five.

input_text: 奂为雍州刺史、镇北将军，乃言于朝，以睿为镇北长史、河南太守。 奂诛，睿并见害。 钧时年九岁，以孝闻。 及长，恬静简交游，好学有思理。 善隶书，为当时楷法，南乡范云、乐安任昉，并称赏之。 高祖与睿少旧故，以女妻钧，即永兴公主也。 天监初，拜驸马都尉，起家秘书郎、太子舍人、司徒主簿、秘书丞。 钧在职，启校定秘阁四部书，更为目录。 又受诏料检西省法书古迹，别为品目。 迁骠骑从事中郎，中书郎、太子家令、掌东宫书记。 顷之，迁给事黄门侍郎、中庶子、尚书吏部郎、司徒左长史，侍中。 东宫置学士，复以钧为之。 公事免。 复为中庶子，领国子博士、左骁骑将军，博士如故。 出为明威将军、临川内史。 钧体羸多疾，闭阁卧治，而百姓化其德，劫盗皆奔出境。 尝禽劫帅，不加考掠，但和言诮责。 劫帅稽颡乞改过，钧便命遣之，后遂为善人。 郡旧多山疟，更暑必动，自钧在任，郡境无复疟疾。
target_text: Yin Jun, styled Jihe, was from Changping. His father was killed alongside his father-in-law Wang Huan. Orphaned at nine, Yin Jun was known for filial piety. He married Princess Yongxing and held various positions including Secretary Lang and Prince Sheren. He compiled the four books of Mi Ge and catalogued calligraphy monuments. As Linchuan Internal History, he governed with virtue, causing thieves to flee. He once captured a robber leader but released him after a gentle scolding, and the man reformed. He died at forty-nine.

input_text: 在政六年，郡中大治，民李睍等四百二十人诣阙拜表，陈襄德化，求于郡立碑，降敕许之。 又表乞留襄，襄固求还，征为吏部郎，迁秘书监，领扬州大中正。 太清元年，迁度支尚书，中正如故。 二年，侯景举兵围宫城，以襄直侍中省。 三年三月，城陷，襄逃还吴。 贼寻寇东境，没吴郡。 景将宋子仙进攻钱塘，会海盐人陆黯举义，有众数千人，夜出袭郡，杀伪太守苏单于，推襄行郡事。 时淮南太守文成侯萧宁逃贼入吴，襄遣迎宁为盟主，遣黯及兄子映公帅众拒子仙。 子仙闻兵起，乃退还，与黯等战于松江，黯败走，吴下军闻之，亦各奔散。 襄匿于墓下，一夜忧愤卒，时年七十。 襄弱冠遭家祸，终身蔬食布衣，不听音乐，口不言杀害五十许年。
target_text: Lu Xiang, styled Shiqing, was from Wu County. His father and brother were killed during a rebellion, and he mourned beyond ritual requirements. He held positions including Yongning magistrate and served Prince Zhaoming. When his mother fell ill requiring corn syrup in winter, an old man appeared selling exactly the needed amount, then vanished—considered divine intervention. As Poyang Internal History, he suppressed a rebellion led by Xian Yu Chen, capturing him alive while protecting innocent people from false accusations. He reconciled feuding families through gentle persuasion. During Hou Jing's rebellion, the city fell and Lu Xiang fled, later dying of grief at seventy. He lived simply, avoiding music and discussions of killing for fifty years.

target_text: The historian Yao Cha commented that these men, despite different positions and salaries, were all listed among famous ministers for their learning, loyalty, integrity, and filial piety.

input_text: 谥曰元。 有文集行于世。 子孝俨嗣。 孝俨字希庄，聪慧有文才。 射策甲科，除秘书郎、太子舍人。 从幸华林园，于座献《相风乌》、《华光殿》、《景阳山》等颂，其文甚美，高祖深赏异之。 普通元年，薨，时年二十三。 谥曰章。 子慎嗣。 藻字靖艺，元王弟也。 少立名行，志操清洁。 齐永元初，释褐著作佐郎。 天监元年，封西昌县侯，食邑五百户。 出为持节、都督益、宁二州诸军事、冠军将军、益州刺史。 时天下草创，边徼未安，州民焦僧护聚众数万，据郫、繁作乱。 藻年未弱冠，集僚佐议，欲自击之。 或陈不可，藻大怒，斩于阶侧。 乃乘平肩舆，巡行贼垒。 贼弓乱射，矢下如雨，从者举楯御箭，又命除之，由是人心大安。 贼乃夜遁，藻命骑追之，斩首数千级，遂平之。
target_text: The lives and careers of several members of the Xiao family, descendants of Gaozu, focusing on their official positions, military campaigns, and personal virtues.

input_text: 长沙嗣王业字静旷，高祖长兄懿之子也。 懿字元达，少有令誉。 解褐齐安南邵陵王行参军，袭爵临湘县侯。 迁太子舍人、洗马、建安王友。 出为晋陵太守，曾未期月，讼理人和，称为善政。 入为中书侍郎。 永明季，授持节、都督梁、南、北秦、沙四州诸军事、西戎校尉、梁、南秦二州刺史，加冠军将军。 是岁，魏人入汉中，遂围南郑。 懿随机拒击，伤杀甚多，乃解围遁去。 懿又遣氐帅杨元秀攻魏历城、皋兰、骆谷、坑池等六戍，克之。魏人震惧，边境遂宁。 进号征虏将军，增封三百户，迁督益、宁二州军事、益州刺史。 入为太子右卫率、尚书吏部郎、卫尉卿。
target_text: Xiao Yi, son of Gaozu's eldest brother, held various military and civil posts, including governor of Liangzhou. He successfully repelled a Wei invasion, capturing enemy garrisons and securing the border. Promoted multiple times, he was later killed on the orders of Marquis Shuhun due to court intrigue. He was posthumously honored with titles and a grand funeral.

target_text: His son, Xiao Ye, was intelligent and served in the Qi and Liang dynasties, holding positions such as governor and general. Known for his honesty and devotion to Buddhism, he died at forty-eight. His works were widely circulated.

input_text: 自遭家祸，恒布衣蒲席，不食鲜禽，非在公庭，不听音乐。高祖每以此称之。 出为使持节、督南徐州刺史。 侯景乱，藻遣长子彧率兵入援，及城开，加散骑常侍、大将军。 景遣其仪同萧邕代之，据京口，藻因感气疾，不自疗。 或劝奔江北，藻曰： 吾国之台铉，位任特隆，既不能诛剪逆贼，正当同死朝廷，安能投身异类，欲保余生。 因不食累日。 太清三年，薨，时年六十七。 永阳嗣王伯游，字士仁，高祖次兄敷之子。 敷字仲达，解褐齐后将军、征虏行参军，辅太子舍人，洗马，迁丹阳尹丞。 入为太子中舍人，除建威将军、随郡内史。 招怀远近，黎庶安之，以为前后之政莫之及也。 进号宁朔将军，征为庐陵王谘议参军。 建武四年，薨。
target_text: Xiao Zao, younger brother of King Yuan, was a capable governor who personally suppressed a rebellion in Yizhou, earning him respect. He held numerous high-ranking posts, including governor of Yongzhou and Yanzhou, and was praised for his humility and literary talent. He refused to flee during the Hou Jing rebellion, choosing to starve himself to death at sixty-seven.

input_text: 自遭家祸，恒布衣蒲席，不食鲜禽，非在公庭，不听音乐。高祖每以此称之。 出为使持节、督南徐州刺史。 侯景乱，藻遣长子彧率兵入援，及城开，加散骑常侍、大将军。 景遣其仪同萧邕代之，据京口，藻因感气疾，不自疗。 或劝奔江北，藻曰： 吾国之台铉，位任特隆，既不能诛剪逆贼，正当同死朝廷，安能投身异类，欲保余生。 因不食累日。 太清三年，薨，时年六十七。 永阳嗣王伯游，字士仁，高祖次兄敷之子。 敷字仲达，解褐齐后将军、征虏行参军，辅太子舍人，洗马，迁丹阳尹丞。 入为太子中舍人，除建威将军、随郡内史。 招怀远近，黎庶安之，以为前后之政莫之及也。 进号宁朔将军，征为庐陵王谘议参军。 建武四年，薨。
target_text: Xiao Boyou, son of Xiao Fu, was known for his demeanor and was appointed to oversee remote border regions, dying young at twenty-three.

input_text: 高祖即位，追赠侍中、司空，封永阳郡王，谥曰昭。 伯游美风神，善言玄理。 天监元年四月，诏曰： 兄子伯游，虽年识未弘，意尚粗可。 浙东奥区，宜须抚莅，可督会稽、东阳、新安、永嘉、临海五郡诸军事、辅国将军、会稽太守。 二年，袭封永阳郡王。 五年，薨，时年二十三。 谥曰恭。 衡阳嗣王元简，字熙远，高祖第四弟畅之子。 畅仕齐至太常，封江陵县侯，卒。 天监元年，追赠侍中、骠骑大将军、开府仪同三司。 封衡阳郡王。 谥曰宣。 元简三年袭封，除中书郎，迁会稽太守。 十三年，入为给事黄门侍郎，出为持节、都督广、交、越三州诸军事、平越中郎将、广州刺史。
target_text: Xiao Yuanjian, son of Xiao Chang, served as governor of Guangzhou and Yingzhou, dying in office.

input_text: 还为太子中庶子，迁使持节、都督郢、司、霍三州诸军事、信武将军、郢州刺史。 十八年正月，卒于州。 谥曰孝。 子俊嗣。 桂阳嗣王象，字世翼，长沙宣武王第九子也。 初，叔父融仕齐至太子洗马。 永元中，宣武之难，融遇害。 高祖平京邑，赠给事黄门侍郎。 天监元年，加散骑常侍、抚军大将军，封桂阳郡王。 谥曰简。 无子，乃诏象为嗣，袭封爵。 象容止闲雅，善于交游，事所生母以孝闻。 起家宁远将军、丹阳尹。 到官未几，简王妃薨，去职。 服阕，复授明威将军、丹阳尹。 象生长深宫，始亲庶政，举无失德，朝廷称之。 出为持节、督司、霍、郢三州诸军事、征远将军、郢州刺史。 寻迁湘、衡二州诸军事、轻车将军、湘州刺史。 湘州旧多虎暴，及象在任，为之静息，故老咸称德政所感。 除中书侍郎，俄以本官行石头戍军事，转给事黄门侍郎、兼领军，又以本官兼宗正卿。 寻迁侍中、太子詹事，未拜，改授持节、督江州诸军事、信武将军、江州刺史。 以疾免。 寻除太常卿，加侍中，迁秘书监、领步兵校尉。 大同二年，薨，谥曰敦。 子慥嗣。 史臣曰：长沙诸嗣王，并承袭土宇，光有籓服。 桂阳王象以孝闻，在于牧湘，猛虎息暴，盖德惠所致也。 昔之善政，何以加焉。
target_text: Xiao Xiang, son of King Xuanwu, was noted for his filial piety and effective governance. As governor of Xiangzhou, his virtue reportedly stopped tiger attacks. He held various high offices before dying in the second year of Datong.

target_text: The text concludes that the successor kings of Changsha were prosperous, with Xiao Xiang of Guiyang particularly praised for his filial piety and benevolent rule, which surpassed previous governance.

input_text: 高祖三王高祖八男：丁贵嫔生昭明太子统，太宗简文皇帝，庐陵威王续；阮修容生世祖孝元皇帝；吴淑媛生豫章王综；董淑仪生南康简王绩；丁充华生邵陵携王纶；葛修容生武陵王纪。 综及纪别有传。 南康简王绩，字世谨，高祖第四子。 天监八年，封南康郡王，邑二千户。 出为轻车将军，领石头戍军事。 十年，迁使持节、都督南徐州诸军事、南徐州刺史，进号仁威将军。 绩时年七岁，主者有受货，洗改解书，长史王僧孺弗之觉，绩见而辄诘之，便即时首服，众咸叹其聪警。 十六年，征为宣毅将军、领石头戍军事。 十七年，出为使持节、都督南、北兗、徐、青、冀五州诸军事、南兗州刺史，在州著称。 寻有诏征还，民曹嘉乐等三百七十人诣阙上表，称绩尤异一十五条，乞留州任，优诏许之，进号北中郎将。 普通四年，征为侍中、云麾将军，领石头戍军事。 五年，出为使持节、都督江州诸军事、江州刺史。 丁董淑仪忧，居丧过礼，高祖手诏勉之，使摄州任，固求解职，乃征授安右将军、领石头戍军事，寻加护军。
target_text: Emperor Gaozu had eight sons by various consorts, including Prince Zhaoming, Emperor Taizong Jianwen, and others. Among them, Xiao Ji, the fourth son, was titled King of Nankang Jian. At age seven, he demonstrated intelligence by catching a subordinate altering documents. He held various military and civil posts, including governor of South Xuzhou and Jiangzhou, and was praised for his frugality and personal handling of affairs. After his mother's death, he mourned strictly and insisted on resigning his post. He died in office at twenty-five, leaving behind substantial unnamed funds in the treasury. His son Xiao Hui succeeded him, showing early intelligence and literary talent. During the Hou Jing rebellion, Hui initially resisted but eventually surrendered to Hou Jing after the capital fell. He secretly plotted to restore the Liang dynasty but was betrayed and killed, along with his brother Xiao Congli, who was captured and executed at twenty-one.

target_text: Xiao Xu, the fifth son, titled King of Luling, was known for his bravery and physical strength, excelling in archery. He held numerous military governorships, including in Yongzhou and Jiangzhou, and was praised for his martial prowess. He died at forty-four, posthumously honored as Sikong.

input_text: 时纶长史韦质、司马姜律先在于外，闻纶败，驰往迎之。于是复收散卒，屯于齐昌郡，将引魏军共攻南阳。 侯景将任约闻之，使铁骑二百袭纶，纶无备，又败走定州。 定州刺史田龙祖迎纶，纶以龙祖荆镇所任，惧为所执，复归齐昌。 行至汝南，西魏所署汝南城主李素者，纶之故吏，闻纶败，开城纳之。 纶乃修浚城池，收集士卒，将攻竟陵。 西魏安州刺史马岫闻之，报于西魏，西魏遣大将军杨忠、仪同侯几通率众赴焉。二年二月，忠等至于汝南，纶婴城自守。 会天寒大雪，忠等攻不能克，死者甚众。 后李素中流矢卒，城乃陷。 忠等执纶，纶不为屈，遂害之。投于江岸，经日颜色不变，鸟兽莫敢近焉。 时年三十三。 百姓怜之，为立祠庙，后世祖追谥曰携。 长子坚，字长白。
target_text: Xiao Lun, the sixth son, titled King of Shaoling, was intelligent and erudite, skilled in writing. He held various posts but was dismissed for embezzling civilian property and ordering an assassination. He later regained titles and led troops against Hou Jing, suffering defeats. After the capital fell, he fled and eventually established a base in Yingzhou. He wrote a letter to Emperor Yuan urging reconciliation among the Liang princes to unite against Hou Jing, warning that internal strife would benefit the enemy. Despite his efforts, he was defeated by Wang Sengbian and fled, eventually captured and killed by Western Wei forces at thirty-three. His son Xiao Jian was killed during Hou Jing's siege, and another son Xiao Que, known for his bravery, was executed by Hou Jing after the city fell.

input_text: 后从景行，见天上飞鸢，群虏争射不中，确射之，应弦而落。 贼徒忿嫉，咸劝除之。 先是携王遣人密导确，确谓使者曰： 侯景轻佻，可一夫力致，确不惜死，正欲手刃之；但未得其便耳。 卿还启家王，愿勿以为念也。 事未遂而为贼所害。 史臣曰：自周、汉广树籓屏，固本深根；高祖之封建，将遵古制也。 南康、庐陵并以宗室之贵，据磐石之重，绩以孝著，续以勇闻。 纶聪警有才学，性险躁，屡以罪黜，及太清之乱，忠孝独存，斯可嘉矣。
target_text: The historian comments that while some princes like Xiao Ji and Xiao Xu were commendable for their filial piety and courage, Xiao Lun, despite his talents, was sinister and impetuous, though his loyalty during the Taiqing period was noteworthy.

input_text: 太祖五王 太祖十男。张皇后生长沙宣武王懿、永阳昭王敷、高祖、衡阳宣王畅。李太妃生桂阳简王融。 懿及融，齐永元中为东昏所害；敷、畅，建武中卒：高祖践阼，并追封郡王。 陈太妃生临川靖惠王宏，南平元襄王伟。 吴太妃生安成康王秀，始兴忠武王憺。 费太妃生鄱阳忠烈王恢。 临川靖惠王宏，字宣达，太祖第六子也。 长八尺，美须眉，容止可观。 齐永明十年，为卫军庐陵王法曹行参军，迁太子舍人。 时长沙王懿镇梁州，为魏所围，明年，给宏精兵千人赴援，未至，魏军退。 迁骠骑晋安王主簿，寻为北中郎桂阳王功曹史。 衡阳王畅，有美名，为始安王萧遥光所礼。 及遥光作乱，逼畅入东府，畅惧祸，先赴台。 高祖在雍州，常惧诸弟及祸，谓南平王伟曰： 六弟明于事理，必先还台。 及信至，果如高祖策。 高祖义师下，宏至新林奉迎，拜辅国将军。 建康平，迁西中郎将、中护军，领石头戍军事。 天监元年，封临川郡王，邑二千户。
target_text: Emperor Taizu had ten sons. Queen Zhang raised Xiao Yi, Xiao Fu, and Xiao Chang. Concubine Li gave birth to Xiao Rong. Xiao Zhu and Xiao Rong were killed during the Yongyuan period of Qi; Xiao Fu and Xiao Chang died during the Jianwu period and were posthumously named county kings after Gaozu ascended the throne. Concubine Chen bore Xiao Hong and Xiao Wei. Concubine Wu gave birth to Xiao Xiu and Xiao Qi. Fei Taifei gave birth to Xiao Hui.
