target_text: Liu Fu, the Marquis of Xiu, fled to the capital. When Liu Wu rebelled, Liu Fu and others were dismissed. Later, hearing he had repeatedly advised Liu Wu, his title was changed to Honghou. The Dowager Dowager was related to Empress Dowager Dou. She requested to stay in the capital, which was granted. Liu Fu's son Piqiang and four others supported her and served as officials. When the wife passed away, she was given a cemetery. Liu Fu passed the kingdom to his great-grandson, but he had no sons, and the kingdom was cut off. Piqiang, courtesy name Shaoqing, was good at reading the *Poetry* and could write articles. During Emperor Wu's reign, he followed Erqianshi Discussion as a clan son and was the head of each clan. He was pure-hearted and refused to be an official. When Emperor Zhao ascended the throne, someone persuaded General Huo Guang to make more friends with the clan. Huo Guang agreed and chose available people in the clan. Piqiang's son Liu De was in the Prime Minister's Palace. He was in his thirties and wanted to be hired. Some said his father was still there and favored by the late emperor. So Piqiang was made Doctor Guanglu and Guardsman of Kenle. He was eighty years old then. He was promoted to Zongzheng and died within months. Liu De, named Lu Shu, practiced Huang Lao's skills and had strategies. He discussed political affairs and was summoned to Ganquan Palace. In Emperor Zhao's early years, he became Zong Zhengcheng and participated in executing Liu Ze's imperial edict. He became Dahonglucheng, then Taizhong doctor, and later Zongzheng, participating in torturing the Shangguan family and Gaizhu. Liu De held the *Laozi* idea of contentment. After his wife died, Huo Guang wanted to marry his daughter to him, but Liu De refused, fearing prosperity. He repeatedly blamed Princess Gai for inappropriate behavior. The censor thought Huo Guang resented Liu De and wanted to impeach him. Liu De avoided being a commoner and lived in seclusion. Huo Guang was angry and summoned Liu De to guard Qingzhou. Over a year later, he became Zongzheng again and participated in establishing Emperor Xuan. He was given the title of Marquis of Guannei and later Marquis of Yangcheng. His son Anmin became a doctor's assistant, and over 20 people in the clan became officials due to Liu De. Liu De was generous and rehabilitated sinners. He used his family property to support brothers and guests, saying, "Wealth is resented by the people." In his eleventh year, his son Liu Xiang should be punished for casting fake gold, and Liu De filed a lawsuit. When he passed away, Dahonglu wrote to defend his son's crime. Shao Ling said to give him the title of Muhou and establish heirs. It was passed to Sun Qingji, who became Zong Zhengtai Chang. After his death, his son Liu Cen succeeded and became a general. After death, it was passed to his son, but when Wang Mang failed, it was discontinued.

input_text: 恭、显见其书，愈与许、史比而怨更生等。 堪性公方，自见孤立，遂直道而不曲。 是岁夏寒，日青无光，恭、显及许、史皆言堪、猛用事之咎。 上内重堪，又患众口之浸润，无所取信。 时长安令杨兴以材能幸，常称誉堪。 上欲以为助，乃见问兴： 朝臣龂龂不可光禄勋，何邪？ 兴者，倾巧士，谓上疑堪，因顺指曰： 堪非独不可于朝廷，自州里亦不可也。 臣见众人闻堪前与刘更生等谋毁骨肉，以为当诛，故臣前言堪不可诛伤，为国养恩也。 上曰： 然此何罪而诛？ 今宜奈何？ 兴曰： 臣愚以为可赐爵关内侯，食邑三百户，勿令典事。 明主不失师傅之恩，此最策之得者也。 上于是疑。 会城门校尉诸葛丰亦言堪、猛短，上因发怒免丰。 语在其传。 又曰： 丰言堪、猛贞信不立，联闵而不治，又惜其材能未有所效，其左迁堪为河东太守，猛槐里令。 显等专权日甚。 后三岁余，孝宣庙阙灾，其晦，日有蚀之。 于是上召诸前言日变在堪、猛者责问，皆稽首谢。 乃因下诏曰： 河东太守堪，先帝贤之，命而傅联。 资质淑茂，道术通明，论议正直，秉心有常，发愤悃愊，信有忧国之心。
target_text: Liu Xiang, courtesy name Zizheng, originally named Gengsheng. At twelve, he became a chariot man due to his father Liu De's favor. After the crowning ceremony, he was promoted to a doctor of admonishment. At this time, Emperor Xuan recruited famous Confucian and talented people. Geng Sheng was proficient and able to connect words, so he presented poems and poems. The emperor believed in magical alchemy again, and there was the *Secretary of Hongbaoyuan in the Pillow* from Huainan. The book told of gods instructing ghosts to cast gold and Zou Yan's method of righteousness and longevity. No one could see it, but Geng Sheng's father Liu De got it when handling the Huainan case. Geng Sheng read it and offered it, saying it could make gold. The emperor ordered him to cast it, but it cost much and was ineffective. The emperor handed him to officials, who impeached him for casting fake gold and sent him to jail to die. His brother Anmin wrote a letter, willing to pay half of the households to atone for his sin. The emperor thought him a genius and reduced his death sentence. When *Guliang Chunqiu* was established as an academic official, he was recruited to study it and lecture on the *Five Classics* in Shiqu. He was made a doctor and given to Shi Huangmen. He was promoted to Sanqi, admonished official, and given to Shizhong. When Emperor Yuan ascended the throne, Taifu Xiao Wangzhi and Young Fu Zhou Kan were in charge of secretarial affairs. Geng Sheng was younger but they thought highly of him. He was promoted to Sanqi Zongzheng, serving as Shizhong, and served with Jin Chang. The four worked together to assist in political affairs but suffered from the indulgence of relatives Xu and Shi and eunuchs Honggong and Shi Xian. They planned to report to the emperor to remove them. Their words leaked, and they were falsely accused. Zhou Kan and Geng Sheng were sent to prison, and Wangzhi was dismissed. That spring there was an earthquake, and in summer a guest star appeared. The emperor realized something and granted Wang the title of Marquis of Guannei. In autumn, Zhou Kan and Liu Xiang were recruited and wanted to be admonishing officials, but Hong Gong and Shi Xian reported them, and they were both made Zhonglang. In winter, the ground shook again. The disciples of Hong Gong, Shi Xian, Xu, and Shi all looked sideways at Wangzhi and became more afraid. They asked his foreign relatives to write a letter about the extraordinary situation, saying they heard about the former general Xiao Wangzhi and others. They were loyal and selfless but offended the noble minister. Now people on the road think Wangzhi and others will be framed again. The letter said the earthquake was because the people in power were too powerful. It cited examples of Ji Bu, Ni Kuan, Dong Zhongshu, and Xia Housheng, who were guilty but later became famous officials. It argued that a minister with faults can benefit the world. It said the earthquake was probably caused by Hong Gong and others. Chen Yu believed Hong Gong and Shi Xian should be reprimanded and Wangzhi and others used. After the report, Hong Gong and Shi Xian suspected Geng Sheng and asked him to torture the treacherous person. He confessed and was arrested. He was convicted of scheming with Wangzhi and Zhou Kan to exclude the chariot generals and slander relatives. He was a disloyal minister but was not killed. He did not repent and taught others to say extraordinary things. He was reborn as a commoner. Wangzhi was also convicted and committed suicide. The emperor felt remorse and promoted Zhou Kan. Hong Gong and Shi Xian were afraid and slandered them. They went to Fengshi to remonstrate, saying they were fortunate to have a flesh-and-blood relative but were not cautious. They saw disasters happening and the world out of order. They wanted to be honest but feared going beyond their duty. They said Shun appointed nine officials, and all gave way to each other. If all sages are in harmony, then all things are in harmony. The *Poetry* said the beautiful Qing Temple is solemn and harmonious. At this time, King Wu and Duke周公 inherited the political affairs, and the courtiers were in harmony. The *Poetry* said the guests come in harmony. The princes are in harmony below, and heaven will retaliate above. Later, during the period of You and Li, the court was at odds. The poet said people do not do good deeds and resent each other. When villains are in power, they obey evil opinions. The *Poetry* said competing with friends is a traitor. A君子 sticks to justice alone. The *Poetry* said he acts diligently but is framed. At this time, the moon is eclipsed and has no light. The *Poetry* said on the first day of the lunar month and at the end of the lunar month, there is an eclipse. The changes in the sky appear above, and the changes in the earth move below. The *Poetry* said hundreds of rivers are boiling. The霜 falls out of control. The *Poetry* said there is a lot of frost in the first month. These are all caused by disharmony. From then on, the world was in chaos. King Li fled, and King You was killed. In the last years of King Ping, Dr. Zhou broke away from his brother-in-law and ran to Lu. From then on, the Yin family's ministers had exclusive power. The princes betrayed the Zhou Dynasty. During the 242 years, there were 36 solar eclipses, 5 earthquakes, 2 mountain collapses, 3 comets, no stars at night, one night of stars falling like rain, and 14 fires. Changdi entered 3 countries, 5 meteorites fell, 6 hawks flew upside down, and many disasters occurred. At this time, 36 kings were killed, 52 kingdoms were destroyed, and the princes fled. There were many disasters in the Zhou Dynasty. From this point of view, harmony leads to auspiciousness; misbehavior leads to disasters. Now His Majesty has created the achievements of three generations. Nowadays, the virtuous and the unworthy are confused. The memorial was handed over to the bus, and the prisoners were filled with Northern troops. The courtiers were at odds with each other. There were countless things used to confuse the ears and eyes. Divide into groups and form parties. When an upright minister is employed, it is a sign of governance; when an upright minister is framed, it is a sign of chaos. For those who rely on power, their children are listed in the court like fish scales. Therefore, the sun and the moon lack light, the霜雪 falls in summer, the seawater boils out, the valleys shift, and the stars move abnormally. Following the path of the declining Zhou Dynasty, acting according to what the poet ridiculed, but wanting to achieve peace and elegance, is like walking backward but wanting to be ahead of others. It has been six years since the early Yuan Dynasty. During the six years of studying the *Spring and Autumn Annals*, there have not been as many disasters as there are now. The reason is that the slanderous evil spirits work together. The reason is that the emperor is suspicious. Having a suspicious mind will attract slander and thieves; having an indecisive will will open the door to evil. When slanderous and evil people advance, they must be repeled by the wise. So the *Yi* has "No" and "Tai". When the villain's way grows, the君子's way decreases. When the君子's way grows, the villain's way decreases. The *Poetry* also said that rain and snow fell one after another. In the past, Gonggong, Jidou, Shun and Yu were in the court of Yao, and the Duke of Zhou, Guan and Cai were serving in the Zhou Dynasty. At this time, people took turns to slander each other. Emperor Yao and King Cheng were able to advance and employ Shun, Yu, and Zhou Gong while excluding Gonggong, Guan, and Cai, so they had great rule. Confucius, Ji and Meng all served as officials in Lu, and Li Si and his uncles and grandsons all served in Qin. Dinggong and Shihuang appointed Ji, Meng, and Li Si to the exclusion of Confucius and his uncles, so they were in chaos. Therefore, the beginning of honor and disgrace in ordering chaos lies in the people you trust. The *Poetry* says that my heart is not a stone and cannot be transferred by others. The *Yi* says: "I give orders as easily as sweating." Now that a good order has been issued and then withdrawn within three months, this is taking back what has been done. The *Analects of Confucius* says: Seeing evil is like testing boiling water. Now the two palaces are reporting that the person who flatters the sycophants should not be in office, and they will not be rejected after several years. Therefore, issuing orders is like withdrawing sweat, appointing wise men is like turning stones, and rejecting traitors is like uprooting mountains. Therefore, villains peek into the gaps, modify words, use clever words to slander, create rumors, make anonymous documents to slander others, and make noise among the people. Therefore, the *Poetry* says: I am worried and resentful of the many villains in my heart. In the past, Confucius, Yan Yuan and Zigong praised each other and did not form cliques; Yu, Ji and Gaotao recommended each other and did not form cliques for personal gain. Therefore, when a sage is in a superior position, he will introduce his kind to gather in the court. The *Yi* says, "The flying dragon is in the sky, and the adults gather together." Those who are above will recommend their kind, and those below will recommend their kind. Therefore, Tang appoints Yi Yin, and the unkind ones stay away. Now the evil ministers and the virtuous ministers are together in the palace, gathering together to conspire, disobeying good and relying on evil, forming cliques and slanders, and making many scaremongerings. Since ancient times, all wise and sage kings have achieved stability without killing good people. Therefore, Shun had the punishment of banishing the four bad guys, and Confucius had the punishment of killing in two views. Now rely on your majesty's wisdom, sincerely ponder the heart of heaven and earth, examine it according to the traces of the killing of two views, look at the hexagrams of "No" and "Tai", examine the poems of rain and snow, choose how Zhou and Tang used talents as a method, think about how Qin and Lu discarded talents as a warning, examine the blessings of good omen, and reflect on disasters Disasters of difference are used to measure the changes of the day. Banish the evil party, break up the dangerous gathering, close the door of the evil group, open the path of righteousness, make decisions and doubts, distinguish hesitations, make right and wrong clear, then you can eliminate many disasters, and all kinds of auspiciousness will come together. This is the foundation of peace and the welfare of all generations. I am fortunate enough to be able to rely on relatives of the emperor. I have indeed seen the imbalance of yin and yang, and I dare not not report what I heard to the emperor. I privately speculate on the disasters and disasters in the *Spring and Autumn Annals* to help with current events, and list the reasons in separate sections, which is not suitable for disclosure. I would like to risk my life and submit it in a sealed seal. When Hong Gong and Shi Xian saw his petition, they colluded with Xu and Shi and resented him. Zhou Kan has a fair and upright temperament. Seeing that he is isolated, he will act in accordance with the right path and not go against the grain. This summer was cold and the sun was blue and dull. Hong Gong, Shi Xian, Xu and Shi all said that Zhou Kan and Zhang Meng were in power wrong. The emperor thought highly of Zhou, but he was also suffering from the infiltration of public opinion and was at a loss as to what to do. At that time, Chang'an ordered Yang Xing to be favored because of his talents and often praised Zhou Kan. The emperor wanted him to help, so he summoned Yang Xingjian and said, "The courtiers are angry and don't tolerate Guang Luxun. Why?" Yang Xing was a cunning man and thought that the emperor was suspicious of Zhou Kan, so he obeyed the order and said: "Zhou Kan is not only not allowed in the court, but also in the state." I saw that everyone heard that Zhou Kan had conspired with Liu Gengsheng and others before, and thought he should be killed. Therefore, I said before that Zhou Kan should not be killed because he was doing favors for the country. The emperor said: But what crime has this committed that warrants execution? What to do now? Yang Xing said: I think I can confer the title of Marquis of Guannei with the title of Marquis of Guannei and a settlement of 300 households without letting him take charge of affairs. It is the most appropriate strategy for Mingzhu not to lose his master's kindness. The emperor then became suspicious. When Zhuge Feng, the captain of the city gate school, also spoke ill of Zhou Kan and Zhang Meng, the emperor became angry and dismissed Zhuge Feng from his post. It's all about his passing. He also said: Zhuge Feng said that Zhou Kan and Zhang did not behave upright and honest. I did not take pity on them, and it was a pity that their talents could not be put to use. Zhou Kan was demoted to the governor of Hedong and Zhang Meng to the order of Huaili. The dictatorship of Shi Xian and others was even more powerful. More than three years later, a fire broke out in Xiaoxuan Temple, and there was a solar eclipse on the last day of this month. So Zaoshang summoned several people who had said that the sun's change was due to Zhou Kan and Zhang Meng, and they all apologized. So Xia Shao said: "Zhou Kan, the governor of Hedong, the late emperor respected him and appointed him to be my master." He has good character, is proficient in Taoism, has integrity in discussion, has perseverance, is sincere and energetic, and truly cares about the country. Because he cannot flatter the powerful, he is lonely and helpless, his progress and retreat are suppressed, and he ultimately cannot prosper. In the past, when the ministers saw the disaster, they did not devote themselves to self-cultivation and ponder the cause. Instead, they talked about the natural disaster in a confused way and blamed this person. I had no choice but to demote him from the court to test him and show his talents. After Zhou Kan went out, big changes happened again and everyone fell silent. Zhou Kan had been in power for less than a year, and the three old officials and knowledgeable people praised his virtues. When envoys passed through the county, no one did not praise him. This is enough to show that the late emperor understood talents, and I understand it myself. The common people then created troubles, criticized and slandered, some of which were tortuous and obscure, and could not be discussed clearly. They also suspected others of the same kind and wanted to harm him, but I did not take any action. I am forced by the world and cannot concentrate. Previously, there was a disaster in the sky, and I was very frightened. Now that Zhou Kan is getting old, he may not be able to explain himself. What will he do if he is ostracized by others? Zhou Kan was summoned to the court. He was worshiped as Doctor Guanglu, with a rank of two thousand stones, and was in charge of the secretarial affairs. Zhang Meng became Taizhong's doctor again and served Shizhong. Shi Xian was in charge of Shangshu affairs, and the five Shangshu were all members of his party. Zhou Kan rarely saw the emperor, and often communicated through Shi Xian, and all matters were decided through Shi Xian's mouth. Zhou Kan fell ill with mute disease and died after being unable to speak. Genti framed him so fiercely that he committed suicide on the bus. Reincarnation was very painful, so he wrote eight chapters in total, including "Slander", "Essays", "Rescue" and "Ode to the World", using ancient metaphors to express condolences for himself and his kind. So it was abandoned for more than ten years. When Emperor Cheng ascended the throne, Shi Xian and others confessed their crimes, so he was reincarnated and used it again, changing his name to Xiang. Liu Xiang summoned him as Zhonglang as his former Jiuqing, and asked him to lead and protect the three auxiliaries in the capital. He submitted sealed chapters many times and was promoted to Doctor Guanglu. At this time, the emperor's uncle Wang Feng, Marquis of Yangping, became the general in charge of the government. He relied on the Queen Mother and specialized in state power. All seven brothers were granted the title of marquis. There were many major disasters at that time, and Liu Xiang believed that it was the fault of his relatives Guisheng and Wang Feng brothers who were in power. The emperor was carefully studying "Poems" and "Books", reading ancient texts on the blackboard, and ordered Liu Xiang to be the secretary of the "Five Classics" in the school. In Liu Xiangkun's "Shangshu" and "Hongfan", Jizi stated for King Wu the fulfillment of blessings and misfortunes of the five elements of yin and yang. Liu Xiang collected the ancient records of Fu Rui's disasters from the Spring and Autumn Kingdom to the Qin and Han Dynasties, deduced what happened, and added explanations of misfortunes and blessings, and wrote out the fulfillment of divination, arranged by category, each with its own entries, a total of eleven articles, titled "Hong Fan's Five Elements Biography", and reported it to the emperor. The emperor knew in his heart that Liu Xiang was loyal and sincere, and he originally made this comment because of the Wang and Feng brothers, but in the end he could not take away the Wang family's power. After a long time, Changling was built, but it could not be completed for many years, and it returned to Yanling. The system was luxurious. Liu Shangshang admonished: I heard the "Book of Changes" said: When you are safe, you don't forget the danger; when you survive, you don't forget the destruction. Therefore, your own peace and the country can be protected. Therefore, a virtuous monarch observes the ending and the beginning extensively, understands the truth thoroughly, and makes a clear distinction between right and wrong. The king must be familiar with the three traditions and understand that the destiny given by destiny is broad and not limited to one surname. Confucius was talking about "Poems", and the officials who arrived in Yin were so good and agile that they held a ceremony in Zhoujing to drink wine and help the sacrifices. They sighed: How great is the destiny of heaven! Good deeds must not be passed on to descendants, because wealth and honor are impermanent; if this is not the case, then why should the princes be vigilant and cautious, and why should the people be advised and encouraged? Probably because he was sad that Wei Zi served the Zhou Dynasty, and deplored Yin's demise. Even with the sage of Yao and Shun, it could not teach a son like Danzhu; even with the virtue of Yutang, it could not teach Jie and Zhou who were the last descendants. From ancient times to the present, there is no country that is immortal. In the past, Emperor Gaozu destroyed Qin and established his capital in Luoyang. After understanding Liu Jing's words, he thought that his virtue was not as good as that of Huang, but more virtuous than that of children, so he moved his capital to Laosheng, relying on Gu's virtues and using the dangers of fortress. The short and long ways of the world are judged by virtue, so they often tremble and dare not avoid death. This is probably what King Cong meant when he said "wealth is impermanent". Emperor Xiaowen stood on the Ba Mausoleum, facing the water to the north. He felt sad and miserable. He turned around and said to the ministers: Ah! Use Beishan stone to make the coffin, cut off the wadding and put it between the utensils, and paint it well. How can you shake it? Zhang Shizhi said: If there is something worth asking for in the wrapping, even if it is as strong as Nanshan, there will still be cracks to drill through; if there is nothing worth asking for in the wrapping, even if there is no stone coffin, what is the sadness? Death has no end, but countries rise and fall, so if you explain it, you are planning for the infinite future. Xiaowen realized that he was buried lightly and did not build a mountain tomb. "Yi" says: In ancient times, burials were covered with firewood and hidden in the wilderness without making graves or planting trees. Later generations of saints used coffins instead. Making coffins began with the Yellow Emperor. Huangdi was buried in Qiaoshan, and Yao was buried in Jiyin. The tombs were both small and the burial goods were meager. Shun was buried in Cangwu, and his two concubines had no attendants. Yu was buried in Kuaiji, and the original order of everything on the ground was not changed. There is no burial place in Yin Tang. Dukes Wen, Wu, and Zhou were buried in Bi, Duke Mu of Qin was buried under the Prayer Hall of Yongliquan Palace, and Chuilizi was buried in the arsenal. There are no tombs in either of them. This is the plan that the Holy Emperor, the Ming King, the Wise Lord, the Wise Lord, and the wise men have thought deeply about and spread to the infinite. Their virtuous ministers and filial sons also obeyed the orders and were buried sparingly. This was indeed the ultimate expression of loyalty and filial piety in serving their emperor and father. Duke Zhou was the younger brother of King Wu, and it was very meager to bury his brother. Confucius buried his mother in Fang, and praised the ancient people who built tombs instead of building tombs. He said: Qiu is a person who travels around in the east, west, north, and south, so he must not leave marks. A four-foot grave was made, but it collapsed when it rained. The disciple repaired it and told Confucius. Confucius cried and said: I heard that in ancient times, tombs were not repaired. Probably to criticize them. Yanling Jizi returned to Qi State. His son died. He was buried between Ying and Bo. There was no spring water in the ground. He used the clothes he wore at that time to bury him and made a grave to cover the pit. The height could be as high as the elbow. He cried: "The flesh and blood return to the earth. This is fate, and the soul is everywhere." Ying and Bo were more than a thousand miles away from Wu, and Ji Zi refused to bury him and return home. Confucius went to see it and said: "What Yanling Jizi did is very polite." Therefore, Zhongni was a filial son, Yanling was a loving father, Shun Yu was a忠臣, and Zhou Gong knew how to be a younger brother. They buried the monarch and their relatives with very little money; they were not frugal, but in line with etiquette. Sima Huan of the Song Dynasty made a stone coffin, but Zhongni said that it would be better to let it decay as soon as possible. Lu Buwei, the prime minister of Qin, gathered his wise men to write the *Spring and Autumn Annals*, which also talked about the principle of thin burial. They were all sensible people. When he arrived at the King of Wu's house, he was buried without ceremony. More than ten years later, the Yue people dug up his tomb. By the time of the Qin Dynasty, the five kings Huiwen, Wu, Zhao and Yanxiang had built large tombs and buried many of them, but they were all dug up and their bodies were exposed. It was very sad. The First Emperor of Qin was buried in the mountain curve of Lishan Mountain. Three springs were cast below, and a mountain tomb was built above. It was more than fifty feet high and more than five miles around. The stone coffin was made into a palace villa, human anointing was made into lamps and candles, mercury was made into rivers and seas, and gold was made into geese. The treasures buried, the mechanical ingenuity, the magnificence of the coffins, the grandeur of the palaces are endless. He also killed many palace people and buried tens of thousands of craftsmen alive. The world was built with the pain of labor. The construction of Lishan Mountain was not completed, and Zhou Zhang's millions of troops had already arrived below. Xiang Ji burned his palace buildings, and everyone who went there dug out. Later, the shepherd boy lost his sheep, and the sheep went into the storage room. The shepherd boy held up a fire to look for the sheep, but the coffin caught fire and burned down. From ancient times to the present, there has been no grander funeral than that of the First Emperor. Within a few years, he suffered the disaster of Xiang Ji externally and the disaster of Mu Shu internally. Isn’t it very sad! Therefore, the more virtuous people are buried, the more modest their burials are, and the more intelligent people are buried, the simpler their burials are. Those without moral wisdom will be buried thickly, their tombs will be high, their palaces and temples will be more ornate, and they will be dug up more quickly. From this point of view, the test of light and darkness, and the good and bad luck of funerals, are clearly visible. Zhou De had declined and was extravagant, but King Xuan was wise and rejuvenated. He instead saved palace expenses and reduced the size of his temple. The poet praised him, such as the poem "Si Qian". The first chapter says that the palace follows the system, and the next chapter says that there are many descendants. When he came to support Yan Gong, he decorated the ancestral temple and built many platforms. His descendants were extinct twice. The *Spring and Autumn Annals* ridiculed him. Zhou Xuan prospered like this, while Lu and Qin became extinct like this. This is the gain and loss of luxury and frugality. 陛下即位，亲身从事节俭，开始建第一个陵，形制约小，天下没人不称赞贤明。 When it came to moving to Changling, the low places were filled up, the earth was piled up into mountains, and the tombs of the people were opened, totaling tens of thousands, and cities were built. The time was tight and the cost was hundreds of millions and hundreds of millions. The dead are holding grudges underground, while the living are grieving on the ground. The resentment has become yin and yang, coupled with famine, there are hundreds of thousands of people dead and in exile. I am very sad. If the deceased has a spirit, opening someone else's tomb will do a lot of harm; if he has no spirit, then there is no need to enlarge it? Discussing with the wise people makes everyone unhappy, and makes the people complain when they see it; if it is just to please the stupid and indulgent people, why do it? Your Majesty is very kind and sincere, and extremely intelligent and knowledgeable. He should carry forward the virtues of the Han family, carry forward the good deeds of the Liu family, and glorify the Five Emperors and Three Kings. However, he competes with the monarchs of the Qin Dynasty for luxury, compares with graves, and pleases the eyes of fools. He only pursues temporary beauty, goes against the wishes of wise men, and loses peace for all eternity. I am privately ashamed of your Majesty. Please observe the system of the sage Huang Di, Yao, Shun, Yu, Tang, Wen, Wu, Zhou Gong, and Zhongni from above, and understand the thoughts of Mu Gong, Yanling, Chuili, and Zhang Shizhi from the bottom. Emperor Xiaowen cut the tombs thin and buried them lightly, using frugality to calm the gods, which can be followed. Qin Zhao and the First Emperor added mountains and buried them in large sums, which caused worries due to extravagance, which is enough to serve as a warning. The scale of the original mausoleum should be based on the opinions of the ministers to stabilize the people. After the book was written, the emperor was very moved by Liu Xiang's words, but he could not act according to his opinions. Liu Xiang saw that the customs were more extravagant, while the likes of Zhao and Wei were of humble origin and transcended etiquette. Liu Xiang believed that Wang's teachings started from the outside and from the near. So he excerpted the virtuous concubines and chaste wives recorded in the "Poems" and "Books", who made the country

input_text: 樊哙，沛人也，以屠狗为事。 后与高祖俱隐于芒砀山泽间。 陈胜初起，萧何、曹参使哙求迎高祖，立为沛公。 哙以舍人从攻胡陵、方与，还守丰，击泗水临丰下，破之。 复东定沛，破泗水守薛西。 与司马尸二战砀东，却敌，斩首十五级，赐爵国大夫。 常从，沛公击章邯军濮阳，攻城先登，斩首二十三级，赐爵列大夫。 从攻城阳，先登。下户牖，破李由军，斩首十六级，赐上闻爵。 后攻圉都尉、东郡守尉于成武，却敌，斩首十四级，捕虏十六人，赐爵五大夫。 从攻秦军，出亳南。 河间守军于杠里，破之。 击破赵贲军开封北，以却敌先登，斩候一人，首六十八级，捕虏二十六人，赐爵卿。 从攻破扬熊于曲遇。 攻宛陵，先登，斩首八级，捕虏四十四人，赐爵封号贤成君。 从攻长社、轘辕，绝河津，东攻秦军尸乡，南攻秦军于犨。 破南阳守齮于阳城。东攻宛城，先登。 西至郦，以却敌，斩首十四级，捕虏四十人，赐重封。 攻武关，至霸上，斩都尉一人，首十级，捕虏百四十六人，降卒二千九百人。 项羽在戏下，欲攻沛公。
target_text: Fan Kuai, a native of Peixian County, was a dog butcher by trade. He hid with Emperor Gaozu in the Mangshan and Cishan areas to avoid official duties. During Chen Sheng's uprising, Xiao He and Cao Shen sent Fan Kuai to retrieve Gaozu, who became Peigong. Fan Kuai served as a Sheren, attacking Huling, Fangyu, and Fengyi, defeating the Sishui County Supervisor. He pacified Peixian County and defeated the Sishui County Governor at Xuexian. He fought Sima Chao in Ci County, beheading fifteen enemies, earning the title of doctor. Fan Kuai frequently followed Peigong, leading assaults on Puyang, Chengyang, and Hufu, beheading many enemies and receiving promotions. He fought at Chengwu, Boyi, Gangli, and Kaifeng, beheading a commander and sixty-eight enemies, earning the title of minister. He defeated Yang Xiong at Quyu, ascended Wanling first, and was named Xianchengjun. He fought at Changshe, Nianyuan, and the Yellow River ferry, defeating Qin forces at Xixiang and Nianyi. He defeated Nanyang's Shouling at Yangcheng, ascended Wancheng first, and repelled enemies at Li County. At Wuguan and Bashang, he beheaded a captain and ten enemies, capturing 146 and surrendering 2,900 soldiers.

input_text: 后数日，项羽入屠咸阳，立沛公为汉王。 汉王赐哙爵为列侯，号临武侯。 迁为郎中，从入汉中。 还定三秦，别击西丞白水北，雍轻车骑雍南，破之。 从攻雍、斄城，先登。 击章平军好畤，攻城，先登陷阵，斩县令丞各一人，首十一级，虏二十人，迁为郎中骑将。 从击秦车骑壤东，却敌，迁为将军。 攻赵贲，下郿、槐里、柳中、咸阳；灌废丘，最。 至栎阳，赐食邑杜之樊乡。 从攻项籍，屠煮枣，击破王武、程处军于外黄。 攻邹、鲁、瑕丘、薛。 项羽败汉王于彭城，尽复取鲁、梁地。 哙还至荥阳，益食平阴二千户，以将军守广武一岁。项羽引东，从高祖击项籍，下阳夏，虏楚周将军卒四千人。 围项籍陈，大破之。屠胡陵。
target_text: At the Hongmen Banquet, Xiang Yu prepared to attack Peigong. Peigong apologized to Xiang Yu via Xiang Bo. During the feast, Yafu ordered Xiang Zhuang to assassinate Peigong with a sword dance, but Xiang Bo protected him. Fan Kuai, hearing the urgency, entered the camp with sword and shield, confronting Xiang Yu. He drank wine and ate pork leg, condemning Xiang Yu for listening to slander and estranging Peigong. Xiang Yu remained silent. Peigong left, and Fan Kuai escorted him back to Bashang, leaving Zhang Liang to apologize. Xiang Yu abandoned his plan to kill Peigong. Later, Xiang Yu entered Xianyang, burning and killing, and made Peigong King of Han. Fan Kuai was made Marquis of Linwu, then doctor, and followed the king to Hanzhong. He pacified the Three Qin Dynasties, attacking Xixian, Yong County, Yongxian, and Tengcheng, ascending cities first. He attacked Zhang Ping at Haozhi, beheading a magistrate and a deputy, and was promoted to Cavalry General. He defeated Qin chariot and cavalry forces at Shumian and Rangxiang, becoming a general. He attacked Zhao Bi, occupying Jun, Huaili, Liuzhong, and Xianyang, diverting water to irrigate waste hills. The King of Han granted him Fan Township in Du County as a food town.

input_text: 项籍死，汉王即皇帝位，以哙有功，益食邑八百户。 其秋，燕王臧荼反，哙从攻虏荼，定燕地。 楚王韩信反，哙从至陈，取信，定楚。 更赐爵列侯，与剖符，世世勿绝，食舞阳，号为舞阳侯，除前所食。 以将军从攻反者韩王信于代。 自霍人以往至云中，与绛侯等共定之，益食千五百户。 因击陈豨与曼丘臣军，战襄国，破柏人，先登，降定清河、常山凡二十七县，残东垣，迁为左丞相。 破得綦母卯、尹潘军于无终、广昌。破豨别将胡人王黄军代南，因击韩信军参合。 军所将卒斩韩信，击豨胡骑横谷，斩将军赵既，虏代丞相冯梁、守孙奋、大将王黄、将军一人、太仆解福等十人。 与诸将共定代乡邑七十三。 后燕王卢绾反，哙以相国击绾，破其丞相抵蓟南，定燕县十八、乡邑五十一。 益食千三百户，定食舞阳五千四百户。 从，斩首百七十六级，虏二百八十七人。别，破军七，下城五，定郡六、县五十二，得丞相一人，将军十三人，二千石以下至三百石十二人。 哙以吕后弟吕须为妇，生子伉，故其比诸将最亲。
target_text: Fan Kuai followed the king to attack Xiang Yu, slaughtering Zaoyi and defeating Wang Wu and Cheng Chu at Waihuang. He attacked Zouxian, Luxian, Xiaqiu, and Xuexian. After Xiang Yu defeated the king at Pengcheng, Fan Kuai returned to Rongyang, receiving 2,000 households in Pingyin and garrisoning Guangwu Mountain for a year. He surrounded Xiang Yu at Chen County, defeating him and bloodbathing Hu Ling. After Xiang Yu's death, the king became emperor, granting Fan Kuai 800 households. He followed Gaozu to suppress Zang Tu's rebellion, capturing Zang Tu and pacifying Yan. He arrested Han Xin at Chen County, pacifying Chu. Gaozu granted Fan Kuai the title of Marquis of Wuyang, exempting previous titles. He followed Gaozu to attack Chen Xi in Daidi, pacifying Dai land and increasing households by 1,500. He attacked Chen Xi and Manqiuchen, capturing Bairen County, ascending cities first, and pacifying Qinghe and Changshan counties (27 total), destroying Shuyuan County, and becoming Left Prime Minister. He defeated Qi Muyin and Yin Pan at Wuzhong and Guangchang, and Chen Xi's general Wang Huang at Daidi, attacking Han Xin at Shenhe. His men killed Han Xin, defeated Xiongnu cavalry at Henggu, and captured General Zhao Ji, Prime Minister Feng Liang, and others. He pacified 72 counties in Dai. He attacked Lu Wan, pacifying 18 counties and 51 townships in Yan. Gaozu added 1,300 households, totaling 5,400 in Wuyang. Fan Kuai beheaded 176 enemies, captured 287, defeated seven armies, occupied five cities, and pacified six commanderies and 52 counties. He married Empress Lu's sister, Lu Xu, and had a son, Fan Kang. He was closest to the emperor.

input_text: 孝惠六年，哙薨，谥曰武侯，子伉嗣。 而伉母吕须亦为临光侯，高后时用事颛权，大臣尽畏之。 高后崩，大臣诛吕须等，因诛伉，舞阳侯中绝数月。 孝文帝立，乃复封哙庶子市人为侯，复故邑。 薨，谥曰荒侯。 子佗广嗣。 六岁，其舍人上书言： 荒侯市人病不能为人，令其夫人与其弟乱而生佗广，佗广实非荒侯子。 下吏，免。 平帝元始二年，继绝世，封哙玄孙之子章为舞阳侯，邑千户。 郦商，高阳人也。 陈胜起，商聚少年得数千人。 沛公略地六月余，商以所将四千人属沛公于岐。从攻长社，先登，赐爵封信成君。 从攻缑氏，绝河津，破秦军雒阳东。 从下宛、穰，定十七县。
target_text: During Yingbu's rebellion, Gaozu was ill and refused to see anyone. Fan Kuai opened the palace door, weeping and rebuking Gaozu for isolating himself like Zhao Gao. Gaozu smiled and rose. Later, Gaozu sent Fan Kuai to attack Lu Wan. Slandered for colluding with the Lu family, Gaozu ordered Chen Ping to behead him, but Chen Ping arrested him instead. Gaozu died, and Empress Lu released Fan Kuai, restoring his title. Fan Kuai died in the sixth year of Xiaohui, posthumously named Marquis Wu. His son Fan Kang succeeded. Lu Xu was made Marquise of Linguang, but after Empress Lu's death, ministers killed her and Fan Kang. The title was suspended until Emperor Xiaowen granted it to Fan Kuai's concubine's son, Fan Shi. After Fan Shi's death, his son Fan Tuoguang inherited, but was later deposed for illegitimacy. In the second year of Yuanshi, Emperor Ping granted Fan Zhang, a descendant, the title of Marquis of Wuyang with 1,000 households.

input_text: 别将攻旬关，西定汉中。 沛公为汉王，赐商爵信成侯，以将军为陇西都尉。 别定北地郡，破章邯别将于乌氏、栒邑、泥阳，赐食邑武城六千户。 从击项籍军，与钟离眛战，受梁相国印，益食四千户。 从击项羽二岁，攻胡陵。 汉王即帝位，燕王臧荼反，商以将军从击荼，战龙脱，先登陷阵，破荼军易下，却敌，迁为右丞相，赐爵列侯，与剖符，世世勿绝，食邑涿郡五千户。 别定上谷，因攻代，受赵相国印。 与绛侯等定代郡、雁门，得代丞相程纵、守相郭同、将军以下至六百石十九人。 还，以将军将太上皇卫一岁。 十月，以右丞相击陈豨，残东垣。 又从击黥布，攻其前垣，陷两阵，得以破布军，更封为曲周侯，食邑五千一百户，除前所食。 凡别破军三，降定郡六，县七十三，得丞相、守相、大将各一人，小将二人，二千石以下至六百石十九人。
target_text: Li Shang of Gaoyang County gathered youths during Chen Sheng's uprising. He surrendered 4,000 men to Peigong, attacking Changshe and ascending first, becoming Xinchengjun. He attacked Fengshi, blocked the Yellow River, defeated Qin at Luoyang, captured Wan and Xing, pacifying 17 counties. He assisted in taking Shanguan Pass and pacifying Hanzhong. Peigong became King of Han, making Li Shang Xinchengjun and Captain of Longxi. He pacified Beidi, defeating Zhang Han's deputies, and received 6,000 households in Wucheng. He attacked Xiang Ji, fighting Zhong Limei, and received the Prime Minister's Seal of Liang. He attacked Xiang Yu for two years, then Hu Ling. After the emperor's ascension, he attacked Zang Tu, defeating him at Longtuo and Yixia, becoming Right Prime Minister and receiving 5,000 households in Zhuojun. He attacked Shanggu and Dai, receiving Zhao Xiang's seal. He pacified Dai and Yanmen with Jianghou, capturing Dai's Prime Minister Cheng Zong and 19 others. He commanded the Imperial Guard for a year. In October, as Right Prime Minister, he attacked Chen Xi, destroying Shuyuan. He attacked Yingbu, breaking barriers and capturing two formations, becoming Marquis of Quzhou with 5,100 households. His military achievements included defeating three rebels, pacifying six counties and 73 counties, capturing one prime minister, one acting prime minister, one general, and 19 officials. He assisted Emperor Xiaohui and Empress Lu. After Empress Lu's death, he was ill. His son Li Ji, friendly with Lu Lu, was used by Zhou Bo to deceive Lu Lu, allowing Zhou Bo to enter the Northern Army and kill the Lu family. Li Shang died that year, posthumously named Jinghou. Li Ji inherited, but was criticized for betraying friends. During Emperor Xiaojing's reign, Li Ji besieged Tong City for seven months without success, but Lebu captured it. Li Ji was stripped of his title for wanting to marry Lord Pingyuan. Emperor Jing named Li Jian, another son, Marquis of Mu. The title passed to Xuansun Su, who was executed for witchcraft. During the Second Beginning, descendants were granted Marquis of Guannei.

input_text: 从击章邯军东阿、濮阳下，以兵车趣攻战疾，破之，赐爵执圭。 从击赵贲军开封，杨熊军曲遇。 婴从捕虏六十八人，降卒八百五十人，得印一匮。 又击秦军雒阳东，以兵车趣攻战疾，赐爵封，转为膝令。 因奉车从攻定南阳，战于蓝田、芷阳，至霸上。 沛公为汉王，赐婴爵列侯，号昭平侯，复为太仆，从入蜀汉。 还定三秦，从击项籍。 至鼓城，项羽大破汉军。 汉王不利，驰去。见孝惠、鲁元，载之。 汉王急，马罢，虏在后，常跋两儿弃之，婴常收载行，面雍树驰。 汉王怒，欲斩婴者十余，卒得脱，而致孝惠、鲁元于丰。 汉王既至荥阳，收散兵，复振，赐婴食邑沂阳。 击项籍下邑，追至陈，卒定楚。
target_text: Xiahou Ying of Peixian County managed horse breeding and driving. He often spoke with Gaozu at Sishang Pavilion. He served as a county official and became friends with Gaozu. Gaozu injured him while playing, but Xiahou Ying testified for Gaozu, enduring imprisonment and whipping. When Gaozu started his army, Xiahou Ying served as a minor official. Gaozu became Peigong, granting Xiahou Ying the title of seventh-level duke and making him a royal servant. He followed Gaozu to attack Huling, surrendering Ping, the Sishui Supervisor, and receiving the ninth rank. He attacked Qin at Yangdong, captured Jiyang and Hufu, defeated Li You at Yongqiu, and received titles and silk. He attacked Zhang Han at Shu'a and Puyang, using chariots to defeat the Qin army, becoming Zhigui. He attacked Trip Ben at Kaifeng and Yang Xiong at Quyu, capturing 68 and surrendering 850, receiving a cabinet of official seals. He pursued Qin at Luoyang, becoming magistrate of Teng County. He fought at Lantian and Zhiyang to Bashang. Peigong became King of Han, granting him the title of Marquis of Zhaoping and making him a royal servant. He followed the king to Shuhan and pacified the Three Qin Dynasties. At Pengcheng, Xiang Yu defeated the Han army. Xiahou Ying rescued Emperor Xiaohui and Princess Lu Yuan, carrying them despite Gaozu's attempts to abandon them. He sent them to Fengdi. At Rongyang, he received Yiyang as a food city. He attacked Xiang Ji at Xiayi, pursuing to Chen, defeating Chu. At Lucheng, he added Zishi County. After the emperor's ascension, he attacked Zang Tu and captured Han Xin. He was made Marquis of Ruyin with a talisman. He attacked Dai, going to Wuquan and Yunzhong, adding 1,000 households. He attacked Han Xin at Jinyang, defeating the enemy. Surrounded at Pingcheng for seven days, he advised slow retreat, escaping. He received Xiyang as a food town. He attacked Xiongnu cavalry at Juzhu and Pingcheng, receiving 500 households. He attacked Chen Xi and Yingbu, adding 1,000 households, totaling 6,900 in Ruyin. He served Gaozu until his death, then served Emperor Hui and Empress Lu. They thanked him for rescuing Xiaohui and Princess Lu Yuan, giving him a first-class residence. After Empress Lu's death, he supported Emperor Wen, remaining a royal servant. He died eight years later, posthumously named Wenhou. The title passed to Xiahou Po, who married Princess Pingyang but committed suicide, ending the feudal state. Xiahou Ying was originally named Teng Gong, and his descendants changed their surname to Sun.

input_text: 黥布反，以车骑将军先出，攻布别将于相，破之，斩亚将楼烦将三人。 又进击破布上柱国及大司马军。 又进破布别将肥铢。 婴身生得左司马一人，所将卒斩其小将十人，追北至淮上。 益食邑二千五百户。 布已破，高帝归，定令婴食颍阴五千户，除前所食邑。 凡从所得二千石二人，别破军十六，降城四十六，定国一、郡二、县五十二，得将军二人，柱国、相各一人，二千石十人。 婴自破布归，高帝崩，以列侯事惠帝及吕后。 吕后崩，吕禄等欲为乱。 齐哀王闻之，举兵西，吕禄等以婴为大将军往击之。 婴至荥阳，乃与绛侯等谋，因屯兵荥阳，风齐王以诛吕氏事，齐兵止不前。 绛侯等既诛诸吕，齐王罢兵归。 婴自荥阳还，与绛侯、陈平共立文帝。 于是益封婴三千户，赐金千斤，为太尉。 三岁，绛侯勃免相，婴为丞相，罢太尉官。 是岁，匈奴大入北地，上令丞相婴将骑八万五千击匈奴。 匈奴去，济北王反，诏罢婴兵。 后岁余，以丞相薨，谥曰懿侯。
target_text: Guan Ying of Suiyang County was a silk merchant. He served as a follower in Zhongjuan under Peigong. He defeated Qin's Shujun at Chengwu and Gangli, becoming Seventh Doctor. He attacked Qin at Bo, Kaifeng, and Quyu, becoming Xuanling Jun. He attacked west of Yangwu to Luoyang, defeating Qin north of Xi. He crossed the Yellow River, defeated the Nanyang governor, pacified Nanyang, entered Wuguan, fought at Lantian, and became Zhigui and Changwenjun. Peigong became King of Han, making him a doctor and then a lieutenant. He pacified the Three Qin Dynasties, captured Shuoyang, and surrendered to the King of Sai. He besieged Zhang Han at Feiqiu. He followed the king east, defeated King Yin, and pacified his territory. He attacked Xiang Yu's general Long Qie and Xiang Tuo at Dingtao, defeating them. The king granted him the title of Changwen Marquis with a seat in Pingxiang. He followed the king to conquer Ci and attack Pengcheng. After Xiang Yu's victory, he garrisoned Yongqiu, defeating Wang Wu and Wei Gongshen. He captured Wai and went to Rongyang. The king appointed him as a cavalry general with Li Bi and Luo Jia. He attacked Chu cavalry at Rongyang, cutting off their food routes. He attacked Xiang Guan at Lu, killing a You Sima and a cavalry general. He defeated Duke Zhe and Wang Wu at Yan, killing five generals. He defeated Dan Ying at the imperial palace. He led cavalry across the Yellow River, escorted the king, and met the prime minister's army at Yisu. He returned to Aocang, becoming imperial censor. In the third year, he received a food town in Pingxiang. As censor, he led cavalry east, defeating rebels at Lixia, capturing Hua Wushang and 46 officials. He captured Linzi and Qi Prime Minister Tian Guang. He pursued Tian Heng to Ying and Bo, defeating his cavalry. He captured Gu and Bo, killing Tian Su at Qiancheng. He followed Han Xin to attack Longdan at Baoshi, killing Longdan and capturing Zhou Lan. After Qi was pacified, Han Xin became king of Qi, sending Guan Ying to attack Chu's Gong Dai at Lu. He defeated the Xue County governor, capturing a cavalryman. He attacked Fu Yang and marched to Tong, Qili, and Xu. He crossed the silver carp, capturing cities to Guangling. He defeated Xideng and Langsheng at Gongpi, killing Zheng Gong. He defeated Chu cavalry at Wangdang, pacified Pengcheng, capturing Xiang Tuo and Liu, Xue, Pei, Deng, Lu, and Dao. He attacked Xuanse and Zhese, capturing a deputy general. He joined the king at Yixiang, defeating Xiang Lan at Chen. His men killed two generals and captured eight. The king added 2,500 households. He pursued Xiang Ji to Shucheng, defeating him. Five of his men killed Xiang Ji, becoming marquises. He captured 12,000 enemies and all generals. He captured Shucheng and Liyang. He crossed Dansi, defeated the Chengsu county magistrate, and pacified 52 counties north of Jin Hui. After the king's ascension, he added 3,000 households. As a chariot general, he attacked Zang Tu and captured Han Xin. He received a talisman and 2,500 households in Yingyin. He attacked King Xin of Han at Daidi, capturing six counties north of Loufan, beheading the left general. He defeated Xiongnu cavalry at Wuquan. He attacked Han Zhi and Bao Chu at Jinyang, killing a general. He led troops from Yan, Zhao, Qi, Liang, and Chu to defeat Xiongnu at Bishi. Surrounded at Pingcheng, he followed the emperor to attack Chen Xi, killing Hou Chang and five generals. He attacked Quni, Lunu, Shangquyang, Anguo, and Anping. He captured Dongdanse. When Yingbu rebelled, he attacked first, defeating Yingbu's generals at Xiangdi, beheading three deputy generals. He destroyed Yingbu's Shangzhu State and Da Sima. He defeated Fei Zhu. He captured Zuo Sima, and his men killed ten young generals, pursuing to the Huaihe River. The emperor added 2,500 households. After Yingbu's defeat, the emperor granted him 5,000 households in Yingyin. He captured two generals with 2,000 stone salaries, destroyed the enemy 16 times, occupied 46 cities, and pacified one traitor, two counties, and 52 counties. He captured two generals, one Zhuguo, and one Xiang. He served Emperor Hui and Empress Lu. After Empress Lu's death, Lu Lu and others rebelled. Guan Ying was sent to attack the Qi army but stationed at Rongyang, persuading the King of Qi to focus on the Lu family. After the Lu family was punished, he supported Emperor Wen, receiving 3,000 households and 1,000 catties of gold, becoming Taiwei. In the third year of Emperor Wen, he became Prime Minister. He led 85,000 cavalry against the Xiongnu, who retreated. He died as prime minister. The title passed to his grandson Bi Qiang, who lost it for crimes. During Emperor Wu's reign, his grandson Yi Zi was made Marquis of Linru but later deposed.

input_text: 传至孙强，有罪，绝。 武帝复封婴孙贤为临汝侯，奉婴后，后有罪，国除。 傅宽，以魏五大夫骑将从，为舍人，起横阳。 从攻安阳、杠里，赵贲军于开封，及击杨熊曲遇、阳武、斩首十二级，赐爵卿。 从至霸上。 沛公为汉王，赐宽封号共德君。 从入汉中，为右骑将。 定三秦，赐食邑雕阴。 从击项籍，待怀，赐爵通德侯。 从击项冠、周兰、龙且，所将卒斩骑将一人敖下，益食邑。 属淮阴，击破齐历下军，击田解。 属相国参，残博，益食邑。 因定齐地，剖符世世勿绝，封阳陵侯，二千六百户，除前所食。 为齐右丞相，备齐。 五岁，为齐相国。 四月，击陈豨，属太尉勃，以相国代丞相哙击豨。 一月，徙为代相国，将屯。 二岁，为丞相，将屯。 孝惠五年，薨，谥曰景侯。 传至曾孙偃，谋反，诛，国除。 靳歙，以中涓从，起宛朐。
target_text: Fu Kuan, a cavalry officer of Wei, followed Peigong, raising troops in Hengyang. He captured Anyang and Gangli, defeated Zhao Ben at Kaifeng, and attacked Yang Xiong at Quyu and Yangwu, killing 12 enemies, becoming a duke. Peigong became King of Han, making him Gongdejun. He entered Guanzhong as a right-hand cavalry general. After pacifying the Three Qin Dynasties, he received Diaoyin as a food town. He attacked Xiang Ji, following the king at Huai County, becoming Marquis of Tongde. He attacked Xiang Guan, Zhou Lan, and Long Qie, killing a cavalry general. Under Han Xin, he defeated Qi Zaili and attacked Tian Jie. Under Cao Shen, he destroyed Bo County. For pacifying Qi, he received a talisman and 2,600 households in Yangling, becoming Marquis of Yangling. He became Right Prime Minister of Qi, then Prime Minister. In April, he attacked Chen Xi under Zhou Bo. In January, he became Xiangguo of Dai, commanding the garrison. Two years later, he became Prime Minister of Dai. He died in the fifth year of Xiaohui, posthumously named Jinghou. The title passed to his great-grandson Fu Yan, who was executed for treason.

input_text: 攻济阳。 破李由军。 击秦军开封东，斩骑千人将一人，首五十七级，捕虏七十三人，赐爵封临平君。 又战蓝田北，斩车司马二人，骑长一人，首二十八级，捕虏五十七人。 至霸上，沛公为汉王，赐歙爵建武侯，迁骑都尉。 从定三秦。 别西击章平军于陇西，破之，定陇西六县，所将卒斩车司马、候各四人，骑长十二人。 从东击楚，至彭城。 汉军败还，保雍丘，击反者王武等。 略梁地，别西击邢说军菑南，破之，身得说都尉二人，司马、候十二人，降吏卒四千六百八十人。 破楚军荥阳东。食邑四千二百户。 别之河内，击赵贲军朝歌，破之，所将卒得骑将二人，车马二百五十匹。 从攻安阳以东，至棘蒲，下十县。 别攻破赵军，得其将司马二人，候四人，降吏卒二千四百人。 从降下邯郸。别下平阳，身斩守相，所将卒斩兵守、郡守各一人，降邺。 从攻朝歌、邯郸，又别击破赵军，降邯郸郡六县。
target_text: Zhou Jie of Pei followed Gaozu as Zhongjuan, raising troops in Wanqu. He attacked Jiyang, defeated Li You, and attacked Qin at Shumian and Kaifeng, beheading a thousand-general and 57 enemies, capturing 73, becoming Lord Linping. He fought at Lantian, killing two chariot commanders, one cavalry commander, and 28 enemies, capturing 57. At Bashang, Peigong became King of Han, making him Marquis of Jianwu and Captain of Cavalry. He pacified the Three Qin Dynasties, attacking Zhang Ping at Longxi, occupying six counties, killing four chariot commanders and four horsemen. He attacked Chu eastward to Pengcheng. After defeat, he held Yongqiu, defeating Wang Wu. He captured Liang, attacking Xing Shuo at Jun County, capturing two captains, 12 Sima, and surrendering 4,680. He defeated Chu at Rongyang, receiving 4,200 households. He led an army to Hanoi, defeating Chu Bi at Chaoge, capturing two cavalry generals and 250 chariots. He attacked Anyang to Jipu, occupying ten counties. He defeated Tong's army, capturing two generals and four Sima, surrendering 2,400. He captured Handan, leading an army to capture Pingyang, beheading a governor and pacifying Ye County. He attacked Chaoge and Handan, defeating Chang's army, capturing six counties in Handan. He returned to Aocang, defeating Xiang Ji south of Chenggao, cutting off Chu's food routes. He defeated a champion in Ludi, occupying Gao, Tan, Xiapi, Qixian, and Zhuyi. He attacked Xiang Han at Jiyang. He returned to Chen, defeating Xiang Ji's army, pacifying Jiangling.

input_text: 孝武皇帝六男。 卫皇后生戾太子，赵婕妤生孝昭帝，王夫人生齐怀王闳，李姬生燕刺王旦、广陵厉王胥，李夫人生昌邑哀王髆。 戾太子据，元狩元年立为皇太子，年七岁矣。 初，上年二十九乃得太子，甚喜，为立禖，使东方朔、枚皋作禖祝。 少壮，诏受《公羊春秋》，又从瑕丘江公受《谷梁》。 及冠就宫，上为立博望苑，使通宾客，从其所好，故多以异端进者。 元鼎四年，纳史良娣，产子男进，号曰史皇孙。 武帝末，卫后宠衰，江充用事，充与太子及卫氏有隙，恐上晏驾后为太子所诛，会巫蛊事起，充因此为奸。 是时，上春秋高，意多所恶，以为左右皆为蛊道祝诅，穷治其事。 丞相公孙贺父子，阳石、诸邑公主，及皇后弟子长平侯卫伉皆坐诛。 语在《公孙贺》、《江充传》。
target_text: Emperor Xiaowu had six sons from various consorts. Prince Ru, born to Queen Wei, was established as crown prince at age seven in the first year of Yuanshou. Emperor Wu was delighted and built a Plum Temple, ordering Dongfang Shuo and Meigao to write congratulations. The prince studied classical texts under Duke Xiaqiu Jiang, was crowned at twenty, and resided in the Tai Palace, where Emperor Wu built Bowang Garden for him to interact with guests.

input_text: 孝武皇帝六男。 卫皇后生戾太子，赵婕妤生孝昭帝，王夫人生齐怀王闳，李姬生燕刺王旦、广陵厉王胥，李夫人生昌邑哀王髆。 戾太子据，元狩元年立为皇太子，年七岁矣。 初，上年二十九乃得太子，甚喜，为立禖，使东方朔、枚皋作禖祝。 少壮，诏受《公羊春秋》，又从瑕丘江公受《谷梁》。 及冠就宫，上为立博望苑，使通宾客，从其所好，故多以异端进者。 元鼎四年，纳史良娣，产子男进，号曰史皇孙。 武帝末，卫后宠衰，江充用事，充与太子及卫氏有隙，恐上晏驾后为太子所诛，会巫蛊事起，充因此为奸。 是时，上春秋高，意多所恶，以为左右皆为蛊道祝诅，穷治其事。 丞相公孙贺父子，阳石、诸邑公主，及皇后弟子长平侯卫伉皆坐诛。 语在《公孙贺》、《江充传》。
target_text: In the fourth year of Yuanding, the prince married Shi Liangdi and fathered Liu Jin. In Emperor Wu's later years, Jiang Chong gained favor and held grudges against the prince and the Wei family. When witchcraft accusations arose, Jiang Chong exploited them for revenge. Emperor Wu, elderly and suspicious, ordered severe investigation. Prime Minister Gongsun He, his son, princesses, and the queen's brother's son were all implicated and killed.

input_text: 充典治巫蛊，既知上意，白言宫中有蛊气，入宫至省中，坏御座掘地。 上使按道侯韩说、御史章赣、黄门苏文等助充。 充遂至太子宫掘蛊，得桐木人。 时上疾，辟暑甘泉宫，独皇后、太子在。 太子召问少傅石德，德惧为师傅并诛，因谓太子曰： 前丞相父子、两公主及卫氏皆坐此，今巫与使者掘地得征验，不知巫置之邪，将实有也，无以自明，可矫以节收捕充等系狱，穷治其奸诈。 且上疾在甘泉，皇后及家吏请问皆不报，上存亡未可知，而奸臣如此，太子将不念秦扶苏事耶？ 太子急，然德言。 征和二年七月壬午，乃使客为使者收捕充等。 按道侯说疑使者有诈，不肯受诏，客格杀说。 御史章赣被创突亡。自归甘泉。 太子使舍人无且持节夜入未央宫殿长秋门，因长御倚华具白皇后，发中厩车载射士，出武库兵，发长乐宫卫，告令百官日江充反。乃斩充以徇，炙胡巫上林中。 遂部宾客为将率，与丞相刘屈氂等战。 长安中扰乱，言太子反，以故众不附。 太子兵败，亡，不得。 上怒甚，群下忧惧，不知所出。
target_text: Jiang Chong investigated the witchcraft case, claiming poisonous air in the palace. He entered the palace, demolished the throne, and dug up ground. Assisted by others, he went to the prince's palace and found a small figure carved from paulownia wood. Emperor Wu was ill at Ganquan Palace, leaving only the queen and prince in the palace.

target_text: The prince consulted his young master Shi De, who warned him about the fate of Prince Fusu of Qin and advised pretending to issue an imperial edict to arrest Jiang Chong. The prince agreed. On Renwu day in the seventh month of the second year of Zhenghe, the prince sent retainers to arrest Jiang Chong and others. One official was killed, another escaped to Ganquan Palace. The prince entered Weiyang Palace, reported to the queen, mobilized weapons and guards, declared Jiang Chong a rebel, killed him, and burned a shaman. He then deployed guests as generals against Prime Minister Liu Quli's army. Chang'an fell into chaos, and the prince's army was defeated. He fled but was not caught.

input_text: 壶关三老茂上书曰： 臣闻父者犹天，母者犹地，子犹万物也。 故天平地安，阴阳和调，物乃茂成；父慈母爱，室家之中子乃孝顺。 阴阳不和，则万物夭伤；父子不和，则室家丧亡。 故父不父则子不子，君不君则臣不臣，虽有粟，吾岂得而食诸！ 昔者虞舜，孝之至也，而不中于瞽叟；孝已被谤，伯奇放流，骨肉至亲，父子相疑。 何者？ 积毁之所生也。 由是观之，子无不孝，而父有不察，今皇太子为汉适嗣，承万世之业，体祖宗之重，亲则皇帝之宗子也。 江充，布衣之人，闾阎之隶臣耳，陛下显而用之，衔至尊之命以迫蹴皇太子，造饰奸诈，群邪错谬，是以亲戚之路隔塞而不通。
target_text: Emperor Wu was furious. A Huguan elder named Mao wrote a letter arguing that the prince had no evil intentions, comparing the situation to ancient examples of slander causing family discord. He urged the emperor to understand the prince's actions and withdraw troops. Emperor Wu was moved and awakened.

input_text: 书奏，天子感寤。 太子之亡也，东至湖，臧匿泉鸠里。 主人家贫，常卖屦以给太子。 太子有故人在湖，闻其富赡，使人呼之而发觉。 吏围捕太子，太子自度不得脱，即入室距户自经。 山阳男子张富昌为卒，足蹋开户，新安令史李寿趋抱解太子，主人公遂格斗死，皇孙二人皆并遇害。 上既伤太子，乃下诏曰： 盖行疑赏，所以申信也。 其封李寿为邘侯，张富昌为题侯。 久之，巫蛊事多不信。 上知太子惶恐无他意，而车千秋复讼太子冤，上遂擢千秋为丞相，而族灭江充家，焚苏文于横桥上，及泉鸠里加兵刃于太子者，初为北地太守，后族。 上怜太子无辜，乃作思子宫，为归来望思之台于湖。 天下闻而悲之。 初，太子有三男一女，女者平舆侯嗣子尚焉。 及太子败，皆同时遇害。
target_text: The prince fled east to Hu County, hiding in a commoner's home. The family was poor, selling shoes to support him. When discovered by local officials, the prince hanged himself. His two grandsons were also killed. Emperor Wu, saddened, later learned the witchcraft accusations were mostly untrue. He executed Jiang Chong's family, built the Palace of Thoughts and a tower in Hu County, and mourned the prince's death.

input_text: 卫后、史良悌葬长安城南。 史皇孙、皇孙妃王夫人及皇女孙葬广明。 皇孙二人随太子者，与太子并葬湖。 太子有遗孙一人，史皇孙子，王夫人男，年十八即尊位，是为孝宣帝，帝初即位，下诏曰： 故皇太子在湖，未有号谥，岁时祠，其议谥，置园邑。 有司奏请； 《礼》 为人后者，为之子也 ，故降其父母不得祭，尊祖之义也。 陛下为孝昭帝后，承祖宗之祀，制礼不逾闲。 谨行视孝昭帝所为故皇太子起位在湖，史良娣冢在博望苑北，亲史皇孙位在广明郭北。 谥法曰 谥者，行之迹也 ，愚以为亲谥宜曰悼，母曰悼后，比诸侯王国，置奉邑三百家。 故皇太子谥曰戾，置奉邑二百家。 史良娣曰戾夫人，置守冢三十家。 园置长丞，周卫奉守如法。 以湖阌乡邪里聚为戾园，长安白亭东为戾后园，广明成乡为悼园。 皆改葬焉。 后八岁，有司复言： 《礼》 父为士，子为天子，祭以天子 。 悼园宜称尊号曰皇考，立庙，因园为寝，以时荐享焉。 益奉园民满千六百家，以为奉明县。 尊戾夫人曰戾后，置园奉邑，及益戾园各满三百家。 齐怀王闳与燕王旦、广陵王胥同日立，皆赐策，各以国土风俗申戒焉，曰： 惟元狩六年四月乙巳，皇帝使御史大夫汤庙立子闳为齐王，曰： 乌呼！ 小子闳，受兹青社。
target_text: The prince had three sons and one daughter, all killed when he failed. Empress Wei and Shi Liangdi were buried south of Chang'an. One grandson survived and later became Emperor Xiaoxuan. Upon ascending, he issued edicts regarding proper burial and memorial arrangements for his father, the former crown prince, establishing cemeteries and households for worship.

input_text: 旦壮大就国，为人辩略，博学经书、杂说，好星历、数术、倡优、射猎之事，招致游士。 及卫太子败，齐怀王又薨，旦自以次第当立，上书求入宿卫。 上怒，下其使狱。 后坐臧匿亡命，削良乡、安次、文安三县。 武帝由是恶旦，后遂立少子为太子。 帝崩，太子立，是为孝昭帝，赐诸侯王玺书。 旦得书，不肯哭，曰： 玺书封小。京师疑有变。 遣幸臣寿西长、孙纵之、王孺等之长安，以问礼仪为名。 王孺见执金吾广意，问： 帝崩所病？立者谁子？年几岁？ 广意言： 待诏五莋宫，宫中讠雚言帝崩，诸将军共立太子为帝，年八九岁，葬时不出临。 归以报王。 王曰： 上弃群臣，无语言，盖主又不得见，甚可怪也。 复遣中大夫至京师上书言： 窃见孝武皇帝躬圣道，孝宗庙，慈爱骨肉，和集兆民，德配天地，明并日月，威武洋溢，远方执宝而朝，增郡数十，斥地且倍，封泰山，禅梁父，巡狩天下，远方珍物陈于太庙，德甚休盛，请立庙郡国。 奏报闻。 时大将军霍光秉政，褒赐燕王钱三千万，益封万三千户。 旦怒曰： 我当为帝，何赐也！ 遂与宗室中山哀王子刘长、齐孝王孙刘泽等结谋，诈言以武帝时受诏，得职吏事，修武备，备非常。
target_text: King Huai of Qi, Liu Hong, died without son after eight years. King Liu Dan of Yanla was eloquent, studied classics, and attracted knights. After Prince Wei's defeat and Liu Hong's death, Liu Dan believed he should be crown prince. Emperor Wu became angry, imprisoned his envoy, and later cut off his fiefdom. Emperor Wu disliked Liu Dan and made his youngest son prince instead.

input_text: 旦壮大就国，为人辩略，博学经书、杂说，好星历、数术、倡优、射猎之事，招致游士。 及卫太子败，齐怀王又薨，旦自以次第当立，上书求入宿卫。 上怒，下其使狱。 后坐臧匿亡命，削良乡、安次、文安三县。 武帝由是恶旦，后遂立少子为太子。 帝崩，太子立，是为孝昭帝，赐诸侯王玺书。 旦得书，不肯哭，曰： 玺书封小。京师疑有变。 遣幸臣寿西长、孙纵之、王孺等之长安，以问礼仪为名。 王孺见执金吾广意，问： 帝崩所病？立者谁子？年几岁？ 广意言： 待诏五莋宫，宫中讠雚言帝崩，诸将军共立太子为帝，年八九岁，葬时不出临。 归以报王。 王曰： 上弃群臣，无语言，盖主又不得见，甚可怪也。 复遣中大夫至京师上书言： 窃见孝武皇帝躬圣道，孝宗庙，慈爱骨肉，和集兆民，德配天地，明并日月，威武洋溢，远方执宝而朝，增郡数十，斥地且倍，封泰山，禅梁父，巡狩天下，远方珍物陈于太庙，德甚休盛，请立庙郡国。 奏报闻。 时大将军霍光秉政，褒赐燕王钱三千万，益封万三千户。 旦怒曰： 我当为帝，何赐也！ 遂与宗室中山哀王子刘长、齐孝王孙刘泽等结谋，诈言以武帝时受诏，得职吏事，修武备，备非常。
target_text: When Emperor Wu died and the prince succeeded as Emperor Xiaozhao, Liu Dan refused to mourn, suspecting changes in the capital. He sent inquiries and later requested temples be built for Emperor Wu. General Huo Guang rewarded him, but Liu Dan angrily claimed he should be emperor. He conspired with others, claiming the young emperor was not Emperor Wu's true son. The plot was discovered, and Liu Dan's co-conspirators were executed. Later, Liu Dan's sister and others conspired with him against Huo Guang. The fourteen-year-old Emperor Zhao trusted Huo Guang and distrusted Liu Dan. The conspiracy was exposed, and Liu Dan hanged himself after receiving an imperial seal condemning his actions.

input_text: 胥壮大，好倡乐逸游，力扛鼎，空手搏熊彘猛兽。 动作无法度，故终不得为汉嗣。 昭帝初立，益封胥万三千户，元凤中入朝，复益万户，赐钱二千万，黄金二千斤，安车驷马宝剑。 及宣帝即位，封胥四子圣、曾、宝、昌皆为列侯，又立胥小子弘为高密王。 所以褒赏甚厚。 始，昭帝时，胥见上年少无子，有觊欲心。 而楚地巫鬼，胥迎女巫李女须，使下神祝诅。 女须泣曰： 孝武帝下我。 左右皆伏。 言 吾必令胥为天子 。 胥多赐女须钱，使祷巫山。 会昭帝崩，胥曰： 女须良巫也！ 杀牛塞祷。 及昌邑王征，复使巫祝诅之。 后王废，胥浸信女须等，数赐予钱物。 宣帝即位，胥曰： 太子孙何以反得立？ 复令女须祝诅如前。 又胥女为楚王延寿后弟妇，数相馈遗，通私书。
target_text: King Li of Guangling, Liu Xu, was strong and liked entertainment. He coveted the throne when Emperor Zhao was young and childless. He employed witches to pray for his ascension. When Emperor Zhao died and King Changyi succeeded, Liu Xu had witches curse him. After King Changyi was deposed and Emperor Xuan ascended, Liu Xu continued his schemes. His treason was discovered, and he hanged himself after a final banquet.

input_text: 子共王意嗣，三年薨。 子哀王护嗣，十六年薨，无子，绝。 后六年，成帝复立孝王子守，是为靖王，立二十年薨。 子宏嗣，王莽时绝。 初，高密哀王弘本始元年以广陵王胥少子立，九年薨。 子顷王章嗣，三十三年薨。 子怀王宽嗣，十一年薨。 子慎嗣，王莽时绝。 昌邑哀王髆，天汉四年立，十一年薨，子贺嗣。 立十三年，昭帝崩，无嗣，大将军霍光征王贺典丧。 玺书曰： 制诏昌邑王：使行大鸿胪事少府乐成，宗正德、光禄大夫吉、中郎将利汉征王，乘七乘传诣长安邸。 夜漏未尽一刻，以火发书。 其日中，贺发，晡时至定陶，行百三十五里，侍从者马死相望于道。 郎中令龚遂谏王，令还郎谒者五十余人。 贺到济阳，求长鸣鸡，道买积竹杖。
target_text: King Ai of Changyi, Liu He, was summoned to preside over Emperor Zhao's funeral. He traveled hastily, causing horses to die. During his twenty-seven days as emperor, he behaved lewdly. General Huo Guang deposed him and returned him to his hometown. Later, Emperor Xuan granted him the title of Marquis of Haihun. After his death, his title was terminated.

input_text: 赞曰：巫蛊之祸，岂不哀哉！ 此不唯一江充之辜，亦有天时，非人力所致焉。 建元六年，蚩尤之旗见，其长竟天。 后遂命将出征，略取河南，建置朔方。 其春，戾太子生。 自是之后，师行三十年，兵所诛屠夷灭死者不可胜数。 及巫蛊事起，京师流血，僵尸数万，太子子父皆败。 故太子生长于兵，与之终始，何独一嬖臣哉！ 秦始皇即位三十九年，内平六国，外攘四夷，死人如乱麻，暴骨长城之下，头卢相属于道，不一日而无兵。 由是山东之难兴，四方溃而逆秦。 秦将吏外畔，贼臣内发，乱作萧墙，祸成二世。 故曰 兵犹火也，弗戢必自焚 ，信矣。 是以仓颉作书， 止  戈 为 武 。 圣人以武禁暴整乱，止息兵戈，非以为残而兴纵之也。
target_text: The text concludes with a reflection on the witchcraft case's harm, noting it was not solely Jiang Chong's fault but also divine will, comparing the situation to the Qin dynasty's downfall and emphasizing that war, like fire, burns itself if not stopped.

input_text: 淮南厉王长，高帝少子也，其母故赵王张敖美人。 高帝八年，从东垣过赵，赵王献美人，厉王母也，幸，有身。 赵王不敢内宫，为筑外宫舍之。 及贯高等谋反事觉，并逮治王，尽捕王母兄弟美人，系之河内。 厉王母亦系，告吏曰： 日得幸上，有子。 吏以闻，上方怒赵，未及理厉王母。 厉王母弟赵兼因辟阳侯言吕后，吕后妒，不肯白，辟阳侯不强争。 厉王母已生厉生，恚，即自杀。 吏奉厉王诣上，上悔，令吕后母之，而葬其母真定。 真定，厉王母家县也。十一年，淮南王布反，上自将击灭布，即立子长为淮南子。 王早失母，常附吕后，孝惠、吕后时以故得幸无患，然常心怨辟阳侯，不敢发。
target_text: King Li of Huainan, the youngest son of Emperor Gao of Han, was born to a former beauty of King Zhao Zhang Ao. His mother became pregnant after being favored by Emperor Gao during a visit to Zhao. When King Zhao was implicated in a rebellion, she was imprisoned and revealed her pregnancy, but Emperor Gao ignored her pleas. After giving birth to King Li, she committed suicide out of resentment. Emperor Gao regretted this and had Empress Lu raise the child. In the eleventh year of his reign, Emperor Gao made Liu Chang the King of Huainan after suppressing a rebellion.

input_text: 淮南厉王长，高帝少子也，其母故赵王张敖美人。 高帝八年，从东垣过赵，赵王献美人，厉王母也，幸，有身。 赵王不敢内宫，为筑外宫舍之。 及贯高等谋反事觉，并逮治王，尽捕王母兄弟美人，系之河内。 厉王母亦系，告吏曰： 日得幸上，有子。 吏以闻，上方怒赵，未及理厉王母。 厉王母弟赵兼因辟阳侯言吕后，吕后妒，不肯白，辟阳侯不强争。 厉王母已生厉生，恚，即自杀。 吏奉厉王诣上，上悔，令吕后母之，而葬其母真定。 真定，厉王母家县也。十一年，淮南王布反，上自将击灭布，即立子长为淮南子。 王早失母，常附吕后，孝惠、吕后时以故得幸无患，然常心怨辟阳侯，不敢发。
target_text: King Li grew up relying on Empress Lu and was favored during the reigns of Emperor Xiaohui and Empress Lu, but he resented Marquis Piyang for not saving his mother. After Emperor Xiaowen ascended, King Li became arrogant and broke laws repeatedly. In the third year of Emperor Wen's reign, he killed Marquis Piyang in revenge, claiming three crimes: failing to save his mother, not preventing Empress Lu's murder of King Zhao Ruyi, and not stopping Empress Lu from ennobling the Lu family. Emperor Wen pardoned him out of pity, but King Li grew more defiant, making his own laws and acting like an emperor.

input_text: 幸臣有罪，大者立断，小者肉刑，不仁。 贵布衣一剑之任，贱王侯之位，不知。 不好学问大道，触情忘行，不祥。 此八者，危亡之路也，而大王行之，弃南面之位，奋诸、贲之勇，常出入危亡之路，臣之所见，高皇帝之神必不庙食于大王之手，明白。 昔者，周公诛管叔，放蔡叔，以安周；齐桓杀其弟，以反国；秦始皇杀两弟，迁其母，以安秦；顷王亡代，高帝夺之国，以便事；济北举兵，皇帝诛之，以安汉。 故周、齐行之于古，秦、汉用之于今，大王不察古今之所以安国便事，而欲以亲戚之意望于太上，不可得也。 亡之诸侯，游宦事人，及舍匿者，论皆有法。 其在王所，吏主者坐。 今诸侯子为吏者，御史主；为军吏者，中尉主；客出入殿门者，卫尉大行主；诸从蛮夷来归谊及以亡名数自占者，内史县令主。 相欲委下吏，无与其祸，不可得也。 王若不改，汉系大王邸，论相以下，为之奈何？ 夫堕父大业，退为布衣所哀，幸臣皆伏法而诛，为天下笑，以羞先帝之德，甚为大王不取也。 宜急改操易行，上书谢罪，曰： 臣不幸早失先帝，少孤，吕氏之世，未尝忘死。 陛下即位，臣怙恩德骄盈，行多不轨。 追念罪过，恐惧，伏地待诛不敢起。
target_text: Emperor Wen's uncle Bo Zhao admonished King Li in a letter, listing eight dangerous behaviors: abandoning his state, disobeying orders, prioritizing his mother's grave over his father's, and more. He warned that disaster would follow if King Li did not reform. King Li was displeased and ignored the advice. In the sixth year, he conspired with seventy men, including Chai Qi, to rebel, contacting Minyue and Xiongnu. The plot was discovered, and King Li was summoned to Chang'an. After interrogation, officials reported his crimes: abandoning Han laws, appointing officials without authorization, harboring fugitives, and planning rebellion. They demanded his execution, but Emperor Wen commuted the sentence to exile in Shu County.

input_text: 乃徙城阳王王淮南故地，而追尊谥淮南王为厉王，置园如诸侯仪。 十六年，上怜淮南王废法不轨，自使失国早夭，乃徙淮南王喜复王故城阳，而立厉王三子王淮南故地，三分之：阜陵侯安为淮南王，安阳侯勃为衡山王，阳周侯赐为庐江王，东城侯良前薨，无后。 孝景三年，吴、楚七国反，吴使者至淮南，王欲发兵应之。 其相曰： 王必欲应吴，臣愿为将。 王乃属之。 相已将兵，因城守，不听王而为汉。 汉亦使曲城侯将兵救淮南，淮南以故得完。 吴使者至庐江，庐江王不应，而往来使越；至衡山，衡山王坚守无二心。 孝景四年，吴、楚已破，衡山王朝，上以为卢信，乃劳苦之曰： 南方卑湿。 徙王王于济北以褒之。 及薨，遂赐谥为贞王。 庐江王以边越，数使使相交，徙为衡山王，王江北。
target_text: King Li refused food and died on the way. Emperor Wen mourned and executed the officials who failed to provide food. He later enfeoffed King Li's four sons as marquises. In the sixteenth year, he made three of them kings in Huainan. During the Rebellion of the Seven States, King Huainan Liu An initially considered joining Wu but was restrained by his prime minister. Liu An, known for his literary pursuits, compiled the "Inner Books" and other works. He plotted rebellion after a comet appeared, believing the emperor had no heir. His daughter Liu Ling spied in Chang'an. The plot was exposed when his grandson Liu Jian informed on him. King Huainan committed suicide, and his kingdom was abolished as Jiujiang County.

input_text: 胶西王端议曰： 安废法度，行邪辟，有诈伪心，以乱天下，营惑百姓，背畔宗庙，妄作妖言。《春秋》曰 臣毋将，将而诛 。 安罪重于将，谋反形已定。 臣端所见其书印图及它逆亡道事验明白，当伏法。 论国吏二百石以上及比者，宗室近幸臣不在法中者，不能相教，皆当免，削爵为士伍，毋得官为吏。 其非吏，它赎死金二斤八两，以章安之罪，使天下明知臣子之道，毋敢复有邪僻背畔之意。 丞相弘、廷尉汤等以闻，上使宗正以符节治王。 未至，安自刑杀。 后、太子诸所与谋皆收夷。 国除为九江郡。 衡山王赐后乘舒生子三人，长男爽为太子，次女无采，少男孝。 姬徐来生子男女四人，美人厥姬生子二人。 淮南、衡山相责望礼节，间不相能。
target_text: King Hengshan Liu Ci, brother of King Huainan, also plotted rebellion. He feuded with his son, Prince Liu Shuang, and favored his younger son Liu Xiao. After Queen Chengshu died, Queen Xu Lai and concubine Jue Ji slandered the prince. The prince was whipped and later accused his father of rebellion. King Hengshan committed suicide when investigated. His kingdom was also abolished. The historian comments that both kings, despite being imperial relatives, perished due to their rebellious nature and the corrupting influence of their ministers, noting that people of Jingchu have historically been prone to insurrection.

input_text: 古者天子建国，诸侯立家，自卿、大夫以至于庶人，各有等差，是以民服事其上，而下无觊觎。 孔子曰： 天下有道，政不在大夫。 百官有司奉法承令，以修所职，失职有诛，侵官有罚。 夫然，故上下相顺，而庶事理焉。 周室既微，礼乐征伐自诸侯出。 桓、文之后，大夫世权，陪臣执命。 陵夷至于战国，合从连衡，力政争强。 由是列国公子，魏有信陵、赵有平原、齐有孟尝、楚有春申，皆借王公之势，竞为游侠，鸡鸣狗盗，无不宾礼。 而赵相虞卿弃国捐君，以周穷交魏齐之厄；信陵无忌窃符矫命，戮将专师，以赴平原之急：皆以取重诸侯，显名天下，扼腕而游谈者，以四豪为称首。 于是背公死党之议成，守职奉上之义废矣。 及至汉兴，禁网疏阔，未之匡改也。 是故代相陈豨从车千乘，而吴濞、淮南皆招宾客以千数。 外戚大臣魏其、武安之属竞逐于京师，布衣游侠剧孟、郭解之徒驰骛于闾阎，权行州域，力折公侯。
target_text: In ancient times, the emperor established a country with a clear hierarchy from officials to common people, ensuring order and obedience. Confucius noted that when the world is at peace, political power does not rest with officials, who must obey the law and face punishment for neglect or violation. However, with the decline of the Zhou royal family, princes began to control rituals and military campaigns. After Duke Huan of Qi and Duke Wen of Jin, officials gained exclusive power, leading to the Warring States Period, where princes abandoned propriety for force. Figures like Lord Xinling, Lord Pingyuan, Lord Mengchang, and Lord Chunshen relied on noble authority to become knight-errants, attracting followers who valued personal bonds over official duties. This trend continued into the Han Dynasty, where bans were loose, and powerful figures like King Liu Bi of Wu and King Liu An of Huainan hosted thousands of guests. Commoners like Guo Xie gained influence, often resorting to violence and crime, yet were admired for their generosity and charm. Despite their crimes, they were seen as sinners against orthodox moral standards, and the emperor eventually ordered Guo Xie's execution for forming a secret faction and abusing power.

input_text: 而少年慕其行，亦辄为报仇，不使知也。 解姊子负解之势，与人饮，使之釂，非其任，强灌之。 人怒，刺杀解姊子，亡去。 解姊怒曰： 以翁伯时人杀吾子，贼不得！ 弃其尸道旁，弗葬，欲以辱解。 解使人微知贼处。 贼窘自归，具以实告解。 解曰： 公杀之当，吾儿不直。 遂去其贼，罪其姊子，收而葬之。 诸公闻之，皆多解之义，益附焉。 解出，人皆避，有一人独箕踞视之。 解问其姓名，客欲杀之。 解曰： 居邑屋不见敬，是吾德不修也，彼何罪！ 乃阴请尉史曰： 是人吾所重，至践更时脱之。 每至直更，数过，吏弗求。 怪之，问其故，解使脱之。 箕踞者乃肉袒谢罪。 少年闻之，愈益慕解之行。 洛阳人有相仇者，邑中贤豪居间以十数，终不听。 客乃见解。 解夜见仇家，仇家曲听。 解谓仇家： 吾闻洛阳诸公在间，多不听。 今子幸而听解，解奈何从它县夺人邑贤大夫权乎！ 乃夜去，不使人知，曰： 且毋庸，待我去，令洛阳豪居间乃听。 解为人短小，恭俭，出未尝有骑，不敢乘车入其县庭。 之旁郡国，为人请求事，事可出，出之；不可者，各令厌其意，然后乃敢尝酒食。 诸公以此严重之，争为用。
target_text: Guo Xie, a native of Zhi County, was the grandson of a good minister. His father was a chivalrous man killed during Emperor Xiaowen's reign. Guo Xie was calm and brave but vicious in his youth, committing murder, robbery, and grave robbing. As he matured, he reflected on his mistakes, practiced self-discipline, and responded to grudges with kindness, though his sinister nature persisted. His sister's son was killed for forcing someone to drink, and Guo Xie, deeming the victim at fault, let the murderer go, earning respect. Another incident involved a man who disrespected Guo Xie; instead of retaliating, Guo Xie secretly exempted him from duty, leading to the man's apology and increased admiration for Guo Xie. In Luoyang, Guo Xie mediated a dispute where local celebrities failed, and he ensured the credit went to them. Despite his humble and frugal lifestyle, Guo Xie's influence grew, and he was eventually forced to move to Maoling due to imperial suspicion. After his move, conflicts arose, leading to murders and his eventual arrest. Although many crimes were pardoned, Guo Xie was executed for treason after a Confucian scholar was assassinated by his followers.

input_text: 诸公以是服而称之。 河平中，王尊为京兆尹，捕击豪侠，杀章及箭张回、酒市赵君都、贾子光，皆长安名豪，报仇怨养刺客者也。 楼护字君卿，齐人。 父世医也，护少随父为医长安，出入贵戚家。 护诵医经、本草、方术数十万言，长者咸爱重之，共谓曰： 以君卿之材，何不宦学乎？ 由是辞其父，学经传，为京兆吏数年，甚得名誉。 是时，王氏方盛，宾客满门，五侯兄弟争名，其客各有所厚，不得左右，唯护尽入其门，咸得其欢心。 结士大夫，无所不倾，其交长者，尤见亲而敬，众以是服。 为人短小精辩，论议常依名节，听之者皆竦。
target_text: After Guo Xie, many knights emerged but none were notable. Figures like Fan Zhongzi, Wangsun Fang, and others were courteous and humble, while others like the Yao and Du families were bandits. Wan Zhang, a knight from Chang'an, became a secret friend of Jing Zhaoyin but was embarrassed by the attention he received. He later refused gifts from the disgraced Shi Xian, earning praise for his conduct. During the Heping period, Wang Zun captured and killed many heroes, including Wan Zhang. Lou Hu, from Qi State, initially practiced medicine but later studied classics and became a minor official. He gained fame by serving the five Wang brothers simultaneously, known for his eloquence and integrity. After his mother's death, thousands mourned. Lou Hu later served as an envoy, distributing gifts to relatives, and was promoted to prefect of Tianshui. He was dismissed but later reinstated, and during Wang Mang's regency, he captured a fugitive, earning a marquisate. However, he was eventually dismissed again and lived in obscurity, though he maintained his principles by supporting an old friend, Lu Gong, for life.

input_text: 数月免。 初，遵为河南太守，而弟级为荆州牧，当之官，俱过长安富人故淮阳王外家左氏饮食作乐。 后司直陈崇闻之，劾奏： 遵兄弟幸得蒙恩超等历位，遵爵列侯，备郡守，级州牧奉使，皆以举直察枉宣扬圣化为职，不正身自慎。 始遵初除，乘藩车入闾巷，过寡妇左阿君置酒歌讴，遵起舞跳梁，顿仆坐上，暮因留宿，为侍婢扶卧。 遵知饮酒饫宴有节，礼不入寡妇之门，而湛酒混肴，乱男女之别，轻辱爵位，羞污印韨，恶不可忍闻。 臣请皆免。 遵既免，归长安，宾客愈盛，饮食自若。 久之，复为九江及河内都尉，凡三为二千石。 而张竦亦至丹阳太守，封淑德侯。 后俱免官，以列侯归长安。 竦居贫，无宾客，时时好事者从之质疑问事，论道经书而已。 而遵昼夜呼号，车骑满门，酒肉相属。
target_text: Chen Zun, from Duling County, was known for his indulgence and extravagance, contrasting with his friend Zhang Song's frugality. Despite his reckless behavior, Chen Zun was valued for his talent and became a magistrate. He was later dismissed for misconduct but continued to host lavish parties. During Wang Mang's reign, he served as governor of Henan County but was dismissed again. Chen Zun was known for his eloquence and charm, and his letters were treasured. He died in Shuofang after being captured by bandits. Yuan She, from Maoling, gained fame by returning funeral donations and mourning his father for three years. He became a magistrate but was dismissed after seeking revenge for his uncle's murder. Yuan She was known for his generosity and ability to mobilize people, often helping the poor and organizing funerals. However, he was also involved in violence, killing a man who slandered him. During Wang Mang's reign, Yuan She was appointed as an official but was eventually executed after ordering the assassination of a chief registrar. Since the reigns of Emperor Ai and Emperor Ping, many heroes emerged in various counties, but their numbers were too many to count.

input_text: 爰盎字丝。 其父楚人也，故为群盗，徙安陵。 高后时，盎为吕禄舍人。 孝文即位，盎兄哙任盎为郎中。 绛侯为丞相，朝罢趋出，意得甚。 上礼之恭，常目送之。 盎进曰： 丞相何如人也？ 上曰： 社稷臣。 盎曰： 绛侯所谓功臣，非社稷臣。 社稷臣主在与在，主亡与亡。 方吕后时，诸吕用事，擅相王，刘氏不绝如带。 是时绛侯为太尉，本兵柄，弗能正。 吕后崩，大臣相与共诛诸吕，太尉主兵，适会其成功，所谓功臣，非社稷臣。 丞相如有骄主色，陛下谦让，臣主失礼，窃为陛下弗取也。 后朝，上益庄，丞相益畏。 已而绛侯望盎曰： 吾与汝兄善，今儿乃毁我！ 盎遂不谢。 及绛侯就国，人上书告以为反，征系请室，诸公莫敢为言，唯盎明绛侯无罪。 绛侯得释，盎颇有力。 绛侯乃大与盎结交。
target_text: Yuan Ang, also known as Zisi, was a native of Chu who later moved to Anling. He served as a retainer to Lü Lu during Empress Lü's reign and was recommended as a doctor by his brother Yuan Sha under Emperor Wen of Han. Yuan Ang famously criticized Prime Minister Zhou Bo, calling him a "hero" rather than an "important minister," arguing that Zhou Bo had failed to act against the Lü clan during their usurpation and only succeeded after Empress Lü's death. Despite Zhou Bo's initial anger, Yuan Ang later defended him when Zhou Bo was falsely accused of treason, leading to their friendship.

input_text: 夫曾参以布衣犹难之，今陛下亲以王者修之，过曾参远矣。 诸吕用事，大臣颛制，然陛下从代乘六乘传，驰不测渊，虽贲、育之勇不及陛下。 陛下至代邸，西乡让天子者三，南乡让天子者再。 夫许由一让，陛下五以天下让，过许由四矣。 且陛下迁淮南王，欲以苦其志，使改过，有司宿卫不谨，故病死。 于是上乃解，盎繇此名重朝廷。 盎常引大体慷慨。 宦者赵谈以数幸，常害盎，盎患之。 盎兄子种为常侍骑，谏盎曰： 君众辱之，后虽恶君，上不复信。 于是上朝东宫，赵谈骖乘，盎伏车前曰： 臣闻天子所与共六尺舆者，皆天下豪英。今汉虽乏人，陛下独奈何与刀锯之余共载！
target_text: Yuan Ang advised Emperor Wen against indulging Liu Chang, the King of Huainan, whose arrogance led to rebellion. When the king died in exile, Yuan Ang consoled the grieving emperor by listing his three great virtues: filial piety during his mother's illness, courage in facing danger when coming to the capital, and humility in repeatedly declining the throne. Yuan Ang also clashed with the eunuch Zhao Tan, insisting he should not ride in the emperor's carriage, and prevented the emperor from reckless chariot racing. He corrected the seating order between the queen and Consort Shen, warning against favoritism by citing the tragic fate of "human pigs."

input_text: 然盎亦以数直谏，不得久居中。 调为陇西都尉，仁爱士卒，士卒皆争为死。 迁齐相，徒为吴相。 辞行，种谓盎曰： 吴王骄日久，国多奸，今丝欲刻治，彼不上书告君，则利剑刺君矣。 南方卑湿，丝能日饮，亡何，说王毋反而已。 如此幸得脱。 盎用种之计，吴王厚遇盎。 盎告归，道逢丞相申屠嘉，下车拜谒，丞相从车上谢。 盎还，愧其吏，乃之丞相舍上谒，求见丞相。 丞相良久乃见。 因跪曰： 愿请间。 丞相曰： 使君所言公事，之曹与长史掾议之，吾且奏之；则私，吾不受私语。 盎即起说曰： 君为相，自度孰与陈平、绛侯？ 丞相曰： 不如。 盎曰： 善，君自谓弗如。 夫陈平、绛侯辅翼高帝，定天下，为将相，而诛诸吕，存刘氏；君乃为材官蹶张，迁为队帅，积功至淮阳守，非有奇计攻城野战之功。
target_text: Yuan Ang served as governor of Longxi, prime minister of Qi, and later of Wu, following his nephew Yuan Zhong's advice to avoid conflict with the rebellious King of Wu by drinking daily and not interfering. He later confronted Prime Minister Shen Tujia, criticizing him for being less capable than Chen Ping and Zhou Bo and for stifling open discourse. Shen Tujia eventually apologized and treated him as a guest.

input_text: 且盎不宜有谋。 错犹与未决。 人有告盎，盎恐，夜见窦婴，为言吴所以反，愿至前，口对状。 婴入言，上乃召盎。盎入见，竟言吴所以反，独急斩错以谢吴，吴可罢。 上拜盎为泰常，窦婴为大将军。 两人素相善。是时，诸陵长安中贤大夫争附两人。车骑随者日数百乘。 及晁错已诛，盎以泰常使吴。 吴王欲使将，不肯。 欲杀之，使一都尉以五百人围守盎军中。 初，盎为吴相时，从史盗私盎侍儿。盎知之，弗泄，遇之如故。 人有告从史， 君知女与侍者通 ，乃亡去。 盎驱自追之，遂以侍者赐之，复为从史。 司马夜引盎起，曰： 君可以去矣，吴王期旦日斩君。 盎弗信，曰： 何为者？ 司马曰： 臣故为君从史盗侍儿者也。 盎乃惊，谢曰： 公幸有亲，吾不足累公。 司马曰： 君疵去，臣亦且亡，辟吾亲，君何患！ 乃以刀决帐，道从醉卒直出。 司马与分背。盎解节旄怀之，屐步行七十里，明，见梁骑，驰去，遂归报。 吴、楚已破，上更以元王子平陆侯礼为楚王，以盎为楚相。 尝上书，不用。 盎病免家居，与闾里浮湛，相随行斗鸡走狗。 雒阳剧孟尝过盎，盎善待之。
target_text: Yuan Ang had a long-standing feud with Chao Cuo. When the Rebellion of the Seven States broke out, Yuan Ang advised Emperor Jing to execute Chao Cuo to appease the rebels. After Chao Cuo's death, Yuan Ang was sent as an envoy to Wu but was surrounded by Wu forces. A former subordinate, whom Yuan Ang had once forgiven for an affair with his maid, helped him escape. Yuan Ang later became Prime Minister of Chu but resigned due to illness. He was assassinated by agents of the King of Liang after opposing the king's succession to the throne.

input_text: 以文学为太常掌故。 错为人峭直刻深。 孝文时，天下亡治《尚书》者，独闻齐有伏生，故秦博士，治《尚书》，年九十余，老不可征。乃诏太常，使人受之。 太常遣错受《尚书》伏生所，还，因上书称说。 诏以为太子舍人，门大夫，迁博士。 又上书言： 人主所以尊显功名扬于万世之后者，以知术数也。 故人主知所以临制臣下而治其众，则群臣畏服矣；知所以听言受事，则不欺蔽矣；知所以安利万民，则海内必从矣；知所以忠孝事上，则臣子之行备矣：此四者，臣窃为皇太子急之。 人臣之议或曰皇太子亡以知事为也，臣之愚，诚以为不然。 窃观上世之君，不能奉其宗庙而劫杀于其臣者，皆不知术数者也。 皇太子所读书多矣，而未深知术数者，不问书说也。 夫多诵而不知其说，所谓劳苦而不为功。 臣窃观皇太子材智高奇，驭射技艺过人绝远，然于术数未有所守者，以陛下为心也。 窃愿陛下幸择圣人之术可用今世者，以赐皇太子，因时使太子陈明于前。 唯陛下裁察。 上善之，于是拜错为太子家令。 以其辩得幸太子，太子家号曰 智囊 。
target_text: Chao Cuo, a native of Yingchuan, studied Legalist philosophy under Zhang Hui and became a doctor under Emperor Wen. He was sent to study the *Book of Documents* from Fu Sheng and later served as a tutor to the crown prince, earning the nickname "think tank." Chao Cuo wrote extensively on military strategy, advocating for selecting good generals, training soldiers, and using superior weapons. He proposed using surrendered barbarians and border settlers to defend against the Xiongnu, emphasizing the importance of terrain and equipment. He also criticized the Qin dynasty's harsh policies and recommended settling families in border fortresses with proper housing, tools, and incentives.
