target_text: Under Emperor Jing, Chao Cuo rose to power as Imperial Censor and pushed for reducing the fiefs of feudal princes, sparking widespread resentment. His father warned him of the danger, but Chao Cuo insisted it was necessary for the state's stability. When the Seven States rebelled, Chao Cuo was executed on the advice of Yuan Ang and others, despite his loyalty. After his death, Deng Gong defended him, noting that the rebellion was premeditated and not truly about Chao Cuo. Emperor Jing later regretted the execution.

input_text: 乃拜邓公为城阳中尉。 邓公，成固人也，多奇计。 建元年中，上招贤良，公卿言邓先。邓先时免，起家为九卿。 一年，复谢病免归。 其子章，以修黄、老言显诸公间。 赞曰：爰盎虽不好学，亦善傅会，仁心为质，引义慷慨。 遭孝文初立，资适逢世。 时已变易，及吴壹说，果于用辩，身亦不遂。 晁错锐于为国远虑，而不见身害。 其父睹之，经于沟渎，亡益救败，不如赵母指括，以全其宗。 悲夫！ 错虽不终，世哀其忠。 故论其施行之语著于篇。
target_text: The historian's commentary notes that Yuan Ang, though not deeply learned, was perceptive and benevolent, but his scheme to kill Chao Cuo ultimately led to his own downfall. Chao Cuo was farsighted in statecraft but blind to his personal peril, unlike Zhao Kuo's mother who saved her family from destruction. Despite his unjust death, Chao Cuo's loyalty was mourned, and his policy writings were preserved.

input_text: 王商字子威，涿郡蠡吾人也，徙杜陵。 商公武、武兄无故，皆以宣帝舅封。 无故为平昌侯，武为乐昌侯。 语在《外戚传》。 商少为太子中庶子，以肃敬敦厚称。 父薨，商嗣为侯，推财以分异母诸弟，身无所受，居丧哀戚。 于是大臣荐商行可以厉群臣，义足以厚风俗，宜备近臣。 繇是擢为诸曹、侍中、中郎将。 元帝时，至右将军、光禄大夫。 是时，定陶共王爱幸，几代太子。 商为外戚重臣辅政，拥佑太子，颇有力焉。 元帝崩，成帝即位，甚敬重商，徙为左将军。 而帝元舅大司马大将军王凤颛权，行多骄僣。 商论议不能平凤，凤知之，亦疏商。 建始三年秋，京师民无故相惊，言大水至，百姓奔走相蹂躏、老弱号呼，长安中大乱。
target_text: Wang Shang, styled Ziwei, originally from Liwu County in Zhuo Commandery, later moved to Duling. His father Wang Wu and uncle were granted marquisates as relatives of Emperor Xuan, with Wang Wu becoming Marquis of Lechang. Wang Shang succeeded his father, distributed his inheritance to half-brothers, and was praised for his seriousness and loyalty. He rose to become General of the Left and Guanglu大夫 during Emperor Yuan's reign, supporting the crown prince against the favored King Dingtao.

input_text: 天子亲御前殿，召公卿议。 大将军凤以为太后与上及后宫可御船，令吏民上长安城以避水。 群臣皆从凤议。 左将军商独曰： 自古无道之国，水犹不冒城郭。 今政治和平，世无兵革，上下相安，何因当有大水一日暴至？ 此必讹言也，不宜令上城，重惊百姓。 上乃止。 有顷，长安中稍定，问之，果讹言。 上于是美壮商之固守，数称其议。 而凤大惭，自恨失言。 明年，商代匡衡为丞相，益封千户，天子甚尊任之。 为人多质有威重，长八尺余，身体鸿大，容貌甚过绝人。 河平四年，单于来朝，引见白虎殿。 丞相商坐未央廷中，单于前，拜谒商。 商起，离席与言，单于仰视商貌，大畏之，迁延却退。 天子闻而叹曰： 此真汉相矣！
target_text: Under Emperor Cheng, Wang Shang served as General of the Left. When false rumors of a flood caused panic in the capital, General Wang Feng proposed evacuating to the city walls. Wang Shang argued that floods had never breached a virtuous capital, and the panic would worsen. The emperor agreed, and calm was restored. Wang Shang replaced Kuang Heng as Chancellor, earning the emperor's trust. During a visit by the Xiongnu Chanyu, Wang Shang's imposing stature so frightened the Chanyu that he trembled, prompting the emperor to praise him as a worthy Chancellor.

input_text: 下朝者左将军丹等问匡，对曰： 窃见丞相商作威作福，从外制中，取必于上，性残贼不仁，遣票轻吏微求人罪，欲以立威，天下患苦之。 前频阳耿定上书言商与父傅通，及女弟淫乱，奴杀其私夫，疑商教使。 章下有司，商私怨怼。 商子俊欲上书告商，俊妻左将军丹女，持其书以示丹，丹恶其父子乘迕，为女求去。 商不尽忠纳善以辅至德，知圣主崇孝，远别不亲，后庭之事皆爱命皇太后，太后前闻商有女，欲以备后宫，商言有固疾，后有耿定事，更诡道因李贵人家内女，执左道以乱政，诬罔悖大臣节，故应是而日蚀。 《周书》曰： 以左道事君者诛。 《易》曰： 日中见昧，则折其右肱。 往者丞相周勃再建大功，及孝文时纤介怨恨，而日为之蚀，于是退勃使就国，卒无怵惕忧。 今商无尺寸之功，而有三世之宠，身位三公，宗族为列侯、吏二千石、侍中诸曹，给事禁门内，连昏诸侯王，权宠至盛。
target_text: Wang Shang clashed with Wang Feng over the punishment of Yang Wei, a corrupt official. Wang Feng urged leniency, but Wang Shang insisted on dismissal, deepening Wang Feng's resentment. Wang Feng secretly sought Wang Shang's faults and exposed a family scandal: Wang Shang had initially refused to send his ill daughter to the harem at the Empress Dowager's request, but later used a favored concubine's influence to do so after being threatened. A solar eclipse occurred, and Zhang Kuang blamed Wang Shang for moral failings, citing his alleged adultery, murder, and deceit. Despite Wang Feng's demands for execution, the emperor spared Wang Shang, stripping him of his title. Wang Shang died three days later from vomiting blood.

input_text: 史丹字君仲，鲁国人也，徙杜陵。 祖父恭有女弟，武帝时为卫太子良娣，产悼皇考。 皇考者，孝宣帝父也。 宣帝微时依倚史氏。 语在《史良娣传》。 及宣帝即尊位，恭已死，三子，高、曾、玄。 曾、玄皆以外属旧恩封：曾为将陵侯，玄平台侯。 高侍中，贵幸，以发举反者大司马霍禹功封乐陵侯。 宣帝疾病，拜高为大司马、车骑将军，领尚书事。 帝崩，太子袭尊号，是为孝元帝。 高辅政五年，乞骸骨，赐安车驷马、黄金，罢就第。 薨，谥曰安侯。 自元帝为太子时，丹以父高任为中庶子，侍从十余年。 元帝即位，为驸马都尉侍中，出常骖乘，甚有宠。 上以丹旧臣，皇考外属，亲信之，诏丹护太子家。 是时，傅昭仪子定陶共王有材艺，子母俱爱幸，而太子颇有酒色之失，母王皇后无宠。 建昭之后，元帝被疾，不亲政事，留好音乐。
target_text: Shi Dan, styled Junzhong, from Lu, later moved to Duling. His grandfather's sister was a concubine of Prince Wei, mother of Emperor Xuan's father. Shi Dan served as a crown prince's attendant for over a decade. When Emperor Yuan fell ill and favored King Dingtao over the prince, Shi Dan wept before the emperor, arguing the prince was established and respected. The emperor relented, securing the prince's succession. After Emperor Cheng's accession, Shi Dan became General of the Left and Marquis of Wuyang. He was outwardly suave but cautious, trusted by the emperor. He lived extravagantly with many concubines and servants, serving as general for sixteen years before retiring due to illness and dying shortly after.

input_text: 为将军前后十六年，永始中病乞骸骨，上赐策曰： 左将军寝病不衰，愿归治疾，朕愍以官职之事久留将军，使躬不瘳。 使光禄勋赐将军黄金五十斤，安车驷马，其上将军印绶。 宜专精神，务近医药，以辅不衰。 丹归第数月薨，谥曰顷侯。 有子男女二十人，九男皆以丹任并为侍中、诸曹，亲近在左右。 史氏凡四人侯，至卿、大夫、二千石者十余人，皆讫王莽乃绝，唯将陵侯曾无子，绝于身云。 傅喜字稚游，河内温人也，哀帝祖母定陶傅太后从父弟。 少好学问，有志行。 哀帝立为太子，成帝选喜为太子庶子。 哀帝初即位，以喜为卫尉，迁右将军。 是时，王莽为大司马，乞骸骨，避帝外家。
target_text: Fu Xi, styled Zhiyou, from Wen County, was cousin to Emperor Ai's grandmother. He served as a crown prince's attendant and later as General of the Right. When Wang Mang resigned, Fu Xi declined power, citing illness. Empress Dowager Fu wanted to claim equal status with Emperor Cheng's mother, but Fu Xi, with Kong Guang and Shi Dan, opposed this. The emperor dismissed Shi Dan and then Fu Xi, accusing him of failing to correct errors and fostering treachery. Fu Xi was sent to his fiefdom, later recalled by Wang Mang, but died of old age. His son inherited the title, which ended after Wang Mang's fall.

input_text: 传不云乎？ 岁寒然后知松伯之后凋也 。 其还喜长安，以故高安侯莫府赐喜，位特进，奉朝请。 喜虽外见褒赏，孤立忧惧，后复遣就国，以寿终。 莽赐谥曰贞侯。 子嗣，莽败乃绝。 赞曰：自宜、元、成、哀外戚兴者，许、史、三王、丁、傅之家，皆重侯累将，穷贵极富，见其位矣，未见其人也。 阳平之王多有材能，好事慕名，其势尤盛，旷贵最久。 然至于莽，亦以覆国。 王商有刚毅节，废黜以忧死，非其罪也。史丹父子相继，高以重厚，位至三公。 丹之辅道副主，掩恶扬美，傅会善意，虽宿儒达士无以加焉。
target_text: The commentary notes that from Emperor Xuan to Emperor Ai, powerful families like the Xu, Shi, Wang, Ding, and Fu clans held high positions but lacked talent. Wang Shang was deposed for his integrity, dying blameless. Shi Dan's loyalty secured the crown prince's position, earning rewards. Fu Xi's steadfastness was recognized, but during the transition between Emperor Ai and Emperor Ping, fortune and misfortune shifted rapidly.

input_text: 王莽字巨君，孝元皇后之弟子也。 元后父及兄弟皆以元、成世封侯，居位辅政，家凡九侯、五大司马，语在《元后传》。 唯莽父曼蚤死，不侯。 莽群兄弟皆将军五侯子，乘时侈靡，以舆马声色佚游相高，莽独孤贫，因折节为恭俭。 受《礼经》，师事沛郡陈参，勤身博学，被服如儒生。 事母及寡嫂，养孤兄子，行甚敕备。 又外交英俊，内事诸父，曲有礼意。 阳朔中，世父大将军凤病，莽侍疾，亲尝药，乱首垢面，不解衣带连月。 凤且死，以托太后及帝，拜为黄门郎，迁射声校尉。 久之，叔父成都侯商上书，愿分户邑以封莽，及长乐少府戴崇、侍中金涉、胡骑校尉箕闳、上谷都尉阳并、中郎陈汤，皆当世名士，咸为莽言，上由是贤莽。 永始元年，封莽为新都侯，国南阳新野之都乡，千五百户。 迁骑都尉、光禄大夫、侍中。宿卫谨敕，爵位益尊，节操愈谦。
target_text: Wang Mang, also known as Jujun, was the nephew of Empress Xiaoyuan. During the reigns of Emperors Yuan and Cheng of the Han Dynasty, Empress Yuan's father and brothers all became marquises, held important positions, and assisted in government affairs. Nine family members were granted the title of marquis, and five served as chief ministers. Only Wang Mang's father, Wang Man, died early and was not granted a title. Wang Mang's uncles and brothers, as sons of generals and marquises, lived luxurious lives, but Wang Mang, being lonely and poor, treated others with humility and lived simply. He studied "Etiquette" and "Zhou Rites" under Chen Shen, dressed like an ordinary scholar, served his mother and widowed sister-in-law, raised his fatherless nephew, and behaved with caution. He made friends with outstanding talents and served his uncles with tact and courtesy. During the Yangshuo period, his uncle Wang Feng fell ill, and Wang Mang served him diligently, not combing his hair or washing his face for months. When Wang Feng was dying, he entrusted Wang Mang to the Queen Mother and Emperor Cheng, leading to Wang Mang's appointment as Huang Menlang and later promotion to Shesheng Xiaowei.

input_text: 散舆马衣裘，振施宾客，家无所余。 收赡名士，交结将相、卿、大夫甚众。 故在位更推荐之，游者为之谈说，虚誉隆洽，倾其诸父矣。 敢为激发之行，处之不惭恧。 莽兄永为诸曹，蚤死，有子光，莽使学博士门下。 莽休沐出，振车骑，奉羊酒，劳遗其师，恩施下竟同学。 诸生纵观，长老叹息。 光年小于莽子宇，莽使同日内妇，宾客满堂。 须臾，一人言太夫人苦某痛，当饮某药，比客罢者数起焉。 尝私买侍婢，昆弟或颇闻知，莽因曰： 后将军朱子元无子，莽闻此儿种宜子，为买之。 即日以婢奉子元。 其匿情求名如此。 是时，太后姊子淳于长以材能为九卿，先进在莽右。
target_text: Over time, his uncle Chengdu Marquis Wang Shang and other notable figures spoke highly of Wang Mang, leading Emperor Cheng to consider him a wise man. In the first year of Yongshi, Wang Mang was granted the title of Marquis of Xindu with 1,500 households. He was later promoted to Cavalry Captain and Guanglu Doctor, serving as a guard in the palace. As his official position rose, his attitude became more humble. He distributed his wealth to guests, leaving no extra clothing in his house, and supported famous people, making friends with many officials. His reputation spread throughout the government and public, surpassing his uncles. Wang Mang's brother Wang Yong had died, leaving a son named Wang Guang, whom Wang Mang had study under a doctor. During his vacations, Wang Mang visited his teacher with gifts and gave presents to classmates, attracting admiration from scholars and elders. Wang Guang married on the same day as Wang Mang's son Wang Yu, with a hall full of congratulatory guests. Wang Mang once secretly bought a maidservant, claiming he bought her for General Zhu Ziyuan because she could bear many sons, and gave her away that day, hiding his true feelings to pursue fame.

input_text: 莽阴求其罪过，因大司马曲阳侯根白之，长伏诛，莽以获忠直，语在《长传》。 根因乞骸骨，荐莽自代，上遂擢为大司马。 是岁，绥和元年也，年三十八矣。 莽既拔出同列，继四父而辅政，欲令名誉过前人，遂克已不倦，聘诸贤良以为掾史，赏赐邑钱悉以享士，愈为俭约。 母病，公卿列侯遣夫人问疾，莽妻迎之，衣不曳地，布蔽膝。 见之者以为僮使，问知其夫人，皆惊。 辅政岁余，成帝崩，哀帝即位，尊皇太后为太皇太后。 太后诏莽就第，避帝外家。 莽上疏乞骸骨，哀帝遣尚书令诏莽曰： 先帝委政于君而弃群臣，朕得奉宗庙，诚嘉与君同心合意。
target_text: Wang Mang secretly collected crimes of Chun Yuchang, the son of the Queen Mother's sister, and reported him to Emperor Cheng through Grand Sima Wanggen. Chunyu Chang was executed, and Wang Mang gained a reputation for loyalty. Wang Gen then recommended Wang Mang to replace him, and Emperor Cheng promoted Wang Mang to Grand Sima at age thirty-eight. Wang Mang set strict demands on himself, hired virtuous people as subordinates, and used his rewards and fiefdom income to entertain scholars, living frugally. His wife, when greeting guests, wore a sarong that only reached her knees, surprising those who mistook her for a slave. After Emperor Cheng died and Emperor Ai succeeded, the Queen Mother ordered Wang Mang to resign, but Emperor Ai refused his resignation and reappointed him. Wang Mang later clashed with Empress Dowager Fu, leading to his resignation again. He was rewarded with gold and chariots and returned to his palace. Many officials praised him, and the emperor treated him with favor, sending special envoys to serve him at home.

input_text: 太后诏公卿举可大司马者，大司徒孔光、大司空彭宣举莽，前将军何武、后将军公孙禄互相举。 太后拜莽为大司马，与议立嗣。 安阳侯王舜，莽之从弟，其人修饬，太后所信爱也，莽白以舜为车骑将军，使迎中山王奉成帝后，是为孝平皇帝。 帝年九岁，太后临朝称制，委政于莽。 莽白赵氏前害皇子，傅氏骄僣，遂废孝成赵皇后、孝哀傅皇后，皆令自杀，语在《外戚传》。 莽以大司徒孔光名儒，相三主，太后所敬，天下信之，于是盛尊事光，引光女婿甄邯为侍中奉车都尉。 诸哀帝外戚及大臣居位素所不说者，莽皆傅致其罪，为请奏，令邯持与光。 光素畏慎，不敢不上之，莽白太后，辄可其奏。 于是前将军何武、后将军公孙禄坐互相举免，丁、傅及董贤亲属皆免官爵，徙远方。 红阳侯立，太后亲弟，虽不居位，莽以诸父内敬惮之，畏立从容言太后，令已不得肆意，乃复令光奏立旧恶： 前知定陵侯淳于长犯大逆罪，多受其赂，为言误朝；后白以官婢杨寄私子为皇子，众言曰吕氏、少帝复出，纷纷为天下所疑，难以示来世，成襁褓之功。 请遣立就国。
target_text: After three years in his feudal state, hundreds of officials petitioned for Wang Mang's recall. In the first year of Yuanshou, a solar eclipse occurred, and virtuous men praised Wang Mang's merits, leading the emperor to recall him. When Wang Mang returned to the capital, Emperor Ai died without a son, and the Queen Mother summoned Wang Mang to take control. Wang Mang reported that Da Sima Gao'an Hou Dong Xian was too young and not suitable, so his seal was confiscated, and Dong Xian committed suicide. The Queen Mother appointed Wang Mang as Grand Sima, and they selected the King of Zhongshan to succeed as Emperor Xiaoping. When Emperor Ping was nine, the Queen Mother acted as regent and entrusted government affairs to Wang Mang. Wang Mang deposed Empress Xiaocheng Tang and Empress Xiaoai Fu, ordering them to commit suicide. He treated Grand Situ Kong Guang with respect and used him to report on officials he disliked, leading to their dismissal or exile. Wang Mang also forced his uncle Wang Li to return to his feudal country, using coercion and blackmail to control the Queen Mother and her ministers.

input_text: 始，风益州令塞处蛮夷献白雉，元始元年正月，莽白太后下诏，以白雉荐宗庙。 群臣因奏言太后： 委任大司马莽定策定宗庙。 故大司马霍光有安宗庙之功，益封三万户，畴其爵邑，比萧相国。 莽宜如光故事。 太后问公卿曰： 诚以大司马有大功当著之邪？ 将以骨肉故欲异之也？ 于是群臣乃盛陈： 莽功德致周成白雉之瑞，千载同符。 圣王之法，臣有大功则生有美号，故周公及身在而托号于周。 莽有定国安汉家之大功，宜赐号曰安汉公，益户，畴爵邑，上应古制，下准行事，以顺天心。 太后诏尚书具其事。 莽上书言： 臣与孔光、王舜、甄丰、甄邯共定策，今愿独条光等功赏，寝置臣莽，勿随辈列。
target_text: Wang Mang promoted those who obeyed him and killed those who opposed him. He used false humility to confuse the Queen Mother and the public. When the Yizhou Order offered white-feathered pheasants, Wang Mang reported it to the Queen Mother, and the ministers recommended he be granted the title of Anmo Gong with increased fiefdoms. Wang Mang refused multiple times, but the Queen Mother eventually granted him the title. He accepted the titles of Taifu and An Mogong but resigned from the increased fiefdom and hereditary rewards. He suggested rewarding other officials and implementing benevolent policies. After winning public favor, Wang Mang wanted to be dictatorial and hinted to officials to write memorials saying the Queen Mother should not interfere in trivial matters. The Queen Mother issued an edict allowing Wang Mang to evaluate and decide on official matters, giving him power equal to the emperor.

input_text: 始，风益州令塞处蛮夷献白雉，元始元年正月，莽白太后下诏，以白雉荐宗庙。 群臣因奏言太后： 委任大司马莽定策定宗庙。 故大司马霍光有安宗庙之功，益封三万户，畴其爵邑，比萧相国。 莽宜如光故事。 太后问公卿曰： 诚以大司马有大功当著之邪？ 将以骨肉故欲异之也？ 于是群臣乃盛陈： 莽功德致周成白雉之瑞，千载同符。 圣王之法，臣有大功则生有美号，故周公及身在而托号于周。 莽有定国安汉家之大功，宜赐号曰安汉公，益户，畴爵邑，上应古制，下准行事，以顺天心。 太后诏尚书具其事。 莽上书言： 臣与孔光、王舜、甄丰、甄邯共定策，今愿独条光等功赏，寝置臣莽，勿随辈列。
target_text: Wang Mang used false reputations to please the Queen Mother, donating money and land to help the poor. He led ministers in reporting auspicious omens and asked the Queen Mother to conserve her energy. During floods or droughts, Wang Mang only ate vegetables, and the Queen Mother urged him to eat meat for his health. Wang Mang sent envoys to the Xiongnu Chanyu, who changed his name to comply with Chinese customs. Wang Mang also gave his daughter to Emperor Ping as queen to consolidate his power, despite initial refusal. The ministers insisted, and Wang Mang's daughter became queen. Wang Mang declined increased betrothal gifts and distributed them to poor families. Chen Chong, a Grand Situ Sizhi, wrote a memorial praising Wang Mang's virtues and merits, comparing him to the Duke of Zhou and recommending he be granted the title of prime minister. The Queen Mother showed the memorial to the ministers, and they discussed it.

input_text: 公其专意翼国，期于致平。 莽因是诛灭卫氏，穷治吕宽之狱，连引郡国豪桀素非议已者，内及敬武公主、梁王立、红阳侯立、平阿侯仁，使者迫守，皆自杀。 死者以百数，海内震焉。 大司马护军褒奏言： 安汉公遭子宇陷于管、蔡之辜，子受至重，为帝室故不敢顾私。 惟宇遭罪，喟然愤发作书八篇，以戒子孙。 宜班郡国，令学官以教授。 事下群公，请令天下吏能诵公戒者，以著官簿，比《孝经》。 四年春，郊祀高祖以配天，宗祀孝文皇帝以配上帝。 四月丁未，莽女立为皇后，大赦天下。 遣大司徒司直陈崇等八人分行天下，览观风俗。 太保舜等奏言： 《春秋》列功德之义，太上有立德，其次有立功，其次有立言，唯至德大贤然后能之。 其在人臣，则生有大赏，终为宗臣，殷之伊尹，周之周公是也。
target_text: Wang Mang's son Wang Yu, fearing Emperor Ping's resentment, conspired with his teacher Wu Zhang and brother-in-law Lu Kuan to smear Wang Mang's mansion with blood to frighten him. Wang Mang arrested Wang Yu, who drank poison and died. Wang Mang killed Wang Yu's wife after she gave birth and used the incident to kill the Wei family and others, implicating many counties and feudal states. Hundreds of people died, shocking the world. Chen Zuo, the Grand Sima Hujun, praised Wang Mang for punishing his son like the Duke of Zhou. The ministers requested that Wang Mang's admonitions be distributed and treated like the "Book of Filial Piety." In the spring of the fourth year of the Yuan Dynasty, people worshiped heaven and offered sacrifices to Emperor Gaozu and Emperor Xiaowen. Wang Mang's daughter was made queen, and a general amnesty was announced. Eight officials were dispatched to inspect social customs. Taibao Wang Shun and others reported that Wang Mang's merits should be rewarded like Yi Yin and the Duke of Zhou. The ministers requested that Wang Mang be given the title of prime minister, ranking above the three dukes, with various honors and rewards.

input_text: 始，风益州令塞处蛮夷献白雉，元始元年正月，莽白太后下诏，以白雉荐宗庙。 群臣因奏言太后： 委任大司马莽定策定宗庙。 故大司马霍光有安宗庙之功，益封三万户，畴其爵邑，比萧相国。 莽宜如光故事。 太后问公卿曰： 诚以大司马有大功当著之邪？ 将以骨肉故欲异之也？ 于是群臣乃盛陈： 莽功德致周成白雉之瑞，千载同符。 圣王之法，臣有大功则生有美号，故周公及身在而托号于周。 莽有定国安汉家之大功，宜赐号曰安汉公，益户，畴爵邑，上应古制，下准行事，以顺天心。 太后诏尚书具其事。 莽上书言： 臣与孔光、王舜、甄丰、甄邯共定策，今愿独条光等功赏，寝置臣莽，勿随辈列。
target_text: Wang Mang refused the rewards, but the Queen Mother insisted. He eventually accepted the titles and rewards, including the prime minister's seal. Wang Mang proposed building a Mingtang, a national imperial college, and other structures, recruiting scholars from across the country. The ministers reported that Wang Mang's merits were evident, and the construction was completed quickly. The Queen Mother agreed to reward Wang Mang with nine kinds of utensils. In the fifth year of the Yuan Dynasty, many princes and officials petitioned for Wang Mang's rewards. Wang Mang wrote a letter declining, but the Queen Mother insisted. The ministers reported that Wang Mang's merits were like those of Yi Yin and the Duke of Zhou, and they requested the reward of nine tins. The Queen Mother approved, and Wang Mang received various honors and items, including a green apron, formal dress, a jade-inlaid saber, chariots, and military equipment. He was also given a red painted door and steps inside the eaves, with guards and officials appointed to assist him.

input_text: 奏可。 又增法五十条，犯者徙之西海。 徙者以千万数，民始怨矣。 泉陵侯刘庆上书言： 周成王幼少，称孺子，周公居摄。 今帝富于春秋，宜令安汉公行天子事，如周公。 郡臣皆曰： 宜如庆言。 冬，荧惑入月中。 平帝疾，莽作策，请命于泰畤，戴璧秉圭，愿以身代。 藏策金滕，置于前殿，敕诸公勿敢言。 十二月，平帝崩，大赦天下。 莽征明礼者宗伯凤等与定天下吏六百石以上皆服丧三年。 奏尊孝成庙曰统宗，孝平庙曰元宗。 时元帝世绝，而宣帝曾孙有见王五人，列侯广戚侯显等四十八人，莽恶其长大，曰： 兄弟不得相为后。
target_text: In the autumn, Wang Mang dug the Ziwu Road due to an auspicious sign from his daughter, Queen Wang. Eight custom envoys returned, reporting that the customs of the world were uniform and forging folk songs praising virtues. Wang Mang reported this and recorded it in documents. He also reported that there were no lawsuits, thieves, or hungry people, and the system of men and women not walking together was implemented. Twelve people, including Liu Xin and Chen Chong, were granted the title of marquis for building the Mingtang. Wang Mang sent envoys to attract the Qiang people, who offered their land to become subjects. Wang Mang proposed establishing Xihai County and revising state names and boundaries. The memorial was approved, and fifty additional laws were added, with violators exiled to Xihai County. The people became resentful. Liu Qing, Marquis of Quanling, wrote a letter suggesting Wang Mang act as regent like the Duke of Zhou. The ministers agreed. When Emperor Ping fell ill, Wang Mang prayed for his safety and offered to sacrifice his own life. Emperor Ping died, and Wang Mang recruited scholars to participate in the decision to mourn for three years. He selected Liu Ying, a two-year-old great-great-grandson of Emperor Xuan, as the successor.

input_text: 太后诏公卿举可大司马者，大司徒孔光、大司空彭宣举莽，前将军何武、后将军公孙禄互相举。 太后拜莽为大司马，与议立嗣。 安阳侯王舜，莽之从弟，其人修饬，太后所信爱也，莽白以舜为车骑将军，使迎中山王奉成帝后，是为孝平皇帝。 帝年九岁，太后临朝称制，委政于莽。 莽白赵氏前害皇子，傅氏骄僣，遂废孝成赵皇后、孝哀傅皇后，皆令自杀，语在《外戚传》。 莽以大司徒孔光名儒，相三主，太后所敬，天下信之，于是盛尊事光，引光女婿甄邯为侍中奉车都尉。 诸哀帝外戚及大臣居位素所不说者，莽皆傅致其罪，为请奏，令邯持与光。 光素畏慎，不敢不上之，莽白太后，辄可其奏。 于是前将军何武、后将军公孙禄坐互相举免，丁、傅及董贤亲属皆免官爵，徙远方。 红阳侯立，太后亲弟，虽不居位，莽以诸父内敬惮之，畏立从容言太后，令已不得肆意，乃复令光奏立旧恶： 前知定陵侯淳于长犯大逆罪，多受其赂，为言误朝；后白以官婢杨寄私子为皇子，众言曰吕氏、少帝复出，纷纷为天下所疑，难以示来世，成襁褓之功。 请遣立就国。
target_text: A white stone with vermilion words reading "Announcement of Prince Mang of Anhan to be the emperor" was discovered. Wang Mang asked the princes to report this to the Queen Mother, who initially refused but eventually agreed to let Wang Mang act as regent. The ministers reported that Wang Mang should ascend the throne and exercise imperial power, following the example of the Duke of Zhou. The Queen Mother issued an edict allowing Wang Mang to serve as regent and act as the emperor. Wang Mang then sat on the throne, wore the emperor's clothes, and accepted the worship of the ministers. The next year, the name was changed to Jushe. In the first year of Jushe, Wang Mang worshiped the gods and held ceremonies. Liu Ying was made the crown prince, known as Ruzi. Wang Shun, Zhen Feng, and Zhen Han were appointed as officials. In April, Liu Chong, Marquis of Anzhong, attacked Wancheng but failed. Wang Mang pardoned those who surrendered. Liu Jia wrote a memorial praising Wang Mang and suggesting severe punishment for Liu Chong. Wang Mang was pleased and granted Liu Jia a fiefdom. The ministers reported that Wang Mang's power should be increased to conquer the world. The Queen Mother ordered Wang Mang to call himself the "fake emperor" when seeing her. In December, the ministers petitioned to increase Wang Mang's official offices and household staff. The memorial was approved.

input_text: 众稍多，至且十万人，莽恐，遣将军王奇、王级将兵拒之。 以太保甄邯为大将军，受钺高庙，领天下兵，左杖节，右把钺，屯城外。 王舜、甄丰昼夜循行殿中。 十二月，王邑等破翟义于圉。 司威陈崇使监军上书言： 陛下奉天洪范，心合宝龟，膺受元命，豫知成败，咸应兆占，是谓配天。 配天之主，虑则移气，言则动物，施则成化。 臣崇伏读诏书下日，窃计其时，圣思始发，而反虏仍破；诏文始书，反虏大败；制书始下，反虏毕斩，众将未及齐其锋芒，臣崇未及尽共愚虑，而事已决矣。 莽大说。 三年春，地震。 大赦天下。 王邑等还京师，西与王级等合击明、鸿，皆破灭，语在《翟义传》。 莽大置酒未央宫白虎殿，劳赐将帅，诏陈崇治校军功，第其高下。 莽乃上奏曰： 明圣之世，国多贤人，故唐、虞之时，可比屋而封，至功成事就，则加赏焉。
target_text: In the spring of the second year, new currencies were minted, and a ban was issued on carrying gold privately. In September, Zhai Yi, the prefect of Dongjun, raised troops and elected Liu Xin as emperor, accusing Wang Mang of poisoning Emperor Ping. Wang Mang was frightened and sent eight generals to attack Zhai Yi. Tang Ming and Huo Hong also raised troops to respond, growing to nearly 100,000 people. Wang Mang sent generals to resist them and appointed Zhen Han as the general. In December, Wang Yi and other generals defeated Zhai Yi. Chen Chong wrote a memorial praising Wang Mang's wisdom. Wang Mang was very happy. In the spring of three years, an earthquake occurred, and Wang Mang announced a general amnesty. Wang Yi and others defeated Ming Dynasty and Huo Hong. Wang Mang held a banquet to reward the generals and wrote a memorial suggesting that the Zhou system be followed for titles and fiefs. The memorial was approved, and several hundred people were granted titles. The ministers reported that Wang Mang's sons should be promoted to the title of Duke. The Queen Mother agreed, and Wang An and Wang Lin were made dukes. Wang Guang was granted the title of Yan Gonghou. Wang Mang then planned to ascend to the true throne.

input_text: 司威陈崇奏，衍功侯光私报执金吾窦况，令杀人，况为收系，致其法。 莽大怒，切责光。 光母曰： 女自视孰与长孙、中孙？ 遂母子自杀，及况皆死。 初，莽以事母、养嫂、抚兄子为名，及后悖虐，复以示公义焉。 令光子嘉嗣爵为侯。 莽下书曰： 遏密之义，讫于季冬，正月郊祀，八音当奏。 王公卿士，乐凡几等？ 五声八音，条各云何？ 其与所部儒生各尽精思，悉陈其义。 是岁，广饶侯刘京，车骑将军千人扈云、太保属臧鸿奏符命。 京言齐郡新井，云言巴郡石牛，鸿言扶风雍石，莽皆迎受。 十一月甲子，莽上奏太后曰：
target_text: In September, Wang Mang's mother died. Instead of expressing grief, Wang Mang asked the Queen Mother to discuss his mourning clothes. The doctors and Confucian scholars said that the regent should not wear mourning clothes for his biological mother. Wang Mang implemented their suggestion. Chen Chong reported that Wang Guang had privately told Zhi Jinwu Shi Ji to kill for him. Wang Mang was furious, and Wang Guang and his mother committed suicide. Wang Mang wrote a letter about the prohibition of playing music and asked about the grades of music. In this year, Liu Jing, Hu Yun, and Zang Hong reported auspicious omens. Wang Mang readily accepted them. On Jiazi day in November, Wang Mang wrote a memorial to the Queen Mother, citing various omens and requesting to be called the "false emperor" and to change the calendar. The memorial was approved. The common people learned of his belief in the talisman, and the ministers discussed it widely. Aizhang, a native of Zitong County, made a copper cabinet with inscriptions claiming Wang Mang was the true emperor. Wang Mang went to the Gaodi Temple to receive the copper cabinet, wore the crown, and ascended the throne as the True Dragon Emperor. He declared a new country, changed the calendar, and set the colors of carriages, horses, and clothing to yellow.

input_text: 四年五月，莽曰： 保成师友祭酒唐林、故谏议祭酒琅邪纪逡，孝弟忠恕，敬上爱下，博通旧闻，德行醇备，至于黄发，靡有愆失。 其封林为建德侯，逡为封德侯，位皆特进，见礼如三公。 赐弟一区，钱三百万，授几杖焉。 六月，更授诸侯茅土于明堂，曰： 予制作地理，建封五等，考之经艺，合之传记，通于义理，论之思之，至于再三，自始建国之元以来九年于兹，乃今定矣。 予亲设文石之平，陈菁茅四色之土，钦告于岱宗泰社后土、先祖先妣，以班授之。 各就厥国，养牧民人，用成功业。 其在缘边，若江南，非诏所召，遣侍于帝城者，纳言掌货大夫且调都内故钱，予其禄，公岁八十万，侯、伯四十万，子、男二十万。 然复不能尽得。 莽好空言，慕古法，多封爵人，性实遴啬，托以地理未定，故且先赋茅土，用慰喜封者。 是岁，复明六管之令。
target_text: In the fourth year of his reign, Wang Mang granted titles and rewards to several officials, including Lu Ta and Xian Zhi, who received the rank of special advance and were treated with the same etiquette as the three princes. He also awarded them houses, money, and ceremonial items. In June, he formally enfeoffed princes at the Mingtang, claiming he had spent nearly nine years planning the land system and feudal hierarchy based on classical texts. However, Wang Mang was known for his empty rhetoric and stinginess, using the undetermined land plan as an excuse to delay actual implementation while granting symbolic titles to appease those who desired rank.

input_text: 每一管下，为设科条防禁，犯者罪至死，吏民抵罪者浸众。 又一切调上公以下诸有奴婢者，率一口出钱三千六百，天下愈愁，盗贼起。 纳言冯常以六管谏，莽大怒，免常官。 置执法左右刺奸。 选用能吏侯霸等分督六尉、六队，如汉刺史，与三公士郡一人从事。 临淮瓜田仪等为盗贼，依阻会稽长州，琅邪女子吕母亦起。 初，吕母子为县吏，为宰所冤杀。 母散家财，以酤酒买兵弩，阴厚贫穷少年，得百余人，遂攻海曲县，杀其宰以祭子墓。 引兵入海，其众浸多，后皆万数。 莽遣使者即赦盗贼，还言： 盗贼解，辄复合。 问其故，皆曰愁法禁烦苛，不得举手。 力作所得，不足以给贡税。 闭门自守，又坐邻伍铸钱挟铜，奸吏因以愁民。 民穷，悉起为盗贼。
target_text: Wang Mang reaffirmed six financial management systems, establishing harsh laws with punishments including execution for violations. He levied taxes on slave owners, requiring 3,600 yuan per slave, which caused widespread resentment and led to the rise of bandits. When officials like Nayan and Feng Chang advised against these policies, Wang Mang removed them from office. He appointed law enforcement officers with powers similar to Han dynasty governors to supervise the six systems. Rebellions erupted across the country, including Guatianyi's occupation of Changzhouyuan and Lu Mu's uprising in Langxie County, where a woman whose son was unjustly killed by a county magistrate gathered followers, attacked Haiqu County, and eventually commanded tens of thousands of troops.

input_text: 莽大怒，免之。 其或顺指，言 民骄黠当诛 。及言 时运适然，且灭不久 ，莽说，辄迁之。 是岁八月，莽亲之南郊，铸作威斗。 威斗者，以五石铜为之，若北斗，长二尺五寸，欲以厌胜众兵。 既成，令司命负之，莽出在前，入在御旁。 铸斗日，大寒，百官人马有冻死者。 五年正月朔，北军南门灾。 以大司马司允费兴为荆州牧，见，问到部方略，兴对曰： 荆、扬之民率依阻山泽，以渔采为业。 间者，国张六管，税山泽，妨夺民之利，连年久旱，百姓饥穷，故为盗贼。 兴到部，欲令明晓告盗贼归田里，假贷犁牛种食，阔其租赋，几可以解释安集。 莽怒，免兴官。 天下吏以不得奉禄，并为奸利，郡尹县宰家累千金。 莽下诏曰： 详考始建国二年胡虏猾夏以来，诸军吏及缘边吏大夫以上为奸利增产致富者，收其家所有财产五分之四，以助边急。 公府士驰传天下，考覆贪饕，开吏告其将，奴婢告其主，几以禁奸，奸愈甚。
target_text: Wang Mang's envoys reported that thieves dispersed but regrouped due to harsh prohibitions, heavy taxes, and the inability of people to make a living. Wang Mang dismissed officials who reported these truths and promoted those who flattered him. In August, he forged a copper weapon shaped like the Big Dipper to intimidate peasant armies, but during its casting, extreme cold killed many officials and horses. Fires broke out at the Northern Army camp, and when newly appointed officials like Fei Xing suggested lenient policies to address the root causes of rebellion, Wang Mang dismissed them. Officials across the country sought illegal profits due to unpaid salaries, amassing fortunes.

input_text: 皇孙功崇公宗坐自画容貌，被服天子衣冠，刻印三：一曰 维祉冠存己夏处南山臧薄冰 ，二曰 肃圣宝继 ，三曰 德封昌图 。 又宗舅吕宽家前徙合浦，私与宗通，发觉按验，宗自杀。 莽曰： 宗属为皇孙，爵为上公，知宽等叛逆族类，而与交通；刻铜印三，文意甚害，不知厌足，窥欲非望。 《春秋》之义， 君亲毋将，将而诛焉。 迷惑失道，自取此事，乌呼哀哉！ 宗本名会宗，以制作去二名，今复名会宗。 贬厥爵，改厥号，赐谥为功崇缪伯，以诸伯之礼葬于故同谷城郡。 宗姊妨为卫将军王兴夫人，祝诅姑，杀婢以绝口。 事发觉，莽使中常侍惲责问妨，并以责兴，皆自杀。 事连及司命孔仁妻，亦自杀。 仁见莽免冠谢，莽使尚书劾仁： 乘 乾 车，驾 神 马，左苍龙，右白虎，前朱雀，后玄武，右杖威节，左负威斗，号曰赤星，非以骄仁，乃以尊新室之威命也。 仁擅免天文冠，大不敬。 有诏勿劾，更易新冠。 其好怪如此。 以真道侯王涉为卫将军。 涉者，曲阳侯根子也。 根，成帝世为大司马，荐莽自代，莽恩之，以为曲阳非令称，乃追谥根曰直道让公，涉嗣其爵。 是岁，赤眉力子都、樊崇等以饥馑相聚，起于琅邪，转抄掠，众皆万数。 遗使者发郡国兵击之，不能克。 六年春，莽见盗贼多，乃令太史推三万六千岁历纪，六岁一改元，布天下。 下书曰： 《紫阁图》曰 太一、黄帝皆仙上天，张乐昆仑虔山之上。
target_text: Wang Mang's grandson Wang Zong was discovered drawing himself in imperial regalia and engraving seals with rebellious inscriptions. After investigation, Wang Zong committed suicide, and his sister Wang Zhi also died after being implicated in murder and witchcraft. The Red Eyebrow Army, led by Li Zidu and Fan Chong, began their uprising in Langxie County due to famine, gathering ten thousand troops. Wang Mang's attempts to suppress them failed. In the sixth year, Wang Mang calculated a 36,000-year calendar and changed the year name, claiming to follow divine instructions, but people laughed at these practices.

input_text: 后世圣主得瑞者，当张乐秦终南山之上。 予之不敏，奉行未明，乃今谕矣。 复以宁始将军为更始将军，以顺符命。 《易》不云乎？ 日新之谓盛德，生生之谓易。 予其飨哉！ 欲以诳耀百姓，销解益贼。 众皆笑之。 初献《新乐》于明堂、太庙。 群臣始冠麟韦之弁。 或闻其乐声，曰： 清厉而哀，非兴国之声也。 是时，关东饥旱数年，力子都等党众浸多，更始将军廉丹击益州不能克，征还。 更遣复位后大司马护军郭兴、庸部牧李晔击蛮夷若豆等，太傅牺叔士孙喜清洁江湖之益贼。 而匈奴寇边甚。 莽乃大募天下丁男及死罪囚、吏民奴，名曰 猪突豨勇 ，以为锐卒。 一切税天下吏民，訾三十取一，缣帛皆输长安。 令公卿以下至郡县黄绶皆保养军马，多少各以秩为差。
target_text: The Kanto region suffered from drought and famine for consecutive years, causing rebel numbers to grow. Wang Mang recruited strong men, condemned criminals, and slaves to form elite troops, collecting one-thirtieth of property from officials and civilians to fund military campaigns. He also recruited specialists with unique skills to attack the Xiongnu, including a man who claimed to be able to fly but only managed a few hundred steps before falling. Wang Mang appointed them all as commanders despite knowing their claims were false.

input_text: 即得当，欲遣尤与廉丹击匈奴，皆赐姓徵氏，号二徵将军，当诛单于舆而立当代之。 出车城西横厩，未发。 尤素有智略，非莽攻伐四夷，数谏不从，著古名将乐毅、白起不用之意及言边事凡三篇，奏以风谏莽。 及当出廷议，尤固言匈奴可且以为后，先忧山东盗贼。 莽大怒，乃策尤曰： 视事四年，蛮夷猾夏不能遏绝，寇贼奸宄不能殄灭，不畏天威，不用诏命，貌很自臧，持必不移，怀执异心，非沮军议。 未忍致于理，其上大司马武建伯印韨，归故郡。 以降符伯董忠为大司马。 翼平连率田况奏郡县訾民不实，莽复三十税一。 以况忠言忧国，进爵为伯，赐钱二百万。 众庶皆詈之。 青、徐民多弃乡里流亡，老弱死道路，壮者入贼中。 夙夜连率韩博上言： 有奇士，长丈，大十围，来至臣府，曰欲奋击胡虏。 自谓巨毋霸，出于蓬莱东南，五城西北昭如海濒，轺车不能载，三马不能胜。 即日以大车四马，建虎旗，载霸诣阙。 霸卧则枕鼓，以铁箸食，此皇天所以辅新室也。 愿陛下作大甲高车，贲、育之衣，遣大将一人与虎贲百人迎之于道。 京师门户不容者，开高大之，以视百蛮，镇安天下。 博意欲以风莽。 莽闻恶之，留霸在所新丰，更其姓曰巨母氏，谓因文母太后而霸王符也。 征博下狱，以非所宜言，弃市。
target_text: Wang Mang's policies led to widespread suffering. People abandoned their homes, the old and weak died on roadsides, and the strong joined thieves. Officials like Han Bo tried to ridicule Wang Mang with absurd reports, but Wang Mang executed them. He changed the year name to Emperor of the Earth and issued harsh decrees allowing executions even in spring and summer, terrifying the people. When natural disasters occurred, Wang Mang blamed his officials rather than his own policies.

input_text: 三辅悉平，更始都长安，居长乐宫。 府藏完具，独未央宫烧攻莽三日，死则案堵复故。 更始至，岁余政教不行。 明年夏，赤眉樊崇等众数十万人入关，立刘盆子，称尊号，攻更始，更始降之。 赤眉遂烧长安宫室市里，害更始。 民饥饿相食，死者数十万，长安为虚，城中无人行。 宗庙园陵皆发掘，唯霸陵、杜陵完。 六月，世祖即位，然后宗庙社稷复立，天下艾安。 赞曰： 王莽始起外戚，折节力行，以要名誉，宗族称孝，师友归仁。 及其居位辅政，成、哀之际，勤劳国家，直道而行，动见称述。 岂所谓 在家必闻，在国必闻 ， 色取仁而行违 者邪？
target_text: The rebellion continued to spread, with various leaders emerging across the country. Wang Mang's attempts to suppress them through military force and harsh laws only worsened the situation. His officials grew increasingly fearful, and the people's suffering intensified. The Han dynasty eventually revived under Emperor Gengshi, who captured Chang'an and executed Wang Mang's supporters. The Red Eyebrow Army later overthrew Emperor Gengshi, causing further destruction, until Emperor Shizu restored order and peace to the realm.

input_text: 始建国元年正月朔，莽帅公侯卿士奉皇太后玺韨，上太皇太后，顺符命，去汉号焉。 初，莽妻宜春侯王氏女，立为皇后。 本生四男：宇、获、安、临。 二子前诛死，安颇荒忽，乃以临为皇太子，安为新嘉辟。 封宇子六人：千为功隆公，寿为功明公，吉为功成公，宗为功崇以，世为功昭公，利为功著公。 大赦天下。 莽乃策命孺子曰： 咨尔婴，昔皇天右乃太祖，历世十二，享国二百一十载，历数在于予躬。 《诗》不云乎？ 侯服于周，天命靡常。 封尔为定安公，永为新室宾。 於戏！ 敬天之休，往践乃位，毋废予命。 又曰： 其以平原、安德、漯阴、鬲、重丘，凡户万，地方百里，为定安公国。 立汉祖宗之庙于其国，与周后并，行其正朔、服色。 世世以事其祖宗，永以命德茂功，享历代之祀焉。 以孝平皇后为定安太后。 读策毕，莽亲执孺子手，流涕歔欷，曰： 昔周公摄位，终得复子明辟，今予独迫皇天威命，不得如意！ 哀叹良久。
target_text: On the first day of the first lunar month of the first year of the founding of the People's Republic of China, Wang Mang led the princes and ministers to present the newly made Imperial Seal of the Empress Dowager to her, thereby removing the name of the Han Dynasty. Wang Mang had married the daughter of the Wang family of the Marquis of Yichun as his queen, who bore him four sons: Wang Zi, Wang Huo, Wang An, and Wang Lin. Two of his sons had been executed earlier. Due to Wang An's confusion, Wang Lin was made crown prince, and Wang An was given a new title. Six sons were granted the title of king. An amnesty was announced for the whole world. Wang Mang then wrote a policy letter ordering the boy Liu Ying to step down, granting him the title of Ding'an Gong and making him a guest of the new dynasty. Queen Xiaoqian was named the Queen Mother of Ding'an. After reading the policy, Wang Mang personally held the boy's hand, sighed with tears, and expressed his sorrow. The middle master took the boy down to the palace, and the boy faced north, calling himself a minister. Hundreds of officials accompanied him, and no one was unmoved.

input_text: 中傅将孺子下殿，北面而称臣。 百僚陪位，莫不感动。 又按金匮，辅臣皆封拜。 以太傅、左辅、骠骑将军安阳侯王舜为太师，封安新公；大司徒就德侯平晏为太傅，就新公；少阿、羲和、京兆尹、红休侯刘歆为国师，嘉新公；广汉梓潼哀章为国将，美新公：是为四辅，位上公。 太保、后承承阳侯甄邯为大司马，承新公；丕进侯王寻为大司徒，章新公；步兵将军成都侯王邑为大司空，隆新公：是为三公。 大阿、右拂；大司空、卫将军广阳侯甄丰为更始将军，广新公；京兆王兴为卫将军，奉新公；轻车将军成武侯孙建为立国将军，成新公；京兆王盛为前将军，崇新公：是为四将。 凡十一公。 王兴者，故城门令史。 王盛者，卖饼。 莽按符命求得此姓名十余人，两人容貌应卜相，径从布衣登用，以视神焉。 余皆拜为郎。 是日，封拜卿大夫、侍中、尚书官凡数百人。 诸刘为郡守，皆徙为谏大夫。
target_text: According to the instructions on the gold cabinet, the auxiliary ministers held appointment ceremonies. The Taifu, Zuo Fu, and Husband General Anyang Hou Wang Shun were appointed as the Grand Master and granted the title of An Xingong; the Great Situ Juudehou Pingyan was appointed as the Grand Tutor and granted the title of Xingong; Shao'a, Xihe, and Jingzhao Yin Hongxiu Hou Liu Xin were appointed as the Imperial Preceptors and granted the title of Jiaxin Gong; Aizhang, a native of Zitong County in Guanghan County, was appointed as the State General and granted the title of Mei Xingong. These were the fourth assistants, ranking in the rank of Grand Duke. The Taibao and later Chengyang Marquis Zhen Han was appointed as the Great Sima and granted the title of New Gong; the Marquis of Pi Jin, Wang Xun, was granted the title of the Great Situ and granted the title of the New Duke; the infantry general, the Marquis of Chengdu, was granted the title of the Grand Sikong and granted the title of Long Xingong. These were the three Dukes. Da'a, Youfu, Da Sikong, and Wei generals Guangyang Hou Zhenfeng were appointed as Gengshi generals and granted the title of Guangxin Gong; Wang Xing from Jingzhao Yin was appointed as the Wei general and granted the title of Xingong; General Qingche Cheng Wuhou Sun Jian was appointed as the founding general and granted the title of Xingong; Wang Sheng from Jingzhao Yin was appointed as the former general and granted the title of Chongxin Gong. These were the four generals. Eleven males in total. Wang Xing was the original official of the city gate, and Wang Sheng was a cake seller. Wang Mang found more than ten people with such names according to the talisman, and they were directly recruited from civilians to show their magic. Others with the same name were awarded the title of Langguan. On this day, a total of several hundred people were awarded the official positions of minister, minister, and minister. Members of the royal family surnamed Liu who served as county governors were all transferred to admonish the officials. Mingguang Palace was changed to Ding'an Pavilion, and Queen Mother Ding'an was allowed to live there. The former Dahonglu official residence was used as a public residence in Ding'an, with guards and envoys set up to monitor and manage it. The nursery staff and nanny were warned not to talk to him, and he was allowed to stay in a small room surrounded by four walls. Later, Wang Ling married his granddaughter Wang Yu's daughter to him.

input_text: 斗平元心中，司空典致物图，考度以绳，主司地里，平治水土，掌名山川，众殖鸟兽，蕃茂草木。 各策命以其职，如典诰之文。 置大司马司允，大司徒司直，大司空司若，位皆孤卿。 更名大司农曰羲和，后更为纳言，大理曰作士，太常曰秩宗，大鸿胪曰典乐，少府曰共工，水衡都尉曰予虞，与三公司卿凡九卿，分属三公。 每一卿置大夫三人，一大夫置元士三人，凡二十七大夫，八十一元士，分主中都官诸职。 更名光禄勋曰司中，太仆曰太御，卫尉曰太卫，执金吾曰奋武，中尉曰军正，又置大赘官，主乘舆服御物，后又典兵秩，位皆上卿，号曰六监。 改郡太守曰大尹，都尉曰太尉，县令长曰宰，御史曰执法，公车司马曰王路四门，长乐宫曰常乐室，未央宫曰寿成室，前殿曰王路堂，长安曰常安。 更名秩百名曰庶士，三百石曰下士，四百石曰中士，五百石曰命士，六百石曰元士，千石曰下大夫，比二千石曰中大夫，二千石曰上大夫，中二千石曰卿。 车服黻冕，各有差品。 又置司恭、司徒、司明、司聪、司中大夫及诵诗工、彻膳宰，以司过。 策曰： 予闻上圣欲昭厥德，罔不慎修厥身，用绥于远，是用建尔司于五事。
target_text: Wang Mang issued a policy document stipulating the responsibilities of the officials, linking them to the five planets and the moon, sun, and Beidou. Other officials made regulations according to their duties. There were appointed Grand Sima Siyun, Grand Situ Sizhi, and Grand Situ Kong Siruo, all of whom were appointed as Guqing. Da Sinong was renamed Xihe, and later Nayan, Dali was renamed Zuoshi, Taichang was renamed Zhizhong, Dahonglu was renamed Dianle, the Shaofu was renamed Gonggong, and the Shuiheng Duwei was renamed Yuyu. In addition, the three company ministers were renamed nine ministers in total, and they were placed under the jurisdiction of the three princes. There were three officials under each minister, and three officials under each official. A total of twenty-seven officials and eighty-one officials were in charge of all the duties of various government offices in the capital. Guang Luxun was renamed Sizhong, the imperial servant was renamed Taiyu, the Weiwei was renamed Taiwei, Zhijinwu was renamed Fenwu, the lieutenant was renamed Junzheng, and a large official was set up to be in charge of the emperor's vehicles, clothes and utensils, and later in charge of military supplies. The positions were all senior ministers, called the Sixth Supervisor. The prefect of the county was renamed Taiyin, the captain was renamed Taiwei, the county magistrate and magistrate were renamed Zai, the censor was renamed Enforcement, the carriage driver was renamed Wanglu Simen, Changle Palace was renamed Changleshi, Weiyang Palace was renamed Shouchengshi, the front hall was renamed Wanglutang, and Chang'an was renamed Chang'an. The people with a salary of 100 stones were renamed common people, those with a salary of 300 stones were renamed corporals, those with a salary of 400 stones were renamed sergeants, those with a salary of 500 stones were renamed Mingshi, those with a salary of 600 stones were renamed yuanshi, those with a thousand stones were renamed xiaodafu, those with 2000 stones were renamed middle doctors, 2000 stones were renamed shangdafu, and those with 2000 stones were renamed qing. The carriages, horses, dresses, and hats they use all have different levels. Doctors Sigong, Situ, Siming, Sicong, Sizhong, poetry reciters, and Che Shanzai were also appointed to detect faults.

input_text: 予惟黄帝、帝少昊、帝颛顼、帝喾、帝尧、帝舜、帝夏禹、皋陶、伊尹咸有圣德，假于皇天，功烈巍巍，光施于远。 予甚嘉之，营求其后，将祚厥祀。 惟王氏，虞帝之后也，出自帝喾；刘氏，尧之后也，出自颛顼。 于是封姚恂为初睦侯，奉黄帝后；梁护为脩远伯，奉少昊后；皇孙功隆公千，奉帝喾后；刘歆为祁烈伯，奉颛顼后；国师刘歆子叠为伊休侯，奉尧后；妫昌为始睦侯，奉虞帝后；山遵为褒谋子，奉皋陶后；伊玄为褒衡子，奉伊尹后。 汉后定安公刘婴，位为宾。 周后卫公姬党，更封为章平公，亦为宾。 殷后宋公孔弘，运转次移，更封为章昭侯，位为恪。 夏后辽西姒丰，封为章功侯，亦为恪。 四代古宗，宗祀于明堂，以配皇始祖考虞帝。 周公后褒鲁子姬就、宣尼公后褒成子孔钧，已前定焉。 莽又曰： 予前在摄时，建郊宫，定祧庙，立社稷，神祇报况，或光自上复于下，流为乌，或典气熏烝，昭耀章明，以著黄、虞之烈焉。
target_text: Wang Mang issued a policy letter saying that there are no two suns in the sky, and there are no two kings on the earth. Some of the princes of the Han Dynasty were called kings, until foreigners from all over the world also imitated the title of king, which violated the ancient system and deviated from the principle of unification. It should be ensured that the names of princes and kings are all called Gong, and that the names of foreigners from all over the world who steal their names and call themselves kings are changed to Hou. He also said that the emperor's lineage should be inherited, developed and integrated; the lineage with noble virtues should enjoy sacrifices for a long time. He thought that Huangdi, Shaohao, Zhuanxu, Diru, Yao of Tang, Yushun, Xia Yu, Gaotao and Yiyin all had sage virtues. He admired them, sought their descendants, and intended to continue their sacrifices. He believed that the surname Wang was a descendant of Yu Shun and came from imperial learning; the surname Liu was a descendant of Tang Yao and came from Zhuan Xu. So Yao Xun was granted the title of Marquis of Chumu, the descendant of the Yellow Emperor; Liang Hu was the descendant of Xiu Yuanbo, the descendant of Shaowu; the grandson of the emperor Gonglong Gongwang Qian was the descendant of the emperor; Liu Xin was the descendant of Qi Liebo, the descendant of Zhuan Xu; the country Liu Xin's son Liu Die was Yixiuhou and inherited the descendants of Tang Yao; Machang was Shimuhou and inherited the descendants of Yu Shun; Shan Zun was Baomou's son and inherited Gaotao's descendants; Yixuan was Baohengzi and inherited Yiyin's descendants. Liu Ying, the descendant of the Han Dynasty, Ding'an Gong, was a state guest. Ji Dang, a descendant of Duke Wei of the Zhou Dynasty, was renamed Duke Zhang Ping and was also a state guest. Song Gong Kong Hong, a descendant of the Yin Dynasty, had his fortune changed and his position moved. He was renamed Zhang Zhaohou and his status was that of a distinguished guest. Si Feng, a descendant of the Xia Dynasty from Liaoxi County, was granted the title of Zhang Gonghou and was also an honored guest. The ancestors of the Xia, Yin, Zhou, and Han dynasties were worshiped together in the Mingtang, and they were allowed to follow the great imperial ancestor Yu Shun to share. The descendants of Zhou Gong praised Lu Zi Ji Ji, and the descendants of Confucius praised Cheng Zi Ji Gou. It has been determined before.

input_text: 封陈崇为统睦侯，奉胡王后；田丰为世睦侯，奉敬王后。 天下牧守皆以前有翟义、赵明等领州郡，怀忠孝，封牧为男，守以附城。 又封旧恩戴崇、金涉、箕闳、杨并等子皆为男。 遣骑都尉嚣等分治黄帝园位于上都桥畤，虞帝于零陵九疑，胡王于淮阳陈，敬王于齐临淄，愍王于城阳莒，伯王于济南东平陵，孺王于魏郡元城，使者四时致祠。 其庙当作者，以天下初定，且祫祭于明堂太庙。 以汉高庙为文祖庙。 莽曰： 予之皇始祖考虞帝受嬗于唐，汉氏初祖唐帝，世有传国之象，予复亲受金策于汉高皇帝之灵。 惟思褒厚前代，何有忘时？ 汉氏祖宗有七，以礼立庙于定安国。 其园寝庙在京师者，勿罢，祠荐如故。 予以秋九月亲入汉氏高、元、成、平之庙。 诸刘更属籍京兆大尹，勿解其复，各终厥身，州牧数存问，勿令有侵冤。
target_text: Wang Mang continued that when he was the regent, he built suburban sacrificial altar sites, established ancestral temples, and set up Tugu Shrine. The gods repaid him with brilliance from above covering the bottom, flowing down and turning into old crows, and yellow air rising and shining brightly to highlight the afterglow of Huangdi and Yushun. From the Yellow Emperor to King Bo of Jinan, there were five surnames of our ancestors. Huangdi had twenty-five sons and gave them twelve surnames. The surname accepted by the ancestors of Yu and Shun was Yao. In the Tao and Tang Dynasties, the surname was Yu, in the Zhou Dynasty, the surname was Chen, in Qi State, the surname was Tian, ​​and in Jinan, the surname was Wang. He prostrated himself in memory of the great emperor Kao Huangdi, and the great emperor Kao Yushun. They have been worshiped together in the Mingtang, and they should also be included in the ancestors' temples. Five ancestral temples and four ancestral temples should be built, and their queens or wives should all enjoy them. When offering sacrifices to heaven and earth, let the Yellow Emperor share with the sky, and let the Yellow Queen share with the earth. The east residence of Xin Duhou was used as the Ancestral Temple, and sacrifices were made on time every two years. The ancestors respected by the people should also be worshiped from generation to generation. The imperial court has set an example for the whole country. People with the five surnames of Yao, Ma, Chen, Tian, ​​and Wang are all descendants of Huangdi and Yushun, and they all belong to my clan. Didn’t the Book of Books say it? In order to promote love and harmony among the nine clans, all parts of the country should be ordered to report the names of these five surnames to the Zhizong clan and treat them as royal clans. Grant them immunity from taxation and labor for generations to come, and have nothing to do with it. Among them, the Wang surname in Yuancheng County is not allowed to marry each other with the surnames Yao, Yan, Chen, and Tian, ​​so as to distinguish clans and separate relatives. Chen Chong was granted the title of Tongmuhou to inherit the descendants of King Hu; Tian Feng was granted the title of Shimuhou to inherit the descendants of King Jing. Because of the rebellion of Zhai Yi, Tang Ming and others in the past, the state pastors and county governors across the country were able to occupy their states and counties. They were loyal and filial, and granted the governors the title of baron and the governor the title of annexed city. He also granted the title of baron to the sons of his old benefactors Dai Chong, Jin She, Ji Hong and Yang Bing. They sent Weixiao and others from Qidu to repair the Yellow Emperor's tomb in Shangdu Bridge, Yu Shun's tomb in Jiuyi, Lingling County, King Hu's tomb in Chen County, Huaiyang County, King Jing's tomb in Linzi County, Qi County, King Min's tomb in Ju County, Chengyang State, King Bo's tomb in Shupingling County, Jinan County, and King Ru's tomb in Yuancheng County, Wei County, and envoys were sent to offer sacrifices according to the seasons. Their ancestral temple should be built, because the country has just been pacified, and for the time being, joint sacrifices will be held in the Mingtang Ancestral Temple. Take Han Gaodi Temple as Wenzu Temple. Wang Mang said that his great emperor Kao Yushun accepted the ceded political power from Tang Yao. The early ancestor of the Han Dynasty was Tang Yao. He wanted to praise and treat the previous dynasty, how could he forget it? There were seven ancestors of the Han Dynasty, and ancestral temples should be built in Ding'an State according to etiquette. The temples attached to their cemeteries in the capital should not be abolished, and the sacrifices should continue as before. He would personally go to the ancestral temples of Emperor Gao, Emperor Yuan, Emperor Cheng, and Emperor Ping of the Han Dynasty to offer sacrifices in September in autumn. The names of the royal families surnamed Liu were transferred to the management of Jingzhao Dayin. Their privileges of exemption from taxes and labor should not be revoked. They should be limited to themselves. The state pastor should often go to condolences and prevent them from being wronged and persecuted.

input_text: 昔武王伐纣，迁九鼎于雒邑，伯夷、叔齐薄之，饿死于首阳，不食其禄，周犹称盛德焉。 然孔子贤此二人，以为 不降其志，不辱其身 也。 而《孟子》亦云： 闻伯夷之风者，贪夫廉，懦夫有立志 ； 奋乎百世之上，百世之下莫不兴起，非贤人而能若是乎！ 汉兴有园公、绮里季、夏黄公，甪里先生，此四人者，当秦之世，避而入商雒深山，以待天下之定也。 自高祖闻而召之，不至。 其后吕后用留侯计，使皇太子卑辞束帛致礼，安车迎而致之。 四人既至，从太子见，高祖客而敬焉，太子得以为重，遂用自安。 语在《留侯传》。 其后谷口有郑子真，蜀有严君平，皆修身自保，非其服弗服，非其食弗食。 成帝时，元舅大将军王凤以礼聘子真，子真遂不亻出而终。
target_text: King Wu of Zhou overthrew King Zhou of Shang, moving the Nine Tripods to Luoyi. Boyi and Shuqi, deeming King Wu unfaithful and unfilial, starved to death on Shouyang Mountain rather than eat Zhou grain, earning praise for their moral purity. Confucius lauded their unwavering resolve, and Mencius declared that hearing of Boyi’s conduct could reform the greedy and cowardly, inspiring generations. After the Han rose, four recluses—Yuan Gong, Qili Ji, Xia Huang Gong, and Mr. Jiaoli—fled to Shangluo Mountain during Qin rule. Emperor Gaozu summoned them in vain, but Empress Lu, following Zhang Liang’s strategy, had the crown prince humbly invite them with gifts. Their presence stabilized the prince’s position, as recorded in the *Biography of the Marquis of Liu*. Later, Zheng Zizhen of Gu Valley and Yan Junping of Shu cultivated self-respect, refusing improper attire or food. Zheng Zizhen declined recruitment by General Wang Feng. Yan Junping, a diviner in Chengdu, used his trade to guide people toward filial piety, obedience, and loyalty, earning a modest living before teaching Laozi. He authored over 100,000 words on Daoist philosophy. Yang Xiong, who studied under him, praised his conduct to officials, noting that Yan could be seen but not employed. Yan lived past ninety, revered by the people of Shu. Yang Xiong later wrote that a gentleman’s virtue establishes his reputation, contrasting the wealth of princes with the enduring fame of recluses like Zheng Zizhen and Yan Junping, whom he deemed national treasures.

input_text: 王贺虽不遵道，然犹知敬礼吉，乃下令曰： 寡人造行不能无惰，中尉甚忠，数辅吾过。 使谒者千秋赐中尉牛肉五百斤，酒五石，脯五束。 其后复放从自若。 吉辄谏争，甚得辅弼之义，虽不治民，国中莫不敬重焉。 久之，昭帝崩，亡嗣，大将军霍光秉政，遣大鸿胪、宗正迎昌邑王。 吉即奏书戒王曰： 臣闻高宗谅暗，三年不言。 今大王以丧事征，宜日夜哭泣悲哀而已，慎毋有所发。 且何独丧事，凡南面之君何言哉？ 天不言，四时行焉，百物生焉，愿大王察之。 大将军仁爱勇智，忠信之德天下莫不闻，事孝武皇帝二十余年未尝有过。 先帝弃群臣，属以天下，寄幼孤焉，大将军抱持幼君襁褓之中，布政施教，海内晏然，虽周公、伊尹亡以加也。 今帝崩，亡嗣，大将军惟思可以奉宗庙者，攀援而立大王，其仁厚岂有量哉！ 臣愿大王事之敬之，政事一听之，大王垂拱南面而已。 愿留意，常以为念。 王既到，即位二十余日以行淫乱废。 昌邑群臣坐在国时不举奏王罪过，令汉朝不闻知，又不能辅道，陷王大恶，皆下狱诛。 唯吉与郎中令龚遂以忠直数谏正得减死，髡为城旦。 起家复为益州刺史，病去官，复征为博士、谏大夫。 是时，宣帝颇修武帝故事，宫室车服盛于昭帝。 时外戚许、史、王氏贵宠，而上躬亲政事，任用能吏。 吉上疏言得失，曰：
target_text: Wang Ji (Ziyang) of Langxie excelled in classics, serving as a county official and later as lieutenant of Changyi. He admonished King Changyi for excessive hunting, citing ancient customs and the *Book of Songs* to urge moderation, warning that reckless travel harmed health and governance. He advocated study, ritual, and self-cultivation over indulgence. The king, though flawed, rewarded Wang Ji for his loyalty but continued his ways. After Emperor Zhao’s death, General Huo Guang summoned King Changyi to the capital. Wang Ji advised the king to mourn silently and defer to Huo Guang, comparing him to Zhou Gong and Yi Yin. The king was deposed after 20 days for lewdness; most of his officials were executed, but Wang Ji and Gong Sui were spared due to their admonitions, though sentenced to shave their heads and build cities. Wang Ji later served as governor of Yizhou and a court doctor. Under Emperor Xuan, he criticized the court’s focus on trivial matters over foundational governance, urging ritual education, selection of virtuous aides, and rejection of hereditary offices. He proposed reducing extravagance, abolishing coinage, and promoting agriculture. The emperor deemed his ideas impractical, so Wang Ji resigned, returning to Langxie. His reputation for integrity was marred by a minor incident: he divorced his wife for picking dates from a neighbor’s tree, though neighbors persuaded him to take her back. Wang Ji taught the Five Classics and died en route to a summons from Emperor Yuan. His son Wang Jun, also virtuous, served as an admonisher and governor, known for his capability alongside Zhao Guanghan and Zhang Chang. Wang Jun, after his wife’s death, refused remarriage, citing lack of virtue. His son Wang Chong became a censor but was demoted for pleading for a relative; later, under Wang Mang, he became Grand Sikong and Marquis of Fuping, but died by poisoning. The Wang family maintained honesty across generations, though their love for fine carriages and clothes puzzled contemporaries, leading to the saying “Wang Yang could turn gold.”

input_text: 天子下其议，令民产子七岁乃出口钱，自此始。 又罢上林宫馆希幸御者，及省建章、甘泉宫卫卒，减诸侯王庙卫卒，省其半。 余虽未尽从，然嘉其质直之意。 禹又奏欲罢郡国庙，定汉宗庙迭毁之礼，皆未施行。 为御史大夫数月卒，天子赐钱百万，以其子为郎，官至东郡都尉。 禹卒后，上追思其议，竟下诏罢郡国庙，定迭毁之礼。 然通儒或非之，语在《韦玄成传》。 两龚皆楚人也，胜字君宾，舍字君倩。 二人相友，并著名节，故世谓之楚两龚。 少皆好学明经，胜为郡吏，舍不仕。 久之，楚王入朝，闻舍高名，聘舍为常侍，不得已随王，归国固辞，愿卒学，复至长安。 而胜为郡吏，三举孝廉，以王国人不得宿卫补吏，再为尉，一为丞，胜辄至官乃去。 州举茂才，为重泉令，病去官。 大司空何武、执金吾阎崇荐胜，哀帝自为定陶王固已闻其名，征为谏大夫。 引见，胜荐龚舍及亢父甯寿、济阴侯嘉，有诏皆征。 胜曰： 窃见国家征医巫，常为驾，征贤者宜驾。
target_text: Gong Yu (Shaoweng) of Langxie, known for his classic learning, served as a doctor and governor of Liangzhou before resigning. Recruited by Emperor Yuan, he advised frugality, citing ancient standards: few concubines, simple palaces, and light taxes. He criticized the extravagance of Emperor Wu’s era, noting that officials and nobles overstepped ranks, leading to waste and poverty. He urged reducing palace horses, craftsmen, and concubines, and returning gardens to the poor. Emperor Yuan adopted some suggestions, cutting horse feed and distributing land. Gong Yu later became a censor, submitting dozens of memorials. He argued that taxes on three-year-olds caused infanticide, proposing taxes start at age seven. He condemned coinage for diverting labor from farming, causing hunger, and advocated returning to barter. He also criticized atonement laws for encouraging corruption, urging strict punishment for dishonest officials. Emperor Yuan implemented the seven-year tax rule and reduced palace guards, though other reforms stalled. Gong Yu died shortly after becoming censor; the emperor granted his son a post. His proposals on temple abolition were later enacted but criticized by scholars.

input_text: 骏以孝廉为郎。 左曹陈咸荐骏贤父子，经明行修，宜显以厉俗。 光禄勋匡衡亦举骏有专对材。 迁谏大夫，使责淮阳宪王。 迁赵内史。 吉坐昌邑王被刑后，戒子孙毋为王国吏，故骏道病，免官归。 起家复为幽州刺史，迁司隶校尉，奏免丞相匡衡，迁少府，八岁，成帝欲大用之，出骏为京兆尹，试以政事。 先是，京兆有赵广汉、张敞、王尊、王章，至骏皆有能名，故京师称曰： 前有赵、张，后有三王。 而薛宣从左冯翊代骏为少府，会御史大夫缺，谷永奏言： 圣王不以名誉加于实效。 考绩用人之法，薛宣政事已试。 上然其议。宣为少府月余，遂超御史大夫，至丞相，骏乃代宣为御史大夫，并居位。 六岁病卒，翟方进代骏为大夫。 数月，薛宣免，遂代为丞相。 众人为骏恨不得封侯。 骏为少府时，妻死，因不复娶，或问之，骏曰： 德非曾参，子非华、元，亦何敢娶？ 骏子崇以父任为郎，历刺史、郡守，治有能名。 建平三年，以河南太守征入为御史大夫数月。 是时，成帝舅安成恭侯夫人放寡居，共养长信宫，坐祝诅下狱，崇奏封事，为放言。 放外家解氏与崇为婚，哀帝以崇为不忠诚，策诏崇曰： 朕以君有累世之美，故逾列次。
target_text: Gong Sheng (Junbin) and Gong She (Junqian) of Chu, known for integrity, were called the “Two Gongs.” Gong Sheng served as an admonisher under Emperor Ai, criticizing poverty, crime, and official corruption. He accused Dong Xian of disrupting court order, leading to conflict with colleagues. After a dispute with Xiahou Chang over ritual, he was demoted and resigned. Recruited again, he refused to serve under Wang Mang, who sent envoys with lavish gifts. Gong Sheng, bedridden, refused the seal, saying he could not serve two dynasties. He starved himself to death at 79, instructing simple burial. Gong She, also a classicist, served briefly as governor of Taishan but resigned due to illness. He died at 68 during Wang Mang’s regency. Bao Xuan (Zidu) of Bohai, a diligent scholar, served as an admonisher under Emperor Ai. He wrote vehemently against the favoritism shown to Dong Xian and the Fu and Ding clans, warning that corruption, heavy taxes, and harsh laws caused seven reasons for displacement and seven causes of death. He urged the recall of virtuous officials like He Wu and Kong Guang. Emperor Ai initially tolerated him, but after Bao Xuan humiliated a prime minister’s subordinate, he was imprisoned. Over a thousand students protested, leading to his sentence being reduced to shaving and iron chains. He later moved to Shangdang, where Wang Mang had him executed for associating with a wanted man. Other figures like Xin Xing, Ji Kui, and Xue Fang displayed varying degrees of integrity, with some refusing Wang Mang’s summons. The historian concludes that while hermits and officials each have merits, true virtue lies in unwavering adherence to the good path, as exemplified by Gong Sheng and Xue Fang.

input_text: 盖宽饶字次公，魏郡人也。 明经为郡文学，以孝廉为郎。 举方正，对策高第，迁谏大夫，行郎中户将事。 劾奏卫将军张安世子侍中阳都侯彭祖不下殿门，并连及安世居位无补。 彭祖时实下门，宽饶坐举奏大臣非是，左迁为卫司马。 先是时，卫司马在部，见卫尉拜谒，常为卫官繇使市买。 宽饶视事，案旧令，遂揖官属以下行卫者。 卫尉私使宽饶出，宽饶以令诣官府门上谒辞。 尚书责问卫尉，由是卫官不复私使候、司马。 候、司马不拜，出先置卫，辄上奏辞，自此正焉。 宽饶初拜为司马，未出殿门，断其禅衣，令短离地，冠大冠，带长剑，躬案行士卒庐室，视其饮食居处，有疾病者身自抚循临问，加致医药，遇之甚有恩。 及岁尽交代，上临飨罢卫卒，卫卒数千人皆叩头自请，愿复留共更一年，以报宽饶厚德。 宣帝嘉之，以宽饶为太中大夫，使行风俗，多所称举贬黜，奉使称意。 擢为司隶校尉，刺举无所回避，小大辄举，所劾奏众多，廷尉处其法，半用半不用，公卿贵戚及郡国吏繇使至长安，皆恐惧莫敢犯禁，京师为清。 平恩侯许伯入第，丞相、御史、将军、中二千石皆贺，宽饶不行。 许伯请之，乃往，从西阶上，东乡特坐。 许伯自酌曰： 盖君后至。
target_text: Gai Kuanrao, from Weijun, rose through the ranks due to his classical knowledge and filial piety. As an imperial censor, he impeached Pengzu, son of General Zhang Anshi, for refusing to dismount at the palace gate. However, since Pengzu had actually dismounted, Kuanrao was demoted for misrepresentation. As Sima of the Guards, he reformed protocols, personally cared for soldiers' welfare, and earned such loyalty that retiring soldiers requested to serve another year. Emperor Xuan promoted him to Sili Xiaowei, where he fearlessly investigated officials, creating peace in the capital. At a celebration for Xu Bo's new residence, Kuanrao sat apart and warned about the impermanence of wealth. He later impeached a performer for disrespectful dancing. Despite his integrity and poverty—using half his salary to pay informants—his harshness and tendency to frame others created enemies. Wang Sheng advised him to be more cautious, but Kuanrao ignored this counsel. He submitted a memorial criticizing the emperor's reliance on eunuchs and suggesting that rulers should yield to the worthy. The emperor deemed this treasonous. Despite Zheng Chang's defense, Kuanrao was imprisoned and committed suicide.

input_text: 上不许。 是后，所言益不用，丰复上书言： 臣闻伯奇孝而弃于亲，子胥忠而诛于君，隐公慈而杀于弟，叔武弟而杀于兄。 夫以四子之行，屈平之材，然犹不能自显而被刑戮，岂不足以观哉！ 使臣杀身以安国，蒙诛以显君，臣诚愿之。 独恐未有云补，而为众邪所排，令谗夫得遂，正直之路雍塞，忠臣沮心，智士杜口，此愚臣之所惧也。 丰以春夏系治人，在位多言其短。 上徙丰为城门校尉，丰上书告光禄勋周堪、光禄大夫张猛。 上不直丰，乃制诏御史： 城门校尉丰，前与光禄勋堪、光禄大夫猛在朝之时，数称言堪、猛之美。 丰前为司隶校尉，不顺四时，修法度，专作苛暴，以获虚威，朕不忍下吏，以为城门校尉。 不内省诸己。而反怨堪、猛，以求报举，告案无证之辞，暴扬难验之罪，毁誉恣意，不顾前言，不信之大者也。 朕怜丰之耆老，不忍加刑，其免为庶人。 终于家。
target_text: Zhuge Feng, from Langxie, became Sili Xiaowei under Emperor Yuan. He attempted to arrest the favored relative Xu Zhang but was thwarted when Xu fled to the palace. The emperor confiscated Zhuge's talisman, ending the Sili's traditional authority. Zhuge apologized in a memorial but continued criticizing corrupt officials. He was transferred to city gate captain after arresting prisoners in spring and summer. When he accused former colleagues, the emperor removed him from office for untrustworthiness, and he died at home.

input_text: 里语曰： 腐木不可以为柱，卑人不可以为主。 天人之所不予，必有祸而无福，市道皆共知之，朝廷莫肯一言，臣窃伤心。 自念得以同姓拔擢，尸禄不忠，污辱谏争之官，不敢不尽死，唯陛下深察。 书奏，上使侍御史收缚辅，系掖庭秘狱，群臣莫知其故。 于是中朝左将军辛庆忌、右将军廉褒、光禄勋师丹、太中大夫谷永俱上书曰： 臣闻明王垂宽容之听，崇谏争之官，广开忠直之路，不罪狂狷之言，然后百僚在位，竭忠尽谋，不惧后患，朝廷无谄谀之士，元首无失道之愆。 窃见谏大夫刘辅，前以县令求见，擢为谏大夫，此其言必有卓诡切至，当圣心者，故得拔至于此。 旬日之间，收下秘狱，臣等愚，以为辅幸得托公族之亲，在谏臣之列，新从下土来，未知朝廷体，独触忌讳，不足深过。 小罪宜隐忍而已，如有大恶，宜暴治理官，与众共之。 昔赵简子杀其大夫鸣犊，孔子临河而还。 今天心未豫，灾异屡降，水旱迭臻，方当隆宽广问，褒直尽下之时也。 而行惨急之诛于谏争之臣，震惊群下，失忠直心。 假令辅不坐直言，所坐不著，天下不可户晓。 同姓近臣本以言显，其于治亲养忠之义诚不宜幽囚于掖庭狱。 公卿以下见陛下进用辅亟，而折伤之暴，人有惧心，精锐销耎，莫敢尽节正言，非所以昭有虞之听，广德美之风也。 臣等窃深伤之，唯陛下留神省察。
target_text: Liu Fu, a royal family member, became an admonishing doctor under Emperor Cheng. He opposed making Tang Jiandan queen, arguing it defied divine will. The emperor imprisoned him in a secret prison. Several high officials petitioned for his release, arguing that punishing remonstrators chilled loyal hearts. The emperor reduced his sentence to hard labor.

input_text: 上乃徙系辅共工狱，减死罪一等，论为鬼薪。 终于家。 郑崇字子游，本高密大族，世与王家相嫁娶。 祖父以訾徙平陵。 父宾明法令，为御史，事贡公，名公直。 崇少为郡文学史，至丞相大车属。 弟立与高武侯傅喜同门学，相友善。 喜为大司马，荐崇，哀帝擢为尚书仆射。 数求见谏争，上初纳用之。 每见曳革履，上笑曰： 我识郑尚书履声。 久之，上欲封祖母傅太后从弟商，崇谏曰： 孝成皇帝封亲舅五侯，天为赤黄昼昏，日中有黑气。 今祖母从昆弟二人已侯。 孔乡侯，皇后父；高武侯以三公封，尚有因缘。
target_text: Zheng Chong served under Emperor Ai, known for his distinctive leather shoes. He opposed ennobling Fu Shang, the emperor's grandmother's cousin, citing precedents where such actions caused celestial disturbances. Despite the Empress Dowager's anger, Zheng persisted. He also criticized Dong Xian's excessive favor. After being alienated, he was accused of colluding with the royal family and died in prison.

input_text: 即度稚季而谴它事，众口讠雚哗，终身自堕。 宝曰： 受教。 稚季耳目长，闻知之，杜门不通水火，穿舍后墙为小户，但持锄自治园，因文所厚自陈如此。 文曰： 我与稚季幸同土壤，素无睚，顾受将命，分当相直。 诚能自改，严将不治前事，即不更心，但更门户，适趣祸耳。 稚季遂不敢犯法，宝亦竟岁无所谴。 明年，稚季病死。 宝为京兆尹三岁，京师称之。 会淳于长败，宝与萧育等皆坐免官。 文复去吏，死于家。 稚季子杜苍，字君敖，名出稚季右，在游侠中。 哀帝即位，征宝为谏大夫，迁司隶。 初，傅太后与中山孝王母冯太后俱事元帝，有隙，傅太后使有司考冯太后，令自杀，众庶冤之。
target_text: Sun Bao served as Yizhou governor, quelling rebellions by offering amnesty to non-leaders. He exposed corruption involving the emperor's uncle Wang Li. As Jing Zhaoyin, he was pressured to protect the knight Du Zhiji but managed to avoid confrontation. He was dismissed when Chunyu Chang fell from power. Recalled under Emperor Ai, he investigated Empress Dowager Feng's death, angering Empress Dowager Fu, who had him imprisoned. Released after appeals, he later defended Zheng Chong but was dismissed. Under Emperor Ping, he opposed praising Wang Mang's virtues, was dismissed again, and lived in retirement.

input_text: 大司马车骑将军王音内领尚书，外典兵马，踵故选置从事中郎与参谋议，奏请隆为从事中郎，迁谏大夫。 成帝末，隆奏封事言： 古老选诸侯入为公卿，以褒功德，宜征定陶王使在国邸，以填万方。 其后上竟立定陶王为太子，隆迁翼州牧、颍川太守。 哀帝即位，以高第入为京兆尹，迁执金吾。 时，侍中董贤方贵，上使中黄门发武库兵，前后十辈，送董贤及上乳母王阿舍。 隆奏曰： 武库兵器，天下公用，国家武备，缮治造作，皆度大司农钱。 大司农钱自乘舆不以给共养，共养劳赐，一出少府。 盖不以本臧给末用，不以民力共浮费，别公私，示正路也。 古者诸侯方伯得颛征伐，乃赐斧钺，汉家边吏，职在距寇，亦赐武库兵，皆任其事然后蒙之。
target_text: Wu Jianglong advised Emperor Cheng to recruit the Prince of Dingtao as heir. Under Emperor Ai, he criticized giving weapons from the imperial arsenal to Dong Xian and the emperor's wet nurse. After Empress Dowager Fu's maid purchase dispute, he was demoted. Wang Mang later exiled him for his role in Empress Dowager Feng's case.

input_text: 以隆前有安国之言，左迁为沛郡都尉，迁南郡太守。 王莽少时，慕与隆交，隆不甚附。 哀帝崩，莽秉政，使大司徒孔光奏隆前为冀州牧治中山冯太后狱冤陷无辜，不宜处位在中土。 本中谒者令史立、侍御史丁玄自典考之，但与隆连名奏事。 史立时为中太仆，丁玄奏山太守，及尚书令赵昌谮郑崇者为河内太守，皆免官，徙合浦。 何并字子廉，祖父以吏二千石自平舆徙平陵。 并为郡吏，至大司空掾，事何武。 武高其志节，举能治剧，为长陵令，道不拾遗。 初，邛成太后外家王氏贵，而侍中王林卿通轻侠，倾京师。
target_text: He Bing, as Changling magistrate, killed the fugitive Wang Linqing, who had murdered a servant. Though Empress Dowager Qiong Cheng grieved, Emperor Ai promoted He Bing. As Yingchuan prefect, he arrested criminals Zhao Ji and Li Kuan, and drove out Zhong Wei, whose brother was a powerful official. He Bing governed with integrity, his family not living in the government office. On his deathbed, he requested a simple burial.

input_text: 恢如父言。 王莽擢恢为关都尉。 建武中以并孙为郎。 赞曰：盖宽饶为司臣，正色立于朝，虽《诗》所谓 国之司直 无以加也。 若采王生之言以终其身，斯近古之贤臣矣。 诸葛、刘、郑虽云狂瞽，有异志焉。 孔子曰： 吾未见刚者。 以数子之名迹，然毌将污于冀州，孙宝桡于定陵，况俗人乎！ 何并之节，亚尹翁归云。
target_text: The commentary praises Gai Kuanrao's integrity but notes he should have heeded Wang Sheng's advice. Zhuge, Liu, and Zheng had unique ambitions. Even these upright officials had flaws, showing how difficult true integrity is. He Bing's character rivaled Yin Wenggui's.

input_text: 眭弘字孟，鲁国蕃人也。 少时好侠，斗鸡走马，长乃变节，从嬴公受《春秋》。 以明经为议郎，至符节令。 孝昭元凤三年正月，泰山、莱芜山南匈匈有数千人声，民视之，有大石自立，高丈五尺，大四十八围，入地深八尺，三石为足。 石立后有白乌数千下集其旁。 是时，昌邑有枯社木卧复生，又上林苑中大柳树断枯卧地，亦自立生，有虫食树叶成文字，曰 公孙病已立 ，孟推《春秋》之意，以为 石、柳，皆阴类，下民之象；泰山者，岱宗之岳，王者易姓告代之外。 今大石自立，僵柳复起，非人力所为，此当有从匹夫为天子者。 枯社木复生，故废之家公孙氏当复兴者也。
target_text: Suihong, courtesy name Meng, was from the state of Lu. Initially fond of cockfighting and horse racing, he later transformed his character and studied the "Spring and Autumn" with Ying Gong. Through his mastery of Confucian classics, he became a Yilang and reached the position of Fuli Jieliang.

input_text: 眭弘字孟，鲁国蕃人也。 少时好侠，斗鸡走马，长乃变节，从嬴公受《春秋》。 以明经为议郎，至符节令。 孝昭元凤三年正月，泰山、莱芜山南匈匈有数千人声，民视之，有大石自立，高丈五尺，大四十八围，入地深八尺，三石为足。 石立后有白乌数千下集其旁。 是时，昌邑有枯社木卧复生，又上林苑中大柳树断枯卧地，亦自立生，有虫食树叶成文字，曰 公孙病已立 ，孟推《春秋》之意，以为 石、柳，皆阴类，下民之象；泰山者，岱宗之岳，王者易姓告代之外。 今大石自立，僵柳复起，非人力所为，此当有从匹夫为天子者。 枯社木复生，故废之家公孙氏当复兴者也。
target_text: In the first month of the third year of Emperor Zhao's Yuanfeng reign, a great roar was heard south of Laiwu Mountain in Mount Tai. A large stone stood up by itself, measuring one to five feet high, as thick as forty-eight arm spans, and eight feet deep into the ground, with three other stones serving as its feet. Thousands of white crows gathered around it. Simultaneously, dead trees in the Changyi Shrine revived, and a broken willow in Shanglin Garden stood up and regained life, with insects eating its leaves into shapes resembling the words "Gongsun Bing has been established." Suihong interpreted these events through the "Spring and Autumn," concluding that stones and willows symbolized common people, while Mount Tai represented the site of imperial ceremonies. He argued that these phenomena indicated commoners would become emperors and the deposed Gongsun clan would revive. He advocated for the Han emperor to abdicate in favor of a worthy successor. His friend, an internal official, submitted this memorial. Since Emperor Zhao was young and General Huo Guang governed, Huo Guang was angered and had Suihong and his friend executed for treason. Five years later, when Emperor Xiaoxuan rose from the people to the throne, he recruited Suihong's son as a Lang.

input_text: 孟意亦不知其所在，即说曰： 先师董仲舒有言，虽有继体守文之君，不害圣人之受命。 汉家尧后，有传国之运。 汉帝宜谁差天下，求索贤人，禅以帝位，而退自封百里，如殷、周二王后，以承顺天命。 孟使友人内官长赐上此书。 时，昭帝幼，大将军霍光秉政，恶之，下其书廷尉。 奏赐、孟妄设袄言惑众，大逆不道，皆伏诛。 后五年，孝宣帝兴于民间，即位，征孟子为郎。 夏侯始昌，鲁人也。 通《五经》，以《齐诗》、《尚书》教授。 自董仲舒、韩婴死后，武帝得始昌，甚重之。 始昌明于阴阳，先言柏梁台灾曰，至期日果灾。 时，昌邑王以少子爱，上为选师，始昌为太傅。 年老，以寿终。 族子胜亦以儒显名。 夏侯胜字长公。 初，鲁共王分鲁西宁乡以封子节侯，别属大河，大河后更名东平，故胜为东平人。
target_text: Xiahou Shichang, from Lu, was proficient in the Five Classics and taught Qi Shi and Shangshu. After Dong Zhongshu and Han Ying died, Emperor Wu valued him greatly. Shichang understood yin and yang, once predicting the exact date of a fire at Bailiang Terrace. He served as tutor to King Changyi and died of old age. His nephew Xiahou Sheng, courtesy name Changgong, was also a renowned Confucian scholar. Xiahou Sheng lost his father young but studied diligently, learning "Shang Shu" and "Hong Fan's Five Elements" from Shichang, and later studied under Jian Qing and Ouyang. He was sophisticated and learned from multiple teachers.

input_text: 胜少孤，好学，从始昌受《尚书》及《洪范五行传》，说灾异。 后事蕳卿，又从欧阳氏问。 为学精孰，所问非一师也。 善说礼服。 征为博士、光禄大夫。 会昭帝崩，昌邑王嗣立，数出。 胜当乘舆前谏曰： 天久阴而不雨，臣下有谋上者，陛下出欲何之？ 王怒，谓胜为袄言，缚以属吏。 吏白大将军霍光，光不举法。 是时，光与车骑将军张安世谋欲废昌邑王。 光让安世以为泄语，安世实不言。 乃召问胜，胜对言： 在《洪范传》曰 皇之不极，厥罚常阴，时则下人有伐上者 ，恶察察言，故云臣下有谋。 光、安世大惊，以此益重经术士。
target_text: When King Changyi succeeded Emperor Zhao, he frequently traveled. Xiahou Sheng once blocked the king's carriage to remonstrate, warning that prolonged overcast weather without rain indicated ministers plotting against the emperor. The king was furious and had him bound, but Huo Guang did not punish him. When Huo Guang and Zhang Anshi were discussing deposing the king, Xiahou Sheng explained his prediction came from the "Hong Fan" biography, which stated that when an emperor rules improperly, subordinates will rebel. Huo Guang and Anshi were impressed and valued Confucian scholars more thereafter. They eventually petitioned the Queen Mother to depose King Changyi and establish Emperor Xuan. Xiahou Sheng was appointed Shaofu of Changxin and given the title of Marquis of Guannei.

input_text: 见时谓上为君，误相字于前，上亦以是亲信之。 尝见，出道上语，上闻而让胜，胜曰： 陛下所言善，臣故扬之。 尧言布于天下，至今见诵。 臣以为可传，故传耳。 朝廷每有大议，上知胜素直，谓曰： 先生通正言，无惩前事。 胜复为长信少府，迁太子太傅。 受诏撰《尚书》、《论语说》，赐黄金百斤。 年九十卒官，赐冢茔，葬平陵。 太后赐钱二百万，为胜素服五日，以报师傅之恩，儒者以为荣。 始，胜每讲授，常谓诸生曰： 士病不明经术，经术苟明，其取青紫如俯拾地芥耳。 学经不明，不如归耕。
target_text: When Emperor Xuan wanted to honor Emperor Wu's achievements, Xiahou Sheng opposed, arguing that although Emperor Wu defeated barbarians and expanded territory, he killed many ministers, exhausted resources, and caused widespread suffering and cannibalism. The ministers impeached Xiahou Sheng for slandering the late emperor, and he was imprisoned. After an earthquake killed over six thousand people, Emperor Xuan issued a general amnesty, and Xiahou Sheng was pardoned and served as an admonition official. He was known for his forthrightness, addressing the emperor as "king" and calling colleagues by name in court. Emperor Xuan trusted him for this honesty. Xiahou Sheng died in office at ninety, and the Queen Mother mourned him for five days.

input_text: 房曰： 中书令石显、尚书令五鹿君相与合同，巧佞之人也，事县官十余年；及丞相韦侯，皆久亡补于民，可谓亡功矣。 此尤不欲行考功者也。 淮阳王即朝见，劝上行考功，事善；不然，但言丞相、中书令任事久而不治，可休丞相，以御史大夫郑弘代之，迁中书令置他官，以钩盾令徐立代之，如此，房考功事得施行矣。 博具从房记诸所说灾异事，因令房为淮阳王作求朝奏草，皆持柬与淮阳王。 石显微司具知之，以房亲近，未敢言。 及房出守郡，显告房与张博通谋，非谤政治，归恶天子，诖误诸侯王，语在《宪王传》。 初，房见道幽、厉事，出为御史大夫郑弘言之。 房、博皆弃市，弘坐免为庶人。 房本姓李，推律自定为京氏，死时年四十一。 翼奉字少君，东海下邳人也。 治《齐诗》，与萧望之、匡衡同师。 三人经术皆明，衡为后进，望之施之政事，而奉惇学不仕，好律历阴阳之占。 元帝初即位，诸儒荐之，征待诏宦者署，数言事宴见，天子敬焉。 时，平昌侯王临以宣帝外属侍中，称诏欲从奉学其术。 奉不肯与言，而上封事曰： 臣闻之于师，治道要务，在知下之邪正。
target_text: Jingfang, courtesy name Junming, studied "The Book of Changes" under Jiao Yanshou. Jiao Gan, his teacher, was known for predicting evil events and governing Xiaohuang County well. Jingfang was particularly skilled in connecting hexagrams with daily events and using meteorological changes as symptoms. During Emperor Yuan's reign, he predicted events accurately and was frequently consulted. He warned about disasters and criticized the appointment of flattering officials like Shi Xian. Jingfang recommended implementing a system to inspect officials' performance, but faced opposition from powerful ministers. He was eventually appointed prefect of Wei County but feared being isolated from the emperor. After sending several sealed memorials warning about yin energy overwhelming yang and predicting disasters, he was imprisoned and executed at age forty-one.

target_text: Yi Feng, courtesy name Shaojun, studied "Qi Shi" and was diligent in learning, preferring calendar and yin-yang divination to officialdom. Emperor Yuan respected him greatly. Yi Feng wrote extensively about using the twelve laws to understand human emotions and predict disasters. He warned about the dangers of powerful relatives and advocated for frugality, criticizing excessive palace construction. He proposed moving the capital to Chengzhou to reform institutions and reduce expenses. Although Emperor Yuan found his views unusual, Yi Feng became a doctor and admonishing official, dying in old age.
